-- ============================================= -- Author:		HaiDv -- Create date: 18/03/2014 -- Description:	Báo cáo cảnh báo số giờ làm thêm quá hạn trong 1 tháng và 1 năm của nhân viên. -- Khai báo hai biến: H_HourPerYear, H_HourPerMonth trong tham số hệ thống -- ============================================= CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[ufn_Hrm_WarningOverdue] ( 	@_DocDate1		DateType	= NULL, 	@_EmployeeCode	NVARCHAR(16)	= '', 	@_Norm_OT		NUMERIC(18,2)	= 0, 	@_Weekends_OT	NUMERIC(18,2)	= 0, 	@_Holiday_OT	NUMERIC(18,2)	= 0, 	@_Id			INT				= 0 ) RETURNS INT AS BEGIN 	 	-- Lấy tham số hệ thống 	DECLARE @_HourPerMonth INT,	@_ResultMonth NUMERIC(18,2), 			@_HourPerYear INT,	@_ResultYear NUMERIC(18,2) 	SET @_HourPerMonth = (SELECT VarValue FROM B00Config WHERE VarKey = N'H_HourPerMonth') 	SET @_HourPerYear = (SELECT VarValue FROM B00Config WHERE VarKey = N'H_HourPerYear') 	 	--RETURN 0; 	-- Khai báo ngày 	DECLARE @_FirstDayOfYear SMALLDATETIME, @_FirstDayOfMonth SMALLDATETIME, @_LastDayOfMonth SMALLDATETIME     SET @_FirstDayOfYear = CONVERT(SMALLDATETIME,'01/01/' + STR(YEAR(@_DocDate1),LEN(STR(YEAR(@_DocDate1)))),103)     SET @_FirstDayOfMonth = CONVERT(SMALLDATETIME,'01/' + STR(MONTH(@_DocDate1),LEN(STR(MONTH(@_DocDate1)))) + '/'  													+ STR(YEAR(@_DocDate1),LEN(STR(YEAR(@_DocDate1)))),103) 	SET @_LastDayOfMonth = DATEADD(MM,1,@_FirstDayOfMonth)-1 	 	-- Lấy số giờ làm thêm một tháng											         ;WITH OverMonth (EmployeeCode, Months) AS     ( 		SELECT InOut.EmployeeCode, SUM(InOut.Normal_OT + InOut.Weekends_OT + InOut.Holiday_OT) Months 			FROM vB30HrmInOut InOut  			WHERE InOut.Date BETWEEN @_FirstDayOfMonth AND @_DocDate1 					AND InOut.EmployeeCode = @_EmployeeCode 					AND @_Id <> InOut.Id 					AND InOut.IsActive = 1 			GROUP BY InOut.EmployeeCode     )      SELECT TOP 1 @_ResultMonth = ISNULL(Months,0)  		FROM OverMonth 		WHERE EmployeeCode = @_EmployeeCode 	SET @_ResultMonth = ISNULL(@_ResultMonth,0) 	 		-- Lấy số giờ làm thêm một năm											         ;WITH OverYear (EmployeeCode, Years) AS     ( 		SELECT InOut.EmployeeCode, SUM(InOut.Normal_OT + InOut.Weekends_OT + InOut.Holiday_OT) Years 			FROM vB30HrmInOut InOut  			WHERE InOut.Date BETWEEN @_FirstDayOfYear AND @_DocDate1 					AND InOut.EmployeeCode = @_EmployeeCode 					AND @_Id <> InOut.Id 					AND InOut.IsActive = 1 			GROUP BY InOut.EmployeeCode     )      SELECT TOP 1 @_ResultYear = ISNULL(Years,0)  		FROM OverYear 		WHERE EmployeeCode = @_EmployeeCode 	SET @_ResultYear = ISNULL(@_ResultYear,0) 	 	IF (@_ResultMonth + @_Norm_OT + @_Weekends_OT + @_Holiday_OT) > @_HourPerMonth 		RETURN 1; 		 	IF (@_ResultYear + @_Norm_OT + @_Weekends_OT + @_Holiday_OT) > @_HourPerYear 		RETURN 1; 		 	RETURN 0; 	  END

-- ============================================= -- Author:		<HaiDv> -- Create date: <10/04/2014> -- Description:	<Cảnh báo nghỉ phép vượt quá thời gian phép. Thời gian nghỉ phép lấy từ báo cáo ngày nghỉ phép> -- ============================================= CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[ufn_Hrm_WarningVacation] ( 	@_DocDate		DateType		= NULL, 	@_RowId_TST		NVARCHAR(24)	= '', 	@_EmployeeCode	NVARCHAR(16)	= '', 	@_WorkDay		NUMERIC(18,2)	= 0, 	@_Id			INT				= 0 ) RETURNS INT AS BEGIN 	IF (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.vB20HRMTimesheetType  				WHERE VAC_Code = (SELECT TOP 1 VarValue FROM B00Config b WHERE VarKey = 'H_Vacation')  					AND RowId = @_RowId_TST) = 0 		RETURN 0; 		 	DECLARE @_FirstDayOfYear SMALLDATETIME, @_Quantity NUMERIC(18,2), @_QMax NUMERIC(18,2), @_BranchCode NVARCHAR(3) 	SET @_FirstDayOfYear =  CAST(CAST(YEAR(@_DocDate) AS NCHAR(4)) + '0101' AS SMALLDATETIME) 	SET @_BranchCode = (SELECT TOP 1 BranchCode FROM B20Employee WHERE Code = @_EmployeeCode) 	 	SET @_Quantity = (SELECT TOP 1 SUM(WorkDay)  		FROM vB30HrmTimesheet  		WHERE EmployeeCode = @_EmployeeCode  			AND Date BETWEEN @_FirstDayOfYear AND @_DocDate  			AND VAC_Code = (SELECT TOP 1 VarValue FROM B00Config b WHERE VarKey = 'H_Vacation')  			AND iD <> @_Id 			AND IsActive = 1 		GROUP BY EmployeeCode) 	 	SET @_QMax = (SELECT TOP 1 Quantity FROM dbo.ufn_Hrm_WarningVacation_Tb(@_DocDate,@_EmployeeCode,1,0,@_BranchCode)) 	 	IF ISNULL(@_Quantity,0) + ISNULL(@_WorkDay,0) > ISNULL(@_QMax,0) 		RETURN 1; 	RETURN 0; 	  END

-- Hàm lấy bộ phận cuối cùng của nhân viên CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[ufn_HrmEmployee_GetLastDept] ( 	@_DocDate AS SmallDatetime, 	@_EmployeeCode dbo.CodeType, 	@_BranchCode NCHAR(3) ) RETURNS dbo.CodeType AS BEGIN 	DECLARE @_DeptCodeTmp dbo.CodeType 	 	SET @_DeptCodeTmp =  	ISNULL((SELECT ISNULL(app.DeptCode,empl.DeptCode) 		FROM B20Employee empl 		OUTER APPLY 		( 			SELECT TOP 1 app.DeptCode 			FROM dbo.B30HRMAppointed app  			WHERE (app.EffectiveDate <= @_DocDate AND (app.ExpireDate IS NULL OR app.ExpireDate > @_DocDate))  				AND app.EmployeeCode = empl.Code AND app.DeptCode <> '' AND app.BranchCode = @_BranchCode AND app.isActive = 1 			ORDER BY app.EffectiveDate DESC	 		) app 		WHERE empl.Code = @_EmployeeCode 	), '') 	 	RETURN @_DeptCodeTmp END

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[ufn_QRcode_ADD_CMD_MANG]() RETURNS TINYINT AS BEGIN     DECLARE @_Result TINYINT = 0;      -- Có dòng LOT rỗng/NULL và mã hàng đó đã có trong DOCQRCODE → 1     IF EXISTS (         SELECT 1         FROM TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG t WITH (NOLOCK)         WHERE (t.LOT = '' OR t.LOT IS NULL)           AND EXISTS (               SELECT 1 FROM DOCQRCODE d WITH (NOLOCK)               WHERE d.MAHANGFCC = t.MAHANG           )     )         SET @_Result = 1;      -- Không có dòng LOT rỗng/NULL nào, nhưng có dòng chưa OK → 2     ELSE IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE LOT = '' OR LOT IS NULL)          AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE STATUS <> 'OK')         SET @_Result = 2;      ELSE         SET @_Result = 0;      RETURN @_Result; END

/*-- ============================================= -- Nguyễn Hải Thăng -- Description:	Kiểm tra tính hợp lệ của một số ký tự --	!#$%^*_><={}[]\|;"`~&@// -- =============================================*/ CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[ufn_sys_Check_Validation_Character] ( 	@_CharInput AS nvarchar(254) --WITH ENCRYPTION ) RETURNS INT AS BEGIN 	IF ISNULL(@_CharInput, '') = ''	RETURN 0  	IF CHARINDEX('!', @_CharInput) > 0 OR CHARINDEX('#', @_CharInput) > 0 			OR CHARINDEX('$', @_CharInput) > 0 OR CHARINDEX('%', @_CharInput) > 0  			OR CHARINDEX('^', @_CharInput) > 0 OR CHARINDEX('*', @_CharInput) > 0 			OR CHARINDEX('_', @_CharInput) > 0 OR CHARINDEX('>', @_CharInput) > 0 			OR CHARINDEX('<', @_CharInput) > 0 OR CHARINDEX('=', @_CharInput) > 0 			OR CHARINDEX('{', @_CharInput) > 0 OR CHARINDEX('}', @_CharInput) > 0 			OR CHARINDEX('[', @_CharInput) > 0 OR CHARINDEX(']', @_CharInput) > 0 			OR CHARINDEX('\', @_CharInput) > 0 OR CHARINDEX('|', @_CharInput) > 0 			OR CHARINDEX(';', @_CharInput) > 0 OR CHARINDEX('"', @_CharInput) > 0 			OR CHARINDEX('`', @_CharInput) > 0 OR CHARINDEX('~', @_CharInput) > 0 			OR CHARINDEX('&', @_CharInput) > 0 OR CHARINDEX('@', @_CharInput) > 0 			OR CHARINDEX('//', @_CharInput) > 0 --OR CHARINDEX('''', @_CharInput) > 0 		RETURN 1  	RETURN 0 END

/*-- ============================================= -- Nguyễn Hải Thăng -- Description:	Kiểm tra tài khoản ngân hàng có phải là IBAN hay không (International Bank Account Number) Quy tắc: 1. Đảo 4 ký tự đầu đưa ra sau cùng (ABCD1234 --> 1234ABCD) 2. Thay thế các ký tự chữ thành ký tự số tương ứng (A = 10, ... Z = 35) 3. Chia dãy số đó cho 97, nếu còn dư 1 thì chuẩn -- =============================================*/ CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[ufn_sys_Check_Validation_IBAN_Account] ( 	@_BankAccountNo AS nvarchar(36) --WITH ENCRYPTION ) RETURNS INT AS BEGIN 	IF ISNULL(@_BankAccountNo, '') = ''	RETURN 0  	SET @_BankAccountNo = UPPER(@_BankAccountNo)  	DECLARE @_Len INT, @_t1 INT, @_t2 INT, @_Char NVARCHAR(1) 	SET @_Len = LEN(@_BankAccountNo) 	SET @_t1 = 1  	-- Loại bỏ các ký tự không hợp lệ 	WHILE @_t1 <= @_Len 	BEGIN 		SET @_Char = SUBSTRING(@_BankAccountNo, @_t1, 1)  		IF NOT (UNICODE(@_Char) BETWEEN 48 AND 57 OR UNICODE(@_Char) BETWEEN 65 AND 90) 			SET @_BankAccountNo = STUFF(@_BankAccountNo, @_t1, 1, ' ')  		SET @_t1 = @_t1 + 1 	END  	SET @_BankAccountNo = REPLACE(@_BankAccountNo, ' ', '')  	-- Độ dài từ 15 đến 34. Hai ký tự đầu phải là chữ cái 	IF LEN(@_BankAccountNo) NOT BETWEEN 15 AND 34  			AND UNICODE(LEFT(@_BankAccountNo, 1)) NOT BETWEEN 65 AND 90 			AND UNICODE(SUBSTRING(@_BankAccountNo, 2, 1)) NOT BETWEEN 65 AND 90 		RETURN 0  	-- Đảo ngược 4 ký tự đầu ra phía sau 	SET @_Len = LEN(@_BankAccountNo)  	SET @_BankAccountNo = SUBSTRING(@_BankAccountNo, 5, @_Len) + LEFT(@_BankAccountNo, 4)  	SET @_t1 = 1  	-- Thay thế chữ cái bằng chữ số tương ứng 	WHILE @_t1 <= LEN(@_BankAccountNo) 	BEGIN 		SET @_Char = SUBSTRING(@_BankAccountNo, @_t1, 1)  		IF UNICODE(@_Char) BETWEEN 65 AND 90 			SET @_BankAccountNo = STUFF(@_BankAccountNo, @_t1, 1, STR(UNICODE(@_Char) - 55, 2))  		SET @_t1 = @_t1 + 1 	END 	 	IF ISNUMERIC(@_BankAccountNo) = 0	RETURN 0  	-- Nếu chia cho 97 còn dư 1 thì đúng là nó 	IF CAST(@_BankAccountNo AS NUMERIC(36)) % 97 = 1 		RETURN 1  	RETURN 0 END

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[ufn_sys_Code128_AddChecksum] ( 	@_Barcode VARCHAR(96) = '' ) RETURNS NVARCHAR(96) AS BEGIN  	DECLARE @_i tinyint, @_checksum Bigint, @_Mini int, @_Dummy tinyint,  			@_tableB tinyint, @_Char nchar(1), @_Code128 NVARCHAR(96); 	SELECT @_Code128 = '', @_i = 1; 	 	If Len(@_Barcode) = 0 RETURN ''; 	--Check for valid characters 	 	WHILE @_i <= LEN(@_Barcode) 	BEGIN 		SET @_Char = SUBSTRING(@_Barcode, @_i, 1) 		IF ASCII(@_Char) = 203 OR (ASCII(@_Char) BETWEEN 32 AND 126) 			SET @_i = @_i + 1; 		ELSE 		BEGIN 			SET @_i = 0; 			BREAK; 		END 	END 	 	SELECT @_TableB = 1; 	 	IF @_i > 0 	BEGIN 		SET @_i = 1 --i% devient l'index sur la chaine / i% become the string index 		While @_i <= Len(@_Barcode) 		BEGIN 			If @_TableB = 1 			BEGIN 			  --See if interesting to switch to table C 			  --yes for 4 digits at start or end, else if 6 digits 				SET @_mini = CASE WHEN @_i = 1 Or @_i + 3 = Len(@_Barcode) THEN 4 ELSE 6 END  				SET @_mini = @_mini - 1 				If @_i + @_mini <= Len(@_Barcode) 				BEGIN 					While @_mini >= 0 					BEGIN 						If ASCII(SUBSTRING(@_Barcode, @_i + @_mini, 1)) < 48 Or ASCII(SUBSTRING(@_Barcode, @_i + @_mini, 1)) > 57 							BREAK 						SET @_mini = @_mini - 1; 					END 				END 				 				If @_mini < 0 --Choice of table C 				BEGIN 					If @_i = 1  --Starting with table C 						SET @_Code128 = Char(205) 					Else		--Switch to table C 						SET @_Code128 = @_Code128 + Char(199) 		             					SET @_tableB = 0 				END 				ELSE 					If @_i = 1 SET @_Code128 = Char(204) --Starting with table B 			END  			IF Not @_tableB = 1 			BEGIN 			  --'We are on table C, try to process 2 digits 				SET @_mini = 2 				 				SET @_mini = @_mini - 1 				IF @_i + @_mini <= Len(@_Barcode) 				BEGIN 					While @_mini >= 0 					BEGIN 						If ASCII(SUBSTRING(@_Barcode, @_i + @_mini, 1)) < 48 Or ASCII(SUBSTRING(@_Barcode, @_i + @_mini, 1)) > 57 							BREAK 						SET @_mini = @_mini - 1; 					END 				END 				 				IF @_mini < 0	--OK for 2 digits, process it 				BEGIN 					SET @_dummy = CAST(SUBSTRING(@_Barcode, @_i, 2) AS numeric) 					SET @_dummy = CASE WHEN @_dummy < 95 THEN @_dummy + 32 ELSE @_dummy + 100 END 					SET @_code128 = @_code128 + Char(@_dummy) 					SET @_i = @_i + 2 				END 				ELSE --We haven't 2 digits, switch to table B 				BEGIN 					SET @_code128 = @_code128 + Char(200) 					SET @_tableB = 1 				END 			END 			If @_tableB = 1 			BEGIN 				--Process 1 digit with table B 			  SET @_code128 = @_code128 + SUBSTRING(@_Barcode, @_i, 1) 			  SET @_i = @_i + 1; 			END 		END		-- End of while        --Calculation of the checksum 		SET @_i = 1; 		WHILE @_i <= Len(@_code128) 		BEGIN 			SET @_dummy = ASCII(SUBSTRING(@_code128, @_i, 1)) 			SET @_dummy = CASE WHEN @_dummy < 127 THEN @_dummy - 32 ELSE @_dummy - 100 END 			If @_i = 1 SET @_checksum = @_dummy 			SET @_checksum = (@_checksum + (@_i - 1) * @_dummy) % 103 			SET @_i = @_i + 1; 		END       --Calculation of the checksum ASCII code 		SET @_checksum = CASE WHEN @_checksum < 95 THEN @_checksum + 32 ELSE @_checksum + 100 END       --Add the checksum and the STOP 		SELECT @_code128 = @_code128 + Char(@_checksum) + Char(206)     END 	RETURN @_code128; -- Cắt dấu tiếng Việt CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[ufn_sys_ConvertFromSignToUnSing] ( 	@_StrInput NVARCHAR(4000) ) RETURNS NVARCHAR(4000) AS BEGIN     	IF @_StrInput IS NULL  		RETURN @_StrInput 	IF @_StrInput = ''  		RETURN @_StrInput 	 	DECLARE @_Sign_Chars NCHAR(136) 	DECLARE @_UnSign_Chars NCHAR (136)  	SET @_Sign_Chars = N'ăâđêôơưàảãạáằẳẵặắầẩẫậấèẻẽẹéềểễệế 						ìỉĩịíòỏõọóồổỗộốờởỡợớùủũụúừửữựứỳỷỹỵý 						ĂÂĐÊÔƠƯÀẢÃẠÁẰẲẴẶẮẦẨẪẬẤÈẺẼẸÉỀỂỄỆẾÌỈĨỊÍ 						ÒỎÕỌÓỒỔỖỘỐỜỞỠỢỚÙỦŨỤÚỪỬỮỰỨỲỶỸỴÝ'  	SET @_UnSign_Chars = N'aadeoouaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaeeeeeeeeee 						iiiiiooooooooooooooouuuuuuuuuuyyyyy 						AADEOOUAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAEEEEEEEEEEIIIII 						OOOOOOOOOOOOOOOUUUUUUUUUUYYYYY'  	DECLARE @_Counter int 	DECLARE @_Counter1 int 	SET @_Counter = 1  	WHILE (@_Counter <=LEN(@_StrInput)) 	BEGIN   		SET @_Counter1 = 1  		WHILE (@_Counter1 <=LEN(@_Sign_Chars) + 1) 		BEGIN 			IF UNICODE(SUBSTRING(@_Sign_Chars, @_Counter1,1)) = UNICODE(SUBSTRING(@_StrInput,@_Counter ,1)) 				 				BEGIN           					IF @_Counter=1 						SET @_StrInput = SUBSTRING(@_UnSign_Chars, @_Counter1, 1) + SUBSTRING(@_StrInput, @_Counter + 1, LEN(@_StrInput) - 1)                   					ELSE 						SET @_StrInput = SUBSTRING(@_StrInput, 1, @_Counter - 1) + SUBSTRING(@_UnSign_Chars, @_Counter1, 1) +  										SUBSTRING(@_StrInput, @_Counter + 1, LEN(@_StrInput)- @_Counter) 					BREAK 				END 						 			SET @_Counter1 = @_Counter1 +1 		END  		SET @_Counter = @_Counter +1 	END 	RETURN @_StrInput END

-- Hàm tạo giá trị rowId CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[ufn_sys_EAN13_AddChecksum] ( 	@_Barcode VARCHAR(16) = '' ) RETURNS VARCHAR(96) AS BEGIN 	IF LEN(RTRIM(LTRIM(ISNULL(@_Barcode, '')))) <> 12 RETURN @_Barcode; 	 	DECLARE @_i tinyint, @_sum int, @_subs char(1), @_Weights tinyint; 	 	SELECT @_i = 1, @_sum = 0, @_Weights = 1, @_Barcode = RTRIM(LTRIM(ISNULL(@_Barcode, ''))); 	 	WHILE @_i <= 12		--LEN(@_Barcode) 	BEGIN 		SET @_subs = SUBSTRING(@_Barcode, @_i, 1); 		 		IF ISNUMERIC(@_subs) = 0 RETURN @_Barcode; 		 		SET @_sum = @_sum + CAST(@_subs AS tinyint) * CASE WHEN @_i%2 = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 3 END; 		 		SET @_i = @_i + 1; 	END 	 	SET @_Barcode = @_Barcode + CAST((10 - @_sum % 10)%10 AS varchar(1)); 	RETURN @_Barcode; END

-- Hàm lấy giá trị doanh số bổ sung thuế CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[ufn_sys_GetDsBST]  (	 	@_str NVarchar(254) = N'', 	@_strBST dbo.CodeType = N'BST' )  RETURNS MoneyType AS  BEGIN  	 	IF @_str = N'' RETURN 0;  	DECLARE @_Pos SmallInt,  			@_strValue dbo.CodeType, 			@_ValueTmp CHAR(1), 			@_Value MoneyType  	SET @_Value = 0  	SET @_Pos = PATINDEX('%' + @_strBST + '%', UPPER(@_str))  	IF @_Pos = 0 RETURN 0;  	DECLARE @_strTmp NVARCHAR(254), @_i SmallInt  	SET @_strValue = N'' 	IF @_Pos > 0 	BEGIN 		SET @_strTmp = SUBSTRING(@_str, @_Pos + LEN(@_strBST), LEN(@_str)) 		SET @_strTmp = REPLACE(@_strTmp, N' ', N'') 		SET @_strTmp = REPLACE(@_strTmp, N':', N'') 		SET @_strTmp = REPLACE(@_strTmp, N';', N'') 		SET @_strTmp = REPLACE(@_strTmp, N' ', N'')	--Thăng: Không phải dấu cách mà là ký tự điều khiển đặc biệt. Nếu có thì sẽ bị lỗi  		SET @_strValue = '' 		SET @_i = 1 		WHILE @_i < = LEN(@_strTmp) 		BEGIN 			SET @_valueTmp = SUBSTRING(@_strTmp, @_i, 1)  			IF ISNUMERIC(@_ValueTmp) = 1 OR @_ValueTmp = '.' 				SET @_strValue = @_strValue + SUBSTRING(@_strTmp, @_i, 1) 			ELSE 				BREAK  			SET @_i = @_i + 1 		END	 	END 	SET @_strValue = LTRIM(REPLACE(@_strValue, ' ', ''))  	-- 17/12/2015 ThắngĐQ: Fix lỗi BST cập nhật ký tự cuối cùng 	IF CHARINDEX('-', @_strValue, 2) <> 0 	BEGIN 		SET @_strValue = LEFT(@_strValue, CHARINDEX('-', @_strValue, 2) - 1) 	END	 	 	IF @_strValue <> '' AND ISNUMERIC(@_strValue) = 1 		SET @_Value = CAST(@_strValue AS NUMERIC(18, 2))  	RETURN @_Value	 END

SET @_strValue = @_strValue + SUBSTRING(@_strTmp, @_i, 1) 			ELSE 				BREAK  			SET @_i = @_i + 1 		END	 	END 	SET @_strValue = LTRIM(REPLACE(@_strValue, ' ', ''))  	RETURN @_strValue	 END

CREATE FUNCTION [ufn_sys_GetTablePermissionExpr] ( 	@_UserId AS int, 	@_TableName varchar(100), 	@_BranchCode varchar(3) = NULL, 	@_FiscalYear CodeType = NULL, 	@_RoleIdList varchar(100) = NULL ) RETURNS nvarchar(MAX) AS BEGIN 	------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 	-- Hàm/thủ tục được tạo tự động bởi BravoTools nếu không tồn tại hoặc sẽ bị xóa 	-- và tạo lại nếu thực hiện "Cập nhật các hàm và thủ tục TSQL" trong BravoTools 	-- Trả về chuỗi biểu thức điều kiện loại bỏ những dữ liệu không có quyền  	-- để dùng ở cuối mệnh đề WHERE khi SELECT một bảng dữ liệu 	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------  	DECLARE @isAdminRole AS bit; 	DECLARE @isModeratorRole AS bit; 	DECLARE @isIsolatedRole AS bit; 	SET @isAdminRole = 0; 	SET @isModeratorRole = 0; 	SET @isIsolatedRole = 0;  	IF ISNULL(@_RoleIdList, '') = '' 	BEGIN 		DECLARE @RoleTable TABLE (RoleId int); 		WITH cteUsers (Id, ParentId) AS 		( 			SELECT Id, ParentId 				FROM [B00UserList] WITH (NOLOCK) 				WHERE Id = @_UserId 			UNION ALL 			SELECT u.Id, u.ParentId 				FROM [B00UserList] AS u WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN 				cteUsers ON u.Id = cteUsers.ParentId 		) 		INSERT INTO @RoleTable 			SELECT DISTINCT RoleId  				FROM B00UserRole AS ur WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN  					cteUsers AS u ON u.Id = ur.UserId INNER JOIN  					B00RoleList AS rl WITH (NOLOCK) ON rl.Id = ur.RoleId 				WHERE ur.IsActive = 1 AND rl.IsActive = 1;  		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP (1) 1 FROM @RoleTable WHERE RoleId = 1) 			SET @isAdminRole = 1; 	 		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP (1) 1 FROM @RoleTable WHERE RoleId = 4) 			SET @isModeratorRole = 1; 		 		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP (1) 1 FROM @RoleTable WHERE RoleId = 3) 			SET @isIsolatedRole = 1; 	END; 	ELSE 	BEGIN 		SET @_RoleIdList = ',' + @_RoleIdList + ','; 		IF CHARINDEX(',1,', @_RoleIdList) > 0 			SET @isAdminRole = 1; 		 		IF CHARINDEX(',4,', @_RoleIdList) > 0 			SET @isModeratorRole = 1; 		 		IF CHARINDEX(',3,', @_RoleIdList) > 0 			SET @isIsolatedRole = 1; 	END;  	DECLARE @prefix AS nvarchar(100); 	SET @prefix = ''; 	 	-- Xử lý riêng biệt cho 2 bảng B00RoleList và B00UserList với người dùng không phải là admin 	IF @_TableName = 'B00RoleList' OR @_TableName = 'B00UserList' 	BEGIN 		IF @isAdminRole = 0 		BEGIN 			IF @isModeratorRole = 1 AND @_TableName = 'B00RoleList' 				SET @prefix = 'RoleType NOT IN (1,4,5)'; 			ELSE IF @isModeratorRole = 1 AND @_TableName = 'B00UserList' 				SET @prefix = 'Id IN (SELECT Id FROM dbo.ufn_sys_GetModeratedUserTable(' + LTRIM(STR(@_UserId)) + '))'; 			ELSE IF @isModeratorRole = 0 AND @_TableName = 'B00RoleList' 				SET @prefix = '0=1'; 			ELSE IF @isModeratorRole = 0 AND @_TableName = 'B00UserList' 				SET @prefix = 'Id=' + LTRIM(STR(@_UserId)); 		END; 	END;  	DECLARE @ignoreCreatedBy AS bit; 	SET @ignoreCreatedBy = 0;  	-- Các bảng B00 trừ B00Layout sẽ không query theo CreatedBy 	IF @_TableName <> 'B00Layout' AND @_TableName LIKE 'B00%' 		SET @ignoreCreatedBy = 1; 	-- Cần bỏ qua các bảng không có cột CreatedBy để tránh bị lỗi khi query 	ELSE IF OBJECT_ID(@_TableName) IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.columns WITH (NOLOCK) 			WHERE [object_id] = OBJECT_ID(@_TableName) AND [name] = 'CreatedBy') 		SET @ignoreCreatedBy = 1;  	DECLARE @filterExpr AS nvarchar(MAX); 	SET @filterExpr = '';  	-- Quyền dữ liệu được lưu với TableName <> '', ColumnName = '', FilterExpr có thể = '' hoặc không 	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM B00PermissionData WITH (NOLOCK) 		WHERE TableName = @_TableName AND ColumnName = '') 	BEGIN 		IF @isIsolatedRole = 1 AND @ignoreCreatedBy = 0 			SET @filterExpr = '(' + (CASE WHEN @prefix <> '' THEN @prefix + ' AND '  				ELSE '' END) + 'CreatedBy IN (-1,' + LTRIM(STR(@_UserId)) + '))'; 		ELSE IF @prefix <> '' 			SET @filterExpr = '(' + @prefix + ')'; 		 		RETURN @filterExpr; 	END;  	DECLARE @UserListTable TABLE 	( 		BuiltinOrder int 		,UserId int 		,RoleId int 	); 	 	INSERT INTO @UserListTable SELECT BuiltinOrder, UserId, RoleId  		FROM dbo.ufn_sys_GetPermissionUserListTable(@_UserId); 	 	DECLARE @expr AS nvarchar(MAX); 	SET @expr = '';  	-- Với vai trò người dùng cô lập cần kiểm trả quyền cho phép để mở dữ liệu của cả người khác NoOpen = 0 	IF @isIsolatedRole = 1 AND @ignoreCreatedBy = 0 	BEGIN 		DECLARE @PermissionAll TABLE 		( 			TableName varchar(48) 			,FilterExpr nvarchar(128) 			,BuiltinOrder int 			,RoleId int 			,UserId int 			,NoOpen tinyint 			,NoInherit tinyint 		); 		 		-- Nếu cần tham chiếu nhiều hơn 1 lần với dữ liệu lớn thì dùng bảng tạm sẽ nhanh hơn 		-- CTE vì CTE chỉ là một dạng macro thay thế chứ không caching như bảng tạm 		--WITH ctePermissionAll AS 		--( 		INSERT INTO @PermissionAll SELECT  				pd.TableName 				,pd.FilterExpr 				,o.BuiltinOrder 				,p.RoleId 				,p.UserId 				,p.NoOpen 				,p.NoInherit 			FROM B00Permission AS p WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN  				@UserListTable AS o ON  					o.RoleId = ISNULL(p.RoleId, -1) AND o.UserId = ISNULL(p.UserId, -1) INNER JOIN 				B00PermissionData AS pd WITH (NOLOCK) ON pd.Id = p.DataId 			WHERE pd.TableName = @_TableName AND pd.ColumnName = '' 				AND (ISNULL(p.NoOpen, 1) = 0 OR ISNULL(p.NoInherit, 0) = 1) 				AND p.IsActive = 1 AND pd.IsActive = 1; 		--) 		WITH ctePermissionNoInherit AS 		( 			SELECT TableName, FilterExpr, BuiltinOrder  				FROM @PermissionAll WHERE NoInherit = 1 		) 		,cteExpr AS 		( 			SELECT  a.FilterExpr 					,a.NoOpen 				FROM @PermissionAll AS a INNER JOIN  					ctePermissionNoInherit AS b ON a.TableName = b.TableName AND a.FilterExpr = b.FilterExpr  						AND (a.BuiltinOrder < b.BuiltinOrder OR (a.BuiltinOrder = b.BuiltinOrder AND a.NoInherit = 1)) 			UNION 			SELECT  a.FilterExpr 					,a.NoOpen 				FROM @PermissionAll AS a  				WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM @PermissionAll WHERE  					NoInherit = 1 AND TableName = a.TableName AND FilterExpr = a.FilterExpr) 		) 		SELECT @expr = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(STUFF(CONVERT(nvarchar(MAX),  			(SELECT ' OR ' + (CASE WHEN FilterExpr = '' THEN '0=0' ELSE FilterExpr END) 				FROM cteExpr WHERE NoOpen = 0 FOR XML PATH ('') 			), 1), 1, 4, ''), '>', '>'), '<', '<'), '&', '&');  		SET @expr = LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(@expr, ''))); 		IF @expr <> '' SET @expr = @expr + ' OR '; 		SET @expr = '(' + @expr + 'CreatedBy IN (-1,' + LTRIM(STR(@_UserId)) + '))'; 	END;  	DECLARE @exprNOT AS nvarchar(MAX);  	DECLARE @exprCreatedBy AS nvarchar(100); 	IF @ignoreCreatedBy = 1 		SET @exprCreatedBy = ''; 	ELSE 		SET @exprCreatedBy = ' AND CreatedBy>0 AND CreatedBy<>' + LTRIM(STR(@_UserId));  	-- Đối với tất cả các vai trò cần kiểm tra quyền cấm mở dữ liệu  	-- NoOpen = 1 và cấm mở dữ liệu của người khác NoOpenDOU = 1 	 	DECLARE @PermissionAll0 TABLE 	( 		TableName varchar(48) 		,FilterExpr nvarchar(128) 		,BuiltinOrder int 		,RoleId int 		,UserId int 		,NoOpen tinyint 		,NoOpenDOU tinyint 		,NoInherit tinyint 	);  	-- Nếu cần tham chiếu nhiều hơn 1 lần với dữ liệu lớn thì dùng bảng tạm sẽ nhanh hơn 	-- CTE vì CTE chỉ là một dạng macro thay thế chứ không caching như bảng tạm 	--WITH ctePermissionAll AS 	--( 	INSERT INTO @PermissionAll0 SELECT  			pd.TableName 			,pd.FilterExpr 			,o.BuiltinOrder 			,p.RoleId 			,p.UserId 			,p.NoOpen 			,p.NoOpenDOU 			,p.NoInherit 		FROM B00Permission AS p WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN  			@UserListTable AS o ON  				o.RoleId = ISNULL(p.RoleId, -1) AND o.UserId = ISNULL(p.UserId, -1) INNER JOIN 			B00PermissionData AS pd WITH (NOLOCK) ON pd.Id = p.DataId 		WHERE pd.TableName = @_TableName AND pd.ColumnName = ''  			AND (ISNULL(p.NoOpen, 0) = 1 OR ISNULL(p.NoOpenDOU, 0) = 1 OR ISNULL(p.NoInherit, 0) = 1) 			AND p.IsActive = 1 AND pd.IsActive = 1; 	--) 	WITH ctePermissionNoInherit AS 	( 		SELECT TableName, FilterExpr, BuiltinOrder  			FROM @PermissionAll0 WHERE NoInherit = 1 	) 	,cteExpr AS 	( 		SELECT  a.FilterExpr 				,a.NoOpen 				,a.NoOpenDOU 			FROM @PermissionAll0 AS a INNER JOIN  				ctePermissionNoInherit AS b ON a.TableName = b.TableName AND a.FilterExpr = b.FilterExpr  					AND (a.BuiltinOrder < b.BuiltinOrder OR (a.BuiltinOrder = b.BuiltinOrder AND a.NoInherit = 1)) 		UNION 		SELECT  a.FilterExpr 				,a.NoOpen 				,a.NoOpenDOU 			FROM @PermissionAll0 AS a  			WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM @PermissionAll0 WHERE  				NoInherit = 1 AND TableName = a.TableName AND FilterExpr = a.FilterExpr) 	) 	SELECT @exprNOT = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(STUFF(CONVERT(nvarchar(MAX),  		(SELECT  				(CASE WHEN FilterExpr = '' THEN 					(CASE WHEN ISNULL(NoOpenDOU, 0) = 1 THEN 						@exprCreatedBy 					ELSE 						(CASE WHEN ISNULL(NoOpen, 0) = 1 THEN ' OR 0=0' ELSE '' END) 					END) 				ELSE 					(CASE WHEN ISNULL(NoOpenDOU, 0) = 1 THEN 						' OR (' + FilterExpr + @exprCreatedBy +')' 					ELSE 						(CASE WHEN ISNULL(NoOpen, 0) = 1 THEN ' OR ' + FilterExpr ELSE '' END) 					END) 				END) 			FROM cteExpr 			ORDER BY FilterExpr FOR XML PATH ('') 		), 1), 1, 4, ''), '>', '>'), '<', '<'), '&', '&');  	SET @exprNOT = LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(@exprNOT, ''))); 	IF @exprNOT <> '' SET @exprNOT = 'NOT (' + @exprNOT + ')';  	IF @prefix <> '' SET @filterExpr = @prefix; 	IF @expr <> '' SET @filterExpr = (CASE WHEN @filterExpr <> '' THEN @filterExpr + ' AND ' ELSE '' END) + @expr; 	IF @exprNOT <> '' SET @filterExpr = (CASE WHEN @filterExpr <> '' THEN @filterExpr + ' AND ' ELSE '' END) + @exprNOT; 	IF @filterExpr <> '' SET @filterExpr = '(' + @filterExpr + ')'; 	 	RETURN @filterExpr; END;

-- ============================================= -- Author:		Dinh Quang Thang	 -- Create date: 11/09/2006 -- Description:	Ham lay ten bang ##, Ten bang + cong voi Process ID -- ============================================= CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[ufn_sys_GetTempTableName] (@_Table_Name NVARCHAR(128) = N'') RETURNS NVARCHAR(128) AS BEGIN 	 	DECLARE @_Date DATETIME 	SET @_Date = GetUtcDate() 	 	RETURN 	@_Table_Name + '_' +  		CAST(@@SPID AS VARCHAR(64)) + '_' +	 		STR(DATEPART(yyyy, @_Date), 4) +  		REPLACE(STR(DATEPART(mm, @_Date), 2) , SPACE(1), '0') + 		REPLACE(STR(DATEPART(dd, @_Date), 2) , SPACE(1), '0') +  		REPLACE(STR(DATEPART(hh, @_Date), 2) , SPACE(1), '0') +  		REPLACE(STR(DATEPART(mm, @_Date), 2) , SPACE(1), '0') + 	 		REPLACE(STR(DATEPART(ss, @_Date), 2) , SPACE(1), '0') + 	 		REPLACE(STR(DATEPART(ms, @_Date), 3) , SPACE(1), '0') ; END

-- ============================================= -- Author:		Đinh Quang Thắng -- Create date: 11/09/2007 -- Description:	Lấy kiểu của trường Dạng NChar(32), INT .... -- ============================================= CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[ufn_sys_GetType] 	(@_Type_Id INT = 0, @_LengTh INT, @_Precision INT, @_Scale INT) RETURNS NVARCHAR(128) AS  BEGIN 	RETURN TYPE_NAME(@_Type_Id) +  		CASE  		WHEN TYPE_NAME(@_Type_Id) IN (N'nVarchar', N'varchar', N'binary') AND @_LengTh = 0 THEN N'(MAX)'   		WHEN TYPE_NAME(@_Type_Id) IN (N'nChar', N'nVarchar') THEN N'(' + CAST(@_LengTh/2 AS NVARCHAR(8)) + N')'  		WHEN TYPE_NAME(@_Type_Id) IN (N'Char', N'Varchar') THEN N'(' + CAST(@_LengTh AS NVARCHAR(8)) + N')'  		WHEN TYPE_NAME(@_Type_Id) IN (N'numeric', N'decimal') THEN N'(' + CAST(@_Precision AS NVARCHAR(8)) + N',' + CAST(@_Scale AS NVARCHAR(8)) + N')' 		WHEN TYPE_NAME(@_Type_Id) = N'binary' AND @_LengTh <> 0 THEN N'(' + CAST(@_LengTh AS NVARCHAR(8)) + N')' 	 		ELSE N'' END  END

-- Created by: Đinh Quang Thắng -- Description: Hàm kiểm tra 1 bảng đang bị lock hay không CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[ufn_sys_IsDeadlock]  (   	@_TableName NVARCHAR(64) = NULL ) RETURNS tinyint  AS BEGIN 	IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM sys.dm_tran_locks AS Lock  			--LEFT JOIN sys.dm_exec_sessions AS Session ON Session.session_id = Lock.request_session_id 			--LEFT JOIN sys.dm_exec_requests AS Request ON Request.session_id = Session.session_id 			LEFT JOIN sys.tables AS UserTable ON UserTable.object_id = Lock.resource_associated_entity_id AND type = 'U' 		WHERE Lock.resource_type = 'OBJECT'  			AND UserTable.Name = @_TableName  			AND Lock.request_mode = 'IX') 		RETURN 1	 			 	RETURN 0  END

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[ufn_sys_IsGroup]  ( 	@_LookUpValue nvarchar(24) = NULL, 	@_LookUpTable nvarchar(24) = NULL ) RETURNS Bit AS BEGIN 	DECLARE @_IsGroup Bit 	 	SET @_IsGroup = NULL; 	IF @_LookUpValue IS NULL OR @_LookUpTable IS NULL RETURN @_IsGroup 	IF Object_Id(@_LookUpTable) IS NULL RETURN @_IsGroup 	 	IF @_LookUpTable = N'B20ChartOfAccount' 		SET @_IsGroup = (SELECT IsGroup FROM B20ChartOfAccount WHERE Code = @_LookUpValue) 	ELSE IF @_LookUpTable = N'B20Customer' 		SET @_IsGroup = (SELECT IsGroup FROM B20Customer WHERE Code = @_LookUpValue) 	ELSE IF @_LookUpTable = N'B20Item' 		SET @_IsGroup = (SELECT IsGroup FROM B20Item WHERE Code = @_LookUpValue) 	ELSE IF @_LookUpTable = N'B20Dept' 		SET @_IsGroup = (SELECT IsGroup FROM B20Dept WHERE Code = @_LookUpValue) 	ELSE IF @_LookUpTable = N'B20Asset' 		SET @_IsGroup = (SELECT IsGroup FROM B20Asset WHERE Code = @_LookUpValue) 	ELSE IF @_LookUpTable = N'B20ExpenseCatg' 		SET @_IsGroup = (SELECT IsGroup FROM B20ExpenseCatg WHERE Code = @_LookUpValue)	 	ELSE IF @_LookUpTable = N'B20Asset' 		SET @_IsGroup = ISNULL((SELECT IsGroup FROM B20Asset WHERE Code = @_LookUpValue),0)	 	ELSE IF @_LookUpTable = N'B20Employee' 		SET @_IsGroup = (SELECT IsGroup FROM B20Employee WHERE Code = @_LookUpValue) 	ELSE IF @_LookUpTable = N'B20CustomerStatus'	 		SET @_IsGroup = (SELECT IsGroup FROM B20CustomerStatus WHERE Code = @_LookUpValue) 		 	RETURN ISNULL(@_IsGroup, 0) END

CREATE FUNCTION [ufn_sys_IsRoleType] ( 	@_UserId int 	,@_RoleType tinyint ) RETURNS bit AS BEGIN 	------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 	-- Hàm/thủ tục được tạo tự động bởi BravoTools nếu không tồn tại hoặc sẽ bị xóa 	-- và tạo lại nếu thực hiện "Cập nhật các hàm và thủ tục TSQL" trong BravoTools 	-- Trả về 1 nếu user @_UserId có vai trò @_RoleType 	------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 	DECLARE @isTrue AS bit; 	WITH cteUsers (Id, ParentId) AS 	( 		SELECT Id, ParentId 			FROM [B00UserList] WITH (NOLOCK) 			WHERE Id = @_UserId 		UNION ALL 		SELECT u.Id, u.ParentId 			FROM [B00UserList] AS u WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN 			cteUsers ON u.Id = cteUsers.ParentId 	) 	SELECT TOP (1) @isTrue = 1  		FROM B00UserRole AS ur WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN  			cteUsers AS u ON u.Id = ur.UserId INNER JOIN  			B00RoleList AS rl WITH (NOLOCK) ON rl.Id = ur.RoleId 		WHERE rl.RoleType = @_RoleType AND ur.IsActive = 1 AND rl.IsActive = 1; 	RETURN ISNULL(@isTrue, 0); END;

--	============================================================  --	Author: Dinh Quang Thang --	Created date: 04/02/2009 --	Description: Ham lay dieu kien dung sai cua thang tinh toan trong Gia thanh --	============================================================  CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[ufn_sys_Key_Thang]  	(	@_Thang	SmallInt = 1, 		@_Thang0 SmallInt = 1, 		@_Thang1 SmallInt = 1,  		@_Thang2 SmallInt = 1 	)  RETURNS Bit  --WITH ENCRYPTION AS   BEGIN  	IF @_Thang0 = @_Thang1 - 1 		RETURN CASE WHEN (@_Thang >= @_Thang0 AND @_Thang <= @_Thang2) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END  	IF @_Thang1 = @_Thang2 		RETURN CASE WHEN @_Thang IN (@_Thang0, @_Thang2) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END  	RETURN CASE WHEN (@_Thang >= @_Thang1 AND @_Thang <= @_Thang2) OR @_Thang = @_Thang0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END END

-- Hàm thay đổi giá trị list code CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[ufn_sys_MergeListCode] ( 	@_string AS NVARCHAR(4000) = '', 	@_OldValue LongCodeType = NULL, 	@_NewValue LongCodeType	= NULL, 	@_DelimitedBy NCHAR(1) = ',' ) RETURNS NVARCHAR(4000) AS BEGIN 	IF @_string  = '' RETURN ''  	IF @_OldValue = NULL OR @_NewValue = NULL RETURN @_string  	SET @_string = @_DelimitedBy + REPLACE(@_string, ' ', '') + @_DelimitedBy  	DECLARE @_strTmp NVARCHAR(4000) 	 	SET @_strTmp = REPLACE(@_string,  			@_DelimitedBy + RTRIM(@_OldValue) + @_DelimitedBy,  			@_DelimitedBy + RTRIM(@_NewValue) + @_DelimitedBy)  	SET @_strTmp = STUFF(@_strTmp, 1, LEN(@_DelimitedBy), '') 	SET @_strTmp = STUFF(@_strTmp, LEN(@_strTmp) - LEN(@_DelimitedBy) + 1, LEN(@_DelimitedBy), '') 	RETURN @_strTmp END

CREATE FUNCTION [ufn_sys_MessageText](@_TextKey [nvarchar](36), @_LangId [int]) RETURNS [nvarchar](1000) AS BEGIN 	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 	-- Hàm/thủ tục được tạo tự động bởi BravoTools nếu không tồn tại hoặc sẽ bị xóa 	-- và tạo lại nếu thực hiện "Cập nhật các hàm và thủ tục TSQL" trong BravoTools 	--------------------------------------------------------------------------------  	IF (@_LangId IS NULL) 		RETURN  			ISNULL((SELECT ISNULL([Text], '') + CHAR(13) +  					ISNULL(Text_English, '') + CHAR(13) +  					ISNULL(Text_French, '') + CHAR(13) +  					ISNULL(Text_Japanese, '') + CHAR(13) +  					ISNULL(Text_Chinese, '') + CHAR(13) +  					ISNULL(Text_Custom, '') 				FROM B00Message WHERE TextKey = @_TextKey), '') 	 	RETURN 		ISNULL(CASE @_LangId 			WHEN 1 THEN (SELECT TOP (1) Text_English FROM B00Message WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE TextKey = @_TextKey) 			WHEN 2 THEN (SELECT TOP (1) Text_French FROM B00Message WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE TextKey = @_TextKey) 			WHEN 3 THEN (SELECT TOP (1) Text_Japanese FROM B00Message WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE TextKey = @_TextKey)  			WHEN 4 THEN (SELECT TOP (1) Text_Chinese FROM B00Message WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE TextKey = @_TextKey) 			WHEN 5 THEN (SELECT TOP (1) Text_Custom FROM B00Message WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE TextKey = @_TextKey) 			ELSE (SELECT TOP (1) [Text] FROM B00Message WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE TextKey = @_TextKey) 		END, '') END;

-- ============================================= -- Author:		Pham Trung -- Create date: <Create Date, ,> -- Description:	<Description, ,> -- ============================================= CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[ufn_sys_MonthDiff] ( 	@ldNgay1 Smalldatetime = '', 	@ldNgay2 Smalldatetime = '' ) RETURNS Decimal(12, 6) AS BEGIN 	-- Declare the return variable here 	-- SELECT [dbo].[ufn_sys_MonthDiff]('Jan 1, 2009', 'Jan 1, 2009') 	DECLARE @RetVal Decimal(12, 6), @_Ngay_Cuoi_Thang1 Smalldatetime,  			@_Ngay_Dau_Thang2 Smalldatetime, @_Ngay_Cuoi_Thang2 Smalldatetime 	 	IF @ldNgay1 = DATEADD(Day, 1, @ldNgay2) OR @ldNgay1 = @ldNgay2 		RETURN 0 		 	SET @_Ngay_Cuoi_Thang1 = DATEADD(Month, 1, @ldNgay1) 	SET @_Ngay_Cuoi_Thang1 = DATEADD(Day, -DAY(@_Ngay_Cuoi_Thang1), @_Ngay_Cuoi_Thang1) 	 	SET @_Ngay_Dau_Thang2 = DATEADD(Day, -DAY(@ldNgay2) + 1, @ldNgay2) 	SET @_Ngay_Cuoi_Thang2 = DATEADD(Day, -1, DATEADD(Month, 1, @_Ngay_Dau_Thang2)) 	 	SET @RetVal = DATEDIFF(Month, @ldNgay1, @ldNgay2) - 1.00 	 	IF DAY(@ldNgay1) <> 1 		SET @RetVal = @RetVal + CAST((DAY(@_Ngay_Cuoi_Thang1) - DAY(@ldNgay1) + 1) AS Decimal(12, 6)) / CAST(DAY(@_Ngay_Cuoi_Thang1) AS Decimal(12, 6)) 	ELSE 		SET @RetVal = @RetVal + 1 	 	IF DAY(DATEADD(Day, 1, @ldNgay2)) <> 1 		SET @RetVal = @RetVal + CAST(DAY(@ldNgay2) AS Decimal(12, 6)) / CAST(DAY(@_Ngay_Cuoi_Thang2) AS Decimal(12, 6)) 	ELSE 		SET @RetVal = @RetVal + 1 	 	RETURN @RetVal END

-- ============================================= -- Author:		Pham Trung -- Create date: <Create Date, ,> -- Description:	<Description, ,> -- ============================================= CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[ufn_sys_MonthDiffTs] ( 	@ldNgay1 Smalldatetime = '', 	@ldNgay2 Smalldatetime = '' ) RETURNS FLOAT AS BEGIN 	-- Declare the return variable here 	-- SELECT [dbo].[ufn_sys_MonthDiff]('Jan 1, 2009', 'Jan 1, 2009') 	 	IF @ldNgay1 = @ldNgay2 		RETURN 0  	DECLARE @_Ngay_Cuoi_Thang1 Smalldatetime, @_Ngay_Cuoi_Thang2 Smalldatetime, 			@_Ngay_Dau_Thang2 Smalldatetime  	SET @_Ngay_Cuoi_Thang1 = DATEADD(Month, 1, @ldNgay1 - DAY(@ldNgay1) + 1) - 1 	SET @_Ngay_Cuoi_Thang2 = DATEADD(Month, 1, @ldNgay2 - DAY(@ldNgay2) + 1) - 1 	SET @_Ngay_Dau_Thang2 = @_Ngay_Cuoi_Thang2 - DAY(@_Ngay_Cuoi_Thang2) + 1 	 	DECLARE @RetVal INT 	SET @RetVal = DATEDIFF(Month, @ldNgay1, @ldNgay2)  	-- Trừ trong cùng tháng cùng năm 	IF @RetVal = 0 		RETURN CONVERT(FLOAT, DATEDIFF(d, @ldNgay1, @ldNgay2)) / DAY(@_Ngay_Cuoi_Thang1)  	-- Xử lý thêm tình huống cuối tháng này với cuối tháng sau 	IF @ldNgay1 = @_Ngay_Dau_Thang2 - 1 AND @_Ngay_Cuoi_Thang2 = @ldNgay2 	BEGIN 		RETURN 1 	END	 	 	RETURN CONVERT(FLOAT, DATEDIFF(d, @ldNgay1, @_Ngay_Cuoi_Thang1) + 1) / DAY(@_Ngay_Cuoi_Thang1)  			+ @RetVal - 1  			+ CASE WHEN DAY(@ldNgay2) = 1 THEN 0 ELSE CONVERT(FLOAT, DAY(@ldNgay2) - 1) / DAY(@_Ngay_Cuoi_Thang2) END END

-- ============================================= -- Author:		Đinh Quang Thắng -- Create date:  -- Description:	Tính thuế thu nhập cá nhân trong trường hợp trả lương NET -- ============================================= CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[ufn_sys_PersonalNetIncomeTax] ( 	@_NetIncome NUMERIC(18, 2) = 0,		-- Thu nhập sau thuế TNCN 	@_Date SmallDatetime = '', 	@_TotalMonth Tinyint = 1			-- Số tháng tính, nếu quyết toán thuế thì đưa thành 12 ) RETURNS NUMERIC(18, 2) AS BEGIN 	IF @_NetIncome = 0 RETURN 0 	 	DECLARE @_PersonalNetIncomeTaxAmount NUMERIC(18, 2), @_Round Tinyint 	SET @_Round = 0 	 	SET @_PersonalNetIncomeTaxAmount = 0 	DECLARE @_LuongTN TABLE  		( 			Amount1 NUMERIC(18, 2),  			Amount2 NUMERIC(18, 2),  			PerLevel NUMERIC(8, 4), 			Exemption TINYINT, 			LevelIncomeTax NUMERIC(18, 2),  			IncomeTax NUMERIC(18, 2),  			IncomeAmount NUMERIC(18, 2) 		); 	 	WITH TaxIncomePara AS 	( 		SELECT No, @_TotalMonth*Amount1 AS Amount1, @_TotalMonth*Amount2 AS Amount2, PerLevel, Exemption,  			ROUND(@_TotalMonth*(Amount2 - Amount1)*PerLevel, @_Round) AS LevelIncomeTax -- Thuế thu nhập chỉ tính chênh lệch của từng mức 		FROM B20HrmTaxIncomePara 		WHERE IsActive = 1 AND ApplyDate <> '' AND  			CASE  				WHEN ISNULL(ExpireDate, '') = '' AND ApplyDate <= @_Date THEN 1 				WHEN ISNULL(ExpireDate, '') <> '' AND ApplyDate <= @_Date AND ExpireDate >= @_Date THEN 1 				ELSE 0 END = 1 	)	 	INSERT INTO @_LuongTN 	SELECT TaxIncomePara.Amount1, TaxIncomePara.Amount2, TaxIncomePara.PerLevel, TaxIncomePara.Exemption, 		TaxIncomePara.LevelIncomeTax,  		ISNULL(tb1.IncomeTax, 0) AS IncomeTax, 		(TaxIncomePara.Amount2 -  ISNULL(tb1.IncomeTax, 0)) AS IncomeAmount -- Thu nhập trước thuế 	FROM TaxIncomePara	 	CROSS APPLY 	(	 		SELECT SUM(tb1.LevelIncomeTax) AS IncomeTax 		FROM TaxIncomePara tb1 		WHERE TaxIncomePara.PerLevel >= tb1.PerLevel 	) tb1	 	ORDER BY No  	IF @_NetIncome > (SELECT MAX(IncomeAmount) FROM @_LuongTN WHERE Amount2 <> 0) 	BEGIN 		SELECT @_PersonalNetIncomeTaxAmount = ROUND((@_NetIncome - IF EXISTS(SELECT VarValue FROM dbo.B00Config WHERE VarKey = @_VarKey)	 	BEGIN	 		DECLARE @M_PGia NVARCHAR(100) 		SET @M_PGia = (SELECT VarValue FROM dbo.B00Config WHERE VarKey = @_VarKey)  		SET @_search_pos = CHARINDEX(@_strSearch, @M_PGia) 		SET @_Pos = @_search_pos 		WHILE @_search_pos <> 0 		BEGIN 			SET @_Pos = @_search_pos 			SET @_search_pos = CHARINDEX(@_strSearch, @M_PGia, @_search_pos + 1) 		END  		IF @_Pos <> 0 			IF SUBSTRING(@M_PGia, @_Pos + 1, LEN(@M_PGia) - @_Pos) <> N'' 				SET @_Round_PGia = LEN(SUBSTRING(@M_PGia, @_Pos + 1, LEN(@M_PGia) - @_Pos)) 	END  	RETURN @_Round_PGia END

CREATE PROCEDURE [_CreateTriggerLog] 	@_TableName TableNameType = NULL 	,@_TableList xml = NULL AS BEGIN 	------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 	-- Hàm/thủ tục được tạo tự động bởi BravoTools nếu không tồn tại hoặc sẽ bị xóa 	-- và tạo lại nếu thực hiện "Cập nhật các hàm và thủ tục TSQL" trong BravoTools 	-- Tạo trigger log cho bảng theo khai báo trong B00DmFile 	------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 	 	SET NOCOUNT ON; 		RETURN @returnValue; 	END 	 	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ' + @eventLogTableName + ' WHERE LastWriteAt > @_Date1 AND Command = ''DELETE'' 	BEGIN 		SET @returnValue = 3; 		RETURN @returnValue; 	END 	 	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ' + @eventLogTableName + ' WHERE LastWriteAt > @_Date1 AND Command = ''UPDATE'' 		AND (ColumnName LIKE ''Amount%'' OR ColumnName LIKE ''%Account%'' OR ColumnName IN(''DocStatus'', ''IsActive''))) 	BEGIN 		SET @returnValue = 4; 		END;  		SET @cmd =  N'	 	-- This trigger was generated by stored procedure _CreateTriggerLog  	SET NOCOUNT ON; 		 	DECLARE @_cont_inf varbinary(128); 	SET @_cont_inf = ISNULL(CONTEXT_INFO(), 0x); 	 	-- Check to context info to bypass trigger 	-- Situations : Tinh gia von, Cap nhat tong tien, Don dep so lieu, MergeCode 	IF	@_cont_inf = 0x55555 OR @_cont_inf = CAST(''CalcCosting'' AS varbinary(128)) OR 		@_cont_inf = CAST(''UpTotalAmount'' AS varbinary(128)) OR  		@_cont_inf = CAST(''AccDoc_RePost'' AS varbinary(128)) OR 		@_cont_inf = CAST(''MergeCode'' AS varbinary(128))  	BEGIN 		--PRINT ' + QUOTENAME('Bypass trigger ' + @triggerName + '!', '''') + '; CREATE PROCEDURE [_DropTableColumn] 	@tablename sysname,  	@columnname sysname AS BEGIN 	------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 	-- Hàm/thủ tục được tạo tự động bởi BravoTools nếu không tồn tại hoặc sẽ bị xóa 	-- và tạo lại nếu thực hiện "Cập nhật các hàm và thủ tục TSQL" trong BravoTools 	-- Xóa một cột cùng các constraints của một bảng 	------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 	SET NOCOUNT ON;  	SELECT CONSTRAINT_NAME, 'C' AS type 	INTO #dependencies 	FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.CONSTRAINT_COLUMN_USAGE WHERE TABLE_NAME = @tablename AND COLUMN_NAME = @columnname  	INSERT INTO #dependencies 	select d.name, 'C' 	from sys.default_constraints d 	join sys.columns c ON c.column_id = d.parent_column_id AND c.object_id = d.parent_object_id 	join sys.objects o ON o.object_id = d.parent_object_id 	WHERE o.name = @tablename AND c.name = @columnname  	INSERT INTO #dependencies 	SELECT i.name, 'I' 	FROM sys.indexes i 	JOIN sys.index_columns ic ON ic.index_id = i.index_id and ic.object_id=i.object_id 	JOIN sys.columns c ON c.column_id = ic.column_id and c.object_id=i.object_id 	JOIN sys.objects o ON o.object_id = i.object_id 	where o.name = @tableName AND i.type=2 AND c.name = @columnname AND is_unique_constraint = 0  	INSERT INTO #dependencies 	SELECT s.NAME, 'S' 	FROM sys.stats AS s 	INNER JOIN sys.stats_columns AS sc  		ON s.object_id = sc.object_id AND s.stats_id = sc.stats_id 	INNER JOIN sys.columns AS c  		ON sc.object_id = c.object_id AND c.column_id = sc.column_id 	WHERE s.object_id = OBJECT_ID(@tableName) 	AND c.NAME = @columnname 	AND s.NAME LIKE '_dta_stat%'  	DECLARE @dep_name nvarchar(500) 	DECLARE @type nchar(1)  	DECLARE dep_cursor CURSOR 	FOR SELECT * FROM #dependencies  	OPEN dep_cursor  	FETCH NEXT FROM dep_cursor  	INTO @dep_name, @type; 	 	IF ISNULL(@_TableName, N'') = N'' RETURN; 	 	IF OBJECT_ID(@_TableName, N'U') IS NULL RETURN;  	DECLARE @_UpdateCmd NVarchar(4000), @_ColumnName Nvarchar(36) 	IF @_Type = N'U' 	BEGIN 		SET @_UpdateCmd = 'UPDATE ' + @_TableName + ' SET ' + NChar(13) 		 		DECLARE curColumns CURSOR FOR 			SELECT Name AS FieldName 				FROM sys.Columns 				WHERE Object_Id = Object_Id(@_TableName) 					AND Name NOT IN ('Id', 'TimeStamp', 'CreatedBy', 'CreatedAt') 		 		OPEN curColumns 		FETCH NEXT FROM curColumns INTO @_ColumnName 		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 		BEGIN 			SET @_UpdateCmd = @_UpdateCmd + '	' + 					@_ColumnName + ' = @' + @_ColumnName + ', ' + Nchar(13) 			FETCH NEXT FROM curColumns INTO @_ColumnName 		END 		CLOSE curColumns 		DEALLOCATE curColumns 		 		SET @_UpdateCmd = LEFT(@_UpdateCmd, LEN(@_UpdateCmd) - 3) 		SET @_UpdateCmd = @_UpdateCmd + NChar(13) + 'WHERE Id = @Id' 	END ELSE  	IF @_Type = N'I' 	BEGIN 		SET @_UpdateCmd =  			N'INSERT INTO ' + @_TableName  		 		SET @_UpdateCmd = @_UpdateCmd + NChar(13) + 			 N'(' + STUFF((SELECT N',' + Name  				FROM sys.Columns 					WHERE Object_Id = Object_Id(@_TableName) 						AND Name NOT IN ('Id', 'TimeStamp', 'CreatedBy', 'CreatedAt') 				FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, N'') + N')' + NChar(13) +  			 N'VALUES '+ NChar(13) + 			 N'(' + STUFF((SELECT N',@' + Name  				FROM sys.Columns 					WHERE Object_Id = Object_Id(@_TableName) 						AND Name NOT IN ('Id', 'TimeStamp', 'CreatedBy', 'CreatedAt') 				FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, N'') + N')'  	END	ELSE 	BEGIN 		SET @_UpdateCmd = STUFF((SELECT N',@' + Name  				FROM sys.Columns 					WHERE Object_Id = Object_Id(@_TableName)  				FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, N'') 	END	 	PRINT @_UpdateCmd END

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.sp_alterdiagram 	( 		@diagramname 	sysname, 		@owner_id	int	= null, 		@version 	int, 		@definition 	varbinary(max) 	) 	WITH EXECUTE AS 'dbo' 	AS 	BEGIN 		set nocount on 	 		declare @theId 			int 		declare @retval 		int 		declare @IsDbo 			int 		 		declare @UIDFound 		int 		declare @DiagId			int 		declare @ShouldChangeUID	int 	 		if(@diagramname is null) 		begin 			RAISERROR ('Invalid ARG', 16, 1) 			return -1 		end 	 		execute as caller; 		select @theId = DATABASE_PRINCIPAL_ID();	  		select @IsDbo = IS_MEMBER(N'db_owner');  		if(@owner_id is null) 			select @owner_id = @theId; 		revert; 	 		select @ShouldChangeUID = 0 		select @DiagId = diagram_id, @UIDFound = principal_id from dbo.sysdiagrams where principal_id = @owner_id and name = @diagramname  		 		if(@DiagId IS NULL or (@IsDbo = 0 and @theId <> @UIDFound)) 		begin 			RAISERROR ('Diagram does not exist or you do not have permission.', 16, 1); 			return -3 		end 	 		if(@IsDbo <> 0) 		begin 			if(@UIDFound is null or USER_NAME(@UIDFound) is null) -- invalid principal_id 			begin 				select @ShouldChangeUID = 1 ; 			end 		end  		-- update dds data			 		update dbo.sysdiagrams set definition = @definition where diagram_id = @DiagId ;  		-- change owner 		if(@ShouldChangeUID = 1) 			update dbo.sysdiagrams set principal_id = @theId where diagram_id = @DiagId ;  		-- update dds version 		if(@version is not null) 			update dbo.sysdiagrams set version = @version where diagram_id = @DiagId ;  		return 0 	END
