CUSTOMER FACTORY FILTER     -------------------------------------------------------------------------     CREATE TABLE #CustomerFactory     (         NhaMay nvarchar(200) NOT NULL             PRIMARY KEY     );      IF @CustomerNo = N'100001'     BEGIN         INSERT INTO #CustomerFactory         (             NhaMay         )         VALUES             (N'HON DA - VIET NAM(NHA MAY VP)'),             (N'HON DA - VIET NAM(NHA MAY HN)');     END     ELSE     BEGIN         INSERT INTO #CustomerFactory         (             NhaMay         )         VALUES             (N'YAMAHA - VIET NAM');     END;       -------------------------------------------------------------------------     -- 4. DELIVERY SOURCE     --     -- Normalize:     --     -- 01     -> 1     -- 001    -> 1     -- 0001   -> 1     -- J0663  -> J0663     -- 0J0663 -> J0663     --     -- KHÔNG TRY_CONVERT(INT)     -------------------------------------------------------------------------     ;WITH DeliverySource AS     (         SELECT             P.STT,             P.CUA,             P.TRUYEN,             P.MAHANG,             P.TENHANG,             P.LOT,             P.DV,             P.SOLUONG,             P.NGAYGIAO,             P.GIOGIAO,             P.STATUS,             P.TTPHIEU,             P.NHAMAY,             P.GIOGIAOFCC,             P.GearYMVN,             P.HOP,             P.STATUSDOC,             P.Note,             P.TGLUU,             P.PO_NO,             P.PO_ITEM,              NormalizedGioGiao =                 CASE                     WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(P.GIOGIAO)), N'') IS NULL                         THEN NULL                      WHEN PATINDEX                     (                         N'%[^0]%',                         LTRIM(RTRIM(P.GIOGIAO))                     ) = 0                         THEN N'0'                      ELSE SUBSTRING                     (                         LTRIM(RTRIM(P.GIOGIAO)),                         PATINDEX                         (                             N'%[^0]%',                             LTRIM(RTRIM(P.GIOGIAO))                         ),                         LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(P.GIOGIAO)))                     )                 END          FROM dbo.LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG P          INNER JOIN #CustomerFactory CF             ON CF.NhaMay = P.NHAMAY          WHERE P.NGAYGIAO >= @FromDate           AND P.NGAYGIAO < DATEADD(DAY, 1, @ToDate)     ),      -------------------------------------------------------------------------     -- 5. QR SOURCE     -------------------------------------------------------------------------     QrSource AS     (         SELECT             D.LOTFCC,             D.MAHANGFCC,             D.SLTEMFCC,              D.LOTHVN,             D.MAHANGHVN,             D.SLTEMHVN,              D.STATUS,             D.MAFCC,             D.STT,             D.KETQUA,              D.NGAYXUAT,             D.GIOXUAT,             D.NHAMAY,             D.GIOGIAO,              D.TGLUU,             D.TGLuuDuLieu,              NormalizedGioGiao =                 CASE                     WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(D.GIOGIAO)), N'') IS NULL                         THEN NULL                      WHEN PATINDEX                     (                         N'%[^0]%',                         LTRIM(RTRIM(D.GIOGIAO))                     ) = 0                         THEN N'0'                      ELSE SUBSTRING                     (                         LTRIM(RTRIM(D.GIOGIAO)),                         PATINDEX                         (                             N'%[^0]%',                             LTRIM(RTRIM(D.GIOGIAO))                         ),                         LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(D.GIOGIAO)))                     )                 END          FROM dbo.LUUDOCQRCODE D     ),      -------------------------------------------------------------------------     -- 6. MATCH DELIVERY <-> QR     --     -- Common:     --     -- D.NHAMAY      = P.NHAMAY     -- D.MAHANGFCC   = P.MAHANG     -- D.NGAYXUAT    = P.NGAYGIAO     --     -- Honda:     -- D.GIOXUAT     = P.GIOGIAOFCC     --     -- Yamaha:     -- Normalize(D.GIOGIAO) = Normalize(P.CUA)     -------------------------------------------------------------------------     DeliveryMatched AS     (         SELECT             @CustomerNo AS CustomerNo,              @CustomerDisplayName AS CustomerName,              P.NHAMAY AS Factory,              P.STT AS PhieuSTT,              P.CUA,             P.TRUYEN,              P.MAHANG,             P.TENHANG,             P.LOT AS DeliveryLot,              P.DV,             P.SOLUONG AS DeliveryQuantity,              P.NGAYGIAO,             P.GIOGIAO,             P.GIOGIAOFCC,              P.GearYMVN,             P.HOP,              P.STATUS AS DeliveryStatus,             P.TTPHIEU,             P.STATUSDOC,             P.Note,              P.PO_NO,             P.PO_ITEM,              D.STT AS QrSTT,              D.MAFCC,              D.LOTFCC,             D.MAHANGFCC,             D.SLTEMFCC,              D.LOTHVN,             D.MAHANGHVN,             D.SLTEMHVN,              D.KETQUA AS QrKetQua,              D.NGAYXUAT,             D.GIOXUAT,             D.GIOGIAO AS QrGioGiao,              CONCAT             (                 P.NHAMAY,                 N'|',                 CONVERT(char(8), P.NGAYGIAO, 112),                 N'|',                 ISNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM(P.GIOGIAOFCC)), N''),                 N'|',                 ISNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM(P.CUA)), N''),                 N'|',                 CONVERT(nvarchar(50), P.SOLUONG)             ) AS DeliveryKey,              CASE                 WHEN @CustomerNo = N'100002'                     THEN N'YAMAHA: GIOGIAO = CUA'                 ELSE                     N'HONDA: GIOXUAT = GIOGIAOFCC'             END AS MatchType          FROM DeliverySource P          INNER JOIN QrSource D             ON D.NHAMAY = P.NHAMAY             AND D.MAHANGFCC = P.MAHANG             AND D.NGAYXUAT = P.NGAYGIAO             AND            (                 (                     @CustomerNo <> N'100002'                      AND                     LTRIM(RTRIM(D.GIOXUAT))                         =                     LTRIM(RTRIM(P.GIOGIAOFCC))                 )                  OR                  (                     @CustomerNo = N'100002'                      AND                     D.NormalizedGioGiao                         =                     P.NormalizedGioGiao                 )            )     )      -------------------------------------------------------------------------     -- 7. MATERIALIZE DELIVERY EVIDENCE     --     -- Không dùng CTE DeliveryMatched cho các statement phía sau.     -------------------------------------------------------------------------     SELECT         *     INTO #DeliveryEvidence     FROM DeliveryMatched;       -------------------------------------------------------------------------     -- 8. INDEX     -------------------------------------------------------------------------     CREATE INDEX IX_DeliveryEvidence_QrSTT         ON #DeliveryEvidence(QrSTT);      CREATE INDEX IX_DeliveryEvidence_LotFCC         ON #DeliveryEvidence(LOTFCC);      CREATE INDEX IX_DeliveryEvidence_LotHVN         ON #DeliveryEvidence(LOTHVN);      CREATE INDEX IX_DeliveryEvidence_Item         ON #DeliveryEvidence(MAHANG);       -------------------------------------------------------------------------     -- RESULT SET #1     --     -- DELIVERY EVIDENCE     -------------------------------------------------------------------------     SELECT         CustomerNo,         CustomerName,         Factory,          DeliveryKey,          PhieuSTT,         CUA,         TRUYEN,          MAHANG,         TENHANG,         DeliveryLot,          DV,         DeliveryQuantity,          NGAYGIAO,         GIOGIAO,         GIOGIAOFCC,          GearYMVN,         HOP,          DeliveryStatus,         TTPHIEU,         STATUSDOC,         Note,          PO_NO,         PO_ITEM,          QrSTT,         MAFCC,          LOTFCC,         MAHANGFCC,         SLTEMFCC,          LOTHVN,         MAHANGHVN,         SLTEMHVN,          QrKetQua,          NGAYXUAT,         GIOXUAT,         QrGioGiao,          MatchType      FROM #DeliveryEvidence      ORDER BY         NGAYGIAO,         Factory,         MAHANG,         PhieuSTT,         QrSTT;       -------------------------------------------------------------------------     -- 9. DELIVERY LOTS     --     -- Một dòng QR có thể có:     --     -- LOTFCC =     --     -- LotA-160,     -- LotB-30,     -- LotC-160     --     -- Phải tách thành:     --     -- LotA     -- LotB     -- LotC     --     -- Lot13 = LEFT(token, 13)     --     -- KHÔNG dùng PRIMARY KEY chứa nullable columns.     -------------------------------------------------------------------------     CREATE TABLE #DeliveryLots     (         Lot13 nvarchar(13) NOT NULL,          ItemCode nvarchar(100) NULL,          CustomerNo nvarchar(20) NOT NULL,          CustomerName nvarchar(200) NOT NULL,          Factory nvarchar(200) NULL,          DeliveryKey nvarchar(500) NULL,          DeliveryQuantity int NULL,          NgayGiao date NULL,          PhieuSTT smallint NULL,          QrSTT smallint NULL     );       -------------------------------------------------------------------------     -- 10. SPLIT LOTFCC     -------------------------------------------------------------------------     ;WITH DeliveryLotSource AS     (         SELECT             D.CustomerNo,             D.CustomerName,             D.Factory,             D.DeliveryKey,             D.DeliveryQuantity,             D.NGAYGIAO,             D.PhieuSTT,             D.QrSTT,             D.MAHANG AS ItemCode,             D.LOTFCC AS LotList          FROM #DeliveryEvidence D          WHERE NULLIF         (             LTRIM(RTRIM(D.LOTFCC)),             N''         ) IS NOT NULL          UNION ALL          ---------------------------------------------------------------------         -- 11. SPLIT LOTHVN         ---------------------------------------------------------------------         SELECT             D.CustomerNo,             D.CustomerName,             D.Factory,             D.DeliveryKey,             D.DeliveryQuantity,             D.NGAYGIAO,             D.PhieuSTT,             D.QrSTT,             D.MAHANG AS ItemCode,             D.LOTHVN AS LotList          FROM #DeliveryEvidence D          WHERE NULLIF         (             LTRIM(RTRIM(D.LOTHVN)),             N''         ) IS NOT NULL     ),      DeliveryLotTokens AS     (         SELECT             S.CustomerNo,             S.CustomerName,             S.Factory,             S.DeliveryKey,             S.DeliveryQuantity,             S.NGAYGIAO,             S.PhieuSTT,             S.QrSTT,             S.ItemCode,              LTRIM(RTRIM(SS.value)) AS LotToken          FROM DeliveryLotSource S          CROSS APPLY STRING_SPLIT         (             S.LotList,             N','         ) SS          WHERE NULLIF         (             LTRIM(RTRIM(SS.value)),             N''         ) IS NOT NULL     )      INSERT INTO #DeliveryLots     (         Lot13,         ItemCode,         CustomerNo,         CustomerName,         Factory,         DeliveryKey,         DeliveryQuantity,         NgayGiao,         PhieuSTT,         QrSTT     )     SELECT DISTINCT          LEFT(LotToken, 13) AS Lot13,          ItemCode,          CustomerNo,         CustomerName,         Factory,          DeliveryKey,          DeliveryQuantity,          NGAYGIAO,          PhieuSTT,         QrSTT      FROM DeliveryLotTokens      WHERE LEN(LotToken) >= 13;       -------------------------------------------------------------------------     -- 12. INDEX DELIVERY LOT     -------------------------------------------------------------------------     CREATE INDEX IX_DeliveryLots_Lot13         ON #DeliveryLots(Lot13);      CREATE INDEX IX_DeliveryLots_ItemCode         ON #DeliveryLots(ItemCode);       -------------------------------------------------------------------------     -- 13. STOCK HISTORY -> LOT13 MOVEMENT     -------------------------------------------------------------------------     CREATE TABLE #StockLotMovement     (         StockHistoryId bigint NOT NULL,          Lot13 nvarchar(13) NOT NULL,          SlotId int NULL,          FromSlotId int NULL,          ToSlotId int NULL,          ActionType nvarchar(100) NULL,          MovementQuantity int NULL,          MovementDate datetime NULL,          ItemCode nvarchar(100) NULL,          TemCode nvarchar(500) NULL,          MaPhieu nvarchar(100) NULL,          PerformedBy nvarchar(200) NULL,          QrData nvarchar(max) NULL     );       -------------------------------------------------------------------------     -- 14. STOCK HISTORY LOT SPLIT     -------------------------------------------------------------------------     ;WITH SHBase AS     (         SELECT             SH.Id,             SH.ActionType,             SH.ItemCode,             SH.TemCode,             SH.LotNo,             SH.Quantity,             SH.Date,             SH.SlotId,             SH.PerformedBy,             SH.QrData,             SH.MaPhieu,             SH.FromSlotId,             SH.ToSlotId          FROM dbo.StockHistory SH          WHERE NULLIF         (             LTRIM(RTRIM(SH.LotNo)),             N''         ) IS NOT NULL     ),      SplitLot AS     (         SELECT             SH.*,              LTRIM(RTRIM(SS.value)) AS LotToken          FROM SHBase SH          CROSS APPLY STRING_SPLIT         (             SH.LotNo,             N','         ) SS          WHERE NULLIF         (             LTRIM(RTRIM(SS.value)),             N''         ) IS NOT NULL     ),      Parsed AS     (         SELECT             S.*,              LEFT             (                 S.LotToken,                 13             ) AS LotRaw,              CASE                 WHEN CHARINDEX(N'-', S.LotToken) > 13                 THEN                     SUBSTRING                     (                         S.LotToken,                         CHARINDEX(N'-', S.LotToken) + 1,                         LEN(S.LotToken)                     )                 ELSE NULL             END AS QuantitySuffix          FROM SplitLot S     ),      ParsedQuantity AS     (         SELECT             P.*,              CASE                  -----------------------------------------------------------------                 -- LOT-160                 -----------------------------------------------------------------                 WHEN P.QuantitySuffix IS NOT NULL                       AND P.QuantitySuffix <> N''                       AND P.QuantitySuffix NOT LIKE N'%[^0-9]%'                  THEN TRY_CONVERT                 (                     int,                     P.QuantitySuffix                 )                  -----------------------------------------------------------------                 -- Chỉ có đúng một LOT trong StockHistory                 -----------------------------------------------------------------                 WHEN P.LotToken NOT LIKE N'%,%'                       AND P.Quantity IS NOT NULL                  THEN P.Quantity                  -----------------------------------------------------------------                 -- Nhiều LOT nhưng không có quantity suffix:                 -- Không được chia Quantity một cách võ đoán.                 -----------------------------------------------------------------                 ELSE NULL              END AS MovementQty          FROM Parsed P     )      INSERT INTO #StockLotMovement     (         StockHistoryId,         Lot13,          SlotId,         FromSlotId,         ToSlotId,          ActionType,          MovementQuantity,          MovementDate,          ItemCode,         TemCode,          MaPhieu,         PerformedBy,          QrData     )      SELECT         Id,          LotRaw,          SlotId,         FromSlotId,         ToSlotId,          ActionType,          MovementQty,          Date,          ItemCode,         TemCode,          MaPhieu,         PerformedBy,          QrData      FROM ParsedQuantity      WHERE LEN(LotRaw) = 13;       -------------------------------------------------------------------------     -- 15. INDEX STOCK MOVEMENT     -------------------------------------------------------------------------     CREATE INDEX IX_StockLotMovement_Lot13         ON #StockLotMovement(Lot13);      CREATE INDEX IX_StockLotMovement_SlotId         ON #StockLotMovement(SlotId);      CREATE INDEX IX_StockLotMovement_FromSlotId         ON #StockLotMovement(FromSlotId);      CREATE INDEX IX_StockLotMovement_ToSlotId         ON #StockLotMovement(ToSlotId);       -------------------------------------------------------------------------     -- RESULT SET #2     --     -- LOT LOCATION SUMMARY     --     -- Lot13 có thể có nhiều Slot.     --     -- StockHistory     --      ↓     -- Slot     --      ↓     -- Rack     --      ↓     -- Warehouse     -------------------------------------------------------------------------     ;WITH LotSlots AS     (         SELECT              SLM.Lot13,              SLM.SlotId,              SUM             (                 CASE                      -----------------------------------------------------------------                     -- IMPORT / NHẬP                     -----------------------------------------------------------------                     WHEN                         SLM.ActionType IN                         (                             N'Import',                             N'Nhap',                             N'Nhập',                             N'Put',                             N'PutAway'                         )                          AND                         (                             SLM.ToSlotId IS NULL                             OR SLM.ToSlotId = SLM.SlotId                         )                      THEN ISNULL                     (                         SLM.MovementQuantity,                         0                     )                      -----------------------------------------------------------------                     -- EXPORT / XUẤT                     -----------------------------------------------------------------                     WHEN                         SLM.ActionType IN                         (                             N'Export',                             N'Xuat',                             N'Xuất',                             N'Remove'                         )                          AND                         (                             SLM.FromSlotId IS NULL                             OR SLM.FromSlotId = SLM.SlotId                         )                      THEN -ISNULL                     (                         SLM.MovementQuantity,                         0                     )                      ELSE 0                  END             ) AS EstimatedQuantity          FROM #StockLotMovement SLM          WHERE SLM.SlotId IS NOT NULL          GROUP BY             SLM.Lot13,             SLM.SlotId     )      SELECT          LS.Lot13,          LS.SlotId,          W.WarehouseId,         W.Name AS WarehouseName,          R.RackId,         R.RackName,          R.RackRowCount,         R.ColumnCount,          S.SlotNumber,          S.IsOccupied,          S.ItemCode AS SlotItemCode,          S.LotNo AS SlotLotNo,          S.Quantity AS SlotQuantity,          S.ImportDate AS SlotImportDate,          S.TemCode AS SlotTemCode,          S.Capacity AS SlotCapacity,          S.RowIndex,         S.ColumnIndex,          LS.EstimatedQuantity,          CASE              WHEN LS.EstimatedQuantity > 0                 THEN N'ESTIMATED'              WHEN S.IsOccupied = 1                 THEN N'SLOT_OCCUPIED'              ELSE                 N'HISTORY_ONLY'          END AS LocationStatus      FROM LotSlots LS      LEFT JOIN dbo.Slot S         ON S.SlotId = LS.SlotId      LEFT JOIN dbo.Rack R         ON R.RackId = S.RackId      LEFT JOIN dbo.Warehouse W         ON W.WarehouseId = R.WarehouseId      INNER JOIN     (         SELECT DISTINCT Lot13         FROM #DeliveryLots     ) DL         ON DL.Lot13 = LS.Lot13      WHERE         LS.EstimatedQuantity <> 0          OR          S.IsOccupied = 1      ORDER BY          LS.Lot13,          W.Name,          R.RackName,          S.SlotNumber;       -------------------------------------------------------------------------     -- RESULT SET #3     --     -- LOT MOVEMENT HISTORY     -------------------------------------------------------------------------     SELECT          SLM.StockHistoryId,          SLM.Lot13,          SLM.ActionType,          SLM.MovementQuantity,          SLM.MovementDate,          SLM.ItemCode,          SLM.TemCode,          SLM.MaPhieu,          SLM.PerformedBy,          SLM.SlotId,          SLM.FromSlotId,          SLM.ToSlotId,          ---------------------------------------------------------------------         -- FROM LOCATION         ---------------------------------------------------------------------         FromWarehouse.Name AS FromWarehouseName,          FromRack.RackName AS FromRackName,          FromSlot.SlotNumber AS FromSlotNumber,          ---------------------------------------------------------------------         -- TO LOCATION         ---------------------------------------------------------------------         ToWarehouse.Name AS ToWarehouseName,          ToRack.RackName AS ToRackName,          ToSlot.SlotNumber AS ToSlotNumber,          ---------------------------------------------------------------------         -- CURRENT/HISTORY SLOT         ---------------------------------------------------------------------         CurrentWarehouse.Name AS CurrentWarehouseName,          CurrentRack.RackName AS CurrentRackName,          CurrentSlot.SlotNumber AS CurrentSlotNumber,          SLM.QrData      FROM #StockLotMovement SLM      INNER JOIN     (         SELECT DISTINCT Lot13         FROM #DeliveryLots     ) DL         ON DL.Lot13 = SLM.Lot13      -------------------------------------------------------------------------     -- FROM     -------------------------------------------------------------------------     LEFT JOIN dbo.Slot FromSlot         ON FromSlot.SlotId = SLM.FromSlotId      LEFT JOIN dbo.Rack FromRack         ON FromRack.RackId = FromSlot.RackId      LEFT JOIN dbo.Warehouse FromWarehouse         ON FromWarehouse.WarehouseId = FromRack.WarehouseId      -------------------------------------------------------------------------     -- TO     -------------------------------------------------------------------------     LEFT JOIN dbo.Slot ToSlot         ON ToSlot.SlotId = SLM.ToSlotId      LEFT JOIN dbo.Rack ToRack         ON ToRack.RackId = ToSlot.RackId      LEFT JOIN dbo.Warehouse ToWarehouse         ON ToWarehouse.WarehouseId = ToRack.WarehouseId      -------------------------------------------------------------------------     -- CURRENT/HISTORY SLOT     -------------------------------------------------------------------------     LEFT JOIN dbo.Slot CurrentSlot         ON CurrentSlot.SlotId = SLM.SlotId      LEFT JOIN dbo.Rack CurrentRack         ON CurrentRack.RackId = CurrentSlot.RackId      LEFT JOIN dbo.Warehouse CurrentWarehouse         ON CurrentWarehouse.WarehouseId = CurrentRack.WarehouseId      ORDER BY          SLM.Lot13,          SLM.MovementDate,          SLM.StockHistoryId;       -------------------------------------------------------------------------     -- RESULT SET #4     --     -- PENDING DELIVERY EVIDENCE     --     -- Chỉ dùng các field đã xác nhận tồn tại trong StockHistory.     -- Không tự đoán schema FVN_HangChoGiao.     -------------------------------------------------------------------------     ;WITH Pending AS     (         SELECT              SLM.Lot13,              SLM.MaPhieu,              MAX             (                 SLM.MovementDate             ) AS LastMovementDate,              SUM             (                 CASE                      WHEN                         SLM.ActionType IN                         (                             N'Import',                             N'Nhap',                             N'Nhập',                             N'Put',                             N'PutAway'                         )                      THEN ISNULL                     (                         SLM.MovementQuantity,                         0                     )                      WHEN                         SLM.ActionType IN                         (                             N'Export',                             N'Xuat',                             N'Xuất',                             N'Remove'                         )                      THEN -ISNULL                     (                         SLM.MovementQuantity,                         0                     )                      ELSE 0                  END             ) AS EstimatedQuantity,              MAX             (                 SLM.SlotId             ) AS LastSlotId          FROM #StockLotMovement SLM          INNER JOIN         (             SELECT DISTINCT Lot13             FROM #DeliveryLots         ) DL             ON DL.Lot13 = SLM.Lot13          WHERE NULLIF         (             LTRIM(RTRIM(SLM.MaPhieu)),             N''         ) IS NOT NULL          GROUP BY              SLM.Lot13,              SLM.MaPhieu     )      SELECT          P.Lot13,          P.MaPhieu,          P.LastMovementDate,          P.EstimatedQuantity,          P.LastSlotId,          W.WarehouseId,          W.Name AS WarehouseName,          R.RackId,          R.RackName,          S.SlotNumber,          CASE              WHEN P.EstimatedQuantity > 0                 THEN N'PENDING_EVIDENCE'              ELSE                 N'NO_REMAINING_ESTIMATED_QTY'          END AS PendingStatus      FROM Pending P      LEFT JOIN dbo.Slot S         ON S.SlotId = P.LastSlotId      LEFT JOIN dbo.Rack R         ON R.RackId = S.RackId      LEFT JOIN dbo.Warehouse W         ON W.WarehouseId = R.WarehouseId      ORDER BY          P.Lot13,          P.LastMovementDate DESC,          P.MaPhieu;  END

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.sp_creatediagram 	( 		@diagramname 	sysname, 		@owner_id		int	= null, 	 		@version 		int, 		@definition 	varbinary(max) 	) 	WITH EXECUTE AS 'dbo' 	AS 	BEGIN 		set nocount on 	 		declare @theId int 		declare @retval int 		declare @IsDbo	int 		declare @userName sysname 		if(@version is null or @diagramname is null) 		begin 			RAISERROR (N'E_INVALIDARG', 16, 1); 			return -1 		end 	 		execute as caller; 		select @theId = DATABASE_PRINCIPAL_ID();  		select @IsDbo = IS_MEMBER(N'db_owner'); 		revert;  		 		if @owner_id is null 		begin 			select @owner_id = @theId; 		end 		else 		begin 			if @theId <> @owner_id 			begin 				if @IsDbo = 0 				begin 					RAISERROR (N'E_INVALIDARG', 16, 1); 					return -1 				end 				select @theId = @owner_id 			end 		end 		-- next 2 line only for test, will be removed after define name unique 		if EXISTS(select diagram_id from dbo.sysdiagrams where principal_id = @theId and name = @diagramname) 		begin 			RAISERROR ('The name is already used.', 16, 1); 			return -2 		end 	 		insert into dbo.sysdiagrams(name, principal_id , version, definition) 				VALUES(@diagramname, @theId, @version, @definition) ; 		 		select @retval = @@IDENTITY  		return @retval 	END

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.sp_dropdiagram 	( 		@diagramname 	sysname, 		@owner_id	int	= null 	) 	WITH EXECUTE AS 'dbo' 	AS 	BEGIN 		set nocount on 		declare @theId 			int 		declare @IsDbo 			int 		 		declare @UIDFound 		int 		declare @DiagId			int 	 		if(@diagramname is null) 		begin 			RAISERROR ('Invalid value', 16, 1); 			return -1 		end 	 		EXECUTE AS CALLER; 		select @theId = DATABASE_PRINCIPAL_ID(); 		select @IsDbo = IS_MEMBER(N'db_owner');  		if(@owner_id is null) 			select @owner_id = @theId; 		REVERT;  		 		select @DiagId = diagram_id, @UIDFound = principal_id from dbo.sysdiagrams where principal_id = @owner_id and name = @diagramname  		if(@DiagId IS NULL or (@IsDbo = 0 and @UIDFound <> @theId)) 		begin 			RAISERROR ('Diagram does not exist or you do not have permission.', 16, 1) 			return -3 		end 	 		delete from dbo.sysdiagrams where diagram_id = @DiagId; 	 		return 0; 	END

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_GetCurrentStockStatus] AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;      /*       Match physical LOT identity consistently with delivery confirmation:       full LOT (>13 chars) matches exactly; a 13-character root is accepted       only when it maps to one physical LOT. Multiple slot allocations for the       same physical LOT remain separate location rows.        Every LOT with SLCONLAI > 0 is always reported: the rows of one LOT add up       to STOCKTP.SLCONLAI. Quantity that is not covered by an active SlotLot row       (legacy / imported stock, or a partial put-away) is reported as one extra       row with LocationCode = N'Chua gan slot' so the report never silently       drops location information.        QrData is the full QR of the SlotLot row (falls back to the TemCode when       the QR text was not stored).     */     ;WITH StockLotKeys AS     (         SELECT             LEFT(RTRIM(LOT), 13) AS LotKey,             COUNT(DISTINCT RTRIM(LOT)) AS PhysicalLotCount         FROM dbo.STOCKTP         GROUP BY LEFT(RTRIM(LOT), 13)     ),     Slotted AS     (         SELECT             stp.LOT AS StockLot,             sl.ItemCode AS SlotItemCode,             sl.Quantity AS SlotQuantity,             sl.ImportDate AS SlotImportDate,             sl.MaPhieu AS SlotMaPhieu,             ISNULL(NULLIF(sl.QrData, N''), sl.TemCode) AS SlotQr,             CASE WHEN s.SlotId IS NOT NULL                  THEN w.Name + N'-' + r.RackName + N'-Slot' + CAST(s.SlotNumber AS NVARCHAR(20))                  ELSE NULL END AS SlotLocation,             r.RackName AS RackName,             s.SlotNumber AS SlotNumber,             w.Name AS WarehouseName         FROM dbo.STOCKTP AS stp         LEFT JOIN StockLotKeys AS lk             ON lk.LotKey = LEFT(RTRIM(stp.LOT), 13)         INNER JOIN dbo.SlotLot AS sl             ON sl.PhieuStatus = 0            AND            (                 (LEN(RTRIM(stp.LOT)) > 13 AND RTRIM(sl.LotNo) = RTRIM(stp.LOT))                 OR                 (LEN(RTRIM(stp.LOT)) <= 13                  AND lk.PhysicalLotCount = 1                  AND LEFT(RTRIM(sl.LotNo), 13) = LEFT(RTRIM(stp.LOT), 13))            )         LEFT JOIN dbo.Slot AS s ON s.SlotId = sl.SlotId         LEFT JOIN dbo.Rack AS r ON r.RackId = s.RackId         LEFT JOIN dbo.Warehouse AS w ON w.WarehouseId = r.WarehouseId         WHERE ISNULL(stp.SLCONLAI, 0) > 0     ),     SlottedTotal AS     (         SELECT StockLot, SUM(SlotQuantity) AS SlotQty         FROM Slotted         GROUP BY StockLot     )     SELECT         u.ItemCode,         u.LotNo,         u.QrData,         u.Quantity,         u.LocationCode,         u.Status,         u.ItemName,         u.Model,         u.NgaySX,         u.CaSX,         u.SlSanXuat,         u.SlDaNhap,         u.SlDaXuat,         u.SlTonLot,         u.NgayNhap,         u.NgayXuat,         u.SlotImportDate,         u.SlotMaPhieu     FROM     (         SELECT             ISNULL(sd.SlotItemCode, stp.PART) AS ItemCode,             stp.LOT AS LotNo,             sd.SlotQr AS QrData,             sd.SlotQuantity AS Quantity,             sd.SlotLocation AS LocationCode,             CASE WHEN stp.SATUS = 1 THEN N'Da ket thuc' ELSE N'Dang mo' END AS Status,             stp.NAME AS ItemName,             stp.MODEL AS Model,             stp.NGAYSX AS NgaySX,             stp.CASX AS CaSX,             stp.SLSX AS SlSanXuat,             stp.SLNHAP AS SlDaNhap,             stp.SLXUAT AS SlDaXuat,             stp.SLCONLAI AS SlTonLot,             stp.NGAYNHAP AS NgayNhap,             stp.NGAYXUAT AS NgayXuat,             sd.SlotImportDate AS SlotImportDate,             sd.SlotMaPhieu AS SlotMaPhieu,             sd.WarehouseName AS SortWarehouse,             sd.RackName AS SortRack,             sd.SlotNumber AS SortSlot         FROM dbo.STOCKTP AS stp         INNER JOIN Slotted AS sd ON sd.StockLot = stp.LOT         WHERE ISNULL(stp.SLCONLAI, 0) > 0          UNION ALL          SELECT             stp.PART AS ItemCode,             stp.LOT AS LotNo,             CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(MAX)) AS QrData,             stp.SLCONLAI - ISNULL(st.SlotQty, 0) AS Quantity,             N'Chua gan slot' AS LocationCode,             CASE WHEN stp.SATUS = 1 THEN N'Da ket thuc' ELSE N'Dang mo' END AS Status,             stp.NAME AS ItemName,             stp.MODEL AS Model,             stp.NGAYSX AS NgaySX,             stp.CASX AS CaSX,             stp.SLSX AS SlSanXuat,             stp.SLNHAP AS SlDaNhap,             stp.SLXUAT AS SlDaXuat,             stp.SLCONLAI AS SlTonLot,             stp.NGAYNHAP AS NgayNhap,             stp.NGAYXUAT AS NgayXuat,             CAST(NULL AS DATETIME) AS SlotImportDate,             CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(100)) AS SlotMaPhieu,             N'~' AS SortWarehouse,             N'~' AS SortRack,             2147483647 AS SortSlot         FROM dbo.STOCKTP AS stp         LEFT JOIN SlottedTotal AS st ON st.StockLot = stp.LOT         WHERE ISNULL(stp.SLCONLAI, 0) > 0           AND stp.SLCONLAI - ISNULL(st.SlotQty, 0) > 0     ) AS u     ORDER BY u.LotNo, u.SortWarehouse, u.SortRack, u.SortSlot; END;

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_GetStockHistory]     @FromDate DATETIME = NULL,     @ToDate DATETIME = NULL,     @ItemCode NVARCHAR(100) = NULL AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;      SELECT          SH.Id,         SH.ActionType,         SH.ItemCode,         SH.TemCode,         SH.LotNo,         SH.Quantity,         SH.Date,         SH.SlotId,         WH.Name as whName,         R.RackName,         S.SlotNumber,         SH.PerformedBy     FROM          StockHistory SH     LEFT JOIN          Slot S ON SH.SlotId = S.SlotId     LEFT JOIN          Rack R ON S.RackId = R.RackId     LEFT JOIN          Warehouse WH ON R.WarehouseId = WH.WarehouseId     WHERE          (@FromDate IS NULL OR SH.Date >= @FromDate) AND         (@ToDate IS NULL OR SH.Date <= @ToDate) AND         (@ItemCode IS NULL OR SH.ItemCode = @ItemCode)     ORDER BY          SH.Date DESC END

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.sp_helpdiagramdefinition 	( 		@diagramname 	sysname, 		@owner_id	int	= null 		 	) 	WITH EXECUTE AS N'dbo' 	AS 	BEGIN 		set nocount on  		declare @theId 		int 		declare @IsDbo 		int 		declare @DiagId		int 		declare @UIDFound	int 	 		if(@diagramname is null) 		begin 			RAISERROR (N'E_INVALIDARG', 16, 1); 			return -1 		end 	 		execute as caller; 		select @theId = DATABASE_PRINCIPAL_ID(); 		select @IsDbo = IS_MEMBER(N'db_owner'); 		if(@owner_id is null) 			select @owner_id = @theId; 		revert;  	 		select @DiagId = diagram_id, @UIDFound = principal_id from dbo.sysdiagrams where principal_id = @owner_id and name = @diagramname; 		if(@DiagId IS NULL or (@IsDbo = 0 and @UIDFound <> @theId )) 		begin 			RAISERROR ('Diagram does not exist or you do not have permission.', 16, 1); 			return -3 		end  		select version, definition FROM dbo.sysdiagrams where diagram_id = @DiagId ;  		return 0 	END

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.sp_helpdiagrams 	( 		@diagramname sysname = NULL, 		@owner_id int = NULL 	) 	WITH EXECUTE AS N'dbo' 	AS 	BEGIN 		DECLARE @user sysname 		DECLARE @dboLogin bit 		EXECUTE AS CALLER; 			SET @user = USER_NAME(); 			SET @dboLogin = CONVERT(bit,IS_MEMBER('db_owner')); 		REVERT; 		SELECT 			[Database] = DB_NAME(), 			[Name] = name, 			[ID] = diagram_id, 			[Owner] = USER_NAME(principal_id), 			[OwnerID] = principal_id 		FROM 			sysdiagrams 		WHERE 			(@dboLogin = 1 OR USER_NAME(principal_id) = @user) AND 			(@diagramname IS NULL OR name = @diagramname) AND 			(@owner_id IS NULL OR principal_id = @owner_id) 		ORDER BY 			4, 5, 1 	END

-- ============================================= -- Author:		Do Xuan Hoang -- Create date: 21/03/2013 -- Description: Bao cao chi tiet ket qua dao tao lay du lieu trong bang B30HrmTrainingPlan,  --B30HrmTrainingDetail, B20Employee -- ============================================= CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.Training_Detail_Report 	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here 	@_Ma_Dvcs NCHAR(3) = N'A02',  	@_Ngay_Ct1 SMALLDATETIME = 'Jan 11 2012', 	@_Ngay_Ct2 SMALLDATETIME = 'Jan 11 2013', 	@_DeptCode NVARCHAR(16) = N'' AS BEGIN 	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from 	-- interfering with SELECT statements. 	SET NOCOUNT ON; 	 	DECLARE @_Table_Template TABLE(SN INT,PlanNo NVARCHAR(16),EmployeeName NVARCHAR(254) , 		DESCRIPTIONS NVARCHAR(254),Complete NVARCHAR(96),Uncomplete NVARCHAR(96), 		ChagreByCompany Numeric(18,2),ChagreByEmployee Numeric(18,2) );  	DECLARE @_Table_Result TABLE(SN INT,EmployeeName NVARCHAR(254),Complete NVARCHAR(96), 		 Uncomplete NVARCHAR(96),ChagreByCompany Numeric(18,2),  		 ChagreByEmployee Numeric(18,2),_FormatStyleKey NVARCHAR(24));  	INSERT INTO @_Table_Template  			SELECT DENSE_RANK () OVER(ORDER BY o3.PlanNo DESC),o3.PlanNo,o1.Name ,o2.Description,  			CASE WHEN o2.IsFinished = 1 THEN N'Có' ELSE ' ' END, 			CASE WHEN o2.IsFinished = 0 THEN N'Không' ELSE ' ' END, 					o2.ChagrePaidByEmployer,o2.ChagrePaidByEmployee FROM B20Employee as o1 INNER JOIN  					B30HrmTrainingDetail as o2 						ON o1.Code = o2.EmployeeCode INNER JOIN B30HrmTrainingPlan as o3 						ON o2.RowId_HRMTRP = o3.RowId 					WHERE (o3.DeptCode =  @_DeptCode OR @_DeptCode = '') 						AND o3.BranchCode = @_Ma_Dvcs AND (o3.PlanDate BETWEEN @_Ngay_Ct1 AND @_Ngay_Ct2); 						 					DECLARE @_PlanNo_Number INT; 					SET @_PlanNo_Number = 0; 					DECLARE @_Row_Id INT; 					SET @_Row_Id = 0; 					 					SELECT @_PlanNo_Number = COUNT(DISTINCT PlanNo) FROM @_Table_Template; 					WHILE @_PlanNo_Number > =1  						BEGIN 							SET @_Row_Id = @_Row_Id + 1; 							DECLARE @_Complete INT; 							SET @_Complete = 0; 							DECLARE @_Uncomplete INT; 							SET @_Uncomplete = 0; 							SELECT  @_Complete = COUNT(SN) FROM @_Table_Template  									WHERE Complete = N'Có' AND SN = @_Row_Id; 							SELECT @_Uncomplete = COUNT(SN) FROM @_Table_Template 									WHERE Uncomplete = N'Không' AND SN = @_Row_Id;  							INSERT INTO @_Table_Result 							SELECT DISTINCT @_Row_Id,a.PlanNo+':'+a.Description,@_Complete,@_Uncomplete,  								b.TotalCompany, b.TotalEmployee, 'BOLD' FROM B30HrmTrainingPlan as a INNER JOIN 								(SELECT DISTINCT SN,PlanNo,SUM(ChagreByCompany) as 'TotalCompany', 								SUM(ChagreByEmployee) as 'TotalEmployee' 								FROM @_Table_Template WHERE SN = @_Row_Id 								GROUP BY SN,PlanNo) as b 								ON a.PlanNo = b.PlanNo 								 							INSERT INTO @_Table_Result  								SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY EmployeeName ),EmployeeName,Complete 								,Uncomplete,ChagreByCompany,ChagreByEmployee,'' FROM @_Table_Template 								WHERE SN = @_Row_Id; 								SET @_PlanNo_Number = @_PlanNo_Number - 1;				  						END		 						SELECT * FROM @_Table_Result  END

CREATE PROCEDURE [usp_B00Permission_CopyTo] 	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here 	@_PermissionDataSet xml = NULL -- chứa các bảng B00Permission, B00UserList, B00RoleList với cột Id 	,@_DeleteMode tinyint = 0 -- 0: sao chép các quyền, 1: xóa các quyền 	,@_UserId int = -1 -- Id của người dùng thực hiện 	,@_ApplicationCommandName varchar(50) = NULL AS BEGIN 	------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 	-- Hàm/thủ tục được tạo tự động bởi BravoTools nếu không tồn tại hoặc sẽ bị xóa 	-- và tạo lại nếu thực hiện "Cập nhật các hàm và thủ tục TSQL" trong BravoTools 	-- Sao chép hoặc xóa các quyền của một vai trò/người dùng cho các vai trò/người dùng khác 	------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 	 	SET NOCOUNT ON;  	DECLARE @docHandle int; 	EXEC sp_xml_preparedocument @docHandle OUTPUT, @_PermissionDataSet;  	DECLARE @i AS int; 	DECLARE @k AS varchar(24); 	DECLARE @k0 AS varchar(24); 	SET @i = CHARINDEX('|', @_ApplicationCommandName); 	SET @k = (CASE WHEN @i < 1  		THEN @_ApplicationCommandName ELSE RTRIM(LEFT(@_ApplicationCommandName, @i - 1)) END); 	SET @k0 = (CASE WHEN @i < 1  		THEN NULL ELSE RTRIM(RIGHT(@_ApplicationCommandName, LEN(@_ApplicationCommandName) - @i)) END);  	SET CONTEXT_INFO 0x55555; -- to bypass triggers 	 	IF @_DeleteMode = 1 	BEGIN 		DECLARE @count1 AS int, @count2 AS int, @permissionCount AS int; 		SET @permissionCount = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM OPENXML (@docHandle, '/NewDataSet/vB00Permission', 2) WITH (Id int, DataId int));  		-- Delete all rows have matched RoleId/UserId 		IF @permissionCount < 1 		BEGIN 			SELECT @count1 = COUNT(*) FROM B00Permission WHERE 				UserId IN (SELECT Id FROM OPENXML (@docHandle, '/NewDataSet/B00UserList', 2) WITH (Id int)); 			IF @count1 > 0 				DELETE FROM B00Permission WHERE 					UserId IN (SELECT Id FROM OPENXML (@docHandle, '/NewDataSet/B00UserList', 2) WITH (Id int))  			SELECT @count2 = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM B00Permission WHERE 				RoleId IN (SELECT Id FROM OPENXML (@docHandle, '/NewDataSet/B00RoleList', 2) WITH (Id int))); 			IF @count2 > 0 				DELETE FROM B00Permission WHERE 					RoleId IN (SELECT Id FROM OPENXML (@docHandle, '/NewDataSet/B00RoleList', 2) WITH (Id int)) 		END; 		ELSE 		-- Delete rows have matched RoleId/UserId and DataId 		BEGIN 			SELECT @count1 = COUNT(*) FROM B00Permission WHERE  				DataId IN (SELECT DataId FROM OPENXML (@docHandle, '/NewDataSet/vB00Permission', 2) WITH (Id int, DataId int)) AND 				UserId IN (SELECT Id FROM OPENXML (@docHandle, '/NewDataSet/B00UserList', 2) WITH (Id int)); 			IF @count1 > 0 				DELETE FROM B00Permission WHERE  					DataId IN (SELECT DataId FROM OPENXML (@docHandle, '/NewDataSet/vB00Permission', 2) WITH (DataId int)) AND 					UserId IN (SELECT Id FROM OPENXML (@docHandle, '/NewDataSet/B00UserList', 2) WITH (Id int)); 		 			SELECT @count2 = COUNT(*) FROM B00Permission WHERE  				DataId IN (SELECT DataId FROM OPENXML (@docHandle, '/NewDataSet/vB00Permission', 2) WITH (Id int, DataId int)) AND 				RoleId IN (SELECT Id FROM OPENXML (@docHandle, '/NewDataSet/B00RoleList', 2) WITH (Id int)); 			IF @count2 > 0 				DELETE FROM B00Permission WHERE  					DataId IN (SELECT DataId FROM OPENXML (@docHandle, '/NewDataSet/vB00Permission', 2) WITH (Id int, DataId int)) AND 					RoleId IN (SELECT Id FROM OPENXML (@docHandle, '/NewDataSet/B00RoleList', 2) WITH (Id int)); 		END;  		IF @count1 + @count2 > 0 			INSERT INTO B00EventLog (TableName, Command, LastValue, LastWriteBy, CommandKey, CommandKey0) 				VALUES ('B00Permission', 'BULK DELETE', LTRIM(STR(@count1 + @count2)) + ' row(s) deleted', @_UserId, @k, @k0); 	END; 	ELSE 	BEGIN 		DECLARE @CopyPermission TABLE 		( 			DataId int 			,RoleId int 			,UserId int 			,NoAddNew tinyint 			,NoEdit tinyint 			,NoEditDOU tinyint 			,NoDelete tinyint 			,NoDeleteDOU tinyint 			,NoRecall tinyint 			,NoRecallDOU tinyint 			,NoPrintOut tinyint 			,NoPrintOutDOU tinyint 			,NoOpen tinyint 			,NoOpenDOU tinyint 			,NoDisplay tinyint 			,NoInherit tinyint 			,CreatedBy int 		); 		 		INSERT INTO @CopyPermission SELECT  			p.DataId, r.Id, NULL, p.NoAddNew, p.NoEdit, p.NoEditDOU, p.NoDelete, p.NoDeleteDOU 				,p.NoRecall, p.NoRecallDOU, p.NoPrintOut, p.NoPrintOutDOU, p.NoOpen, p.NoOpenDOU 				,p.NoDisplay, p.NoInherit, @_UserId 			FROM B00Permission AS p CROSS JOIN 				(SELECT Id FROM OPENXML (@docHandle, '/NewDataSet/B00RoleList', 2) WITH (Id int)) AS r 			WHERE p.Id IN (SELECT Id FROM OPENXML (@docHandle, '/NewDataSet/vB00Permission', 2) WITH (Id int, DataId int)); 		 		INSERT INTO @CopyPermission SELECT  			p.DataId, NULL, u.Id, p.NoAddNew, p.NoEdit, p.NoEditDOU, p.NoDelete, p.NoDeleteDOU 				,p.NoRecall, p.NoRecallDOU, p.NoPrintOut, p.NoPrintOutDOU, p.NoOpen, p.NoOpenDOU 				,p.NoDisplay, p.NoInherit, @_UserId 			FROM B00Permission AS p CROSS JOIN 				(SELECT Id FROM OPENXML (@docHandle, '/NewDataSet/B00UserList', 2) WITH (Id int)) AS u 			WHERE p.Id IN (SELECT Id FROM OPENXML (@docHandle, '/NewDataSet/vB00Permission', 2) WITH (Id int, DataId int));  		DECLARE @count AS int; 		SELECT @count = COUNT(*) FROM B00Permission AS p INNER JOIN @CopyPermission AS t ON p.DataId = t.DataId AND  			ISNULL(p.RoleId, -1) = ISNULL(t.RoleId, -1) AND ISNULL(p.UserId, -1) = ISNULL(t.UserId, -1) 			WHERE ISNULL(t.RoleId, t.UserId) IS NOT NULL; 		IF @count > 0 		BEGIN 			DELETE B00Permission FROM B00Permission AS p INNER JOIN @CopyPermission AS t ON p.DataId = t.DataId AND  				ISNULL(p.RoleId, -1) = ISNULL(t.RoleId, -1) AND ISNULL(p.UserId, -1) = ISNULL(t.UserId, -1) 				WHERE ISNULL(t.RoleId, t.UserId) IS NOT NULL;   			INSERT INTO B00EventLog (TableName, Command, LastValue, LastWriteBy, CommandKey, CommandKey0) 				VALUES ('B00Permission', 'BULK DELETE', LTRIM(STR(@count1 + @count2)) + ' row(s) deleted', @_UserId, @k, @k0); 		END;  		SELECT @count = COUNT(*) FROM @CopyPermission WHERE ISNULL(RoleId, UserId) IS NOT NULL; 		IF @count > 0 		BEGIN 			INSERT INTO B00Permission (DataId, RoleId, UserId, NoAddNew, NoEdit, NoEditDOU, NoDelete, NoDeleteDOU 					,NoRecall, NoRecallDOU, NoPrintOut, NoPrintOutDOU, NoOpen, NoOpenDOU, NoDisplay, NoInherit, CreatedBy) 				(SELECT * FROM @CopyPermission WHERE ISNULL(RoleId, UserId) IS NOT NULL);  			INSERT INTO B00EventLog (TableName, Command, LastValue, LastWriteBy, CommandKey, CommandKey0) 				VALUES ('B00Permission', 'BULK INSERT', LTRIM(STR(@count1 + @count2)) + ' row(s) inserted', @_UserId, @k, @k0); 		END; 	END;  	EXEC sp_xml_removedocument @docHandle; END;

CREATE PROCEDURE [usp_B00Permission_FindMember] 	@_ParentCommandKey varchar(24) = '', 	@_SubCommandKey varchar(24) = '', 	@_TableName varchar(48) = '', 	@_ColumnName varchar(48) = '', 	@_FilterExpr nvarchar(128) = '' AS BEGIN 	------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 	-- Hàm/thủ tục được tạo tự động bởi BravoTools nếu không tồn tại hoặc sẽ bị xóa 	-- và tạo lại nếu thực hiện "Cập nhật các hàm và thủ tục TSQL" trong BravoTools 	-- Trả về dữ liệu để cập nhật phân quyền cho vai trò hoặc người sử dụng 	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------    	SET NOCOUNT ON;  	SELECT p.RoleId, p.UserId 			,MAX(p.NoAddNew) AS NoAddNew 			,MAX(p.NoEdit) AS NoEdit 			,MAX(p.NoEditDOU) AS NoEditDOU 			,MAX(p.NoDelete) AS NoDelete 			,MAX(p.NoDeleteDOU) AS NoDeleteDOU 			,MAX(p.NoRecall) AS NoRecall 			,MAX(p.NoRecallDOU) AS NoRecallDOU 			,MAX(p.NoPrintOut) AS NoPrintOut 			,MAX(p.NoPrintOutDOU) AS NoPrintOutDOU 			,MAX(p.NoOpen) AS NoOpen 			,MAX(p.NoOpenDOU) AS NoOpenDOU 			,MAX(p.NoDisplay) AS NoDisplay 			,MAX(p.NoInherit) AS NoInherit 			,CAST(MAX(ISNULL(LTRIM(u.FullName + ' (' + u.UserName + ')'), r.RoleName)) AS nvarchar(68)) AS RoleName 			,CAST(MAX(CASE WHEN u.IsGroup IS NULL THEN 2 ELSE u.IsGroup END) AS tinyint) AS ObjType 		FROM B00Permission AS p INNER JOIN 			B00PermissionData AS pd ON p.DataId = pd.Id LEFT OUTER JOIN 			B00UserList AS u ON u.Id = p.UserId LEFT OUTER JOIN 			B00RoleList AS r ON r.Id = p.RoleId 		WHERE pd.ParentCommandKey = @_ParentCommandKey AND pd.SubCommandKey = @_SubCommandKey 			AND pd.TableName = @_TableName AND pd.ColumnName = @_ColumnName 			AND pd.FilterExpr = @_FilterExpr AND pd.IsActive = 1 AND p.IsActive = 1 			/*AND (p.NoAddNew IS NOT NULL OR p.NoEdit IS NOT NULL OR p.NoEditDOU IS NOT NULL 			OR p.NoDelete IS NOT NULL OR p.NoDeleteDOU IS NOT NULL OR p.NoRecall IS NOT NULL 			OR p.NoRecallDOU IS NOT NULL OR p.NoPrintOut IS NOT NULL OR p.NoPrintOutDOU IS NOT NULL 			OR p.NoOpen IS NOT NULL OR p.NoOpenDOU IS NOT NULL OR p.NoDisplay IS NOT NULL OR p.NoInherit > 0)*/ 		GROUP BY p.RoleId, p.UserId 		ORDER BY ObjType DESC; END;

CREATE PROCEDURE [usp_B00Permission_GetData] 	@_UserId int = NULL, 	@_RoleId int = NULL AS BEGIN 	------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 	-- Hàm/thủ tục được tạo tự động bởi BravoTools nếu không tồn tại hoặc sẽ bị xóa 	-- và tạo lại nếu thực hiện "Cập nhật các hàm và thủ tục TSQL" trong BravoTools 	-- Trả về dữ liệu để cập nhật phân quyền cho vai trò hoặc người sử dụng 	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------    	SET NOCOUNT ON;  	IF @_UserId IS NOT NULL 		SELECT p.Id 				,p.DataId 				,p.RoleId 				,(CASE WHEN ISNULL(p.UserId, p.RoleId) IS NULL THEN @_UserId ELSE p.UserId END) AS UserId 				,p.NoAddNew 				,p.NoEdit 				,p.NoEditDOU 				,p.NoDelete 				,p.NoDeleteDOU 				,p.NoRecall 				,p.NoRecallDOU 				,p.NoPrintOut 				,p.NoPrintOutDOU 				,p.NoOpen 				,p.NoOpenDOU 				,p.NoDisplay 				,p.NoInherit 				,p.MD5Hash 				,p.IsActive 				,p.CreatedBy 				,p.CreatedAt 				,p.ModifiedBy 				,p.ModifiedAt 				,p.[timestamp] 				,(CASE WHEN pd.ParentCommandKey = '' AND c.CommandKey IS NOT NULL THEN c.CommandKey ELSE pd.ParentCommandKey END) AS ParentCommandKey 				,pd.SubCommandKey 				,pd.TableName 				,pd.ColumnName 				,pd.FilterExpr 				,pd.DataDesc 				,CAST(ISNULL(LTRIM(u.FullName + ' (' + u.UserName + ')'), r.RoleName) AS nvarchar(68)) AS RoleName 				,ISNULL(o.BuiltinOrder, CAST (1 AS int)) AS BuiltinOrder 				,CAST(CASE WHEN u.IsGroup IS NULL THEN 2 ELSE u.IsGroup END AS tinyint) AS ObjType 				,CAST(CASE WHEN ISNULL(p.RoleId, p.UserId) IS NULL OR p.UserId = @_UserId THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS bit) AS IsEditable 			FROM B00Permission AS p INNER JOIN 				ufn_sys_GetPermissionUserListTable(@_UserId) AS o ON  					o.RoleId = ISNULL(p.RoleId, -1) AND o.UserId = ISNULL(p.UserId, -1) LEFT OUTER JOIN  				B00PermissionData AS pd ON p.DataId = pd.Id LEFT OUTER JOIN 				B00UserList AS u ON u.Id = (CASE WHEN p.RoleId IS NOT NULL THEN NULL ELSE ISNULL(p.UserId, @_UserId) END) LEFT OUTER JOIN  				B00RoleList AS r ON r.Id = p.RoleId LEFT OUTER JOIN 				B00Layout AS l ON pd.TableName = 'B00Layout' AND pd.FilterExpr LIKE N'Id=%' AND  					LTRIM(STR(l.Id)) = LTRIM(REPLACE(pd.FilterExpr, N'Id=', '')) LEFT OUTER JOIN 				B00Command AS c ON l.FormName = (CASE WHEN c.CtorArg2 > '' THEN c.CtorArg2 ELSE c.ClassName +  					(CASE WHEN c.CtorArg1 > '' THEN '_' + c.CtorArg1 ELSE '' END) END) 			WHERE pd.IsActive = 1 AND ISNULL(p.IsActive, 1) = 1; 	ELSE IF @_RoleId IS NOT NULL 		SELECT p.Id 				,p.DataId 				,ISNULL(p.RoleId, @_RoleId) AS RoleId 				,p.UserId 				,p.NoAddNew 				,p.NoEdit 				,p.NoEditDOU 				,p.NoDelete 				,p.NoDeleteDOU 				,p.NoRecall 				,p.NoRecallDOU 				,p.NoPrintOut 				,p.NoPrintOutDOU 				,p.NoOpen 				,p.NoOpenDOU 				,p.NoDisplay 				,p.NoInherit 				,p.MD5Hash 				,p.IsActive 				,p.CreatedBy 				,p.CreatedAt 				,p.ModifiedBy 				,p.ModifiedAt 				,p.[timestamp] 				,(CASE WHEN pd.ParentCommandKey = '' AND c.CommandKey IS NOT NULL THEN c.CommandKey ELSE pd.ParentCommandKey END) AS ParentCommandKey 				,pd.SubCommandKey 				,pd.TableName 				,pd.ColumnName 				,pd.FilterExpr 				,pd.DataDesc 				,CAST(r.RoleName AS nvarchar(68)) AS RoleName 				,CAST(1 AS int) AS BuiltinOrder 				,CAST(2 AS tinyint) AS ObjType 				,CAST(CASE WHEN ISNULL(p.RoleId, p.UserId) IS NULL OR p.RoleId = @_RoleId THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS bit) AS IsEditable 			FROM B00Permission AS p LEFT OUTER JOIN  				B00PermissionData AS pd ON p.DataId = pd.Id AND p.RoleId = @_RoleId LEFT OUTER JOIN 				B00RoleList AS r ON r.Id = ISNULL(p.RoleId, @_RoleId) LEFT OUTER JOIN 				B00Layout AS l ON pd.TableName = 'B00Layout' AND pd.FilterExpr LIKE N'Id=%' AND  					LTRIM(STR(l.Id)) = LTRIM(REPLACE(pd.FilterExpr, N'Id=', '')) LEFT OUTER JOIN 				B00Command AS c ON l.FormName = (CASE WHEN c.CtorArg2 > '' THEN c.CtorArg2 ELSE c.ClassName +  					(CASE WHEN c.CtorArg1 > '' THEN '_' + c.CtorArg1 ELSE '' END) END) 			WHERE pd.IsActive = 1 AND ISNULL(p.IsActive, 1) = 1; CREATE PROCEDURE [usp_B00UserRole_GetRoleListByUser] 	@_UserId int AS BEGIN 	SET NOCOUNT ON;  	------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 	-- Hàm/thủ tục được tạo tự động bởi BravoTools nếu không tồn tại hoặc sẽ bị xóa 	-- và tạo lại nếu thực hiện "Cập nhật các hàm và thủ tục TSQL" trong BravoTools 	-- Trả về danh sách các vai trò mà người dùng @_UserId được gán hoặc được kế thừa  	------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 	 	WITH cteUsers (Id, ParentId, UserName, BuiltinOrder) AS 	( 		SELECT Id, ParentId, LTRIM(FullName + ' (' + UserName + ')') AS UserName, CAST(1 AS int) AS BuiltinOrder 			FROM [B00UserList] WITH (NOLOCK) 			WHERE Id = @_UserId AND IsActive = 1 		UNION ALL 		SELECT u.Id, u.ParentId, LTRIM(u.FullName + ' (' + u.UserName + ')') AS UserName, cteUsers.BuiltinOrder + 1 AS BuiltinOrder 			FROM [B00UserList] AS u WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN 				cteUsers ON u.Id = cteUsers.ParentId AND u.IsActive = 1 	) 	,cteRoles AS 	( 		SELECT RoleId, MIN(CASE WHEN UserId = @_UserId THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS IsInherit 			FROM B00UserRole AS ur WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN 				cteUsers AS u ON u.Id = ur.UserId 			WHERE ur.IsActive = 1 			GROUP BY RoleId 	) 	SELECT r.RoleId AS Id 			,rl.RoleName 			,rl.RoleType		 			,CAST((CASE WHEN IsInherit = 1 THEN 3 ELSE 2 END) AS tinyint) AS ObjType 		FROM cteRoles AS r LEFT OUTER JOIN 			B00RoleList AS rl WITH (NOLOCK) ON rl.Id = r.RoleId 		WHERE rl.IsActive = 1 		ORDER BY RoleName; END;

CREATE PROCEDURE [usp_B00UserRole_GetUserListByRole] 	@_RoleId int AS BEGIN 	SET NOCOUNT ON;  	------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 	-- Hàm/thủ tục được tạo tự động bởi BravoTools nếu không tồn tại hoặc sẽ bị xóa 	-- và tạo lại nếu thực hiện "Cập nhật các hàm và thủ tục TSQL" trong BravoTools 	-- Trả về danh sách các người dùng có vai trò @_RoleId  	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------  	SELECT ur.UserId AS Id 			,LTRIM(u.FullName + ' (' + u.UserName + ')') AS RoleName 			,CAST(NULL AS tinyint) AS RoleType 			,CAST(u.IsGroup AS tinyint) AS ObjType 		FROM B00UserRole AS ur WITH (NOLOCK) LEFT OUTER JOIN  			B00UserList AS u WITH (NOLOCK) ON u.Id = ur.UserId 		WHERE ur.RoleId = @_RoleId AND ur.IsActive = 1 AND u.IsActive = 1 		ORDER BY ObjType DESC, RoleName; END;

-- ============================================= -- Author:		Pham Trung -- Create date: Nov 15, 2011 -- Description:	Automatic create product code while saving Inventory item -- ============================================= CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[usp_B20Item_Create_ProductCode]  	@_Id Int = NULL, 	@_ProductCostId varchar(16) = '', 	@_Code nvarchar(24) = '', 	@_Name nvarchar(196) = '', 	@_Unit nvarchar(8) = '', 	@_AutoCreateProductCode Bit = NULL AS BEGIN 	SET NOCOUNT ON; 	 	IF ISNULL(@_AutoCreateProductCode, 0) = 0 		RETURN 	 	SET @_AutoCreateProductCode = NULL; 	 	DECLARE @_ErrorMessage nvarchar(400), @_ProductType Smallint; 	SET @_ProductType = 2; 	 	IF ISNULL(@_ProductCostId, '') = '' 		SET @_AutoCreateProductCode = 1; 	ELSE 		SET @_AutoCreateProductCode = 0; 	 	SET @_ErrorMessage = N'Tên sản phẩm không được bỏ trắng' + NCHAR(13) +  					N'Product name can''t be null'; 	 	IF ISNULL(@_Name, '') = '' OR ISNULL(@_Code, '') = '' 		RAISERROR(@_ErrorMessage, 				16, 				1); 	 	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT Id FROM dbo.B20Product WHERE Code = @_Code) 		INSERT INTO dbo.B20Product(Code, Name, Unit, ProductType, IsGroup) 			VALUES(ISNULL(@_Code, ''), @_Name, ISNULL(@_Unit, ''), @_ProductType, 0); 	 	IF @_AutoCreateProductCode = 1 	BEGIN 		SELECT TOP 1 @_ProductCostId = RowId FROM B20Product WHERE Id = SCOPE_IDENTITY();--IDENT_CURRENT(N'B20Product') 		IF ISNULL(@_Id, 0) <> 0 AND ISNULL(@_ProductCostId, '') <> '' 		BEGIN 			UPDATE B20Item SET ProductCostId = @_ProductCostId WHERE Id = @_Id; 		END 	END END

-- ============================================= -- Author:		Phạm Trung -- Create date: 22 July 2013 -- Description:	Xử lý mã hàng được in từ cân điện tử  -- ============================================= CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[usp_B20ItemPrice_BarcodeFromScale] 	@_ItemCode nvarchar(24) = '1100000012300',	--'1100000012300' 	@_TerritoryCode nvarchar(16) = '' AS BEGIN 	SET NOCOUNT ON;  	IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM B20Item 				WHERE Code = @_ItemCode) 		RETURN;  	DECLARE @_i tinyint, @_len tinyint, @_ItemCodeSeek nvarchar(24), @_ItemVariantCode nvarchar(2), 			@_ItemQuantity nvarchar(24);  	SELECT @_i = 1, @_len = LEN(@_ItemCode); 	 	IF @_len >= 13 	BEGIN 		SET @_ItemCodeSeek = LEFT(@_ItemCode, 5); 		SET @_ItemVariantCode = SUBSTRING(@_ItemCode, 6, 2); 		 		IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM vB20ItemPrice  				WHERE ItemCode = @_ItemCodeSeek  					AND ISNULL(TerritoryCode, '') = ISNULL(@_TerritoryCode, '')) 		BEGIN 			SET @_ItemQuantity = SUBSTRING(@_ItemCode, 8, 5); 			 			SELECT TOP 1 Id, ItemType, ItemCatgCode, Name, Code, ISNULL(UnitPrice, 0) AS UnitPrice, Unit,  					ItemGroupCode, ManufacturerCode, IsItemWithSerialNo, 					RowId_SP AS RowId_SP_disc, 					CAST(@_ItemQuantity AS numeric)/1000 AS Quantity, 					QueryTime 				FROM vB20ItemPrice 				WHERE ItemCode = @_ItemCodeSeek AND VariantCode = @_ItemVariantCode 					AND ISNULL(TerritoryCode, '') = ISNULL(@_TerritoryCode, ''); 			 			RETURN; 		END; 	END 	 	WHILE @_i <= @_len 	BEGIN 		SET @_ItemCodeSeek = LEFT(@_ItemCode, @_i); 		 		IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM vB20ItemPrice  				WHERE ItemCode = @_ItemCodeSeek 					AND ISNULL(TerritoryCode, '') = ISNULL(@_TerritoryCode, '')) 			BEGIN 				SET @_ItemQuantity = SUBSTRING(@_ItemCode, @_i + 1, @_len - @_i - 2); 				 				SELECT TOP 1 Id, ItemType, ItemCatgCode, Name, Code, ISNULL(UnitPrice, 0) AS UnitPrice, Unit,  						ItemGroupCode, ManufacturerCode, IsItemWithSerialNo, 						RowId_SP AS RowId_SP_disc, 						CAST(@_ItemQuantity AS numeric)/1000 AS Quantity, 						QueryTime 					FROM vB20ItemPrice 					WHERE ItemCode = @_ItemCodeSeek  						AND ISNULL(TerritoryCode, '') = ISNULL(@_TerritoryCode, ''); 				 				BREAK; 			END; 		SET @_i = @_i + 1; 	END  END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[usp_B20MemberCardType_UpdateMemberDiscountPolicy] 	AS BEGIN 	-- Cập nhật chiết khấu hiện thời cho chủ thẻ 	-- Được gọi bởi DML_B30BizDoc_UpdateSalesPricingPolicy của BizDoc (theo mã chứng từ = 'SP': Chính sách giá) 	 	SET NOCOUNT ON; 	 	UPDATE B20MemberCardType SET ConsumerDiscountRate = ISNULL(b.DiscountRate, 0) 		FROM B20MemberCardType AS a 		OUTER APPLY 		( 			SELECT TOP 1 disc.DiscountRate 			FROM dbo.B30BizDocMemberCardDiscount disc INNER JOIN dbo.B30BizDoc AS biz 				ON disc.BizDocId = biz.BizDocId AND disc.DocDate = biz.DocDate 				INNER JOIN B00DocStatus AS d ON biz.DocStatus = d.DocStatusKey AND d.Post_TheKho = 1 				INNER JOIN B20ItemCatg AS cat ON disc.ItemCatgCode = cat.Code  			WHERE disc.MemberCardTypeCode = a.Code 				AND (FinishedDate = '' OR FinishedDate >= GETDATE()) 				AND cat.IsConsumerItemCatg = 1 AND a.IsActive = 1 			ORDER BY disc.DocDate DESC 		) AS b 		WHERE a.IsActive = 1; 	 	UPDATE B20MemberCardType SET ElectricalDiscountRate = ISNULL(b.DiscountRate, 0) 		FROM B20MemberCardType AS a 		OUTER APPLY 		( 			SELECT TOP 1 disc.DiscountRate 			FROM dbo.B30BizDocMemberCardDiscount disc INNER JOIN dbo.B30BizDoc AS biz 				ON disc.BizDocId = biz.BizDocId AND disc.DocDate = biz.DocDate 				INNER JOIN B00DocStatus AS d ON biz.DocStatus = d.DocStatusKey AND d.Post_TheKho = 1 				INNER JOIN B20ItemCatg AS cat ON disc.ItemCatgCode = cat.Code  			WHERE disc.MemberCardTypeCode = a.Code 				AND (FinishedDate = '' OR FinishedDate >= GETDATE()) 				AND cat.IsElectricalItemCatg = 1 AND a.IsActive = 1 			ORDER BY disc.DocDate DESC 		) AS b 		WHERE a.IsActive = 1; END;

-- ============================================= -- Author:		Nguyen Hai Thang -- Description:	Dọn dẹp số liệu -- 29/02/2016: HảiDV sửa lỗi đình chỉ ở Tồn đầu, chạy dọn dẹp từ đầu --> cuối năm sẽ bị khôi phục lại ở Tồn đầu nhưng không lên báo cáo -- ============================================= CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[usp_B30AccDoc_RePost]  	@_StartDate Smalldatetime	= '20140101 12:00:00', 	@_EndDate Smalldatetime		= '20140831 12:00:00', 	@_RePost TinyInt			= 1, 	@_ReBuildIndex TinyInt		= 0, 	@_MoveToEventLog2 Tinyint	= 0,		-- Move số liệu từ EventLog sang EventLog2 	@_FiscalYear Nvarchar(16)	= '2018', 	@_LangId Int				= 0, 	@_BranchCode Nvarchar(3)	= N'A03' AS BEGIN 	SET NOCOUNT ON; 	DECLARE @_Ngay_Kt_Ht Smalldatetime, @_Ngay_Bd_Nam Smalldatetime, @_Ngay_Kt_Nam Smalldatetime, @_ErrorMessage NVARCHAR(128); 	 	IF @_RePost = 1 		GOTO _RePost;  	_Next_Step2: 	 	IF @_ReBuildIndex = 1 		GOTO _ReBuildIndex;  	_Next_Step3: 	 	IF @_MoveToEventLog2 = 1 		GOTO _MoveToEventLog2; 		 	RETURN;  _RePost: 	SELECT TOP 1 @_Ngay_Kt_Ht = Ngay_Kt_Ht, @_Ngay_Bd_Nam = Ngay_Bd_Nam, @_Ngay_Kt_Nam = Ngay_Kt_Nam 		FROM B00DmStt  		WHERE Ma_Dvcs = @_BranchCode AND Nam = @_FiscalYear  	IF @_StartDate > @_EndDate OR @_Ngay_Kt_Ht >= @_Ngay_Kt_Nam  		RETURN;  	-- Kiểm tra có chứng từ nằm ngoài khoảng thời gian hạch toán không 	IF (@_StartDate NOT BETWEEN @_Ngay_Kt_Ht AND @_Ngay_Kt_Nam)  		OR (@_EndDate NOT BETWEEN @_Ngay_Kt_Ht AND @_Ngay_Kt_Nam) 	BEGIN 		SET @_ErrorMessage = dbo.ufn_sys_MessageText('DATEERROR', @_LangId);  		RAISERROR(@_ErrorMessage, 16,1); 		RETURN; 	END 	 	-- Kiểm tra nếu là Dvcs tổng hợp thì stop 	IF (SELECT IsGroup FROM B00DmDvcs WHERE Ma_Dvcs = @_BranchCode) = 1 	BEGIN 		SET @_ErrorMessage = dbo.ufn_sys_MessageText(N'DvcsTongHop', @_LangId); 		 		RAISERROR(@_ErrorMessage, 16, 1); 		RETURN; 	END	  	-- Tạo bảng để post 	DECLARE @_CtList TABLE (Stt VARCHAR(24), DocDate SmallDatetime, DocCode CHAR(2), DocStatus Tinyint)  	INSERT INTO @_CtList (Stt, DocDate, DocCode, DocStatus) 		SELECT Stt, DocDate, DocCode, DocStatus 		FROM dbo.B30AccDoc ct 		WHERE ct.DocDate BETWEEN @_StartDate AND @_EndDate AND ct.BranchCode = @_BranchCode  	--IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM @_CtList) 	--	RETURN;  	DECLARE @ci varbinary(128) 	SELECT @ci = ISNULL(CONTEXT_INFO(), 0) 	SET CONTEXT_INFO 0x55555; 	 	-- Xóa và cập nhật lại Tồn tức thời nếu dọn dẹp từ đầu năm đến cuối năm 	IF @_StartDate = @_Ngay_Bd_Nam AND @_EndDate = @_Ngay_Kt_Nam 	BEGIN 		DECLARE @ci1 varbinary(128) 		SET @ci1 = CAST('AccDoc_RePost' AS varbinary(128))  		SET CONTEXT_INFO @ci1; 		DELETE FROM B30StockLedger  		WHERE DocDate BETWEEN @_StartDate AND @_EndDate AND 				FiscalYear = @_FiscalYear AND BranchCode = @_BranchCode  		DELETE FROM B30StockLedgerPhys 		WHERE DocDate BETWEEN @_StartDate AND @_EndDate AND 				FiscalYear = @_FiscalYear AND BranchCode = @_BranchCode  		DELETE B30OpenInventory FROM B30OpenInventory a INNER JOIN B30CurrentInventory b 			ON a.InventoryId = b.InventoryId 		WHERE a.Year = @_FiscalYear AND a.BranchCode = @_BranchCode AND a.IsActive = 0 AND b.IsActive = 1 		 		DELETE FROM B30CurrentInventory WHERE FiscalYear = @_FiscalYear AND BranchCode = @_BranchCode  		DELETE FROM B30CurrentInventoryPhys WHERE FiscalYear = @_FiscalYear AND BranchCode = @_BranchCode 	END	ELSE 	BEGIN 		SET CONTEXT_INFO 0x55555; 	END 	 	-- Cập nhật sổ cái 	-- 03/04/2014 ThắngĐQ: Chuyển cách post sổ cái không sử dụng Trigger mà sang thủ tục  	DECLARE @_SttListXML NVARCHAR(MAX) 	SET @_SttListXML = (SELECT Stt, DocDate, DocCode, DocStatus FROM @_CtList FOR XML RAW, ROOT('root')) 				 	EXECUTE usp_B30AccDoc_Post  		@_Stt = NULL, @_DocDate = NULL, @_DocCode = NULL, 		@_DocStatus = NULL,  		@_SttListXML = @_SttListXML, 		@_UpdateType = NULL 	-- Kết thúc cập nhật 	 	-- Cập nhật vào bảng tồn tức vật tư 	IF ISNULL(CONTEXT_INFO(), 0) = CAST('AccDoc_RePost' AS varbinary(128))  	BEGIN 		IF  EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.indexes WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[dbo].[B30CurrentInventory]') AND name = N'IX_B30CurrentInventory_RowId_Unique') 			ALTER TABLE [dbo].[B30CurrentInventory] DROP CONSTRAINT [IX_B30CurrentInventory_RowId_Unique];  		-- 29/02/2016: HảiDV sửa lỗi đình chỉ ở Tồn đầu, chạy dọn dẹp từ đầu --> cuối năm sẽ bị khôi phục lại ở Tồn đầu nhưng không lên báo cáo 		INSERT INTO dbo.B30CurrentInventory 		(	 			BranchCode, FiscalYear, WarehouseCode, ItemCode,  			Quantity, AverageUnitCost, IsActive 		) 		SELECT BranchCode, FiscalYear, WarehouseCode, ItemCode, SUM(Quantity), 			CASE WHEN SUM(Quantity) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(Amount)/SUM(Quantity) END AS AverageUnitCost,  			MIN(CAST(IsActive AS INT)) AS IsActive 		FROM  		(		 			SELECT BranchCode, FiscalYear, WarehouseCode, ItemCode,  				SUM(Quantity*CASE WHEN DocGroup = '1' THEN 1 ELSE -1 END) AS Quantity,  				SUM(Amount*CASE WHEN DocGroup = '1' THEN 1 ELSE -1 END) AS Amount, 				CAST(1 AS INT) AS IsActive 			FROM B30StockLedger 			WHERE  				DocDate BETWEEN @_StartDate AND @_EndDate AND 				FiscalYear = @_FiscalYear AND BranchCode = @_BranchCode AND  				WarehouseCode <> '' AND ItemCode <> '' 			GROUP BY BranchCode, FiscalYear, WarehouseCode, ItemCode 			UNION ALL 			SELECT BranchCode, Year AS FiscalYear, WarehouseCode, ItemCode,  					SUM(CASE WHEN IsActive = 0 THEN 0 ELSE Quantity END) AS Quantity,  					SUM(CASE WHEN IsActive = 0 THEN 0 ELSE Amount END) AS Amount, 					MAX(CAST(IsActive AS INT)) AS IsActive 			FROM B30OpenInventory 			WHERE Year = @_FiscalYear AND BranchCode = @_BranchCode AND  					WarehouseCode <> '' AND ItemCode <> '' 			GROUP BY BranchCode, Year, WarehouseCode, ItemCode 		) tb 		GROUP BY BranchCode, FiscalYear, WarehouseCode, ItemCode;  		ALTER TABLE [dbo].[B30CurrentInventory] ADD  CONSTRAINT [IX_B30CurrentInventory_RowId_Unique] UNIQUE NONCLUSTERED  			([RowId] ASC)WITH (PAD_INDEX  = OFF, STATISTICS_NORECOMPUTE  = OFF, SORT_IN_TEMPDB = OFF,  				IGNORE_DUP_KEY = OFF, ONLINE = OFF, ALLOW_ROW_LOCKS  = ON, ALLOW_PAGE_LOCKS  = ON) ON [PRIMARY]; 	 		-- Cập nhật vào bảng tồn tức thời lô vật tư 		INSERT INTO dbo.B30CurrentInventoryPhys  		(	 			BranchCode, FiscalYear, WarehouseCode, ItemCode,  			ItemLotCode, LocationCode, ItemSerialNo, Quantity 		) 		SELECT BranchCode, FiscalYear, WarehouseCode, ItemCode,  				ItemLotCode, LocationCode, ItemSerialNo, SUM(Quantity) AS Quantity 		FROM  		(		 			SELECT BranchCode, FiscalYear, WarehouseCode, ItemCode,  					ItemLotCode, LocationCode, ItemSerialNo, SUM(ReceiptQuantity - IssueQuantity) AS Quantity 			FROM B30StockLedgerPhys  			WHERE  				DocDate BETWEEN @_StartDate AND @_EndDate AND 				FiscalYear = @_FiscalYear AND BranchCode = @_BranchCode AND  				WarehouseCode <> '' AND ItemCode <> '' 			GROUP BY BranchCode, FiscalYear, WarehouseCode, ItemCode,  					ItemLotCode, LocationCode, ItemSerialNo 			UNION ALL 			SELECT BranchCode, Year AS FiscalYear, WarehouseCode, ItemCode,  					ItemLotCode, LocationCode, ItemSerialNo, SUM(Quantity) AS Quantity 			FROM B30OpenInventoryPhys  			WHERE Year = @_FiscalYear AND BranchCode = @_BranchCode AND  					WarehouseCode <> '' AND ItemCode <> '' 			GROUP BY BranchCode, Year, WarehouseCode, ItemCode,  					ItemLotCode, LocationCode, ItemSerialNo 		) tb 		GROUP BY BranchCode, FiscalYear, WarehouseCode, ItemCode,  			ItemLotCode, LocationCode, ItemSerialNo		 	END 	 	SET CONTEXT_INFO @ci;  	PRINT N'Successful';  	GOTO _Next_Step2;  	RETURN;  _ReBuildIndex: 	DECLARE @_TblList TABLE (TableName NVARCHAR(64)) 	INSERT INTO @_TblList 		SELECT Table_Name FROM information_Schema.tables  		WHERE Table_Type = 'BASE TABLE' AND (Table_Name LIKE 'B20%' OR Table_Name LIKE 'B30%') 		ORDER BY Table_Name  	DECLARE @_TableName NVARCHAR(64), @_Exec VARCHAR(2000), @_FillFactor TinyInt 	SET @_FillFactor = 90  	BEGIN TRANSACTION 	WHILE EXISTS(SELECT * FROM @_TblList) 	BEGIN 		SELECT TOP 1 @_TableName = TableName FROM @_TblList ORDER BY TableName  		SET @_Exec = 'ALTER INDEX ALL ON ' + @_TableName + ' REBUILD WITH (FILLFACTOR = ' + STR(@_FillFactor, 3) + ')'  		EXECUTE (@_Exec)  		IF @@ERROR <> 0 		BEGIN 			PRINT N'Rebuild index error on table: ' + @_TableName 			ROLLBACK TRANSACTION	 			RETURN 		END  		PRINT 'Rebuilt index on ' + @_TableName 		DELETE FROM @_TblList WHERE TableName = @_TableName 	END 	COMMIT TRANSACTION  	GOTO _Next_Step3; 	 	RETURN 	 _MoveToEventLog2: 	SELECT TOP 1 @_Ngay_Kt_Ht = Ngay_Kt_Ht, @_Ngay_Bd_Nam = Ngay_Bd_Nam, @_Ngay_Kt_Nam = Ngay_Kt_Nam 		FROM B00DmStt  		WHERE Ma_Dvcs = @_BranchCode AND Nam = @_FiscalYear  	IF @_StartDate > @_EndDate OR @_Ngay_Kt_Ht >= @_Ngay_Kt_Nam  		RETURN;  	-- Kiểm tra có chứng từ nằm ngoài khoảng thời gian hạch toán không 	IF (@_StartDate NOT BETWEEN @_Ngay_Kt_Ht AND @_Ngay_Kt_Nam)  		OR (@_EndDate NOT BETWEEN @_Ngay_Kt_Ht AND @_Ngay_Kt_Nam) 	BEGIN 		SET @_ErrorMessage = dbo.ufn_sys_MessageText('DATEERROR', @_LangId);  		RAISERROR(@_ErrorMessage, 16,1); 		RETURN; 	END 		 	IF OBJECT_ID('TempDb..#_B00EventLog') IS NOT NULL 	DROP TABLE #_B00EventLog  	SELECT TOP 0 * 		INTO #_B00EventLog 		FROM B00EventLog2  	 	DECLARE @_EndDateTmp SmallDatetime 	SET @_StartDate = CONVERT(Datetime, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), @_StartDate, 103), 103) 	SET @_EndDateTmp = CONVERT(Datetime, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), @_EndDate, 103), 103) + 1  	SELECT @_StartDate, @_EndDateTmp 	BEGIN TRANSACTION 		--SELECT *  		--INTO #_B00EventLog 		--FROM B00EventLog 		--WHERE LastWriteAt BETWEEN @_StartDate AND @_EndDate 		DELETE FROM B00EventLog  		OUTPUT deleted.* INTO #_B00EventLog 		WHERE LastWriteAt >= @_StartDate AND LastWriteAt < @_EndDateTmp 		 		INSERT INTO 	B00EventLog2 		SELECT * FROM #_B00EventLog 		 	COMMIT TRANSACTION  	PRINT N'MoveToEventLog2.';	 	DROP TABLE #_B00EventLog 	 	RETURN 	 END

-- ============================================= -- Author:		Pham Trung -- Create date: Feb 16, 2012 -- Description:	Automatic create product code while saving customer's sales order -- ============================================= CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[usp_B30AccDoc_SaveCashTrans]  	@_Stt varchar(16) = NULL, 	@_DocumentDate smalldatetime = NULL, 	@_vB30AccDocCash_Edit xml = NULL AS BEGIN 	SET NOCOUNT ON; 	 	INSERT INTO @_CtKtTmp 		SELECT Stt, RowId, BranchCode, DocumentCode, DocumentDate, DebitAccount, CreditAccount, 			OriginalAmount, Amount, CurrencyCode, 			TaxCode, ISNULL(TaxRate, 0),  			TaxRegNo, TaxRegName,  			DebitAccount3, CreditAccount3, 			OriginalAmount3, Amount3,  			DebitAccount7, CreditAccount7, 			OriginalAmount7, Amount7,  			DebitAccount8, CreditAccount8, 			OriginalAmount8, Amount8,  			attachedDocumentDate, attachedDocumentNo,  			attachedDocumentSerialNo, OriginalAttachedDocumentDate, 			attachedRowId, exratediffRowId, attachedExRateDiffRowId,  			BookingExchangeRate, OriginalDocumentDate 		FROM OPENXML (@_docHandle, '/NewDataSet/vB30AccDocCash_Edit', 2) 		WITH (Stt varchar(16), RowId varchar(16), BranchCode char(3), DocumentCode char(2), 						DocumentDate smalldatetime, DebitAccount nvarchar(16), CreditAccount nvarchar(16), 						OriginalAmount numeric(18, 2), Amount numeric(18, 2), CurrencyCode nvarchar(16), 						TaxCode nvarchar(16), TaxRate dbo.PercentageType,  						TaxRegNo nvarchar(18), TaxRegName nvarchar(128),  						DebitAccount3 nvarchar(16), CreditAccount3 nvarchar(16), 						OriginalAmount3 numeric(18, 2), Amount3 numeric(18, 2),  						DebitAccount7 nvarchar(16), CreditAccount7 nvarchar(16), 						OriginalAmount7 numeric(18, 2), Amount7 numeric(18, 2),  						DebitAccount8 nvarchar(16), CreditAccount8 nvarchar(16), 						OriginalAmount8 numeric(18, 2), Amount8 numeric(18, 2),  						attachedDocumentDate Smalldatetime, attachedDocumentNo nvarchar(20),  						attachedDocumentSerialNo nvarchar(20), OriginalAttachedDocumentDate Smalldatetime, 						attachedRowId varchar(16), exratediffRowId varchar(16), attachedExRateDiffRowId varchar(16), 						BookingExchangeRate numeric(18, 4), OriginalDocumentDate Smalldatetime) 	 	EXEC sp_xml_removedocument @_docHandle; 	 	-- Nếu chưa lưu chứng từ đi kèm // thêm mới bản ghi 	IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM @_CtKtTmp  				WHERE ISNULL(attachedRowId, '') = '' AND ISNULL(TaxCode, '') <> '') 		INSERT INTO [dbo].[B30AccDocAtchDoc] 				(Stt, BuiltinOrder, RowId_SourceDoc, BranchCode, DocumentCode, 				DocumentDate, DocumentNo, DocumentSerialNo,  				OriginalAmountBeforeTax, AmountBeforeTax, 				TaxCode, TaxRate, DebitAccount, CreditAccount, 				OriginalAmount, Amount, 				TaxRegNo, TaxRegName, AttachedDocType) 			SELECT 					Stt, CAST(1 AS Int), RowId, BranchCode, DocumentCode, 					ISNULL(attachedDocumentDate, DocumentDate), ISNULL(attachedDocumentNo, ''),  					ISNULL(attachedDocumentSerialNo, ''), 					OriginalAmount, Amount, 					TaxCode, TaxRate, DebitAccount3, CreditAccount3, 					OriginalAmount3, Amount3, 					TaxRegNo, TaxRegName, @_AttachedDocType 				FROM @_CtKtTmp 				WHERE ISNULL(attachedRowId, '') = '' AND ISNULL(TaxCode, '') <> ''; CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[usp_B30AccDoc_UpdateDocStatusByTask] 	@_Stt varchar(16) = NULL, 	@_DocStatusDefault tinyint = NULL AS BEGIN 	 	IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM dbo.vB30AccDoc_AsChildOfTask WHERE Stt = @_Stt) AND  			EXISTS(SELECT * FROM dbo.B00DocStatus WHERE DocStatusKey = @_DocStatusDefault AND IsActive = 1) 	BEGIN 		DECLARE @_Post_SoCai Bit, @_IsCancelled Bit; 	 		SELECT TOP 1 @_Post_SoCai = Post_SoCai, @_IsCancelled = IsCancelled 			FROM dbo.B00DocStatus WHERE DocStatusKey = @_DocStatusDefault AND IsActive = 1; 		 		UPDATE vB30AccDoc_AsChildOfTask SET  				DocStatus = @_DocStatusDefault, 				Posted = @_Post_SoCai, 				IsActive = CASE WHEN @_IsCancelled = 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END  			WHERE Stt = @_Stt; 	END END

-- ============================================= -- Author:		Phạm Trung -- Create date: 10 July 2013 -- ============================================= CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[usp_B30AccDocCashReceipt_UpdateRunningExchangeRate]  	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here 	@_BranchCode nvarchar(3), 	@_DocDate Smalldatetime, 	@_SeqNo varchar(16), 	@_LastSeqNo varchar(16), 	@_RunningExchangeRate numeric(18, 5), 	@_RunningOriginalBalance money AS BEGIN 	DECLARE @DoRetry bit, @RetryCounter INT, @ErrorMessage varchar(4000); 	 	IF ISNULL(@_SeqNo, '') <> '' 	BEGIN 		SET @RetryCounter = 1; 		_RETRY_UPDATE_CASHPAYMENT_1: 		BEGIN TRY 			UPDATE dbo.B30AccDocCashPayment SET BookingExchangeRate = @_RunningExchangeRate 				WHERE DocDate >= @_DocDate AND SeqNo = @_SeqNo AND BranchCode = @_BranchCode 		END TRY 		BEGIN CATCH 			SET @doRetry = 0; 			SET @ErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE() 			IF ERROR_NUMBER() = 1205 -- Deadlock Error Number 			BEGIN 				ROLLBACK TRANSACTION 				SET @doRetry = 1; -- Set @doRetry to 1 only for Deadlock 			END 			IF @DoRetry = 1 			BEGIN 				PRINT 'Deadlock Error Number' 				 				SET @RetryCounter = @RetryCounter + 1 -- Increment Retry Counter By one 				IF (@RetryCounter > 3) -- Check whether Retry Counter reached to 3 					RAISERROR(@ErrorMessage, 18, 1) -- Raise Error Message if  						-- still deadlock occurred after three retries 				ELSE 				BEGIN 					WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00.05' -- Wait for 5 ms 					GOTO _RETRY_UPDATE_CASHPAYMENT_1;	-- Go to Label RETRY 				END 			END ELSE 				RAISERROR(@ErrorMessage, 18, 1) 		END CATCH 	END 	 	IF ISNULL(@_LastSeqNo, '') <> '' 	BEGIN 		SET @RetryCounter = 1; 		_RETRY_UPDATE_CASHPAYMENT_2: 		BEGIN TRY 			UPDATE dbo.B30AccDocCashPayment SET SeqNo = NULL 				WHERE SeqNo = @_LastSeqNo AND BranchCode = @_BranchCode; 		END TRY 		BEGIN CATCH 			SET @doRetry = 0; 			SET @ErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE() 			IF ERROR_NUMBER() = 1205 -- Deadlock Error Number 			BEGIN 				ROLLBACK TRANSACTION 				SET @doRetry = 1; -- Set @doRetry to 1 only for Deadlock 			END 			IF @DoRetry = 1 			BEGIN 				PRINT 'Deadlock Error Number' 				 				SET @RetryCounter = @RetryCounter + 1 -- Increment Retry Counter By one 				IF (@RetryCounter > 3) -- Check whether Retry Counter reached to 3 					RAISERROR(@ErrorMessage, 18, 1) -- Raise Error Message if  						-- still deadlock occurred after three retries 				ELSE 				BEGIN 					WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00.05' -- Wait for 5 ms 					GOTO _RETRY_UPDATE_CASHPAYMENT_2;	-- Go to Label RETRY 				END 			END ELSE 				RAISERROR(@ErrorMessage, 18, 1) 		END CATCH 	END 	/*Duyệt từng dòng để tính CLTG?*/ END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[usp_B30AccDocPaybill_GetDataForEdit] 	@_Id int = NULL	 AS BEGIN 	DECLARE @_Stt varchar(16); 	SELECT TOP 1 @_Stt = Stt  		FROM dbo.B30AccDoc  		WHERE Id = @_Id; 	 	IF EXISTS(SELECT RowId FROM dbo.B30AccDocPaybill 				WHERE RowId IN (SELECT RowId FROM vB30AccDocCash WHERE Stt = @_Stt) AND IsActive = 1) 		SELECT CtKtHtt.* 			,CAST(1 AS bit) AS Thanh_Toan 			,CdHtt.DocDate AS DueDocDate 			,CdHtt.DocNo AS DueDocNo 			,CdHtt.Description 			,CdHtt.DueDate 			,CdHtt.Account 			,CdHtt.CustomerCode 			,CdHtt.EmployeeCode 			,CdHtt.CurrencyCode AS DueCurrencyCode 			-- 25/08/14: CuongNc sửa tính lại tỷ giá 			,CASE WHEN DmTte.ExchangeRateOperator = 1 AND CdHtt.TotalOriginalAmount <> 0 THEN (CdHtt.TotalAmount / CdHtt.TotalOriginalAmount) 				  WHEN DmTte.ExchangeRateOperator = 0 AND CdHtt.TotalAmount <> 0 THEN (CdHtt.TotalOriginalAmount / CdHtt.TotalAmount) 				  ELSE CdHtt.ExchangeRate END AS DueExchangeRate 			--,CdHtt.ExchangeRate AS DueExchangeRate 			,CdHtt.TotalOriginalAmount 			,CdHtt.TotalAmount 			,CAST(CdHtt.DueOriginalAmount - ISNULL(CtHtt.OriginalPaymentAmount, 0) AS numeric(18,2)) AS DueOriginalAmount 			,CAST(CdHtt.DueAmount - ISNULL(CtHtt.PaymentAmount, 0)  AS numeric(18,2)) AS DueAmount 			,CAST(ISNULL(CdHtt.TotalOriginalAmount,0) - ISNULL(CdHtt.DueOriginalAmount,0) + ISNULL(CtHtt.OriginalPaymentAmount,0) AS numeric(18,2)) AS TotalOriginalPaymentAmount 			,CAST(ISNULL(CdHtt.TotalAmount,0) - ISNULL(CdHtt.DueAmount,0) + ISNULL(CtHtt.PaymentAmount,0) AS numeric(18,2)) AS TotalPaymentAmount 			,DmTte.DecimalRound, DmTte.ExchangeRateOperator 			,p.Id AS _ParentIdentityKey 		FROM dbo.B30AccDocPaybill AS CtKtHtt LEFT OUTER JOIN 			dbo.vB30CdHtt AS CdHtt ON CdHtt.Stt_Cd_Htt = CtKtHtt.Stt_Cd_Htt LEFT OUTER JOIN 			(SELECT Stt_Cd_Htt, SUM(OriginalAmount) AS OriginalPaymentAmount, SUM(Amount) AS PaymentAmount 				FROM dbo.vB30CtHtt 				WHERE Stt <> @_Stt 				GROUP BY Stt_Cd_Htt 			) AS CtHtt ON CdHtt.Stt_Cd_Htt = CtHtt.Stt_Cd_Htt LEFT OUTER JOIN 			dbo.B20Currency AS DmTte ON DmTte.Code = CdHtt.CurrencyCode 		INNER JOIN (SELECT RowId, Id FROM vB30AccDocCash WHERE Stt = @_Stt AND IsActive = 1) AS p 			ON CtKtHtt.RowId = p.RowId AND CtKtHtt.IsActive = 1 					 		--SELECT c.*, p.Id AS _ParentIdentityKey 		--	FROM vB30CtKtHtt AS c  		--	INNER JOIN (SELECT RowId, Id FROM B30CtKt WHERE Stt = @_Stt AND IsActive = 1) AS p 		--	ON c.RowId = p.RowId AND c.IsActive = 1 	ELSE 		SELECT TOP 0 *, CAST(NULL AS int) AS _ParentIdentityKey  			FROM dbo.vB30AccDocPaybill END
