-- ============================================= -- Author:  -- Create date: -- ============================================= CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[usp_B30AccDocSetDetail_AddingData]  	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here 	@_ItemCode		LongCodeType = '', 	@_BranchCode	char(3) = 'A02', 	@_DocCode_Temp		char(2) = '', 	@_Quantity		QuantityType = 0, 	@_Stt			UniqueKeyType = '', 	@_RowId			UniqueKeyType = '', 	@_Id			int = 0, 	@_ItemType		Smallint = 0, 	@_Amount		MoneyType = 0, 	@_DebitAccount	CodeType = '', 	@_CreditAccount	CodeType = '' AS BEGIN /* usp_B30SetDetail_AddingData @_ItemCode='BOVT01', @_Quantity=1.0000, @_Stt='A020000000000494',  	@_Ngay_Ct='4/11/2012 12:00:00 AM', @_RowId='A0200000000299PX', @_Id=299 */ 	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from 	-- interfering with SELECT statements. 	SET NOCOUNT ON; 	 	DECLARE @_TotalAllocRate MoneyType, @_DocumentGroup char(1), @_IsSaleInvoice tinyint; 	 	SELECT TOP 1 @_DocumentGroup = Nh_Ct, @_IsSaleInvoice = Ct_Hd  		FROM B00DmCt  		WHERE Ma_Ct = @_DocCode_Temp; 	 	SELECT @_TotalAllocRate = SUM(AllocRate)  		FROM B20ItemsSetDef  		WHERE SetItemCode = @_ItemCode; 	 	SELECT @_Quantity = ISNULL(@_Quantity, 0), @_Amount = ISNULL(@_Amount, 0),  			@_TotalAllocRate = ISNULL(@_TotalAllocRate, 0); 	 	IF ISNULL(@_TotalAllocRate, 0) = 0 SET @_TotalAllocRate = 1; 	 	SELECT ISNULL(SetDetail.Id, CAST(-1 * (@_Id * 1000 + CtBo.Id) AS int)) AS Id, 			ISNULL(SetDetail.RowId, '') AS RowId, 			ISNULL(SetDetail.BranchCode, @_BranchCode) AS BranchCode, 			ISNULL(SetDetail.DocCode, @_DocCode_Temp) AS DocCode, 			CtBo.ItemCode,  			CtBo.ItemName AS Description, CtBo.Unit AS Unit, 			CtBo.Quantity*@_Quantity AS Quantity,  			CtBo.AllocRate, CtBo.Quantity AS QuantityInKit, 			CtBo.AllocRate * @_Amount / @_TotalAllocRate AS Amount, 			CAST(1 AS Tinyint) AS Gia_Tb_Tt, 			@_RowId AS RowId_SourceDoc, @_Stt AS Stt, 			CASE WHEN @_DocumentGroup = '1' THEN ig.ItemAccount ELSE  				CASE WHEN @_IsSaleInvoice = 1 THEN ig.COGSAccount ELSE @_DebitAccount END END AS DebitAccount, 			CASE WHEN @_IsSaleInvoice = 1 THEN ig.COGSAccount ELSE  				CASE WHEN @_DocumentGroup = '2' THEN ig.ItemAccount ELSE @_CreditAccount END END AS CreditAccount, 			ig.ItemAccount, ig.COGSAccount, CAST(1 AS tinyint) AS Tag 		FROM vB20ItemsSetDef AS CtBo LEFT OUTER JOIN  			dbo.B20Item AS dmvt ON CtBo.ItemCode = DmVt.Code LEFT OUTER JOIN 			B20ItemGroup AS ig ON dmvt.ItemGroupCode = ig.Code LEFT OUTER JOIN  			dbo.B30AccDocSetDetail AS SetDetail ON SetDetail.RowId_SourceDoc = @_RowId AND  					CtBo.ItemCode = SetDetail.ItemCode AND RowType = '1' --AND SetDetail.Ngay_Ct = @_Ngay_Ct 		WHERE CtBo.SetItemCode = @_ItemCode; 	 END

-- ============================================= -- Author:		Ngô Đình Hải -- Create date: 15 Jun 2010 -- Description:	Hạch toán khấu hao tháng TSCĐ -- ============================================= CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[usp_B30AssetDoc_SavingDepreciationPlan] 	@_B20AssetDeprPlanTmp	AS XML				= NULL,  	@_Date					AS SmallDatetime	= NULL, 	@_Year					AS CodeType			= '2009',  	@_AssetAccount			AS CodeType			= '', 	@_AssetCode				AS CodeType			= '', 	@_Round					AS tinyint			= 0, 	@_BranchCode			AS nchar(3)			= 'A00', 	@_nUserId				AS INT				= 0, 	@_LangId				AS smallint			= 0 AS BEGIN 	SET NOCOUNT ON; -- ============================================= -- Author: Đinh Quang Thắng -- Create date:  -- Insert dữ liệu chi tiết phân bổ -- ============================================= CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[usp_B30CcDcPb_AddingData]  	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here 	@_Ngay_Pb dbo.DateType = NULL,  	@_So_Lan_Pb INT = NULL,  	@_Ky_Pb Tinyint = NULL, 	@_Ngay_PbMax dbo.DateType = NULL,  	@_BuiltinOrderMax INT = NULL, 	@_RowNgay_Hong Tinyint = NULL, 	@_RowNgay_Thanh_Ly Tinyint = NULL AS BEGIN 	SET NOCOUNT ON; CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[usp_B30Cdk_ReminderHanTt] 	@_Ma_DvCs NVARCHAR(3) = N'A01' --WITH ENCRYPTION AS BEGIN 	 	SELECT Stt, Tk_Cong_No, Ngay_Ct + Han_Tt AS Due_Date,  			Tien_No, Tien_No_Nt, Tien_Tt_Nt 		FROM B30Cdk AS CdHtt 		LEFT JOIN (SELECT Stt_Cd_Htt, SUM(Tien_Tt_Nt) AS Tien_Tt_Nt 			FROM B30CtHtt WHERE Ngay_Ct_Tt <= GETDATE() GROUP BY Stt_Cd_Htt) AS CtHtt 			ON CdHtt.Stt = CtHtt.Stt_Cd_Htt 			WHERE Ngay_Ct + Han_Tt <= GETDATE() 					AND ABS(Ps_No_Nt + Ps_Co_Nt) > ISNULL(Tien_Tt_Nt, 0) 					AND Ma_DvCs = @_Ma_DvCs 		UNION ALL 		SELECT Stt, Tk_Cong_No, Ngay_Ct + Han_Tt AS Due_Date, Tien_No, Tien_No_Nt, Tien_Tt_Nt 		FROM B30Ct AS Ct LEFT JOIN 			(SELECT Stt_Cd_Htt, SUM(Tien_Tt_Nt) AS Tien_Tt_Nt 			FROM B30CtHtt WHERE Ngay_Ct_Tt <= GETDATE() GROUP BY Stt_Cd_Htt) AS CtHtt 			ON Ct.Stt = CtHtt.Stt_Cd_Htt 			WHERE Ngay_Ct + Han_Tt <= GETDATE() AND Han_Tt > 0 AND Tien_No_Nt > ISNULL(Tien_Tt_Nt, 0) 					AND Ma_DvCs = @_Ma_DvCs 	 END

SET @_FiscalYear = @_Year; 	 	DECLARE @_ErrorMessage NVARCHAR(128)  	IF (SELECT IsGroup FROM B00DmDvcs WHERE Ma_Dvcs = @_Ma_Dvcs) = 1 	BEGIN 		SET @_ErrorMessage = dbo.ufn_sys_MessageText(N'DvcsTongHop', @_LangId); 		 		RAISERROR(@_ErrorMessage, 16, 1); 		RETURN; 	END 	 	-- So sau dau phay  	DECLARE @_Round_Sl SmallInt, @_Round_Tien SmallInt, @_Round_Gia SmallInt 	SET @_Round_Sl = ISNULL((SELECT TOP 1 VarValue FROM B00Config WHERE VarKey = N'Z_Round_Sl'), 2) 	SET @_Round_Tien = ISNULL((SELECT TOP 1 VarValue FROM B00Config WHERE VarKey = N'Z_Round_Tien'), 0) 	SET @_Round_Gia = ISNULL((SELECT TOP 1 VarValue FROM B00Config WHERE VarKey = N'Z_Round_Gia'), 2) 			 	DECLARE @_strExec NVARCHAR(MAX)  	 	-- Xoa do dang tu dau thang 	-- Lay gia thanh tu bang ZChiTiet 	IF OBJECT_ID('TempDb..#CdzTmp', 'U') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #CdzTmp 	SELECT TOP 0 CAST(0 AS SmallInt) AS Year, CAST(0 AS SmallInt) AS Month,  			Account, ProductCostId, Amount  		INTO #CdzTmp 		FROM B00CtTmp 	 	INSERT INTO #CdzTmp (Year, Month, Account, ProductCostId, Amount) 	SELECT @_Year, @_Month2, Account, ProductCostId, SUM(Amount) 		FROM dbo.B30ZDetail 		WHERE Year = @_Year AND BranchCode = @_Ma_DvCs AND 			Month BETWEEN @_Month1 AND @_Month2 AND 			Account = @_Account AND ProductCostId <> '' AND Amount <> 0 			AND IsActive = 1 		GROUP BY Account, ProductCostId 		ORDER BY Account, ProductCostId  BEGIN TRANSACTION 	-- Xoa gia thanh cu di 	UPDATE dbo.B30Cdz 	SET Amount = 0, UnitProductCost = 0 	WHERE Year = @_Year AND BranchCode = @_Ma_DvCs AND 		Month BETWEEN @_Month1 AND @_Month2 AND Account = @_Account  	IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #CdzTmp)  	BEGIN 		-- Cap nhat vao Cdz 		-- Kiem tra ma co ton tai hay khong - neu khong co thi them moi vao 		IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #CdzTmp tmp 			WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM B30cdz 				WHERE Year = tmp.Year AND Month = tmp.Month AND Account = tmp.Account  					AND ProductCostId = tmp.ProductCostId AND BranchCode = @_Ma_DvCs AND IsActive = 1)) 		BEGIN 			INSERT INTO dbo.B30Cdz (FiscalYear, Year, Month, Account, ProductCostId, BranchCode, CreatedBy) 			SELECT @_FiscalYear, Year, Month, Account, ProductCostId, @_Ma_DvCs, @_nUserId FROM #CdzTmp tmp 				WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM B30cdz 					WHERE Year = tmp.Year AND Month = tmp.Month AND Account = tmp.Account  						AND ProductCostId = tmp.ProductCostId AND BranchCode = @_Ma_DvCs AND IsActive = 1) 		END  		-- Cap nhat gia thanh moi 		UPDATE dbo.B30cdz SET Amount = tmp.Amount,  						UnitProductCost = CASE WHEN cdz.FinishedProductQuantity = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(tmp.Amount/cdz.FinishedProductQuantity, @_Round_Gia) END 			FROM dbo.B30cdz cdz INNER JOIN #CdzTmp tmp 				ON cdz.Year = tmp.Year AND cdz.Month = tmp.Month AND cdz.Account = tmp.Account  AND  				cdz.ProductCostId = tmp.ProductCostId AND cdz.BranchCode = @_Ma_DvCs 			WHERE cdz.IsActive = 1 	END  	-- Xoa gia thanh khong co gia tri 	DELETE FROM dbo.B30cdz 	WHERE Year = @_Year AND (Month BETWEEN @_Month1 AND @_Month2) AND 				Account = @_Account AND ABS(FinishedProductQuantity) + ABS(Amount) = 0 AND BranchCode = @_Ma_DvCs 		AND ProductCostId NOT IN  			(SELECT ProductCostId FROM B30ZExpense  				WHERE Year = @_Year AND (Month BETWEEN @_Month1 AND @_Month2) AND 					Account = @_Account AND (UnfinishedFactorAmount <> 0 OR UnfinishedProductAmount <> 0))  COMMIT TRANSACTION  	GOTO DROP_TABLE_TEMP		  	RETURN; 	 ERROR: 	ROLLBACK TRANSACTION	 	 	GOTO DROP_TABLE_TEMP	 	 	RETURN;  DROP_TABLE_TEMP: 	 	IF OBJECT_ID('TempDb..#CdzTmp', 'U') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #CdzTmp  	RETURN; END

khong --> chi tinh DD cho Field Tien 	DECLARE @_Do_Dang_Yeu_To_Nvl VARCHAR(8) 	SET @_Do_Dang_Yeu_To_Nvl =  		ISNULL((SELECT TOP 1 VarValue FROM dbo.B00Config WHERE VarKey = N'Z_Do_Dang_Yeu_To_Nvl'), 			Account = @_Account AND ABS(FinishedProductQuantity) + ABS(MaterialUnfinishedQuantity) + ABS(UnfinishedProductQuantity) <> 0 	GROUP BY ProductCostId 	ORDER BY ProductCostId 	 	IF @@ERROR <> 0 	BEGIN 		PRINT 'Error script: ' + CHAR(13) + @_strExec 		GOTO DROP_TABLE_TEMP 	END  --BEGIN TRANSACTION  	-- Xoa tien do dang san pham trong Zchi phi 	UPDATE dbo.B30ZExpense SET 			SELECT @_ProductCostId = ProductCostId, 				@_FinishedProductQuantity = FinishedProductQuantity,  				@_UnfinishedProductQuantity = UnfinishedProductQuantity,  				@_MaterialUnfinishedQuantity = ma neu co thieu			 				IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #tblZChiPhi) 				BEGIN 					IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #tblZChiPhi zcp 						WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM dbo.B30ZExpense 							WHERE Year = @_Year AND 							IsMaterialFactor = zcp.IsMaterialFactor AND RowId_MultiPhase = zcp.RowId_MultiPhase AND IsActive = 1)) 						INSERT INTO dbo.B30ZExpense 							(FiscalYear, Year, Month, Account, ProductCostId,  								ExpenseAccount, ItemCode, IsMaterialFactor, RowId_MultiPhase, Ma_DvCs) 						SELECT @_FiscalYear, @_Year, @_Month2, @_Account, @_ProductCostId, 								ExpenseAccount, ItemCode, zcp.RowId_MultiPhase  AND IsActive = 1) 	 					-- Cap nhat chi phi Do dang - NVL 					IF @_Do_Dang_Yeu_To_Nvl <> 'TIEN' 					BEGIN 						UPDATE dbo.B30ZExpense 						SET UnfinishedProductQuantity = @_MaterialUnfinishedQuantity ELSE @_OtherUnfinishedQuantity END) 									END, @_Round_Sl) 							FROM dbo.B30ZExpense cp INNER JOIN #tblZChiPhi zcp 								ON cp.ExpenseAccount = zcp.ExpenseAccount 								WHERE BranchCode = @_Ma_DvCs AND Year = @_Year 									AND Account = @_Account AND ProductCostId = '' AND ItemCode = @_ItemCode 									AND IsActive = 1  						-- Yeu to nguyen vat lieu  		RAISERROR(@_ErrorMessage, 16,1); 		RETURN; 	END  	BEGIN TRANSACTION 		UPDATE B30PosDocSession SET CloseTime = GETDATE() 				WHERE Id IN (SELECT Id FROM #IdList) AND CloseTime IS NULL 				 		-- Cập nhật tính năng refresh 		EXECUTE dbo.usp_B00Dependency_Update 	COMMIT TRANSACTION  END

' + dm.Name AS nvarchar(256)) AS ItemName, 				N'Tặng voucher' AS ItemSerialNo, '' AS Unit, 1 AS GiftQuantity, 				dm.DiscountAmount AS UnitPrice, 0 AS Amount2, 0 AS Amount4, 				0 AS IsItemWithTransport, 0 AS IsItemWithInstall 			FROM B30PosDocApplyDiscount AS Ct0 LEFT OUTER JOIN  				B20DiscountVoucherType AS dm ON Ct0.DiscountVoucherTypeCode = dm.Code 			WHERE Ct0.PosDocId = @_PosDocId AND Ct0.DocDate = @_DocDate  					AND Ct0.IsActive = 1 AND DiscountVoucherTypeCode  > '' 			ORDER BY Ct0.BuiltinOrder; 	 	SELECT @_BuiltinOrder = MAX(BuiltinOrder) + 1 FROM #Detail; 	-- Tặng phiếu mua hàng 	IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM B30PosDoc 			WHERE PosDocId = @_PosDocId AND DocDate = @_DocDate  				AND IsActive = 1 AND DiscountVoucherTypeCode > '') 		INSERT INTO #Detail (BuiltinOrder, BuiltinOrder0, ItemCode, ItemName, ItemSerialNo, Unit, Quantity, 					UnitPrice, Amount2, Amount4, IsItemWithTransport, IsItemWithInstall) 			SELECT CAST(@_BuiltinOrder AS Int) AS BuiltinOrder, CAST(@_BuiltinOrder AS Int),  				GiftItemCode,  				CAST(Ct.DiscountVoucherTypeCode + '. ' + dm.Name AS nvarchar(256)) AS ItemName, 				N'Tặng voucher' AS ItemSerialNo, '' AS Unit, 1 AS GiftQuantity, 				dm.DiscountAmount AS UnitPrice, 0 AS Amount2, 0 AS Amount4, 				0 AS IsItemWithTransport, 0 AS IsItemWithInstall 			FROM B30PosDoc AS Ct LEFT OUTER JOIN  				B20DiscountVoucherType AS dm ON Ct.DiscountVoucherTypeCode = dm.Code 			WHERE Ct.PosDocId = @_PosDocId AND Ct.DocDate = @_DocDate  					AND Ct.IsActive = 1 AND DiscountVoucherTypeCode  > ''; 	 	SELECT @_BuiltinOrder = MAX(BuiltinOrder) + 1 FROM #Detail; 	-- Tặng phiếu mua hàng 	IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM B30PosDoc  			WHERE PosDocId = @_PosDocId AND DocDate = @_DocDate  				AND IsActive = 1 AND GiftItemCode > '') 		INSERT INTO #Detail (BuiltinOrder, BuiltinOrder0, ItemCode, ItemName, ItemSerialNo, Unit, Quantity, 					UnitPrice, Amount2, Amount4, IsItemWithTransport, IsItemWithInstall) 			SELECT CAST(@_BuiltinOrder AS Int) AS BuiltinOrder, CAST(@_BuiltinOrder AS Int),  				GiftItemCode,  				CAST(Ct.GiftItemCode + '. ' + dm.Name AS nvarchar(256)) AS ItemName, 				N'Quà tặng' AS ItemSerialNo, dm.Unit, Ct.GiftQuantity, 				0 AS UnitPrice, 0 AS Amount2, 0 AS Amount4, 				0 AS IsItemWithTransport, 0 AS IsItemWithInstall 			FROM B30PosDoc AS Ct LEFT OUTER JOIN  				B20Item AS dm ON Ct.GiftItemCode = dm.Code 			WHERE Ct.PosDocId = @_PosDocId AND Ct.DocDate = @_DocDate  					AND Ct.IsActive = 1 AND GiftItemCode  > ''; 	 	SELECT @_SubTotalSalesAmount = SUM(Amount2) FROM #Detail; 	SELECT @_TotalDiscountAmount = @_SubTotalSalesAmount - @_TotalSalesAmount 	 	IF @_DocCode = 'R6' 		SELECT @_GiveBackAmount = ABS(@_GiveBackAmount); 	 	SELECT * FROM #Detail 		ORDER BY BuiltinOrder;  	DROP TABLE #Detail; 	 	GOTO ENDPROC; 	 	-- Phiếu nộp tiền mặt về 	R3: 	 	IF OBJECT_ID(N'Tempdb..#CashDeposit') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #CashDeposit; 	SELECT CAST(DenominationCode AS nvarchar(24)) AS DenominationCode, 			CAST(Null AS Money) AS Denomination, 			Quantity, Amount 		INTO #CashDeposit  		FROM B30PosDocCashDeposit AS Ct0 		WHERE PosDocId = @_PosDocId AND Ct0.DocDate = @_DocDate AND Ct0.IsActive = 1  		ORDER BY Denomination DESC; 	 	SELECT @_TotalCashPayment = SUM(Amount) FROM #CashDeposit; 	 	INSERT INTO #CashDeposit (DenominationCode, Denomination, Quantity, Amount) 		SELECT Code, Denomination, 0, 0 			FROM B20Denomination 			WHERE Code NOT IN(SELECT DenominationCode FROM #CashDeposit) 				AND IsActive = 1; CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[usp_B30PosDocSalesRetail_AddingData] ( 	@_PosDocId AS varchar(16) = NULL, 	@_ItemCode AS dbo.LongCodeType = '100031', 	@_TerritoryCode nvarchar(16) = '', 	@_ItemType Tinyint = 0, 	@_QueryTime AS datetime = NULL, 	@_NewDataSet AS xml = NULL ) AS BEGIN 	SET NOCOUNT ON; 	DECLARE @_UnitPrice Money, @_ItemQuantity dbo.QuantityType, @_ItemCatgCode nvarchar(16), 			@_ItemAmount2 Money, @_DiscountRate numeric(8, 5), @_ParentIdentityKey Int; 	 	DECLARE @_docHandle int; 	 	EXEC sp_xml_preparedocument @_docHandle OUTPUT, @_NewDataSet; 	 	IF OBJECT_ID('TempDb..#SalesRetail') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #SalesRetail 	SELECT Id, ParentId, IsGroup, PosDocId, ItemCode, ItemName, Unit,  			UnitPrice, Quantity, Amount9, Amount2, 			DiscountRate, Amount4, ItemId, 			SetItemCode, SetItemQuantity, ItemCatgCode, _ParentIdentityKey 		INTO #SalesRetail 		FROM OPENXML (@_docHandle, '/NewDataSet/vB30PosDocSalesRetail_Edit', 2)  			WITH (Id int, ParentId int, IsGroup bit, PosDocId varchar(16), ItemCode nvarchar(24),  					ItemName nvarchar(196), Unit nvarchar(8), UnitPrice Money, Quantity numeric(15, 4), 					Amount9 Money, Amount2 Money, DiscountRate numeric(8, 5), 					Amount4 Money, ItemId Int, SetItemCode nvarchar(24),  					SetItemQuantity numeric(15, 4), ItemCatgCode nvarchar(16), _ParentIdentityKey Int)  	SELECT TOP 1 @_ParentIdentityKey = Id 		FROM OPENXML (@_docHandle, '/NewDataSet/vB30PosDoc_EditSalesRetail', 2) 			WITH (Id Int); 	 	EXEC sp_xml_removedocument @_docHandle; 	 	IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM B20Item WHERE Code = @_ItemCode AND ItemType <> 3) 		 GOTO EXITPOINT; 	ELSE 		IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM B20ItemPrice WHERE ItemCode = @_ItemCode) 			SELECT TOP 1 @_UnitPrice = UnitPrice, @_ItemQuantity = DefaultQuantity, 					@_ItemAmount2 = DefaultAmount2, @_DiscountRate = DiscountRate, 					@_ItemCatgCode = ItemCatgCode 				FROM vB20ItemPrice 				WHERE ItemCode = @_ItemCode 					AND ISNULL(TerritoryCode, '') = ISNULL(@_TerritoryCode, ''); 		ELSE 			 GOTO EXITPOINT; 	 	IF ISNULL(@_ItemQuantity, 0) = 0 SET @_ItemQuantity = 1; 	 	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #SalesRetail WHERE SetItemCode = @_ItemCode) 	BEGIN 		DECLARE @_AmountTemp numeric(18, 2); 		 		SELECT TOP 0 Id, ParentId, IsGroup, PosDocId, ItemCode, ItemName, Unit,  				UnitPrice, Quantity, Amount9, Amount2, 				DiscountRate, Amount4, ItemId, 				SetItemCode, SetItemQuantity, ItemCatgCode, _ParentIdentityKey, 				CAST(0 AS Bit) AS IsMainlyItem 			INTO #SalesRetail0 			FROM #SalesRetail; 		 		INSERT INTO #SalesRetail0(Id, ParentId, IsGroup, PosDocId, ItemCode, ItemName, Unit,  				UnitPrice, Quantity, Amount9, Amount2, 				DiscountRate, Amount4, ItemId, 				SetItemCode, SetItemQuantity, ItemCatgCode, _ParentIdentityKey, IsMainlyItem) 			SELECT -1*Id - 3000, ParentId, IsGroup, @_PosDocId, ItemCode, ItemName, Unit,  				CASE WHEN IsMainlyItem = 1 AND @_ItemQuantity <> 0 					THEN @_ItemAmount2 / @_ItemQuantity ELSE 0 END AS UnitPrice,  				Quantity*@_ItemQuantity,  				CASE WHEN IsMainlyItem = 1 AND @_ItemQuantity <> 0 					THEN @_ItemAmount2 / @_ItemQuantity ELSE 0 END * Quantity*@_ItemQuantity AS Amount9,  				0 AS Amount2, 				@_DiscountRate, 0 AS Amount4, -1*Id, 				SetItemCode, @_ItemQuantity, @_ItemCatgCode, @_ParentIdentityKey, IsMainlyItem 			FROM dbo.vB20ItemsSetDef 			WHERE SetItemCode = @_ItemCode;  		IF EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 * FROM #SalesRetail0 WHERE IsMainlyItem <> 1 AND Quantity <> 0) 		BEGIN 			UPDATE #SalesRetail0 SET UnitPrice = b.UnitPrice 				FROM #SalesRetail0 AS a LEFT OUTER JOIN vB20ItemPrice AS b 				ON a.ItemCode = b.ItemCode AND a.IsMainlyItem <> 1 					AND ISNULL(TerritoryCode, '') = ISNULL(@_TerritoryCode, ''); 			 			SELECT @_AmountTemp = SUM(UnitPrice * Quantity) 				FROM #SalesRetail0 WHERE IsMainlyItem <> 1; 			 			SET @_AmountTemp = @_ItemAmount2 - @_AmountTemp; -- Chênh lệch giữa giá của bộ với tổng giá các mặt hàng khác trong gói. 			UPDATE #SalesRetail0 SET UnitPrice = @_AmountTemp / Quantity, Amount9 = @_AmountTemp  				WHERE IsMainlyItem = 1 AND ISNULL(Quantity, 0) <> 0; 		END 		 		INSERT INTO #SalesRetail(Id, ParentId, IsGroup, PosDocId, ItemCode, ItemName, Unit,  				UnitPrice, Quantity, Amount9, Amount2, 				DiscountRate, Amount4, ItemId, 				SetItemCode, SetItemQuantity, ItemCatgCode, _ParentIdentityKey) 			SELECT Id, ParentId, IsGroup, PosDocId, ItemCode, ItemName, Unit,  				UnitPrice, Quantity, Amount9, Amount2, 				DiscountRate, Amount4, ItemId, 				SetItemCode, SetItemQuantity, ItemCatgCode, _ParentIdentityKey 			FROM #SalesRetail0; 		 		DROP TABLE #SalesRetail0; 	END 	ELSE BEGIN 		UPDATE #SalesRetail SET Quantity = Quantity + (Quantity / SetItemQuantity) * @_ItemQuantity 			WHERE SetItemCode = @_ItemCode;  		UPDATE #SalesRetail SET SetItemQuantity = SetItemQuantity + @_ItemQuantity 			WHERE SetItemCode = @_ItemCode; 	END 	 	EXITPOINT: 	SELECT * FROM #SalesRetail; 	 	IF OBJECT_ID('TempDb..#SalesRetail') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #SalesRetail 	 END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[usp_B30PosDocSalesReturn_AddingData] ( 	@_PosDocId AS varchar(16) = NULL, 	@_SalesReturnPosDocId AS varchar(16) = NULL, 	@_SalesReturnDocDate AS Smalldatetime = NULL ) AS BEGIN 	SELECT -1 * a.Id AS Id, @_PosDocId AS PosDocId, 			ItemCode, a.Unit, Quantity, Quantity AS SalesQuantity, 			b.Name AS ItemName, 			CAST(Amount2 - DiscountAmount AS money) AS Amount2, 			CAST(CASE WHEN Quantity <> 0  				THEN (Amount2 - DiscountAmount) / Quantity  				ELSE 0 END AS money) AS UnitPrice 		FROM B30PosDocSalesRetail AS a LEFT OUTER JOIN 			dbo.B20Item AS b ON a.ItemCode = b.Code 		WHERE a.PosDocId = @_SalesReturnPosDocId AND a.DocDate = @_SalesReturnDocDate END

CREATE PROCEDURE usp_B30SplitTemLot_Check_ItemLotCode     @_TemBarCode NVARCHAR(30),     @_Id INT = -1 AS BEGIN     DECLARE @_QuantityNhap INT, @_IsTachTem BIT, @_IsOutput BIT, @_Message NVARCHAR(50),@_CreatedAt DATETIME;      IF ISNULL(@_TemBarCode, '') = ''     BEGIN         SET @_Message = N'(*) - Hãy chọn tem cần tách!';     END     ELSE     BEGIN         -- Check if the barcode has the prefix "PL" 		IF LEFT(@_TemBarCode, 2) = 'PL' 		BEGIN 		-- Check if the barcode has the prefix "PL" and the CreatedAt date         SELECT TOP 1 @_CreatedAt = CreatedAt         FROM B30BizDocTemLot         WHERE TemBarCode = @_TemBarCode; 		    -- If the barcode has the prefix "PL" and is created on or after 2025-02-28 		    IF CAST(@_CreatedAt AS DATE) >= '2025-02-28' 		    BEGIN 		        -- Raise an error indicating that pallet labels cannot be split 		        RAISERROR('(*) - Không được phép tách tem palet', 16, 1); 		        RETURN; 		    END 		    ELSE 		    BEGIN 		        -- If the barcode has the prefix "PL" and is created before 2025-02-28 		        SET @_TemBarCode = SUBSTRING(@_TemBarCode, 3, LEN(@_TemBarCode) - 2); 		    END 		END          IF @_Id > 0         BEGIN             IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM B30SplitTemLot WHERE Id = @_Id AND TemBarCode = @_TemBarCode)             BEGIN                 SET @_Message = N'(*) - Không được phép sửa giá trị của Tem gốc';             END         END         ELSE         BEGIN             SELECT @_QuantityNhap = Quantity, @_IsTachTem = IsTachTem, @_IsOutput = IsOutput             FROM B30BizDocTemLot             WHERE TemBarCode = @_TemBarCode AND IsActive = 1 AND IsInput = 1;              IF (@_QuantityNhap > 0 AND @_IsTachTem = 0 AND @_IsOutput = 0)             BEGIN                 SET @_Message = N'(*) - OK!';             END             ELSE             BEGIN                 IF (@_IsTachTem = 1)                 BEGIN                     SET @_Message = N'(*) - Tem này đã được tách';                 END                 ELSE                 BEGIN                     IF (@_IsOutput = 1)                     BEGIN                         SET @_Message = N'(*) - Tem này đã được xuất đi';                     END                     ELSE                     BEGIN                         SET @_Message = N'(*) - Tem không tồn tại hoặc chưa nhập vào kho';                     END                 END             END         END     END      SELECT @_Message; END;

-- ================================================== -- Tồn tức thời hiện màn hình mặt hàng + kho -- ================================================== CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[usp_B30TheKho_CurrentStock] 	@_zCurrentFiscalYear NVARCHAR(8) = '2011', 	@_Code dbo.LongCodeType = NULL, 	@_zCurrentMa_Dvcs NCHAR(3) = 'A00', 	@_CurrencyCode0 NCHAR(3) = 'VND', 	@_nUserId INT			= 0, 	@_LangId Tinyint		= 0 --WITH ENCRYPTION AS BEGIN 	SET NOCOUNT ON;  	IF @_Code IS NULL 	BEGIN 		SELECT TOP 0 CAST(0 AS INT) AS Id, WarehouseCode, ItemCode, Quantity, Amount, WarehouseName 			FROM B00CtTmp 		RETURN 	END 	 	DECLARE @_Ngay_Dau_Nam SmallDatetime, @_Ngay_Cuoi_Nam SmallDatetime  	SET @_Ngay_Dau_Nam = dbo.ufn_sys_GetOpenDateOfFinanceYear0(@_zCurrentFiscalYear, @_zCurrentMa_Dvcs) 	SET @_Ngay_Cuoi_Nam = dbo.ufn_sys_GetCloseDateOfFinanceYear0(@_zCurrentFiscalYear, @_zCurrentMa_Dvcs);  	WITH TheKho (WarehouseCode, ItemCode, Quantity, Amount) AS   		(  			SELECT WarehouseCode, ItemCode, SUM(Quantity) AS Quantity, SUM(Amount) AS Amount  				FROM dbo.B30OpenInventory   				WHERE ItemCode = @_Code AND Year = @_zCurrentFiscalYear AND BranchCode = @_zCurrentMa_Dvcs AND IsActive = 1  				GROUP BY WarehouseCode, ItemCode 			UNION ALL  			SELECT WarehouseCode, ItemCode,  				SUM(CASE WHEN DocGroup = 1 THEN Quantity ELSE -1*Quantity END) AS Quantity,  				SUM(CASE WHEN DocGroup = 1 THEN Amount ELSE -1*Amount END) AS Amount  			FROM dbo.vB30StockLedger  			WHERE DocDate BETWEEN @_Ngay_Dau_Nam AND @_Ngay_Cuoi_Nam AND ItemCode = @_Code 			GROUP BY WarehouseCode, ItemCode  		) 		SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY TheKho.WarehouseCode, TheKho.ItemCode) AS Id,  			TheKho.WarehouseCode, TheKho.ItemCode, SUM(TheKho.Quantity) AS Quantity, SUM(TheKho.Amount) AS Amount, 			MAX(dmkho.Name) AS WarehouseName  		FROM TheKho LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.B20Warehouse dmkho ON TheKho.WarehouseCode = dmkho.Code 		GROUP BY TheKho.WarehouseCode, TheKho.ItemCode   END

SELECT CUỐI – ĐÁNH STT & GROUP     ===================================================== */     SELECT         ROW_NUMBER() OVER         (             ORDER BY ItemCode, _DayOfMonth, BarCode         ) AS Group1,          ROW_NUMBER() OVER         (             PARTITION BY ItemCode, _DayOfMonth             ORDER BY BarCode         ) AS _Stt,          *     FROM CTE_Data     ORDER BY RequestDate; END

Vì vậy CẤU TRÚC 27 KÝ TỰ dưới đây là chuẩn tham     -- chiếu — mọi nơi khác build/parse LOT (Usp_DAT_BarCodeView_ThongKe,     -- QRCodeParser, LotNoHelper.NormalizeLot, CapNhapKhoYMVN...) phải cùng hiểu     -- đúng layout này, nếu không LOT sẽ không khớp được với STOCKTP.     -- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════      IF OBJECT_ID ('TempDb..#CtTmp') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #CtTmp                                    -- Tạo bảng tạm #CtTmp theo đúng schema chuẩn của hệ thống (kế thừa từ B00CtTmp,     -- default value do usp_sys_DefaultTable set) — đây là bảng kết quả trả về cho     -- report in tem, mỗi dòng = 1 tem (tem chẵn hoặc tem lẻ).     SELECT TOP 0 stt, ItemCode AS Model, ItemCode AS ShiftCode, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(18,0)) AS Quantity9,                              DocDate, ItemCode, ItemName, CAST(N'' AS nvarchar(100)) AS ItemLotCode, EmployeeCode, CAST(N'' AS NVARCHAR(10)) AS Group1,                              DeptName, CAST(N'' AS nvarchar(256)) AS QRCODE                           INTO #CtTmp                           FROM dbo.B00CtTmp                                    EXECUTE dbo.usp_sys_DefaultTable '#CtTmp'                                DECLARE @_ItemLotCode NVARCHAR(100), @_Id_Item INT, @_Numrow INT, @_QuantityLe NUMERIC(18,0), @_STT INT, @_TemCounter INT, @_LineID_Int INT                  -- ── BƯỚC 1: Tra ID nội bộ của Mã hàng và Line ─────────────────────────────────     -- ID (số) được dùng thay cho Code (chuỗi) khi build LOT vì cần độ dài cố định     -- (pad 5 ký tự) — Code có thể dài ngắn tuỳ ý nên không nhét được vào layout LOT.     -- Dùng biến riêng @_LineID_Int (không tái sử dụng tham số @_LinesCode) để tránh     -- ghi đè tham số đầu vào — @_LinesCode vẫn có thể cần dùng nguyên bản ở chỗ khác     -- nếu proc được mở rộng sau này.     SELECT @_Id_Item = Id FROM dbo.B20Item WHERE Code = @_ReceiptItemCode                           SELECT @_LineID_Int = id FROM B20Lines WHERE Code = @_LinesCode                               -- ── BƯỚC 2: Cấp số thứ tự tem (TEM_COUNTER) ───────────────────────────────────     -- Bộ đếm tem RIÊNG cho từng tổ hợp (Ngày SX, Ca, Mã hàng) — đảm bảo trong cùng     -- 1 ngày + 1 ca + 1 mã hàng, mỗi lần gọi proc sẽ ra số thứ tự tem KHÁC NHAU     -- (STT tem, 4 chữ số, vị trí 20-23 trong LOT — xem BƯỚC 3), tránh trùng LOT giữa     -- các lần in tem khác nhau trong cùng ca/ngày cho cùng 1 mã hàng.     SELECT TOP 1 @_TemCounter = Total FROM TEM_COUNTER          WHERE DocDate = @_DocDate AND ShiftCode = @_ShiftCode AND LTRIM(RTRIM(ItemCode)) = LTRIM(RTRIM(@_ReceiptItemCode))              IF(@_TemCounter IS NULL)                                 BEGIN                                     -- Chưa có bộ đếm cho tổ hợp (Ngày, Ca, Mã hàng) này → khởi tạo = 1         SET @_TemCounter = 1                                     INSERT INTO TEM_COUNTER(DocDate, ShiftCode, Total, ItemCode)              VALUES (@_DocDate, @_ShiftCode, 1, @_ReceiptItemCode)                                 END                                 ELSE                                 BEGIN                                     -- Đã có → tăng thêm 1, reset về 0 nếu vượt 9999 (giới hạn 4 chữ số của ô STT         -- trong LOT — xem RIGHT('0000'+...,4) ở BƯỚC 3). Vòng lặp 0-9999 chấp nhận         -- được vì số tem in ra trong 1 ca/ngày/mã hàng thực tế không vượt mức này.         SET @_TemCounter = (@_TemCounter + 1) % 10000 -- Reset nếu quá 9999             UPDATE TEM_COUNTER SET Total = @_TemCounter                                     WHERE DocDate = @_DocDate AND ShiftCode = @_ShiftCode AND LTRIM(RTRIM(ItemCode)) = LTRIM(RTRIM(@_ReceiptItemCode))         END                                                  -- ── BƯỚC 3: Build ItemLotCode chuẩn — 27 ký tự, vị trí CỐ ĐỊNH ────────────────     -- Dùng RIGHT('padding'+giá trị, N) thay cho STUFF(...) để tránh lỗi khi giá trị     -- rỗng/NULL bị STUFF trả về NULL toàn chuỗi (bug đã gặp ở phiên bản cũ).     --     -- Bảng vị trí (đúng thứ tự nối chuỗi bên dưới):     --   Vị trí  1- 2 (2 ký tự) : YY            — 2 số cuối năm sản xuất     --   Vị trí  3- 4 (2 ký tự) : MM            — tháng sản xuất (pad 0)     --   Vị trí  5- 6 (2 ký tự) : DD            — ngày sản xuất (pad 0)     --   Vị trí  7-11 (5 ký tự) : Id_Item       — ID nội bộ mã hàng (B20Item.Id, pad 0)     --   Vị trí 12    (1 ký tự) : ShiftCode     — mã ca sản xuất     --   Vị trí 13    (1 ký tự) : GearCode      — mã Gear (mặc định '0' nếu không có)     --   Vị trí 14-16 (3 ký tự) : LineID_Int    — ID nội bộ chuyền (B20Lines.Id, pad 0)     --   Vị trí 17-20 (3 ký tự) : MachinesCode  — mã máy (pad 0, KHÔNG phải ID)     --   Vị trí 20-23 (4 ký tự) : TemCounter    — STT tem trong ca/ngày/mã hàng (BƯỚC 2)     --   Vị trí 24-27 (4 ký tự) : QuantityTmp1  — số lượng đóng gói / tem (SL trên tem)     --     -- LƯU Ý QUAN TRỌNG cho việc khớp LOT khi giao hàng (STOCKTP.LOT):     --   LotNoHelper.NormalizeLot (C#) chuẩn hoá LOT bằng cách giữ 19 ký tự đầu     --   (vị trí 1-19: Ngày+Id_Item+Ca+Gear+Line+Machine) + 4 ký tự cuối (vị trí     --   24-27: SL) = 23 ký tự, LOẠI BỎ vị trí 20-23 (TemCounter) — vì STT tem chỉ có     --   ý nghĩa phân biệt CÁC TEM trong cùng 1 lô, không phải một phần định danh của     --   LÔ SẢN XUẤT. Mọi nơi build/so khớp LOT với STOCKTP phải áp dụng đúng quy tắc     --   cắt này (hiện PhieuRepository.CapNhapKhoYMVN đang dùng SUBSTRING(LOT,1,13) —     --   KHÁC quy tắc 23 ký tự này, cần rà soát lại để tránh sai khớp).     SET @_ItemLotCode =             RIGHT(CAST(YEAR(@_DocDate) AS NVARCHAR), 2) +           RIGHT('0' + CAST(MONTH(@_DocDate) AS NVARCHAR), 2) +             RIGHT('0' + CAST(DAY(@_DocDate) AS NVARCHAR), 2) +              RIGHT('00000' + CAST(ISNULL(@_Id_Item,0) AS NVARCHAR), 5) +              ISNULL(@_ShiftCode,'9') + ISNULL(@_GearCode,'0') +              RIGHT('000' + CAST(ISNULL(@_LineID_Int,0) AS NVARCHAR), 3) +              RIGHT('0000' + ISNULL(@_MachinesCode,'0000'), 4) +              RIGHT('0000' + CAST(ISNULL(@_TemCounter,0) AS NVARCHAR), 4) +              RIGHT('0000' + CAST(CAST(ISNULL(@_QuantityTmp1,0) AS INT) AS NVARCHAR), 4)              -- ── BƯỚC 4: Sinh các TEM CHẴN (số lượng đúng bằng @_QuantityTmp1/tem) ─────────     -- Số tem chẵn = phần nguyên của (Tổng SL nhận / SL mỗi tem). NULLIF tránh chia     -- cho 0 khi @_QuantityTmp1 chưa được truyền (=0) — trường hợp đó @_Numrow sẽ là     -- NULL, vòng WHILE không chạy (NULL > 0 = false), không tem nào được sinh — đúng     -- ý đồ (không có quy cách đóng gói thì không tự chia tem tại đây).     --     -- QRCODE build ra có 6 phần, cách nhau bởi ':' — đúng định dạng "tem tổng" mà     -- QRCodeParser.ParseQRCode (C#) nhận diện (parts.Length == 6 → IsTongPhieu=true):     --   [0] LOT (27 ký tự, ItemLotCode)   [1] Mã hàng   [2] Ngày SX (dd/MM/yyyy)     --   [3] Số lượng trên tem              [4] STT tem trong lô (Group hiển thị)     --   [5] Số Stt của chứng từ B30AccDoc (dùng làm MaPhieu — link ngược về chứng từ gốc)     SET @_Numrow = FLOOR(@_ReceiptQty/NULLIF(@_QuantityTmp1,0))   	   	-- Xây dựng phần tiền tố cố định (20 ký tự đầu tiên của LOT trước phần TemCounter)     DECLARE @_LotPrefix NVARCHAR(20)     SET @_LotPrefix =          RIGHT(CAST(YEAR(@_DocDate) AS NVARCHAR), 2) +           RIGHT('0' + CAST(MONTH(@_DocDate) AS NVARCHAR), 2) +             RIGHT('0' + CAST(DAY(@_DocDate) AS NVARCHAR), 2) +              RIGHT('00000' + CAST(ISNULL(@_Id_Item,0) AS NVARCHAR), 5) +              ISNULL(@_ShiftCode,'9') + ISNULL(@_GearCode,'0') +              RIGHT('000' + CAST(ISNULL(@_LineID_Int,0) AS NVARCHAR), 3) +              RIGHT('0000' + ISNULL(@_MachinesCode,'0000'), 4)    	DECLARE @_LastSoPhieuTong INT = NULL  	SELECT TOP 1 @_LastSoPhieuTong = SoPhieuTong      FROM [B7R2_FCC].[dbo].[SlotLot]     WHERE LotNo = @_LotPrefix -- So khớp 20 ký tự đầu của LotNo     ORDER BY SlotLotId DESC      IF (@_LastSoPhieuTong IS NOT NULL)     BEGIN         -- Đã có dữ liệu: Lấy tiếp tục từ SoPhieuTong (hoặc SoPhieuTong + 1 tùy nghiệp vụ tránh trùng lặp)         SET @_STT = @_LastSoPhieuTong + 1      END     ELSE     BEGIN         -- Chưa có dữ liệu: Khởi tạo bắt đầu từ 1         SET @_STT = 1     END       -- SET @_STT = 1                                                   WHILE @_Numrow > 0                           BEGIN                               INSERT INTO #CtTmp (stt, Model, ShiftCode, Quantity9, DocDate, ItemCode, ItemName, ItemLotCode, EmployeeCode, Group1, DeptName, QRCODE)                               SELECT @_STT, Ct.Model, Ct.ShiftCode, @_QuantityTmp1, @_DocDate, ct.ReceiptItemCode, dmvt.Name,                              @_ItemLotCode,                                       Ct0.EmployeeCode, @_Numrow, ISNULL(dmbp.Name,''),                          @_ItemLotCode + ':' + ct.ReceiptItemCode + ':' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10),Ct.DocDate,103) + ':' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@_QuantityTmp1))) + ':' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@_STT))) + ':' + ct.Stt                               FROM dbo.B30AccDoc Ct              LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.B20Item dmvt ON dmvt.Code = ct.ReceiptItemCode              LEFT OUTER JOIN (                 SELECT Stt, MAX(EmployeeCode) AS EmployeeCode FROM dbo.B30AccDocInventory GROUP BY Stt                               ) AS Ct0 ON    WHERE ct.Id = @_Id                                            SET @_Numrow = @_Numrow - 1                               SET @_STT = @_STT + 1                           END                                                       -- ── BƯỚC 5: Sinh TEM LẺ (số dư sau khi chia hết cho tem chẵn) ─────────────────     -- Vd: tổng SL 1050, mỗi tem 400 → 2 tem chẵn (400+400) + 1 tem lẻ 250. CREATE PROC [dbo].[Usp_BarCodeView_ThongKe_Tmp5]     @_Id INT = NULL,     @_DocDate NVARCHAR(16) = N'',     @_ReceiptItemCode NVARCHAR(24) = N'',     @_LOTTMP NVARCHAR(600) = N'',     @_ShiftCode NVARCHAR(24) = N'',     @_MachinesCode NVARCHAR(24) = N'' AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;      IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#CtTmp') IS NOT NULL         DROP TABLE #CtTmp;      SELECT TOP 0         ItemCode AS Model,         ItemCode AS ShiftCode,         CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(18,0)) AS Quantity9,         ItemCode AS DocDate,         ItemCode,         ItemName,         CAST(N'' AS NVARCHAR(50)) AS ItemLotCode,         EmployeeCode,         CAST(N'' AS NVARCHAR(10)) AS Group1,         DeptName,         CAST(N'' AS NVARCHAR(256)) AS QRCODE     INTO #CtTmp     FROM dbo.B00CtTmp;      EXECUTE dbo.usp_sys_DefaultTable '#CtTmp';      DECLARE         @_Numrow INT,         @_SL NUMERIC(18,0),         @_STT NUMERIC(18,0),         @_MH NVARCHAR(50),         @_SLText NVARCHAR(20),         @_SLPadded NVARCHAR(4),         @_LotFull NVARCHAR(600),         @_LotSuffix NVARCHAR(4),         @_nam NVARCHAR(4),         @_nsx NVARCHAR(6),         @_QRCODE NVARCHAR(256),         @_model NVARCHAR(25),         @_Name NVARCHAR(60),         @_ItemLotCodeTP1 NVARCHAR(50);      /*        Validate toàn bộ batch trước khi thay đổi flag.        LOT chuẩn của TMPLOTTACH là 23 ký tự LOT gốc + 4 ký tự SL.        SL được giới hạn 1..9999 vì hậu tố LOT có đúng 4 chữ số.     */     IF EXISTS     (         SELECT 1         FROM dbo.TMPLOTTACH         WHERE ISNULL(flag, 0) = 0           AND           (               SL IS NULL               OR SL <= 0               OR SL > 9999               OR LOT IS NULL               OR LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(LOT))) < 27               OR RIGHT(LTRIM(RTRIM(LOT)), 4)                     <> RIGHT(N'0000' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20), TRY_CONVERT(BIGINT, SL)), 4)               OR TRY_CONVERT(INT, SUBSTRING(LTRIM(RTRIM(LOT)), 7, 5)) IS NULL               OR LEFT(LTRIM(RTRIM(LOT)), 6) LIKE N'%[^0-9]%'           )     )     BEGIN         THROW 50201,             N'TMPLOTTACH có LOT/SL không hợp lệ. LOT phải có đủ LOT gốc + 4 số SL, hậu tố phải khớp SL (1..9999).',             1;     END;      /* Chặn lỗi mã hàng trước khi bắt đầu đánh dấu flag. */     IF EXISTS     (         SELECT 1         FROM dbo.TMPLOTTACH AS T         WHERE ISNULL(T.flag, 0) = 0           AND NOT EXISTS           (               SELECT 1               FROM dbo.B20item AS I               WHERE I.id = TRY_CONVERT(INT, SUBSTRING(LTRIM(RTRIM(T.LOT)), 7, 5))           )     )     BEGIN         THROW 50202,             N'Không tìm thấy mã hàng tương ứng trong B20item cho một hoặc nhiều LOT của TMPLOTTACH.',             1;     END;      SELECT @_Numrow = COUNT(*)     FROM dbo.TMPLOTTACH     WHERE ISNULL(flag, 0) = 0;      WHILE @_Numrow > 0     BEGIN         /* Lấy LOT FULL nguyên vẹn giống cơ chế YMVN. */         SELECT TOP 1             @_MH = MAHANG,             @_LotFull = LTRIM(RTRIM(LOT)),             @_SL = SL,             @_STT = STT         FROM dbo.TMPLOTTACH         WHERE ISNULL(flag, 0) = 0         ORDER BY STT;          IF @_LotFull IS NULL OR @_SL IS NULL OR @_STT IS NULL             THROW 50203, N'Không lấy được dòng LOT hợp lệ từ TMPLOTTACH.', 1;          SET @_SLText = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20), CONVERT(BIGINT, @_SL));         SET @_SLPadded = RIGHT(N'0000' + @_SLText, 4);          /* Không cắt/ghép LOT: giữ nguyên giá trị đầy đủ đã lưu trong TMPLOTTACH. */         SET @_ItemLotCodeTP1 = @_LotFull;          IF LEN(@_ItemLotCodeTP1) > 50             THROW 50204, N'LOT đầy đủ vượt quá độ dài ItemLotCode (50 ký tự) của report GHEPLOT.', 1;          SET @_Id = TRY_CONVERT(INT, SUBSTRING(@_LotFull, 7, 5));         IF @_Id IS NULL             THROW 50205, N'Không phân tích được ID mã hàng từ LOT.', 1;          /* MP/SP: ký tự 12 là Ca. Không đọc ký tự 13 làm Gear như YMVN. */         SET @_ShiftCode = SUBSTRING(@_LotFull, 12, 1);          SET @_nsx = LEFT(@_LotFull, 6);         SET @_DocDate =             RIGHT(@_nsx, 2) + N'/'             + SUBSTRING(@_nsx, 3, 2) + N'/'             + LEFT(@_nsx, 2);          SET @_ReceiptItemCode = NULL;         SET @_Name = NULL;         SET @_model = NULL;          SELECT             @_ReceiptItemCode = code,             @_Name = name,             @_model = model         FROM dbo.B20item         WHERE id = @_Id;          IF @_ReceiptItemCode IS NULL             THROW 50206, N'Không tìm thấy ItemCode trong B20item.', 1;          /*            QR đủ 4 phần, số lượng dùng dạng số nguyên không có khoảng trắng            do STR() tạo ra.         */         SET @_QRCODE =             @_ItemLotCodeTP1 + N':'             + LTRIM(RTRIM(@_ReceiptItemCode)) + N':'             + LTRIM(RTRIM(@_DocDate)) + N':'             + @_SLText;          IF @_QRCODE IS NULL            OR LEN(@_QRCODE) - LEN(REPLACE(@_QRCODE, N':', N'')) <> 3            OR RIGHT(@_QRCODE, 1) = N':'            OR RIGHT(@_QRCODE, LEN(@_SLText)) <> @_SLText         BEGIN             THROW 50207, N'QR tạo ra không đủ 4 trường hoặc số lượng QR không khớp SL.', 1;         END;          INSERT INTO #CtTmp         (             Model, ShiftCode, Quantity9, DocDate, ItemCode, ItemName,             ItemLotCode, EmployeeCode, Group1, DeptName, QRCODE         )         VALUES         (             @_model, @_ShiftCode, @_SL, @_DocDate, @_ReceiptItemCode, @_Name,             @_ItemLotCodeTP1, N'', CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @_Numrow), N'', @_QRCODE         );          /* Đánh dấu đúng dòng đã lấy; MAHANG + STT là khóa logic của batch hiện tại. */         UPDATE dbo.TMPLOTTACH         SET flag = 1         WHERE STT = @_STT           AND ISNULL(MAHANG, N'') = ISNULL(@_MH, N'');          IF @@ROWCOUNT <> 1             THROW 50208, N'Không đánh dấu được duy nhất dòng TMPLOTTACH đang xử lý.', 1;          SET @_Numrow = @_Numrow - 1;     END;      SELECT *     FROM #CtTmp     ORDER BY ItemLotCode;      /*        Giữ tương thích với luồng cũ: reset flag sau khi lấy dữ liệu report.        Lưu ý: TMPLOTTACH hiện là bảng dùng chung; C# đang DELETE toàn bảng        trước khi insert. Không chạy đồng thời nhiều phiên in trên cùng DB.        Muốn hỗ trợ in song song cần bổ sung BatchId/SessionId ở cả C# và SQL.     */     UPDATE dbo.TMPLOTTACH     SET flag = 0; END

-- ============================================= -- Author:		Đỗ Xuân Hoàng -- Create date: 19/09/2013 -- Description:	Tạo lịch công việc thực hiện -- ============================================= CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[usp_BravoJobSchedule] 	@_JobName NVARCHAR(200) = '', 	@_ScheduleName NVARCHAR(200) = '', 	@_StepName NVARCHAR(200) = N'Lập lịch bravo', 	@_StartDate INT = 0, 	@_ActiveStartTime INT = null, 	@_EndDate INT = 0, 	@_TypeSchedule INT = 1, 	@_TypeInterval INT = 1, 	@_StrExec NVARCHAR(2000) = '', 	@_Ennable bit = 1, 	@_ActiveEndTime NVARCHAR(20) = null, 	@_DescriptJob NVARCHAR(200) = N'', 	@_DatabaseName NVARCHAR(200) = N'' 	WITH EXECUTE AS CALLER AS BEGIN 	SET NOCOUNT ON; 					--TypeSchedule value =  					--1 Once 					--4 Daily 					--8 Weekly 					--16 Monthly 					--32 Monthly, relative to freq_interval 					--64 Run when SQLServerAgent service starts 					--128 Run when SQLServer is idle 					--freq_interval 					 			 	         DECLARE @_CheckScheduleName INT; 	         SET @_CheckScheduleName = 0; 			 DECLARE @jobId BINARY(16) 			 DECLARE @JobDelete BINARY(16); 			 DECLARE @ScheduleDelete INT; 						SELECT @_CheckScheduleName = COUNT(*) FROM msdb.dbo.sysjobs WHERE name = @_ScheduleName; 						SELECT @JobDelete =job_id FROM msdb.dbo.sysjobs  									WHERE name = @_ScheduleName; 						SElECT  @ScheduleDelete = schedule_id FROM msdb.dbo.sysschedules  										WHERE name = @_ScheduleName; 						PRINT @_CheckScheduleName; 						IF @_CheckScheduleName<>0 						BEGIN 								DELETE FROM msdb.dbo.sysjobsteps WHERE job_id = @JobDelete; 								DELETE FROM msdb.dbo.sysjobservers WHERE job_id = @JobDelete; 								DELETE FROM msdb.dbo.sysjobactivity WHERE job_id = @JobDelete; 								DELETE FROM msdb.dbo.sysjobschedules WHERE schedule_id = @ScheduleDelete; 								DELETE FROM msdb.dbo.sysschedules WHERE schedule_id = @ScheduleDelete; 								DELETE From msdb.dbo.sysjobs WHERE job_id = @JobDelete; 								--EXEC sp_delete_job @job_name = @_ScheduleName,@delete_unused_schedule=1; 								--DELETE	FROM	sysschedules WHERE name = @_ScheduleName ; 								--EXEC sp_delete_jobserver   @job_name = @_ScheduleName,@server_name = @@SERVERNAME; 						END 						 						-- Create job 						EXEC msdb.dbo.sp_add_job @job_name = @_ScheduleName , 											@job_id = @jobId OUTPUT; 						-- Create steps for executing job  						EXEC msdb.dbo.sp_add_jobstep 							@job_name = @_ScheduleName, 							@step_name = @_StepName, 							@subsystem = N'TSQL', 							@command = @_StrExec, 							@database_name = @_DatabaseName,  							@retry_attempts = 5, 							@retry_interval = 5 ; 						 						-- Add schedule 						EXEC msdb.dbo.sp_add_schedule 							@schedule_name = @_ScheduleName, 							@freq_type = @_TypeSchedule, 							@active_start_time = @_ActiveStartTime, 							@active_start_date = @_StartDate, 							@freq_interval = @_TypeInterval, 							@freq_recurrence_factor = 1; 						-- Atach job to schedule 						EXEC msdb.dbo.sp_attach_schedule 						   @job_name =@_ScheduleName, 						   @schedule_name = @_ScheduleName; 						-- Add job to server 						EXEC msdb.dbo.sp_add_jobserver 							@job_name = @_ScheduleName; 				 END

-- ============================================ -- Description: Bảng cân đối Kế toán  -- Last: Kqt01 -- ============================================ CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[usp_Chart_BalanceSheet] 	@_DocDate1 Smalldatetime		= NULL, 	@_DocDate2 Smalldatetime		= NULL, 	@_ReportPart NChar(1)			= 'N',	-- C: Tài sản, N: Nguồn vốn 	@_RepForm NVARCHAR(16)			= N'', 	@_LangId SMALLINT				= 0, 	@_Ma_Dvcs NCHAR(3)				= N'A02', 	@_CurrencyCode0 NVARCHAR(3)			= N'VND', 	@_Kd_Cp_Tam NCHAR(1)			= N'K', 	@_DefinitionTableName NVARCHAR(32)= N'B10Kqt01', 	@_LAYOUT_XML nvarchar(MAX)		= '' OUTPUT, 	@_ItemNo nvarchar(3)				= '', 	@_TableValue nvarchar(MAX)		= '' OUTPUT, 	@_TableValueInput nvarchar(MAX)	= '', 	@_ViewOnWeb bit					= 0 --WITH ENCRYPTION AS BEGIN 	SET NOCOUNT ON; 	DECLARE @_CacheKey nvarchar(48), @_LastUpdateCache smalldatetime,  			@_LogDataChange tinyint, @_xmlCache xml, @_ConditionKey nvarchar(48);  	DECLARE @_Ngay_Dau_Nam SMALLDATETIME, @_Xml XML, @_DocDate0 Smalldatetime;  	SET @_DocDate0 = dbo.ufn_sys_GetOpenDateOfFinanceYear(@_DocDate2, @_Ma_Dvcs)  	SET @_CacheKey = 'ChartBalanceSheet'; 	SET @_ConditionKey = @_Ma_Dvcs + CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), @_DocDate1, 112) + CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), @_DocDate2, 112) + STR(@_LangId, 1); 	 	IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM B00Cache WHERE CacheKey = @_CacheKey AND ConditionKey = @_ConditionKey) 	BEGIN 		SELECT TOP 1 @_LastUpdateCache = LastUpdate FROM B00Cache WHERE CacheKey = @_CacheKey; 		 		SET @_LogDataChange = dbo.ufn_B00EventLog_DataChange(@_Ma_Dvcs, @_LastUpdateCache); 	END 	ELSE 		SET @_LogDataChange = 99; 	 	IF @_LogDataChange = 0 		GOTO PROCESSDATA;  	SET @_Ma_Dvcs = RTRIM(@_Ma_Dvcs)  	DECLARE @_Kqt NVARCHAR(64) 	SET @_Kqt = @_DefinitionTableName  	IF Object_Id(@_Kqt, 'U') IS NULL RETURN  	-- Tao bang temp 	IF Object_Id(N'Tempdb..#TKTStmp') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #TKTStmp 	CREATE TABLE #TKTStmp (Id INT DEFAULT 0) 	 	EXECUTE usp_sys_CreateTable N'#TKTStmp', @_Kqt 	 	-- Append so lieu tu bang table 	EXECUTE usp_sys_Append @_Kqt, '#TKTStmp' 	 	DECLARE @_strExec NVARCHAR(4000); 	IF @_LangId <> 0  	BEGIN 		SET @_strExec = 'UPDATE #TKTStmp SET Description = Description_' + dbo.ufn_sys_MessageText('Language', @_LangId) 		EXECUTE(@_strExec) 	END  	-- Tao bang chung tu Tmp 	IF Object_Id(N'Tempdb..#K_CtTmp') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #K_CtTmp 	SELECT TOP 0  			DocDate, CustomerCode, Account, DebitAmount, CreditAmount 		INTO #K_CtTmp 		FROM B00CtTmp  	-- Tao bang CdTmp1: Phuc vu chi tiet cong no 	IF Object_Id(N'Tempdb..#CdTmp1') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #CdTmp1 	SELECT Account, CustomerCode, CustomerName,  		DebitAmount AS DebitBal1, CreditAmount AS CreditBal1,  		DebitAmount AS DebitBal0, CreditAmount AS CreditBal0, 		DebitAmount, CreditAmount, DebitAmount AS DebitBal2, CreditAmount AS CreditBal2 	INTO #CdTmp1 	FROM B00CtTmp 	 	EXECUTE usp_sys_DefaultTable '#CdTmp1' 	 	-- Tao bang CdTmp: Lay so lieu dau nam theo tai khoan 	IF Object_Id(N'Tempdb..#CdTmp') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #CdTmp 	SELECT TOP 0 		Account, CAST(0 AS Bit) AS Done, 		DebitAmount AS DebitBal1, CreditAmount AS CreditBal1,  		DebitAmount AS DebitBal0, CreditAmount AS CreditBal0, 		DebitAmount, CreditAmount, DebitAmount AS DebitBal2, CreditAmount AS CreditBal2, 		DebitAmount AS DebitBal1B, CreditAmount AS CreditBal1B,  		DebitAmount AS DebitBal0B, CreditAmount AS CreditBal0B, 		DebitAmount AS DebitAmountB, CreditAmount AS CreditAmountB,  		DebitAmount AS DebitBal2B, CreditAmount AS CreditBal2B 	INTO #CdTmp 	FROM B00CtTmp 	 	EXECUTE usp_sys_DefaultTable N'#CdTmp' 	 	CREATE INDEX Account ON #CdTmp (Account) 	 	IF ISNULL(@_ItemNo, '') = '' 	BEGIN 		EXECUTE usp_Kqt_BangCanDoiKeToan_Len_TKTS  			@_DocDate1		= @_DocDate1,  			@_DocDate2		= @_DocDate2,  			@_FirstDayOfYear	= @_Ngay_Dau_Nam,  			@_tblTKTStmp	= N'#TKTStmp',  			@_LangId		= @_LangId,  			@_Ma_Dvcs		= @_Ma_Dvcs,  			@_CurrencyCode0		= @_CurrencyCode0,  			@_Kd_Cp_Tam		= @_Kd_Cp_Tam 		 		/* Lưu ý: Nên kết xuất ra chuỗi xml các giá trị int, numeric. Với trường char, varchar mà  		chứa ký tự ; (chấm phẩy) thì sẽ gây ra lỗi. Lý do đây là ký tự đặc biệt để phân cách các parameter*/ 		SET @_Xml = ( 						SELECT Id, CloseAmount, OpenFiscalYearAmount 						FROM #TKTStmp AS [Table] 						WHERE CloseAmount <> 0 OR OpenFiscalYearAmount <> 0 						ORDER BY Stt_Order 						FOR XML AUTO, ELEMENTS 					)  		SELECT @_TableValue = N'<Root>' + CAST(@_Xml AS nvarchar(MAX)) + N'</Root>' 	END  	PROCESSDATA: 	 	IF Object_Id(N'tempdb..#Chart') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Chart; 	CREATE TABLE #Chart (Stt NVARCHAR(4), Description nvarchar(64), TotalAmount numeric(18, 2), 					ChartColor NVARCHAR(24), Rate NUMERIC(7, 2), 					ColName VARCHAR(4), X VARCHAR(4), Y VARCHAR(4)) 	 	IF @_LogDataChange = 0	-- Get data from cache 		BEGIN 			SELECT @_xmlCache = ( 							SELECT CacheValue FROM B00Cache WHERE CacheKey = @_CacheKey 							) 			 			DECLARE @_docHandle int; 			 			EXEC sp_xml_preparedocument @_docHandle OUTPUT, @_xmlCache; 			 			INSERT INTO #Chart 				SELECT TOP 10 CAST(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY Stt_Order) AS NVARCHAR(4)) AS Stt, 						SUBSTRING(Description, CHARINDEX('.', Description) + 1, 64) AS Description,  						CloseAmount AS TotalAmount, 						CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(24)) AS ChartColor, 						CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(7, 2)) AS Rate, 						CAST('' AS VARCHAR(4)) AS ColName, SPACE(4) AS X, SPACE(4) AS Y 					FROM OPENXML (@_docHandle, '/root/tmpTable')  					WITH (Stt_Order Smallint, Description nvarchar(64), CloseAmount numeric(18, 2), ItemSide Char(1)) 					WHERE ItemSide = @_ReportPart; 			 			EXEC sp_xml_removedocument @_docHandle; 		END 	ELSE 		BEGIN 		 		INSERT INTO #Chart 			SELECT TOP 10 CAST(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY Stt_Order) AS NVARCHAR(4)) AS Stt, 					SUBSTRING(Description, CHARINDEX('.', Description) + 1, 64) AS Description,  					CloseAmount AS TotalAmount, 					CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(24)) AS ChartColor, 					CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(7, 2)) AS Rate, 					CAST('' AS VARCHAR(4)) AS ColName, SPACE(4) AS X, SPACE(4) AS Y 				FROM #TKTStmp A 				WHERE Form_B01b = N'C' AND ItemSide = @_ReportPart AND IsOutsideAccount = 0 AND IsPrint = 1 AND Bold_B01B <> 'C'; 			 			-- Saving Balance sheet 			SET @_LastUpdateCache = GETUTCDATE(); 			SELECT @_xmlCache = ( 							SELECT Stt_Order, Description, CloseAmount, ItemSide 								FROM #TKTStmp AS tmpTable  								WHERE Form_B01b = N'C' AND IsOutsideAccount = 0 AND IsPrint = 1 AND Bold_B01B <> 'C' 								FOR XML AUTO, ROOT('root') 								) 			IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM B00Cache WHERE CacheKey = @_CacheKey) 				UPDATE B00Cache SET LastUpdate = @_LastUpdateCache, ConditionKey = @_ConditionKey, 									CacheValue = @_xmlCache 					WHERE CacheKey = @_CacheKey; 			ELSE 				INSERT INTO B00Cache  					VALUES(@_CacheKey, @_ConditionKey, @_LastUpdateCache, @_xmlCache); 		END 	 	DECLARE @_Total NUMERIC(18, 2) 	SET @_Total = ISNULL((SELECT SUM(TotalAmount) FROM #Chart), 0)  	UPDATE #Chart SET Rate = CASE WHEN @_Total = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(TotalAmount/@_Total, 4) * 100 END  	IF @_ViewOnWeb = 1 	BEGIN 		SELECT Description AS [Name], Rate AS [Value] 			FROM #Chart 			ORDER BY [Value] DESC  		RETURN; CREATE PROCEDURE usp_DAT_B30BizDocDetail_UpdateValue       @_BizDocId NVARCHAR(16) = NULL,       @_DocDate SMALLDATETIME = '',       @_ItemLot_Tmp NVARCHAR(50) = '',       @_Check_Sum INT = 0,       @_nUserId INT = NULL   AS   BEGIN       SET NOCOUNT ON;             RETURN;         END     END        IF (@_IsInput = 1 AND @_Check_Sum = 1)           SET @_Message = N'Tem đã nhập vào kho';       ELSE IF (@_IsInput = 0 AND @_Check_Sum = 0)           SET @_Message = N'Tem chưa nhập vào kho';               END               ELSE               BEGIN                   UPDATE dbo.B30BizDocReturnDetail                   SET RevertQuantity = ISNULL(RevertQuantity, 0) + CASE WHEN ISNULL(@_Check_Sum, 0) = 1 THEN @_Quantity ELSE -@_Quantity END,                       InfactQuantity = ISNULL(InfactQuantity, 0) + CASE WHEN ISNULL(@_Check_Sum, 0) = 1 THEN @_Quantity ELSE -@_Quantity END,                       DiffQuantity = ISNULL(Quantity9, 0) - (ISNULL(InfactQuantity, 0) + CASE WHEN ISNULL(@_Check_Sum, 0) = 1 THEN @_Quantity ELSE -@_Quantity END),                       InfactDate = @_DocDate                   WHERE ItemLotCode = @_ItemLotCode; CREATE PROC usp_DAT_B30ExportPDDetail_UpdateValue1 (     @_ExportId     NVARCHAR(16),     @_DocDate      SMALLDATETIME,     @_TemBarCode   NVARCHAR(50),     @_Check_Sum    INT = 0,     @_nUserId      INT ) AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;      /* =====================================================        0. KHAI BÁO BIẾN     ===================================================== */     DECLARE         @_Quantity       NUMERIC(18,2),         @_ItemCode       NVARCHAR(50),         @_ItemLotCode    NVARCHAR(50),         @_ExportQty      NUMERIC(18,2) = 0,         @_RequestQty     NUMERIC(18,2) = 0,         @_LotQty         NUMERIC(18,2),         @_BuiltinOrder   INT,         @_IsCompensation BIT = 0,         @_CompensationNo INT = NULL;      /* =====================================================        1. XÁC ĐỊNH GIAO BÙ     ===================================================== */     IF EXISTS (         SELECT 1         FROM B30ExportPD         WHERE ExportId = @_ExportId           AND HasCompensation = 1     )     BEGIN         SET @_IsCompensation = 1;          SELECT @_CompensationNo = MAX(CompensationNo)         FROM B30ExportPDCompensation         WHERE ExportId = @_ExportId;     END      /* =====================================================        2. LẤY THÔNG TIN TEM     ===================================================== */     SELECT         @_Quantity    = Quantity,         @_ItemLotCode = ItemLotCode,         @_ItemCode    = ItemCode     FROM B30BizDocTemLot     WHERE TemBarCode = @_TemBarCode       AND IsInput = 1       AND IsActive = 1       AND IsOutput = CASE WHEN @_Check_Sum = 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END       AND ISNULL(Stt,'') = CASE WHEN @_Check_Sum = 1 THEN '' ELSE @_ExportId END;      IF ISNULL(@_Quantity,0) = 0     BEGIN         SELECT N'(*) - Tem đã sử dụng hoặc không tồn tại' AS Message;         RETURN;     END      IF LEFT(@_ItemLotCode,2) = 'PL'         SET @_ItemLotCode = SUBSTRING(@_ItemLotCode,3,LEN(@_ItemLotCode));      IF @_Check_Sum = 0         SET @_Quantity = @_Quantity * -1;      /* =====================================================        3. LẤY HEADER (DÒNG REQUEST)     ===================================================== */     SELECT TOP 1         @_ExportQty  = ExportQuantity,         @_RequestQty = RequestQuantity     FROM B30ExportPDDetail     WHERE ExportId = @_ExportId       AND ItemCode = @_ItemCode       AND RequestQuantity > 0;      IF ISNULL(@_RequestQty,0) = 0     BEGIN         SELECT N'(*) - Linh kiện không có trong PD' AS Message;         RETURN;     END      /* =====================================================        4. CHẶN VƯỢT SỐ (CHỈ GIAO THƯỜNG)     ===================================================== */     IF @_IsCompensation = 0        AND (@_ExportQty + @_Quantity) > @_RequestQty     BEGIN         SELECT N'(*) - Không được bắn quá số lượng yêu cầu' AS Message;         RETURN;     END      /* =====================================================        5. BẮN LẦN ĐẦU → UPDATE HEADER (Y HỆT USP CŨ)     ===================================================== */     IF @_IsCompensation = 0 AND ISNULL(@_ExportQty,0) = 0     BEGIN         UPDATE B30ExportPDDetail         SET             ItemLotCode    = @_ItemLotCode,             LotQuantity    = @_Quantity,             ExportQuantity = @_Quantity,             ExportDate     = @_DocDate,             ModifiedAt     = GETDATE(),             ModifiedBy     = @_nUserId         WHERE ExportId = @_ExportId           AND ItemCode = @_ItemCode           AND RequestQuantity > 0;          GOTO UPDATE_TEM;     END      /* =====================================================        6. TÌM LOT ĐÃ TỒN TẠI     ===================================================== */     IF @_IsCompensation = 0     BEGIN         SELECT TOP 1 @_LotQty = LotQuantity         FROM B30ExportPDDetail         WHERE ExportId = @_ExportId           AND ItemCode = @_ItemCode           AND ItemLotCode = @_ItemLotCode           AND RequestQuantity = 0;     END     ELSE     BEGIN         SELECT TOP 1 @_LotQty = LotQuantity         FROM B30ExportPDDetail         WHERE ExportId = @_ExportId           AND ItemCode = @_ItemCode           AND ItemLotCode = @_ItemLotCode           AND RequestQuantity = 0           AND CompensationNo = @_CompensationNo;     END      /* =====================================================        7. UPDATE / INSERT LOT     ===================================================== */     IF ISNULL(@_LotQty,0) <> 0     BEGIN         UPDATE B30ExportPDDetail         SET             LotQuantity = LotQuantity + @_Quantity,             ModifiedAt  = GETDATE(),             ModifiedBy  = @_nUserId         WHERE ExportId = @_ExportId           AND ItemCode = @_ItemCode           AND ItemLotCode = @_ItemLotCode           AND RequestQuantity = 0           AND (                 @_IsCompensation = 0              OR CompensationNo = @_CompensationNo           );     END     ELSE     BEGIN         SELECT @_BuiltinOrder = ISNULL(MAX(BuiltinOrder),0) + 1         FROM B30ExportPDDetail         WHERE ExportId = @_ExportId;          INSERT INTO B30ExportPDDetail         (             ExportId, BuiltinOrder, ItemCode, Unit,             NormQuantity, RequestQuantity, ExportQuantity,             ItemLotCode, LotQuantity, ExportDate,             CompensationNo, CreatedBy         )         VALUES         (             @_ExportId, @_BuiltinOrder, @_ItemCode, '',             0, 0, 0,             @_ItemLotCode, @_Quantity, @_DocDate,             @_CompensationNo, @_nUserId         );     END      /* =====================================================        8. UPDATE HEADER TỔNG (Y HỆT USP CŨ)     ===================================================== */     UPDATE B30ExportPDDetail     SET ExportQuantity = ExportQuantity + @_Quantity     WHERE ExportId = @_ExportId       AND ItemCode = @_ItemCode       AND RequestQuantity > 0;      /* =====================================================        9. UPDATE TEM     ===================================================== */ UPDATE_TEM:     UPDATE B30BizDocTemLot     SET         IsOutput   = CASE WHEN @_Check_Sum = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,         Stt        = CASE WHEN @_Check_Sum = 1 THEN @_ExportId ELSE NULL END,         ModifiedAt = GETDATE(),         ModifiedBy = @_nUserId     WHERE TemBarCode = @_TemBarCode;      SELECT N'' AS Message; END

Nếu cần, bổ sung     -- 1 SELECT rỗng có cấu trúc #CtTmp kèm cột lỗi để tầng gọi (report) không bị crash.                 SET @_ItemLotCodeTP1 = LEFT(@_ItemLotCodeTP, CHARINDEX(',', @_ItemLotCodeTP) - 1)                 SET @_ItemLotCodeTP2 = RIGHT(@_ItemLotCodeTP, LEN(@_ItemLotCodeTP) - CHARINDEX(',', @_ItemLotCodeTP))             END             ELSE             BEGIN                 SET @_ItemLotCodeTP1 = @_ItemLotCodeTP                 SET @_ItemLotCodeTP2 = @_ItemLotCodeTP             END              IF OBJECT_ID('TempDb..#CtTmp') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #CtTmp             SELECT TOP 0 ItemCode AS Model, ItemCode AS ShiftCode, 0 AS GearCode,                    CAST(N'' AS NVARCHAR(1)) AS GearName, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(18,0)) AS Quantity9,                    DocDate, ItemCode, ItemName, CAST(N'' AS NVARCHAR(64)) AS ItemLotCode,                    EmployeeCode, CAST(N'' AS NVARCHAR(10)) AS Group1,                    DeptName, CAST(N'' AS NVARCHAR(256)) AS QRCODE             INTO #CtTmp             FROM dbo.B00CtTmp              EXECUTE dbo.usp_sys_DefaultTable '#CtTmp' SELECT @_ReceiptItemCode = ReceiptItemCode, @_ReceiptQuantity = ReceiptQuantity             FROM dbo.B30AccDoc WHERE Id = @_Id              SELECT @_CodeNo = Id FROM B20Item WHERE Code = Ct0.EmployeeCode, 1 AS Group1, ISNULL(dmbp.Name, '') AS DeptName,                        Ct.ItemLotCodeTP + ':' + ct.ReceiptItemCode + ':' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), Ct.DocDate, 103) + ':' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(ct.ReceiptQuantity))) AS QRCODE                 FROM dbo.B30AccDoc Ct                 LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.B20Item dmvt ON dmvt.Code = ct.ReceiptItemCode                 LEFT OUTER JOIN          LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.B20Employee dmnv ON dmnv.Code = Ct0.EmployeeCode                 LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.B20Dept dmbp ON dmbp.Code = dmnv.DeptCode                 WHERE ct.Id = @_Id = FLOOR(@_ReceiptQuantity / @_MinCloseQty)                 SELECT @_trung = COUNT(*) FROM tbl_DocTem WHERE SP = @_Stt AND IsXuat <> 0                  IF (@_trung = 0)                 BEGIN                     DELETE FROM tbl_DocTem WHERE SP = @_Stt AND IsXuat <> 1                 END                  WHILE @_Numrow > 0                 BEGIN                     -- Ghép lại ItemLotCodeTP1: giữ phần ct.ReceiptItemCode AS ItemCode, dmvt.Name AS ItemName,                                @_ItemLotCodeTP1 AS ItemLotCode,                                dmnv.DeptCode, @_Numrow AS Group1, QRCODE                         FROM dbo.B30AccDoc Ct                         LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.B20Item dmvt ON dmvt.Code = ct.ReceiptItemCode                         LEFT OUTER JOIN (                             SELECT Stt, MAX(EmployeeCode) AS EmployeeCode                             FROM dbo.B30AccDocInventory                             GROUP BY Stt                         ) AS Ct0 ON ct0.Stt = ct.Stt                         LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.B20Employee dmnv ON dmnv.Code = Ct0.EmployeeCode                         LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.B20Dept dmbp ON dmbp.Code = dmnv.DeptCode CREATE PROC Usp_ExportPDView     @_Id INT = NULL,     @_DocDate SMALLDATETIME = NULL,     @_RequestDate SMALLDATETIME = NULL,     @_ItemCodeTP NVARCHAR(50) = NULL,     @_ItemNameTP NVARCHAR(50) = NULL,     @_Model NVARCHAR(50) = NULL,     @_QuantityTP NUMERIC(18,2) = NULL,     @_DocNo NVARCHAR(50) = NULL,     @_EmployeeName NVARCHAR(50) = NULL,     @_PICName NVARCHAR(50) = NULL,     @_RequestId NVARCHAR(50) = NULL,     @_DeptNamePD NVARCHAR(50) = NULL,     @_DocDatePD SMALLDATETIME = NULL,     @_ShiftNamePD NVARCHAR(50) = NULL,     @_EmployeeNamePD NVARCHAR(50) = NULL AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;      DECLARE @_TotalRequestQty NUMERIC(18,2),             @_TotalExportQty  NUMERIC(18,2);      /* =====================================================        1. KIỂM TRA ĐIỀU KIỆN CHO PHÉP IN        ===================================================== */      SELECT         @_TotalRequestQty = SUM(RequestQuantity),         @_TotalExportQty  = SUM(ExportQuantity)     FROM vB30ExportPDDetail_Edit     WHERE ExId = @_Id;      IF ISNULL(@_TotalExportQty,0) = 0     BEGIN         RAISERROR (N'Chưa có dữ liệu xuất để in.', 16, 1);         RETURN;     END      IF EXISTS (         SELECT 1         FROM vB30ExportPDDetail_Edit         WHERE ExId = @_Id           AND ExportQuantity <> RequestQuantity           AND ISNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM(Remark)), '') = ''     )     BEGIN         RAISERROR (N'Tồn tại linh kiện xuất thiếu/thừa nhưng chưa nhập lý do (Remark).', 16, 1);         RETURN;     END      /* =====================================================        2. DỮ LIỆU IN – CHỈ IN DÒNG CHƯA IN        ===================================================== */      SELECT         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ex.CreatedAt, ex.ItemCode) AS IdNo,         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ex.ItemCode ORDER BY ex.CreatedAt) AS STTLot,          CASE WHEN ex.NormQuantity > 0 THEN ex.ItemCode ELSE '' END AS ItemCode,         CASE WHEN ex.NormQuantity > 0 THEN ex.ItemName ELSE '' END AS ItemName,         CASE WHEN ex.NormQuantity > 0 THEN cus.Name2 ELSE '' END AS SupplierName2,          ex.NormQuantity,         ex.RequestQuantity,         ex.ExportQuantity,         ex.ItemLotCode,         ex.LotQuantity,         ex.Unit,         ex.Remark,         '' AS CheckPC,         '' AS CheckPD,         ex.IsPrinted,         ex.PrintSeq     FROM vB30ExportPDDetail_Edit ex     LEFT JOIN B30PDRequestDetail pddt            ON ex.RequestId = pddt.Stt           AND ex.ItemCode = pddt.ItemCode           AND ex.RequestQuantity = pddt.RequestQuantity     LEFT JOIN B20Customer cus            ON pddt.SupplierCode = cus.Code     WHERE ex.ExId = @_Id       AND ex.ExportQuantity > 0       AND ISNULL(ex.IsPrinted,0) = 0     ORDER BY IdNo; END

CREATE PROC usp_FindFaultyComponents @_BudgetStt NVARCHAR(24) = N'' AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;     IF OBJECT_ID ('TempDb..#CtTmp') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #CtTmp;     SELECT TOP 0 ItemCode, cast(0 as int) as _Rank, Description AS itemcodeTP, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(18,0)) AS NormQuantity, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(18,0)) AS Quantity, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(18,0)) AS RequestQuantity,     Description as SupplierCode, cast(0 as int) as generation_number, Description as ItemGroupCode     INTO #CtTmp     FROM dbo.B00CtTmp;      DECLARE @itcode AS NVARCHAR(50), @Qt AS INT, @_Dept AS NVARCHAR(5);     SELECT @_Dept = DeptCode FROM B30Budget WHERE Stt = @_BudgetStt;     DECLARE de CURSOR FOR     SELECT ItemCode, Quantity FROM B30BudgetDetail WHERE Stt = @_BudgetStt;     OPEN de;     FETCH NEXT FROM de INTO @itcode, @Qt;     WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0     BEGIN         PRINT 'Processing ItemCode: ' + @itcode; -- Ghi log mã đang xử lý         WITH generation AS (             SELECT dt.ItemCode, dt.ItemCodeTP, 0 AS generation_number, dt.Quantity AS NormQuantity, it.Name2 AS Dpt             FROM B20ModelDetail dt             LEFT JOIN B20Item it ON dt.ItemCode = it.Code             WHERE dt.ItemCodeTP = @itcode             UNION ALL             SELECT child.ItemCode, child.ItemCodeTP, g.generation_number + 1 AS generation_number, child.NormQuantity, child.Dpt             FROM (                 SELECT dt.ItemCode, dt.ItemCodeTP, dt.Quantity AS NormQuantity, it.Name2 AS Dpt                 FROM B20ModelDetail dt                 JOIN B20Item it ON dt.ItemCodeTP = it.Code             ) child             JOIN generation g ON g.ItemCode = child.ItemCodeTP         )         INSERT INTO #CtTmp (ItemCode, itemcodeTP, Quantity, NormQuantity, RequestQuantity, SupplierCode, generation_number, ItemGroupCode)         SELECT a.ItemCode, a.itemcodeTP, SUM(@Qt * a.NormQuantity), SUM(a.NormQuantity), SUM(@Qt * a.NormQuantity), a.SupplierCode, a.generation_number, a.ItemGroupCode         FROM (             SELECT ge.ItemCode, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ge.ItemCode ORDER BY ge.ItemCode DESC) AS _Rank, ge.ItemCodeTP, ge.NormQuantity,             ISNULL(qc.CustomerCode, '') AS SupplierCode, ge.generation_number, it.ItemGroupCode, ge.Dpt             FROM generation ge             INNER JOIN B20Item it ON ge.ItemCode = it.Code             LEFT JOIN B20ItemQuyCach qc ON ge.ItemCode = qc.ItemCode         ) a         GROUP BY a.ItemCode, a._Rank, a.itemcodeTP, a.SupplierCode, a.generation_number, a.ItemGroupCode;         FETCH NEXT FROM de INTO @itcode, @Qt;     END     CLOSE de;     DEALLOCATE de;      IF (@_Dept = '1700')         SELECT DISTINCT tp.*, it.Name2         FROM #CtTmp tp         INNER JOIN B20Item it ON tp.itemcodeTP = it.Code         WHERE tp.ItemGroupCode = 'LK' AND it.Name2 = '1700'         ORDER BY tp.itemcodeTP, tp.generation_number DESC         OPTION (MAXRECURSION 32767); -- Tăng giới hạn đệ quy     ELSE         SELECT DISTINCT tp.*, it.Name2         FROM #CtTmp tp         INNER JOIN B20Item it ON tp.itemcodeTP = it.Code         WHERE tp.ItemGroupCode = 'LK'         ORDER BY tp.itemcodeTP, tp.generation_number DESC         OPTION (MAXRECURSION 32767); -- Tăng giới hạn đệ quy END

create PROCEDURE dbo.usp_Fix_All_Invalid_PalletLabels     @UserId INT = -1 AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;      BEGIN TRY         BEGIN TRAN;          ---------------------------------------------------         -- 1. Disable pallet sai (IsPL = 1 nhưng không có quy cách pallet)         ---------------------------------------------------         UPDATE t         SET t.IsActive = 0,             t.ModifiedAt = GETDATE(),             t.ModifiedBy = @UserId         FROM dbo.B30BizDocTemLot t         INNER JOIN dbo.B30BizDocDetail d              ON d.ItemLotCode = t.ItemLotCode         INNER JOIN dbo.B20ItemQuyCach qc             ON qc.ItemCode = d.ItemCode            AND qc.CustomerCode = d.CustomerCode         WHERE ISNULL(qc.MaxCloseQty, 0) = 0           AND t.IsPL = 1           AND t.IsInput = 0;          ---------------------------------------------------         -- 2. Convert tem con → tem thường         ---------------------------------------------------         UPDATE t         SET t.ParentId = 0,             t.TemBarCodePL = NULL,             t.IsPL = 0,             t.TemType = 'PO',             t.ModifiedAt = GETDATE(),             t.ModifiedBy = @UserId         FROM dbo.B30BizDocTemLot t         INNER JOIN dbo.B30BizDocDetail d              ON d.ItemLotCode = t.ItemLotCode         INNER JOIN dbo.B20ItemQuyCach qc             ON qc.ItemCode = d.ItemCode            AND qc.CustomerCode = d.CustomerCode         WHERE ISNULL(qc.MaxCloseQty, 0) = 0           AND t.IsInput = 0           AND (                 t.ParentId <> 0                  OR t.TemBarCodePL IS NOT NULL               );          ---------------------------------------------------         -- 3. Dọn orphan (tem con trỏ về pallet đã bị disable)         ---------------------------------------------------         UPDATE t         SET t.ParentId = 0,             t.TemBarCodePL = NULL         FROM dbo.B30BizDocTemLot t         WHERE EXISTS (             SELECT 1             FROM dbo.B30BizDocTemLot pl             WHERE pl.Id = t.ParentId               AND pl.IsPL = 1               AND pl.IsActive = 0         );          COMMIT TRAN;     END TRY     BEGIN CATCH         ROLLBACK TRAN;         THROW;     END CATCH END

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.usp_Fix_Invalid_PalletLabels     @FixDate DATE,     @UserId INT = -1 AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;      BEGIN TRY         BEGIN TRAN;          ---------------------------------------------------         -- 1. Disable pallet sai (MaxCloseQty = 0)         ---------------------------------------------------         UPDATE t         SET t.IsActive = 0,             t.ModifiedAt = GETDATE(),             t.ModifiedBy = @UserId         FROM dbo.B30BizDocTemLot t         INNER JOIN dbo.B20ItemQuyCach qc             ON qc.ItemCode = t.ItemCode            AND qc.CustomerCode = t.ItemCode  -- ⚠️ sửa lại nếu bạn có CustomerCode trong TemLot         WHERE CAST(t.CreatedAt AS DATE) = @FixDate           AND ISNULL(qc.MaxCloseQty, 0) = 0           AND t.IsPL = 1           AND t.IsInput = 0;          ---------------------------------------------------         -- 2. FIX TEM CON → thành tem độc lập         ---------------------------------------------------         UPDATE t         SET t.ParentId = 0,             t.TemBarCodePL = NULL,             t.IsPL = 0,             t.TemType = 'PO',             t.ModifiedAt = GETDATE(),             t.ModifiedBy = @UserId         FROM dbo.B30BizDocTemLot t         INNER JOIN dbo.B20ItemQuyCach qc             ON qc.ItemCode = t.ItemCode            AND qc.CustomerCode = t.ItemCode  -- ⚠️ chỉnh lại đúng field         WHERE CAST(t.CreatedAt AS DATE) = @FixDate           AND ISNULL(qc.MaxCloseQty, 0) = 0           AND t.IsInput = 0           AND (                 t.ParentId <> 0                  OR t.TemBarCodePL IS NOT NULL               );          ---------------------------------------------------         -- 3. (OPTIONAL) Reset ParentId của tem con trỏ về pallet đã bị disable         ---------------------------------------------------         UPDATE t         SET t.ParentId = 0,             t.TemBarCodePL = NULL         FROM dbo.B30BizDocTemLot t         WHERE EXISTS (             SELECT 1             FROM dbo.B30BizDocTemLot pl             WHERE pl.Id = t.ParentId               AND pl.IsPL = 1               AND pl.IsActive = 0         );          COMMIT TRAN;     END TRY     BEGIN CATCH         ROLLBACK TRAN;         THROW;     END CATCH END

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.usp_Get_Tem_Counter     @_TableName NVARCHAR(50),     @_CounterKey NVARCHAR(50),     @_TotalTem INT = 1,     @_TemCounter INT OUTPUT AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;      BEGIN TRY         BEGIN TRAN;          -- Đảm bảo tồn tại dòng Counter         IF NOT EXISTS (             SELECT 1             FROM dbo.B30TemCounter WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)             WHERE TableName = @_TableName               AND CounterKey = @_CounterKey         )         BEGIN             INSERT INTO dbo.B30TemCounter (TableName, CounterKey, Total)             VALUES (@_TableName, @_CounterKey, 0);         END          -- Tăng bộ đếm         UPDATE dbo.B30TemCounter WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)         SET Total = Total + @_TotalTem         WHERE TableName = @_TableName           AND CounterKey = @_CounterKey;          -- Lấy giá trị mới sau khi cập nhật         SELECT @_TemCounter = Total         FROM dbo.B30TemCounter         WHERE TableName = @_TableName           AND CounterKey = @_CounterKey;          COMMIT TRAN;     END TRY     BEGIN CATCH         IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0             ROLLBACK TRAN;          THROW;     END CATCH END

CREATE PROC dbo.usp_Get_Ton_Lot 	@_ItemCode NVARCHAR(24) = '' AS BEGIN     --Lấy dữ liệu gốc 	IF OBJECT_ID ('TempDb..#DataGoc')  IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #DataGoc 	SELECT Code, ItemCode, 0 AS Quantity, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(18,0)) AS QuantityTH 	INTO #DataGoc 	FROM dbo.B20ItemLot  	WHERE ItemCode = @_ItemCode  	--Lấy dữ liệu thực hiện 	IF OBJECT_ID ('TempDb..#ThucHien')  IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #ThucHien 	SELECT @_ItemCode AS ItemCode, ct0.ItemLotCode, SUM(Quantity9) AS Quantity 	INTO #ThucHien 	FROM dbo.B30AccDocInventory ct0 LEFT OUTER JOIN 		dbo.B30AccDoc Ct ON Ct.Stt = Ct0.Stt 	WHERE ItemCode = @_ItemCode AND Ct.IsActive = 1 	GROUP BY ItemLotCode 	 	UPDATE #DataGoc SET QuantityTH = b.Quantity 	FROM #DataGoc a LEFT OUTER JOIN #ThucHien b ON a.ItemCode = b.ItemCode AND a.Code = b.ItemLotCode  	SELECT MAX(Code) AS ItemLotCode, SUM(ISNULL(Quantity,0) - ISNULL(QuantityTH,0)) AS Quantity 	FROM #DataGoc 	WHERE Code <> ''   END

--========================================= -- Nhật ký sử dụng chương trình -- ============================================= CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[usp_History_Rep]  	@_SessionId VARCHAR(66) = NULL, 	@_DocDate1 AS SmallDatetime = NULL, 	@_DocDate2  AS SmallDatetime = NULL, 	@_nUserIdLookup AS INT = NULL,  	@_UserNameLookup AS NVARCHAR(64) = NULL, 	@_TableNameLookup VARCHAR(64) = NULL, 	@_CommandLookup VARCHAR(64) = NULL, 	@_nUserId AS INT = 0, 	@_nCurrentLangId AS smallint = 0 --WITH ENCRYPTION AS BEGIN 	SET NOCOUNT ON;  	DECLARE @_Key NVARCHAR(4000), @_StrExec NVARCHAR(MAX) 	SET @_Key = '' 	IF ISNULL(@_SessionId, '') <> '' 		SET @_Key = @_Key + ' AND (log.SessionId = ''' + @_SessionId + ''')' 		 	IF ISNULL(@_DocDate1, '') <> '' 		SET @_Key = @_Key + ' AND (log.LastWriteAt >= ''' + CAST(@_DocDate1 AS VARCHAR(11)) + ''')' 		 	IF ISNULL(@_DocDate2, '') <> '' 		SET @_Key = @_Key + ' AND (log.LastWriteAt < ''' + CAST(DATEADD(d, 1, @_DocDate2) AS VARCHAR(11)) + ''')' 	 	IF @_nUserIdLookup IS NOT NULL 		SET @_Key = @_Key + ' AND (log.LastWriteBy = ' +STR(@_nUserIdLookup, 10) + ')' 	 	IF @_TableNameLookup IS NOT NULL 		SET @_Key = @_Key + ' AND (log.TableName = ''' + @_TableNameLookup + ''')' 	 	IF @_CommandLookup IS NOT NULL 		SET @_Key = @_Key + ' AND (log.Command = ''' + @_CommandLookup + ''')' 	 	SET @_Key = STUFF(@_Key, 1, 5, SPACE(0)) 	 	SET @_StrExec = 'SELECT * FROM vB00EventLog_BySessionDetail log' + CHAR(13) + 		CASE WHEN 	@_Key <> '' THEN 'WHERE ' + @_Key ELSE '' END + CHAR(13) + 		'ORDER BY log.Command, log.LastWriteAt' 	EXECUTE(@_StrExec) 	 	RETURN END

dbo.ufn_sys_FormatDatetime(@_Date, 'dddd', 1)  	IF OBJECT_ID('Tempdb..#tblFixedShift') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #tblFixedShift 	SELECT *  	INTO #tblFixedShift 	FROM vB30HrmAssignShift HrmAS 	WHERE  		HrmAS.StartDate <= @_Date AND (HrmAS.EndDate IS NULL OR HrmAS.EndDate >= @_Date) AND -- 12/04/2014 HaiDv Sửa HrmAS.EndDate >= @_Date 		HrmAS.BranchCode = @_Ma_Dvcs AND HrmAS.IsActive = 1 AND chấm công 		empl.Code AS EmployeeCode,  		ISNULL(app.DeptCode, empl.DeptCode) AS DeptCode0,	 		HrmAS.ShiftCode,  		@_Date AS ASDate 	INTO #EmplList 	FROM dbo.B20Employee empl 		-- Bộ phận cuối cùng đến thời điểm tính 		OUTER APPLY 		( 			SELECT TOP 1 app.DeptCode 			FROM dbo.B30HRMAppointed app  			WHERE (app.EffectiveDate <= @_Date AND (app.ExpireDate IS NULL OR app.ExpireDate >= @_Date)) -- 12/04/2014 HaiDv Sửa app.ExpireDate >= @_Date 				AND app.EmployeeCode = empl.Code AND app.DeptCode <> ''  				AND app.BranchCode = @_Ma_Dvcs AND app.isActive = 1 			ORDER BY app.EffectiveDate DESC	 		) app 		CROSS APPLY 		( 			SELECT TOP 1 HrmAS.* 			FROM #tblFixedShift HrmAS  			WHERE HrmAS.DeptCode = ISNULL(app.DeptCode, empl.DeptCode) 				AND CASE @_Day  						WHEN 'Monday' THEN Monday 						WHEN 'Tuesday' THEN Tuesday 						WHEN 'Wednesday' THEN Wednesday 						WHEN 'Thursday' THEN Thursday 						WHEN 'Friday' THEN Friday 						WHEN 'Saturday' THEN Saturday 						ELSE Sunday END = CREATE PROC dbo.usp_KeHoachLK 	@_ItemCode NVARCHAR(24) = '', 	@_TotalQuantityActual NUMERIC(18,0) = 0 OUTPUT, 	@_TotalQuantityBudget NUMERIC(18,0) = 0  OUTPUT, 	@_TotalQuantityCL NUMERIC(18,0) = 0  OUTPUT, 	@_DocDate SMALLDATETIME ='', 	@_Title NVARCHAR(192) =N'' OUTPUT AS  BEGIN      --Lấy dữ liệu kế hoạch 	 IF OBJECT_ID ('TempDb..#BudgetLK')  IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #BudgetLK 	SELECT Ct0.ItemCode, sum(Ct0.RequestQuantity) as Quantity, ct.RequestDate as BudgetDate, Ct.BudgetCode, ct.ItemCodeTP as Description,isnull(sum(ct1.Quantity9),0) as QtyInfact 	 INTO #BudgetLK 	 FROM dbo.B30PDRequestDetail AS Ct0  INNER JOIN   			 dbo.B30PDRequest AS Ct ON Ct0.Stt = Ct.Stt LEFT OUTER JOIN   			 dbo.B00DmCt AS DmCt ON Ct0.DocCode = DmCt.Ma_Ct LEFT OUTER JOIN   			 dbo.B20Item AS DmVt ON Ct0.ItemCode = DmVt.Code LEFT OUTER JOIN   			 B20Customer cus ON Ct0.SupplierCode = cus.Code LEFT OUTER JOIN   			 vB30ExportDocInventoryDetail_Edit_NA as Ct1  on Ct0.Stt= Ct1.Stt AND Ct0.ItemCode = Ct1.ItemCode  	  WHERE Ct.IsActive = 1 AND Ct.ItemCodeTP = @_ItemCode AND Ct.RequestDate <= @_DocDate 	  group by Ct0.ItemCode,ct.RequestDate, Ct.BudgetCode,ct.ItemCodeTP  	--------------------------------------------------------------  	--Lấy dữ liệu thực hiện 	select  @_TotalQuantityActual = sum(ct0.Quantity9)   	from B30AccDocInventory ct0,B30DocExport ct  	where Ct.IsActive = 1 AND Ct.ReceiptItemCode = @_ItemCode and ct.stt= ct0.Stt      group by ct0.ItemCode,ct0.DocDate  	SELECT @_TotalQuantityBudget = SUM(Quantity) FROM #BudgetLK  	SELECT @_TotalQuantityCL = ISNULL(@_TotalQuantityBudget,0) - ISNULL(@_TotalQuantityActual,0) 	SELECT a.*, b.Name AS ItemName 	FROM #BudgetLK a LEFT OUTER JOIN 		dbo.B20Item b ON a.ItemCode = b.Code 	 	IF @_TotalQuantityCL <0  		SET @_Title=N'Kế hoạch âm' 	ELSE 	IF @_TotalQuantityCL > 0 		SET @_Title=N'Thực hiện thiếu' 	ELSE SET @_Title=N'Thực hiện đủ' 	 END --INSERT INTO B00Command(CommandKey, [Text], [Desc], DLLName, ClassName, CtorArg1, --           CtorArg2, CtorArgs, MethodName, DefaultEnabledState, IsActive) --VALUES('REP_KEHOACHTH', N'Theo dõi kế hoạch', N'Theo dõi kế hoạch',  --  'Bravo.Bravo7.Reporter', 'Reporter', 'usp_KeHoachThucHien', '', '', 'Show', 1, 1)
