/*     Usp_Qrcode_gheplot (gop HVN + YMVN Gear)     - @USEGEAR = 1 : nhanh Gear (YMVN MP). TMP co the la BANG hoac VIEW.         + Cot Gear: uu tien GEAR, khong co thi dung TTPHIEU (theo cot thuc su ton tai).         + Neu thieu cot, thong bao loi neu ro ten cot thieu.         + Bo qua cac dong TMP da Cap nhat kho (STATUS = 'OK') khi nap #GearSrc.     - @USEGEAR = 0 : nhanh HVN (logic OLD):         1) Khoa lot = LEFT(LOT, 20).         2) Thu tu duyet lot: LOT so tang dan (lot cu truoc).         3) Da XOA dong debug "select * from #IFSCursorTable" (gay grid Ghep lot trong,            vi C# doc nham result set dau tien).         4) Cursor lot doc SLCONLAITMP (ton tam sau khi tru cac don truoc) thay vi SLCONLAI,            giong Usp_Qrcode_gheplot(OLD). Doc SLCONLAI thi don nao cung thay ton day du            => khong bao gio sinh dong ghep.         5) Bo UPDATE STT/HOP tren TMP (gay trung STT giua cac dong cung MAHANG+SOLUONG+GIOGIAO).         6) Sua nhanh cuoi (@HT_SL >= @SOLUONG, @SLCANGHEP > 0): dung @SLCANGHEP truoc khi reset,            them truong hop @HT_SL < @SLCANGHEP.         7) MOI: Loai cac dong da Cap nhat kho (TMP.STATUS = 'OK', da tru SLCONLAI) khoi danh sach            can ghep lot. Khop dong bang MAHANG+SOLUONG+NGAYGIAO+GIOGIAO, danh so RN trong nhom            trung de chi loai dung so dong da OK (dong trung chua giao van duoc xu ly).         8) MOI: #IFSCursorTable nap theo NGAYGIAO, GIOGIAO => gio som lay lot truoc.     Chi tra DUNG 1 result set cuoi cung (MH, GG, LG[, GearName]). */ CREATE PROC [dbo].[Usp_Qrcode_gheplot]     @TMPTABLE nvarchar(128) = N'TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG',     @IFSTABLE nvarchar(128) = N'IFSPHIEUGIAOHANG',     @USEGEAR bit = 0,     @EXPECTEDTMPTABLE nvarchar(128) = NULL,     @VIEWTABLEPREFIX nvarchar(128) = NULL AS BEGIN      SET NOCOUNT ON;      /* ======================= NHANH GEAR (@USEGEAR = 1) ======================= */     IF @USEGEAR = 1     BEGIN         IF @EXPECTEDTMPTABLE IS NULL OR @VIEWTABLEPREFIX IS NULL            OR (@TMPTABLE <> @EXPECTEDTMPTABLE                AND LEFT(@TMPTABLE, LEN(@VIEWTABLEPREFIX) + 1) <> @VIEWTABLEPREFIX + N'_'                AND @TMPTABLE <> N'YMVN_TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG')             THROW 51221, N'Tên TMP không khớp CustomerTableConfig cho xử lý Gear.', 1;          DECLARE @GearObjectId int = OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.' + QUOTENAME(@TMPTABLE));         IF @GearObjectId IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS            (SELECT 1 FROM sys.objects WHERE object_id = @GearObjectId AND type IN (N'U', N'V'))             THROW 51222, N'Không tìm thấy bảng/VIEW TMP dùng cho xử lý Gear.', 1;          -- Chon cot Gear theo cot thuc su ton tai trong bang/VIEW         DECLARE @TmpFull nvarchar(300) = N'dbo.' + QUOTENAME(@TMPTABLE);          DECLARE @GearCol sysname =             CASE WHEN COL_LENGTH(@TmpFull, N'GEAR')    IS NOT NULL THEN N'GEAR'                  WHEN COL_LENGTH(@TmpFull, N'TTPHIEU') IS NOT NULL THEN N'TTPHIEU'                  ELSE N'GEAR' END;          DECLARE @MissingCols nvarchar(500) = N'';         SELECT @MissingCols = @MissingCols + N',' + c.ColName         FROM (VALUES (N'MAHANG'),(N'SOLUONG'),(N'NGAYGIAO'),(N'GIOGIAO'),(@GearCol)) AS c(ColName)         WHERE COL_LENGTH(@TmpFull, c.ColName) IS NULL;          IF @MissingCols <> N''         BEGIN             DECLARE @Msg nvarchar(600) =                 N'TMP Gear thiếu cột: ' + STUFF(@MissingCols, 1, 1, N'') + N' (' + @TMPTABLE + N')';             THROW 51223, @Msg, 1;         END;          CREATE TABLE #GearSrc         (             MAHANG nvarchar(56) NOT NULL,             SOLUONG int NOT NULL,             NGAYGIAO datetime NULL,             GIOGIAO nvarchar(50) NULL,             GearText nvarchar(1000) NULL         );          -- Bo qua dong da Cap nhat kho (STATUS = OK) neu TMP co cot STATUS         DECLARE @GearStatusFilter nvarchar(200) =             CASE WHEN COL_LENGTH(@TmpFull, N'STATUS') IS NOT NULL                  THEN N' AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL([STATUS], N'''')))) <> N''OK'''                  ELSE N'' END;          DECLARE @GearSql nvarchar(max) =             N'INSERT INTO #GearSrc(MAHANG,SOLUONG,NGAYGIAO,GIOGIAO,GearText)               SELECT MAHANG, TRY_CONVERT(int,SOLUONG), NGAYGIAO, GIOGIAO,' + QUOTENAME(@GearCol) +               N' FROM dbo.' + QUOTENAME(@TMPTABLE) +               N' WHERE ISNULL(TRY_CONVERT(int,SOLUONG),0) > 0 AND ISNULL(MAHANG,'''') <> ''''' +               @GearStatusFilter + N';';         EXEC sys.sp_executesql @GearSql;          CREATE TABLE #GearStock         (             StockId int IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,             PART nvarchar(100) NOT NULL,             LOT13 nvarchar(20) NOT NULL,             GearCode nvarchar(10) NULL,             Qty int NOT NULL,             SortKey decimal(38,0) NULL         );          INSERT INTO #GearStock (PART, LOT13, GearCode, Qty, SortKey)         SELECT             s.PART,             LEFT(s.LOT, 20),                           -- 20 ky tu dau lam khoa LOT             SUBSTRING(s.LOT, 13, 1),                   -- ky tu thu 13 = B20Gear.Code             CONVERT(int, s.SLCONLAI),             TRY_CONVERT(decimal(38,0), LEFT(s.LOT, 20))         FROM dbo.STOCKTP s         WHERE s.SLCONLAI > 0           AND LEN(ISNULL(s.LOT, '')) >= 20           AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #GearSrc src WHERE src.MAHANG = s.PART);          CREATE TABLE #GearResult         (             ResultId int IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,             MH nvarchar(56) NOT NULL,             GG nvarchar(50) NULL,             LG nvarchar(1000) NOT NULL,             GearName nvarchar(100) NULL         );          CREATE TABLE #GearItems         (             ItemId int IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,             ItemQty int NOT NULL,             GearName nvarchar(100) NOT NULL,             GearCode nvarchar(10) NOT NULL         );          DECLARE @Part nvarchar(56), @OrderQty int, @DeliveryDate datetime, @DeliveryTime nvarchar(50),                 @GearTextValue nvarchar(1000), @PackQty int, @GearToken nvarchar(400),                 @ResolvedGearName nvarchar(100), @ResolvedGearCode nvarchar(10),                 @ItemQty int, @ItemGearName nvarchar(100), @ItemGearCode nvarchar(10),                 @LotKey nvarchar(20), @StockQty int, @Pending int,                 @LotList nvarchar(1000), @Need int, @ParsedQty int, @DigitStart int, @GearPartialQty int,                 @Digits nvarchar(40), @StockId int;          DECLARE GearOrderCur CURSOR LOCAL FAST_FORWARD FOR             SELECT MAHANG, SOLUONG, NGAYGIAO, GIOGIAO, GearText             FROM #GearSrc             ORDER BY MAHANG, NGAYGIAO, GearText, GIOGIAO;          OPEN GearOrderCur;         FETCH NEXT FROM GearOrderCur INTO @Part,@OrderQty,@DeliveryDate,@DeliveryTime,@GearTextValue;         WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS=0         BEGIN             SET @PackQty = NULL;             SELECT TOP(1) @PackQty = TRY_CONVERT(int,MinCloseQty)             FROM dbo.B20Item WHERE Code=@Part;             IF ISNULL(@PackQty,0) <= 0 SET @PackQty = 1;              TRUNCATE TABLE #GearItems;              /*               Vi du chuoi Gear: "Gear D : 5000pcs, Gear E : 300pcs"               Chu cai = B20Gear.Name ; LOT[13] = B20Gear.Code.             */             IF CHARINDEX(N',',ISNULL(@GearTextValue,N'')) > 0             BEGIN                 DECLARE GearTokenCur CURSOR LOCAL FAST_FORWARD FOR                     SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(strval))                     FROM dbo.Split(@GearTextValue, N',')                     WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(strval)) <> N'';                 OPEN GearTokenCur;                 FETCH NEXT FROM GearTokenCur INTO @GearToken;                 WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS=0                 BEGIN                     SET @ResolvedGearName = LTRIM(RTRIM(SUBSTRING(@GearToken,6,1)));                     SET @DigitStart = PATINDEX('%[0-9]%',@GearToken);                     SET @Digits = CASE WHEN @DigitStart > 0 THEN SUBSTRING(@GearToken,@DigitStart,40) ELSE N'' END;                     SET @ParsedQty = TRY_CONVERT(int,LEFT(@Digits,                         CASE WHEN PATINDEX('%[^0-9]%',@Digits+N'X') > 0                              THEN PATINDEX('%[^0-9]%',@Digits+N'X')-1 ELSE LEN(@Digits) END));                      SET @ResolvedGearCode = NULL;                     SELECT TOP(1) @ResolvedGearCode = CONVERT(nvarchar(10),Code)                     FROM dbo.B20Gear                     WHERE Name=@ResolvedGearName AND ISNULL(IsActive,1)=1                     ORDER BY Id;                      IF @ResolvedGearCode IS NULL OR @ParsedQty IS NULL OR @ParsedQty <= 0                     BEGIN                         CLOSE GearTokenCur; DEALLOCATE GearTokenCur;                         CLOSE GearOrderCur; DEALLOCATE GearOrderCur;                         THROW 51224, N'Không phân tích được Gear hoặc số lượng trong TMP YMVN. Kiểm tra B20Gear.Name/Code và chuỗi GEAR.', 1;                     END;                      INSERT INTO #GearItems(ItemQty,GearName,GearCode)                     VALUES(@ParsedQty,@ResolvedGearName,@ResolvedGearCode);                      FETCH NEXT FROM GearTokenCur INTO @GearToken;                 END;                 CLOSE GearTokenCur;                 DEALLOCATE GearTokenCur;             END             ELSE             BEGIN                 SET @ResolvedGearName = LTRIM(RTRIM(SUBSTRING(ISNULL(@GearTextValue,N''),6,1)));                 SET @ResolvedGearCode = NULL;                 SELECT TOP(1) @ResolvedGearCode = CONVERT(nvarchar(10),Code)                 FROM dbo.B20Gear                 WHERE Name=@ResolvedGearName AND ISNULL(IsActive,1)=1                 ORDER BY Id;                  IF @ResolvedGearCode IS NULL                 BEGIN                     CLOSE GearOrderCur; DEALLOCATE GearOrderCur;                     THROW 51224, N'Không ánh xạ được Gear.Name sang Gear.Code trong B20Gear.', 1;      IF @TmpHasStatus = 1     BEGIN         SET @SQL = N'         ;WITH I AS (             SELECT MAHANG, SOLUONG, NGAYGIAO, GIOGIAO,                    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (                        PARTITION BY MAHANG, SOLUONG, CONVERT(date, NGAYGIAO), LTRIM(RTRIM(GIOGIAO))                        ORDER BY (SELECT 1)) AS RN             FROM ' + QUOTENAME(@IFSTABLE) + N'         ),         D AS (             SELECT MAHANG, SOLUONG, CONVERT(date, NGAYGIAO) AS NG, LTRIM(RTRIM(GIOGIAO)) AS GG,                    COUNT(*) AS CNT             FROM dbo.' + QUOTENAME(@TMPTABLE) + N'             WHERE UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL([STATUS], N'''')))) = N''OK''             GROUP BY MAHANG, SOLUONG, CONVERT(date, NGAYGIAO), LTRIM(RTRIM(GIOGIAO))         )         INSERT INTO #IFSCursorTable (MAHANG, SOLUONG, NGAYGIAO, GIOGIAO)         SELECT I.MAHANG, I.SOLUONG, I.NGAYGIAO, I.GIOGIAO         FROM I         LEFT JOIN D                ON D.MAHANG = I.MAHANG               AND D.SOLUONG = I.SOLUONG               AND D.NG = CONVERT(date, I.NGAYGIAO)               AND D.GG = LTRIM(RTRIM(I.GIOGIAO))         WHERE I.RN > ISNULL(D.CNT, 0)         ORDER BY I.NGAYGIAO, I.GIOGIAO;';     END     ELSE     BEGIN         SET @SQL = N'INSERT INTO #IFSCursorTable (MAHANG, SOLUONG, NGAYGIAO, GIOGIAO)                      SELECT MAHANG, SOLUONG, NGAYGIAO, GIOGIAO FROM ' + QUOTENAME(@IFSTABLE) + N'                      ORDER BY NGAYGIAO, GIOGIAO;';          -- KHONG cap nhat STT/HOP tren TMP o day. STT/HOP da duoc C# gan duy nhat tung dong         -- (EnrichSttHop). Ban OLD co UPDATE nay nhung WHERE CUA/TRUYEN = NULL nen khong khop dong nao.         -- UPDATE khong co CUA/TRUYEN se ghi DE cung mot STT len moi dong trung MAHANG+SOLUONG+GIOGIAO         -- => form 'List trung ma so luong' hien 2 dong cung STT.          ---- Duyet ghep lo cho tung moc so luong         SET @LOTGHEP = '';                     INSERT INTO #TMPGHEPLOT VALUES (@MAHANG, @GIOGIAO, @LOTGHEP);                     UPDATE STOCKTP SET SLCONLAITMP = SLCONLAITMP - @SOLUONG WHERE PART = @MAHANG AND LEFT(LOT, 20) = @HT_LOT;                     SET @SOLUONG = @SOLUONG - @HT_SL;                     UPDATE STOCKTP SET SLCONLAITMP = 0 WHERE PART = @MAHANG AND LEFT(LOT, 20) = @HT_LOT;                 END             END             ELSE             BEGIN                 IF (@HT_SL < @SOLUONG)                 BEGIN                     IF (@SLCANGHEP > 0)                     BEGIN                         IF (@HT_SL < @SLCANGHEP)                         BEGIN                             SET @LOTGHEP = @LOTGHEP + ',' + @HT_LOT + '-' + CAST(@HT_SL AS NVARCHAR);                             SET @SLCANGHEP = @SLCANGHEP - @HT_SL;                             SET @SOLUONG = @SOLUONG - @HT_SL;                             UPDATE STOCKTP SET SLCONLAITMP = 0 WHERE PART = @MAHANG AND LEFT(LOT, 20) = @HT_LOT;                         END                         ELSE                         BEGIN                             SET @LOTGHEP = @LOTGHEP + ',' + @HT_LOT + '-' + CAST(@SLCANGHEP AS NVARCHAR);                             INSERT INTO #TMPGHEPLOT VALUES (@MAHANG, @GIOGIAO, @LOTGHEP);                             ELSE                             BEGIN                                 SET @SLCANGHEP = @QCDG - @DuDuoi;                                 SET @LOTGHEP = @HT_LOT + '-' + CAST(@DuDuoi AS NVARCHAR);                             END                              SET @SOLUONG = @SOLUONG - @HT_SL;                             UPDATE STOCKTP SET SLCONLAITMP = 0 WHERE PART = @MAHANG AND LEFT(LOT, 20) = @HT_LOT;                         END                     END                     ELSE                     BEGIN                         SET @SLGHEP = @HT_SL % @QCDG;                         IF (@SLGHEP > 0)                         BEGIN                             SET @SLCANGHEP = (@SOLUONG % @QCDG) - @SLGHEP;                             IF @SLCANGHEP < 0 SET @SLCANGHEP = @QCDG - @SLGHEP;                              IF @LOTGHEP = ''                                 SET @LOTGHEP = @HT_LOT + '-' + CAST(@SLGHEP AS NVARCHAR);                             ELSE                                 SET @LOTGHEP = @LOTGHEP + ',' + @HT_LOT + '-' + CAST(@SLGHEP AS NVARCHAR);                         END                         ELSE                         BEGIN                             SET @SLCANGHEP = 0;                             IF @LOTGHEP <> ''                             BEGIN                                 INSERT INTO #TMPGHEPLOT VALUES (@MAHANG, @GIOGIAO, @LOTGHEP);                                 SET @LOTGHEP = '';                             END                         END                         SET @SOLUONG = @SOLUONG - @HT_SL;                         UPDATE STOCKTP SET SLCONLAITMP = 0 WHERE PART = @MAHANG AND LEFT(LOT, 20) = @HT_LOT;                     END                 END                 ELSE                 BEGIN                     -- @HT_SL >= @SOLUONG                     IF (@SLCANGHEP > 0)                     BEGIN                         IF (@HT_SL >= @SLCANGHEP)                         BEGIN                             SET @LOTGHEP = @LOTGHEP + ',' + @HT_LOT + '-' + CAST(@SLCANGHEP AS NVARCHAR);                             INSERT INTO #TMPGHEPLOT VALUES (@MAHANG, @GIOGIAO, @LOTGHEP);                             -- dung @SLCANGHEP TRUOC khi reset                             UPDATE STOCKTP SET SLCONLAITMP = @HT_SL - @SLCANGHEP                                 WHERE PART = @MAHANG AND LEFT(LOT, 20) = @HT_LOT;                         END                     END                     ELSE                     BEGIN                         UPDATE STOCKTP SET SLCONLAITMP = @HT_SL - @SOLUONG                             WHERE PART = @MAHANG AND LEFT(LOT, 20) = @HT_LOT;                         SET @SOLUONG = 0;                         BREAK;                     END                 END             END              FETCH NEXT FROM DHT INTO @HT_LOT, @HT_SL;         END          CLOSE DHT;         DEALLOCATE DHT;         -------------------------------         FETCH NEXT FROM IFSPGH INTO @MAHANG, @SOLUONG, @NGAYGIAO, @GIOGIAO;     END     CLOSE IFSPGH;     DEALLOCATE IFSPGH;      SELECT MH, GG, LG FROM #TMPGHEPLOT WHERE CHARINDEX(',', LG, 1) > 0; END

KHỞI TẠO BẢNG CHỨA KẾT QUẢ ĐỘNG (BẢNG VẬT LÝ THEO MÁY TRẠM) ──────     DECLARE @sqlCreateResult NVARCHAR(MAX)     SET @sqlCreateResult = N'         CREATE TABLE [dbo].[' + @RESULT_TABLE + '] (             MH NVARCHAR(56),             SLGIAO INT,             SLTHIEU INT,             GIOGIAO NVARCHAR(50)         )'     EXEC sp_executesql @sqlCreateResult      -- ── 3. TÍNH TOÁN @MaxDaGiao BẰNG DYNAMIC SQL ────────────────────────────     DECLARE @MaxDaGiao INT = 0     DECLARE @sqlMax NVARCHAR(MAX)      SET @sqlMax = N'         IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG WHERE NGAYGIAO = (SELECT TOP 1 NGAYGIAO FROM TBL_TT_MA) AND LEN(GIOGIAO) < 4)           BEGIN               SELECT @MaxOut = MAX(CAST(CASE WHEN CHARINDEX(''h'', GIOGIAO, 1) > 0                                               THEN SUBSTRING(GIOGIAO, 1, CHARINDEX(''h'', GIOGIAO, 1) - 1)                                              ELSE GIOGIAO                                         END AS INT))              FROM LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG               WHERE NGAYGIAO <= (SELECT TOP 1 NGAYGIAO FROM TBL_TT_MAView) AND LEN(GIOGIAO) < 4           END'          EXEC sp_executesql @sqlMax, N'@MaxOut INT OUTPUT', @MaxOut = @MaxDaGiao OUTPUT     SET @MaxDaGiao = ISNULL(@MaxDaGiao, 0)      -- ── 4. THỰC THI LOGIC DUYỆT DỮ LIỆU SỬ DỤNG DYNAMIC SQL TOÀN BỘ ────────     DECLARE @sqlMain NVARCHAR(MAX)     SET @sqlMain = N'         DECLARE @MAHANG NVARCHAR(56), @TTSLGIAO INT, @GIOGIAO NVARCHAR(50)         DECLARE @TK INT, @SLT INT, @SLGIAO INT          DECLARE IFSPGH CURSOR LOCAL FAST_FORWARD FOR           SELECT MAHANG, SUM(TTSLG) as TTSLG          FROM TBL_TT_MAView           WHERE CAST(GIOGIAO AS INT) > @MaxDaGiao          GROUP BY MAHANG            OPEN IFSPGH           FETCH NEXT FROM IFSPGH INTO @MAHANG, @TTSLGIAO           WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0           BEGIN               SELECT @TK = ISNULL(SUM(slconlai), 0) FROM STOCKTP WHERE SLCONLAI > 0 AND PART = @MAHANG                            IF (@TK < @TTSLGIAO)               BEGIN                   DECLARE DUYETHT CURSOR LOCAL FAST_FORWARD FOR                   SELECT MAHANG, SUM(TTSLG) as TTSLG, GIOGIAO                   FROM TBL_TT_MAView                   WHERE CAST(GIOGIAO AS INT) > @MaxDaGiao AND MAHANG = @MAHANG                  GROUP BY MAHANG, GIOGIAO                  ORDER BY CAST(GIOGIAO AS INT) ASC                    OPEN DUYETHT                   FETCH NEXT FROM DUYETHT INTO @MAHANG, @SLGIAO, @GIOGIAO                   WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0                   BEGIN                       IF (@TK > 0)                       BEGIN                           IF (@SLGIAO < @TK)                           BEGIN                               SET @TK = @TK - @SLGIAO                               SET @TTSLGIAO = @TTSLGIAO - @SLGIAO                           END                           ELSE                           BEGIN                               SET @SLT = @SLGIAO - @TK                               SET @TK = 0                               INSERT INTO [dbo].[' + @RESULT_TABLE + '] VALUES(@MAHANG, @SLGIAO, @SLT, @GIOGIAO)                           END                       END                       ELSE                       BEGIN                           INSERT INTO [dbo].[' + @RESULT_TABLE + '] VALUES(@MAHANG, @SLGIAO, @SLGIAO, @GIOGIAO)                       END                        FETCH NEXT FROM DUYETHT INTO @MAHANG, @SLGIAO, @GIOGIAO                   END                   CLOSE DUYETHT                   DEALLOCATE DUYETHT               END                FETCH NEXT FROM IFSPGH INTO @MAHANG, @TTSLGIAO           END                    CLOSE IFSPGH           DEALLOCATE IFSPGH     '      -- Thực thi chuỗi lệnh để đổ dữ liệu vào bảng vật lý động riêng biệt     EXEC sp_executesql @sqlMain, N'@MaxDaGiao INT', @MaxDaGiao = @MaxDaGiao      -- ── 5. XUẤT KẾT QUẢ VÀ DỌN DẸP ─────────────────────────────────────────     DECLARE @sqlSelect NVARCHAR(MAX) = N'         SELECT MH, SLGIAO, SLTHIEU, GIOGIAO          FROM [dbo].[' + @RESULT_TABLE + ']         ORDER BY MH, CAST(GIOGIAO AS INT) ASC'     EXEC sp_executesql @sqlSelect      -- Xóa bảng kết quả của phiên làm việc này ngay sau khi xuất dữ liệu xong     DECLARE @sqlDrop NVARCHAR(MAX) = N'DROP TABLE [dbo].[' + @RESULT_TABLE + ']'     EXEC sp_executesql @sqlDrop END

CREATE PROC [dbo].[Usp_Qrcode_LOAD_PHIEU_DOCQR]     @NGAYGIAO nvarchar(20),     @NHAMAY   nvarchar(50)  = N'',     @GIOFCC   nvarchar(200) = N'',     @ADDNM    int AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON      DECLARE @TTIFS int      CREATE TABLE #GioList (GioInt int)     INSERT INTO #GioList     SELECT TRY_CAST(LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE(value, '''', ''))) AS INT)     FROM STRING_SPLIT(REPLACE(@GIOFCC, '''', ''), ',')     WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE(value, '''', ''))) <> ''       AND LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE(value, '''', ''))) <> '(GIAO DB)'       AND TRY_CAST(LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE(value, '''', ''))) AS INT) IS NOT  BEGIN         IF @NHAMAY = '%NHA MAY HA NAM%'             UPDATE L SET L.GIOGIAOFCC = C.GIOFCCHN             FROM LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG L             INNER JOIN QRCODE_CHANGETIME C ON C.GIOHVN =       ELSE             UPDATE L SET L.GIOGIAOFCC = C.GioFCCVP             FROM LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG L             INNER JOIN QRCODE_CHANGETIME C ON C.GIOHVN = L.GIOGIAOFCC             WHERE L.GIOGIAOFCC NOT LIKE '%H'               AND L.GIOGIAOFCC NOT LIKE '(O TYPE%'               AND L.NHAMAY <> 'YAMAHA - VIET NAM'               AND L.NHAMAY LIKE @NHAMAY     END      IF @GIOFCC = '(GIAO DB)' DOCQRCODE)         BEGIN             DELETE TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG              IF @NHAMAY = '%(NHA MAY VP)'                 SET @ADDNM = 1             ELSE                 SET @ADDNM = 2              -- ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════             -- FIX: nếu IFS rỗng (tháng trước đã close) →             --      bỏ qua bước tạo #LUU/#LUUGIO, đọc thẳng LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG             -- ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════             IF @TTIFS = 0             BEGIN                 -- ── IFS rỗng → đọc thẳng LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG đầy đủ cột ───                 INSERT INTO TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG                     (STT,CUA,TRUYEN,MAHANG,TENHANG,LOT,DV,SOLUONG,                      NGAYGIAO,GIOGIAO,STATUS,TTPHIEU,NHAMAY,ADDNM,                      HOP,STATUSDOC,Note,PO_NO,PO_ITEM)                 SELECT                     STT,CUA,TRUYEN,MAHANG,TENHANG,LOT,DV,SOLUONG,                     NGAYGIAO,GIOGIAO,STATUS,TTPHIEU,@NHAMAY,@ADDNM,                     HOP,STATUSDOC,Note,                     ISNULL(PO_NO,''), ISNULL(PO_ITEM,'')                 FROM LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG                 WHERE CAST(NGAYGIAO AS date) = CAST(@NGAYGIAO AS date)                   AND NHAMAY LIKE @NHAMAY                   AND TRY_CAST(GIOGIAO AS INT) IN (SELECT GioInt FROM #GioList)             END             ELSE             BEGIN                 -- ── IFS có dữ liệu → flow cũ: #LUU + #LUUGIO + LEFT JOIN ─                 CREATE TABLE #LUU (                     MAHANG     nvarchar(50),                     NGAYGIAO   date,                     CUA        nvarchar(20),                     TRUYEN     nvarchar(20),                     SOLUONG    int,                     GIOGIAO    nvarchar(10),                     GIOGIAOFCC nvarchar(50),                     LOT        nvarchar(500),                     STATUS     nvarchar(20),                     STATUSDOC  nvarchar(50)                 )                  INSERT INTO #LUU                 SELECT                     RTRIM(MAHANG), CAST(NGAYGIAO AS date),                     RTRIM(CUA), RTRIM(TRUYEN),                     SOLUONG, GIOGIAO, GIOGIAOFCC, LOT, STATUS, STATUSDOC                 FROM (                     SELECT *,                         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (                             PARTITION BY RTRIM(MAHANG), CAST(NGAYGIAO AS date),                                          RTRIM(CUA),    RTRIM(TRUYEN),                                          SOLUONG,       GIOGIAO,                                          RTRIM(NHAMAY)                             ORDER BY TGLUU DESC                         ) AS RN                     FROM LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG                     WHERE CAST(NGAYGIAO AS date) = CAST(@NGAYGIAO AS date)                       AND NHAMAY LIKE @NHAMAY                       AND GIOGIAO NOT LIKE '%[^0-9]%'                       AND GIOGIAO <> ''                       AND TRY_CAST(GIOGIAO AS INT) IN (SELECT GioInt FROM #GioList)                 ) x                 WHERE x.RN = 1                  CREATE TABLE #LUUGIO (                     MAHANG     nvarchar(50),                     NGAYGIAO   date,                     CUA        nvarchar(20),                     TRUYEN     nvarchar(20),                     SOLUONG    int,                     GIO_PARSE  nvarchar(10),                     LOT        nvarchar(500),                     STATUS     nvarchar(20),                     STATUSDOC  nvarchar(50)                 )                  INSERT INTO #LUUGIO                 SELECT                     l.MAHANG, l.NGAYGIAO, l.CUA, l.TRUYEN, l.SOLUONG,                     RIGHT('00' + LTRIM(RTRIM(gs.value)), 2) AS GIO_PARSE,                     l.LOT, l.STATUS, l.STATUSDOC                 FROM #LUU l                 CROSS APPLY STRING_SPLIT(                     REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(l.GIOGIAOFCC, '(', ''), ')', ''), 'H', ''),                     '+'                 ) gs                 WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(gs.value)) <> ''                   AND TRY_CAST(LTRIM(RTRIM(gs.value)) AS INT)                         IN (SELECT GioInt FROM #GioList)                  CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_LUUGIO                     ON #LUUGIO (MAHANG, CUA, TRUYEN, SOLUONG, GIO_PARSE)                  INSERT INTO TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG                     (STT,CUA,TRUYEN,MAHANG,TENHANG,LOT,DV,SOLUONG,                      NGAYGIAO,GIOGIAO,STATUS,TTPHIEU,NHAMAY,ADDNM,                      HOP,STATUSDOC,Note,PO_NO,PO_ITEM)                 SELECT                     i.STT, i.CUA, i.TRUYEN, i.MAHANG, i.TENHANG,                     ISNULL(l.LOT,       i.LOT)       AS LOT,                     i.DV, i.SOLUONG, i.NGAYGIAO, i.GIOGIAO,                     ISNULL(l.STATUS,    i.STATUS)    AS STATUS,                     i.TTPHIEU, i.NHAMAY, @ADDNM, i.HOP,                     ISNULL(l.STATUSDOC, i.STATUSDOC) AS STATUSDOC,                     i.Note,                     ISNULL(i.PO_NO,   '') AS PO_NO,                     ISNULL(i.PO_ITEM, '') AS PO_ITEM                 FROM IFSPHIEUGIAOHANG i                 LEFT JOIN #LUUGIO l                     ON  l.MAHANG    = RTRIM(i.MAHANG)                     AND l.CUA       = RTRIM(i.CUA)                     AND l.TRUYEN    = RTRIM(i.TRUYEN)                     AND l.SOLUONG   = i.SOLUONG                     AND l.GIO_PARSE = RTRIM(i.GIOGIAO)                  DROP TABLE #LUU                 DROP TABLE #LUUGIO             END         END     END      SELECT STT,CUA,TRUYEN,MAHANG,TENHANG,LOT,DV,SOLUONG,NGAYGIAO,            GIOGIAO,STATUS,TTPHIEU,NHAMAY,ADDNM,HOP,STATUSDOC,Note,            ISNULL(PO_NO,   '') AS PO_NO,            ISNULL(PO_ITEM, '') AS PO_ITEM     FROM TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG     ORDER BY TRY_CAST(STT AS INT), STT      DROP TABLE #GioList END

CREATE PROC [dbo].[Usp_Qrcode_LOAD_PHIEU_DOCQR2405]       @NGAYGIAO   nvarchar(20),       @NHAMAY     nvarchar(50)  = N'',       @GIOFCC     nvarchar(200) = N'',       @ADDNM      int,       @TMPTABLE   nvarchar(100) = N'TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG',       @IFSTABLE   nvarchar(100) = N'IFSPHIEUGIAOHANG',       @DOCQRTABLE nvarchar(100) = N'DOCQRCODE'   AS   BEGIN       SET NOCOUNT ON;          -- ── 1. Build #GioList (giữ INT như SP cũ) ───────────────────────────       CREATE TABLE #GioList (GioInt int)       INSERT INTO #GioList       SELECT TRY_CAST(LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE(value, '''', ''))) AS INT)       FROM   STRING_SPLIT(REPLACE(@GIOFCC, '''', ''), ',')       WHERE  LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE(value, '''', ''))) <> ''         AND  LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE(value, '''', ''))) <> '(GIAO DB)'         AND  TRY_CAST(LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE(value, '''', ''))) AS INT) IS NOT NULL          -- ── 2. Đếm IFS ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────       DECLARE @TTIFS int       DECLARE @SQL   nvarchar(max)       SET @SQL = N'SELECT @CNT = COUNT(*) FROM ' + QUOTENAME(@IFSTABLE)       EXEC sp_executesql @SQL, N'@CNT int OUTPUT', @TTIFS OUTPUT          -- ── 3. Chuẩn hóa NHAMAY ─────────────────────────────────────────────       IF CHARINDEX('(NHA MAY HA NAM)', @NHAMAY) > 0           SET @NHAMAY = '%NHA MAY HA NAM%'       ELSE           SET @NHAMAY = '%(NHA MAY VP)'          IF @NHAMAY LIKE '%NHA MAY VP%'           SET @ADDNM = 1       ELSE           SET @ADDNM = 2          -- ── 4. Normalize LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG — chỉ theo ngày+nhà máy ──────────       -- GIỮ từ SP mới: filter NGAYGIAO + NHAMAY, không update toàn bảng       UPDATE LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG       SET GIOGIAO = CASE           WHEN GIOGIAO = '0H'    THEN '00H'           WHEN GIOGIAO LIKE '%H' THEN REPLACE(GIOGIAO, 'H', '')           ELSE GIOGIAO END       WHERE NHAMAY   LIKE @NHAMAY         AND NGAYGIAO  = @NGAYGIAO         AND (GIOGIAO = '0H' OR GIOGIAO LIKE '%H')          UPDATE LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG       SET NHAMAY = 'HON DA - VIET NAM(NHA MAY VP)'       WHERE NHAMAY   LIKE '%VP)'         AND NGAYGIAO  = @NGAYGIAO          UPDATE LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG       SET GIOGIAOFCC = GIOGIAO       WHERE GIOGIAOFCC = '(GIAO DB)'         AND GIOGIAO   <> '05'         AND NGAYGIAO   = @NGAYGIAO         AND NHAMAY    LIKE @NHAMAY          -- ── 5. Chuẩn hóa GIOGIAOFCC — SET-BASED (GIỮ từ SP mới) ────────────       UPDATE luu       SET luu.GIOGIAOFCC = CASE           WHEN @NHAMAY LIKE '%NHA MAY HA NAM%' THEN ct.GIOFCCHN           ELSE ct.GioFCCVP       END       FROM LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG luu       INNER JOIN QRCODE_CHANGETIME ct              ON  ct.GIOHVN        = luu.GIOGIAOFCC       WHERE  luu.NHAMAY          LIKE @NHAMAY         AND  luu.NGAYGIAO         = @NGAYGIAO         AND  luu.GIOGIAOFCC NOT LIKE '%H'         AND  luu.GIOGIAOFCC NOT LIKE '(O TYPE%'         AND  luu.NHAMAY          <> 'YAMAHA - VIET NAM'          -- ── 6. GIAO DB ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────       IF @GIOFCC = '(GIAO DB)'       BEGIN           SET @SQL =               N'DELETE ' + QUOTENAME(@TMPTABLE) + N';' +               N'INSERT INTO ' + QUOTENAME(@TMPTABLE) +               N' (STT,CUA,TRUYEN,MAHANG,TENHANG,LOT,DV,SOLUONG,NGAYGIAO,GIOGIAO,' +               N'  STATUS,TTPHIEU,NHAMAY,ADDNM,HOP,STATUSDOC,Note,PO_NO,PO_ITEM)' +               N' SELECT STT,CUA,TRUYEN,MAHANG,TENHANG,LOT,DV,SOLUONG,NGAYGIAO,GIOGIAO,' +               N'        STATUS,TTPHIEU,NHAMAY,ADDNM,HOP,STATUSDOC,Note,' +               N'        ISNULL(PO_NO,''''),ISNULL(PO_ITEM,'''')' +               N' FROM ' + QUOTENAME(@IFSTABLE)           EXEC sp_executesql @SQL           GOTO XUAT_KQ       END          -- ── 7. Kiểm tra DOCQR — đang bắn dở → giữ nguyên TMP ───────────────       DECLARE @CntDocQR int = 0       SET @SQL = N'SELECT @CNT = COUNT(*) FROM ' + QUOTENAME(@DOCQRTABLE)       EXEC sp_executesql @SQL, N'@CNT int OUTPUT', @CntDocQR OUTPUT          IF @CntDocQR > 0           GOTO XUAT_KQ          -- ── 8. Không bắn QR → load mới ──────────────────────────────────────       SET @SQL = N'DELETE ' + QUOTENAME(@TMPTABLE)       EXEC sp_executesql @SQL          -- ── 9. TTIFS = 0 → IFS đã close → đọc thẳng LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG ────────       IF @TTIFS = 0       BEGIN           SET @SQL = N'               INSERT INTO ' + QUOTENAME(@TMPTABLE) + N'                   (STT,CUA,TRUYEN,MAHANG,TENHANG,LOT,DV,SOLUONG,                    NGAYGIAO,GIOGIAO,STATUS,TTPHIEU,NHAMAY,ADDNM,                    HOP,STATUSDOC,Note,PO_NO,PO_ITEM)               SELECT                   STT,CUA,TRUYEN,MAHANG,TENHANG,LOT,DV,SOLUONG,                   NGAYGIAO,GIOGIAO,STATUS,TTPHIEU,NHAMAY,@ADDNM,                   HOP,STATUSDOC,Note,                   ISNULL(PO_NO,''''), ISNULL(PO_ITEM,'''')               FROM LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG               WHERE CAST(NGAYGIAO AS date) = CAST(@NGAYGIAO AS date)                 AND NHAMAY LIKE @NHAMAY                 AND GIOGIAO NOT LIKE ''%[^0-9]%''                 AND GIOGIAO <> ''''                 AND (                     NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #GioList)                     OR TRY_CAST(GIOGIAO AS INT) IN (SELECT GioInt FROM #GioList)                 )'           EXEC sp_executesql @SQL,               N'@NGAYGIAO nvarchar(20), @NHAMAY nvarchar(50), @ADDNM int',               @NGAYGIAO, @NHAMAY, @ADDNM           GOTO XUAT_KQ       END          -- ── 10. TTIFS > 0 → IFS có data → #LUU → #LUUGIO → LEFT JOIN ────────       -- GIỮ NGUYÊN từ SP cũ: đây là flow đúng, không dùng LEFT JOIN thô       CREATE TABLE #LUU (           MAHANG     nvarchar(50),           NGAYGIAO   date,           CUA        nvarchar(20),           TRUYEN     nvarchar(20),           SOLUONG    int,           GIOGIAO    nvarchar(10),           GIOGIAOFCC nvarchar(50),           LOT        nvarchar(500),           STATUS     nvarchar(20),           STATUSDOC  nvarchar(50)       )          CREATE TABLE #LUUGIO (           MAHANG    nvarchar(50),           NGAYGIAO  date,           CUA       nvarchar(20),           TRUYEN    nvarchar(20),           SOLUONG   int,           GIO_PARSE nvarchar(10),           LOT       nvarchar(500),           STATUS    nvarchar(20),           STATUSDOC nvarchar(50)       )          -- ── 11. INSERT #LUU — lấy dòng mới nhất theo TGLUU ──────────────────       INSERT INTO #LUU       SELECT           RTRIM(MAHANG), CAST(NGAYGIAO AS date),           RTRIM(CUA), RTRIM(TRUYEN),           SOLUONG, GIOGIAO, GIOGIAOFCC, LOT, STATUS, STATUSDOC       FROM (           SELECT *,               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (                   PARTITION BY RTRIM(MAHANG), CAST(NGAYGIAO AS date),                                RTRIM(CUA), RTRIM(TRUYEN),                                SOLUONG, GIOGIAO, RTRIM(NHAMAY)                   ORDER BY TGLUU DESC               ) AS RN           FROM LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG           WHERE CAST(NGAYGIAO AS date) = CAST(@NGAYGIAO AS date)             AND NHAMAY LIKE @NHAMAY             AND GIOGIAO NOT LIKE '%[^0-9]%'             AND GIOGIAO <> ''             AND (                 NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #GioList)                 OR TRY_CAST(GIOGIAO AS INT) IN (SELECT GioInt FROM #GioList)             )       ) x       WHERE x.RN = 1          -- ── 12. INSERT #LUUGIO — chuẩn hóa GIO_PARSE ────────────────────────       INSERT INTO #LUUGIO       SELECT           l.MAHANG, l.NGAYGIAO, l.CUA, l.TRUYEN, l.SOLUONG,           RIGHT('00' + LTRIM(RTRIM(l.GIOGIAO)), 2) AS GIO_PARSE,           l.LOT, l.STATUS, l.STATUSDOC       FROM #LUU l       WHERE l.GIOGIAO <> ''         AND (             NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #GioList)             OR TRY_CAST(l.GIOGIAO AS INT) IN (SELECT GioInt FROM #GioList)         )          -- Index để tăng tốc JOIN ở bước 13       CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_LUUGIO           ON #LUUGIO (MAHANG, CUA, TRUYEN, SOLUONG, GIO_PARSE)          -- ── 13. INSERT vào TMP — LEFT JOIN IFS + #LUUGIO ─────────────────────       -- FIX NULL: ISNULL(CUA,'') và ISNULL(TRUYEN,'') — giữ từ SP cũ đã fix       SET @SQL = N'           INSERT INTO ' + QUOTENAME(@TMPTABLE) + N'               (STT,CUA,TRUYEN,MAHANG,TENHANG,LOT,DV,SOLUONG,NGAYGIAO,GIOGIAO,                STATUS,TTPHIEU,NHAMAY,ADDNM,HOP,STATUSDOC,Note,PO_NO,PO_ITEM)           SELECT               i.STT, i.CUA, i.TRUYEN, i.MAHANG, i.TENHANG,               ISNULL(l.LOT,       i.LOT),       i.DV, i.SOLUONG, i.NGAYGIAO, i.GIOGIAO,               ISNULL(l.STATUS,    i.STATUS),    i.TTPHIEU, i.NHAMAY, @ADDNM,               i.HOP,               ISNULL(l.STATUSDOC, i.STATUSDOC), i.Note,               ISNULL(i.PO_NO,  '''') AS PO_NO,               ISNULL(i.PO_ITEM,'''') AS PO_ITEM           FROM ' + QUOTENAME(@IFSTABLE) + N' i           LEFT JOIN #LUUGIO l               ON  l.MAHANG                  = RTRIM(i.MAHANG)               AND ISNULL(l.CUA,   '''')     = ISNULL(RTRIM(i.CUA),   '''')               AND ISNULL(l.TRUYEN,'''')     = ISNULL(RTRIM(i.TRUYEN),'''')               AND l.SOLUONG                 = i.SOLUONG               AND l.GIO_PARSE               = RIGHT(''00'' + LTRIM(RTRIM(i.GIOGIAO)), 2)'       EXEC sp_executesql @SQL, N'@ADDNM int', @ADDNM          DROP TABLE #LUU       DROP TABLE #LUUGIO          XUAT_KQ:       DROP TABLE #GioList          -- ── 14. Xuất kết quả ─────────────────────────────────────────────────       SET @SQL =           N'SELECT STT,CUA,TRUYEN,MAHANG,TENHANG,LOT,DV,SOLUONG,' +           N'       NGAYGIAO,GIOGIAO,STATUS,TTPHIEU,NHAMAY,ADDNM,' +           N'       HOP,STATUSDOC,Note,' +           N'       ISNULL(PO_NO,'''')   AS PO_NO,' +           N'       ISNULL(PO_ITEM,'''') AS PO_ITEM' +           N' FROM ' + QUOTENAME(@TMPTABLE) +           N' ORDER BY TRY_CAST(STT AS INT), STT'       EXEC sp_executesql @SQL   END

CREATE PROC [dbo].[Usp_Qrcode_LOAD_PHIEU_DOCQROLD]         @NGAYGIAO nvarchar(20),         @NHAMAY   nvarchar(50)  = N'',         @GIOFCC   nvarchar(200) = N'',         @ADDNM    int     AS     BEGIN         SET NOCOUNT ON;              DECLARE @TTIFS int              -- ── 1. TẠO DANH SÁCH GIỜ TỪ THAM SỐ RADIO ĐANG CHỌN (DÙNG INT ĐỂ LỌC GỐC) ──         CREATE TABLE #GioList (GioInt int)            INSERT INTO #GioList         SELECT TRY_CAST(LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE(value, '''', ''))) AS INT)         FROM STRING_SPLIT(REPLACE(@GIOFCC, '''', ''), ',')         WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE(value, '''', ''))) <> ''           AND LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE(value, '''', ''))) <> '(GIAO DB)'           AND TRY_CAST(LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE(value, '''', ''))) AS INT) IS NOT NULL            SELECT @TTIFS = COUNT(*) FROM IFSPHIEUGIAOHANG              -- ── 2. CHUẨN HÓA THAM SỐ ĐỂ TRA CỨU ─────────────────────────────────         IF CHARINDEX('(NHA MAY HA NAM)', @NHAMAY) > 0             SET @NHAMAY = '%NHA MAY HA NAM%'         ELSE             SET @NHAMAY = '%(NHA MAY VP)'              -- Chuẩn hóa dữ liệu bảng lịch sử quét để tăng tốc độ tìm kiếm         UPDATE LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG SET GIOGIAO = '00H' WHERE GIOGIAO = '0H'         UPDATE LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG SET GIOGIAO = REPLACE(GIOGIAO, 'H', '') WHERE GIOGIAO <> '00H' AND GIOGIAO LIKE '%H'         UPDATE LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG SET NHAMAY  = 'HON DA - VIET NAM(NHA MAY VP)' WHERE NHAMAY LIKE '%VP)'         UPDATE LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG SET GIOGIAOFCC = GIOGIAO WHERE GIOGIAOFCC = '(GIAO DB)' AND GIOGIAO <> '05'              -- Đồng bộ hóa khung giờ thực tế theo bảng tra cứu thời gian         IF EXISTS (             SELECT 1 FROM LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG             WHERE GIOGIAOFCC NOT LIKE '%H'               AND GIOGIAOFCC NOT LIKE '(O TYPE%'               AND NHAMAY <> 'YAMAHA - VIET NAM'         )         BEGIN             IF @NHAMAY = '%NHA MAY HA NAM%'             BEGIN                 UPDATE L SET L.GIOGIAOFCC = C.GIOFCCHN                 FROM LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG L                 INNER JOIN QRCODE_CHANGETIME C ON C.GIOHVN = L.GIOGIAOFCC                 WHERE L.GIOGIAOFCC NOT LIKE '%H' AND L.GIOGIAOFCC NOT LIKE '(O TYPE%' AND L.NHAMAY <> 'YAMAHA - VIET NAM' AND L.NHAMAY LIKE @NHAMAY             END             ELSE             BEGIN                 UPDATE L SET L.GIOGIAOFCC = C.GioFCCVP                 FROM LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG L                 INNER JOIN QRCODE_CHANGETIME C ON C.GIOHVN = L.GIOGIAOFCC                 WHERE L.GIOGIAOFCC NOT LIKE '%H' AND L.GIOGIAOFCC NOT LIKE '(O TYPE%' AND L.NHAMAY <> 'YAMAHA - VIET NAM' AND L.NHAMAY LIKE @NHAMAY             END         END              -- ── 3. XỬ LÝ ĐỔ DỮ LIỆU RA LƯỚI HIỂN THỊ ────────────────────────────         IF @GIOFCC = '(GIAO DB)'         BEGIN             DELETE TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG             INSERT INTO TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG                 (STT,CUA,TRUYEN,MAHANG,TENHANG,LOT,DV,SOLUONG,NGAYGIAO,GIOGIAO,                  STATUS,TTPHIEU,NHAMAY,ADDNM,HOP,STATUSDOC,Note,PO_NO,PO_ITEM)             SELECT STT,CUA,TRUYEN,MAHANG,TENHANG,LOT,DV,SOLUONG,NGAYGIAO,GIOGIAO,                    STATUS,TTPHIEU,NHAMAY,ADDNM,HOP,STATUSDOC,Note,                    ISNULL(PO_NO,''), ISNULL(PO_ITEM,'')             FROM IFSPHIEUGIAOHANG         END         ELSE         BEGIN             IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM DOCQRCODE)             BEGIN                 DELETE TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG                      IF @NHAMAY = '%(NHA MAY VP)'                     SET @ADDNM = 1                 ELSE                     SET @ADDNM = 2                      -- ── BƯỚC 1: Lọc nạp dữ liệu lịch sử quét ──                 CREATE TABLE #LUU (                     MAHANG     nvarchar(50),                     NGAYGIAO   date,                     CUA        nvarchar(20),                     TRUYEN     nvarchar(20),                     SOLUONG    int,                     GIOGIAO    nvarchar(10),                     GIOGIAOFCC nvarchar(50),                     LOT        nvarchar(500),                     STATUS     nvarchar(20),                     STATUSDOC  nvarchar(50)                 )                      INSERT INTO #LUU                 SELECT                      RTRIM(MAHANG), CAST(NGAYGIAO AS date), RTRIM(CUA), RTRIM(TRUYEN),                     SOLUONG, GIOGIAO, GIOGIAOFCC, LOT, STATUS, STATUSDOC                 FROM (                     SELECT *,                         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (                             PARTITION BY RTRIM(MAHANG), CAST(NGAYGIAO AS date),                                          RTRIM(CUA),    RTRIM(TRUYEN),                                          SOLUONG,       GIOGIAO,                                          RTRIM(NHAMAY)                             ORDER BY TGLUU DESC                         ) AS RN                     FROM LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG                     WHERE CAST(NGAYGIAO AS date) = CAST(@NGAYGIAO AS date)                       AND NHAMAY                 LIKE @NHAMAY                       AND GIOGIAO NOT LIKE '%[^0-9]%'                         AND GIOGIAO <> ''                       -- Lọc nhanh bằng ép kiểu INT để tránh sót dữ liệu dạng '6' hay '06'                       AND TRY_CAST(GIOGIAO AS INT) IN (SELECT GioInt FROM #GioList)                  ) x                 WHERE x.RN = 1                      -- ── BƯỚC 2: Tách chuỗi Giờ tổng hợp để phục vụ đối chiếu mẫu ──────                 CREATE TABLE #LUUGIO (                     MAHANG     nvarchar(50),                     NGAYGIAO   date,                     CUA        nvarchar(20),                     TRUYEN     nvarchar(20),                     SOLUONG    int,                     GIO_PARSE  nvarchar(10),                     LOT        nvarchar(500),                     STATUS     nvarchar(20),                     STATUSDOC  nvarchar(50)                 )                      INSERT INTO #LUUGIO                 SELECT                      l.MAHANG, l.NGAYGIAO, l.CUA, l.TRUYEN, l.SOLUONG,                     -- ══ FIX CHÍ MẠNG: Định dạng chuỗi giờ bóc tách về dạng 2 chữ số '0X' (ví dụ: '6' -> '06')                     -- Điều này đảm bảo mỗi khung giờ con trả về đúng mã định danh của nó, không trùng lắp GIO_PARSE                     RIGHT('00' + LTRIM(RTRIM(gs.value)), 2) AS GIO_PARSE,                     l.LOT, l.STATUS, l.STATUSDOC                 FROM #LUU l                 CROSS APPLY STRING_SPLIT(                     REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(l.GIOGIAOFCC, '(', ''), ')', ''), 'H', ''),                     '+'                 ) gs                 WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(gs.value)) <> ''                   AND TRY_CAST(LTRIM(RTRIM(gs.value)) AS INT) IN (SELECT GioInt FROM #GioList)                      CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_LUUGIO ON #LUUGIO (MAHANG, CUA, TRUYEN, SOLUONG, GIO_PARSE)                      -- ── BƯỚC 3: Dùng IFS làm gốc, LEFT JOIN để map trạng thái Quét ──                 INSERT INTO TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG                     (STT,CUA,TRUYEN,MAHANG,TENHANG,LOT,DV,SOLUONG,NGAYGIAO,GIOGIAO,                      STATUS,TTPHIEU,NHAMAY,ADDNM,HOP,STATUSDOC,Note,PO_NO,PO_ITEM)                 SELECT                     i.STT,                     i.CUA,                     i.TRUYEN,                     i.MAHANG,                     i.TENHANG,                     ISNULL(l.LOT,       i.LOT)       AS LOT,                     i.DV,                     i.SOLUONG,                     i.NGAYGIAO,                     i.GIOGIAO,                     ISNULL(l.STATUS,    i.STATUS)    AS STATUS,                     i.TTPHIEU,                     i.NHAMAY,                     @ADDNM,                     i.HOP,                     ISNULL(l.STATUSDOC, i.STATUSDOC) AS STATUSDOC,                     i.Note,                     ISNULL(i.PO_NO,   '') AS PO_NO,                     ISNULL(i.PO_ITEM, '') AS PO_ITEM                 FROM IFSPHIEUGIAOHANG i                 LEFT JOIN #LUUGIO l                     ON  l.MAHANG    = RTRIM(i.MAHANG)                     AND l.CUA       = RTRIM(i.CUA)                     AND l.TRUYEN    = RTRIM(i.TRUYEN)                     AND l.SOLUONG   = i.SOLUONG                     -- So khớp chuẩn chuỗi dạng '06' = '06' (hoàn toàn loại bỏ double row)                     AND l.GIO_PARSE = RTRIM(i.GIOGIAO)                       DROP TABLE #LUU                 DROP TABLE #LUUGIO             END         END              -- ── 4. TRẢ KẾT QUẢ ĐẦU RA CHO GRIDVIEW ───────────────────────────────         SELECT STT,CUA,TRUYEN,MAHANG,TENHANG,LOT,DV,SOLUONG,NGAYGIAO,                GIOGIAO,STATUS,TTPHIEU,NHAMAY,ADDNM,HOP,STATUSDOC,Note,                ISNULL(PO_NO,   '') AS PO_NO,                ISNULL(PO_ITEM, '') AS PO_ITEM         FROM TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG         ORDER BY TRY_CAST(STT AS INT), STT              DROP TABLE #GioList     END

NVARCHAR(50),             PO_ITEM    NVARCHAR(50)         )'     EXEC sp_executesql @sqlCreate      -- Đổ dữ liệu từ View Oracle vào bảng tạm #IFS     INSERT INTO #IFS       SELECT   INSERT #DP VALUES(0,N',');   DECLARE @qrStt int,@qrQty int,@qrLot nvarchar(1000),@qrHvn int;   DECLARE QrCursor CURSOR LOCAL FAST_FORWARD FOR SELECT STT,SLTEMFCC,LOTFCC,SLTEMHVN FROM #QRData ORDER BY STT;     IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #DP WHERE Qty=@_SLGIAO) BREAK;    END;    FETCH NEXT FROM QrCursor INTO @qrStt,@qrQty,@qrLot,@qrHvn;   END;   CLOSE QrCursor; DEALLOCATE QrCursor;   SELECT @path=Path FROM #DP WHERE Qty=@_SLGIAO;   IF @path IS NULL   BEGIN    IF @OwnTran=1 COMMIT TRANSACTION;    SELECT CAST(NULL AS nvarchar(56)) AS LOTFCC,CAST(0 AS int) AS FCC,CAST(0 AS int) AS HVN WHERE 1=0;    RETURN;   END;    CREATE TABLE #Chosen(STT int NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY);   INSERT #Chosen SELECT DISTINCT TRY_CONVERT(int,value) FROM STRING_SPLIT(@path,N',')    WHERE NULLIF(value,N'') IS NOT NULL AND TRY_CONVERT(int,value) IS NOT NULL;   SELECT @chosenCount=COUNT(*) FROM #Chosen;   IF @chosenCount=0 THROW 51105,N'Danh sách QR phân bổ rỗng.',1;    SELECT TOP 0 LOTFCC,SLTEMFCC,SLTEMHVN INTO #CtTmp FROM dbo.DOCQRCODE;   -- FIX: @token nvarchar(56) -> (1000), @lotPart nvarchar(30) -> (100): tranh cat ngam   DECLARE @lot nvarchar(1000),@fcc int,@hvn int,@pos int,@next int,@token nvarchar(1000),           @hyphen int,@lotPart nvarchar(100),@qtyPart int;   DECLARE ChosenCursor CURSOR LOCAL FAST_FORWARD FOR    SELECT q.LOTFCC,q.SLTEMFCC,q.SLTEMHVN FROM #QRData q JOIN #Chosen c ON c.STT=q.STT ORDER BY q.STT;   OPEN ChosenCursor;   FETCH NEXT FROM ChosenCursor INTO @lot,@fcc,@hvn;       SET @qtyPart=TRY_CONVERT(int,SUBSTRING(@token,@hyphen+1,20));       IF @qtyPart>0       BEGIN        IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #CtTmp WHERE LOTFCC=@lotPart)         UPDATE #CtTmp SET SLTEMFCC=SLTEMFCC+@qtyPart,SLTEMHVN=SLTEMHVN+@qtyPart WHERE LOTFCC=@lotPart;     ELSE INSERT #CtTmp(LOTFCC,SLTEMFCC,SLTEMHVN) VALUES(RTRIM(@lot),@fcc,@hvn);    END;    FETCH NEXT FROM ChosenCursor INTO @lot,@fcc,@hvn;   END;   CLOSE ChosenCursor; DEALLOCATE ChosenCursor;    -- LOT payload must reconcile to the same exact quantity before any QR is marked DG.   DECLARE @LotTotal bigint;   SELECT @LotTotal=SUM(CONVERT(bigint,SLTEMFCC)) FROM #CtTmp;   IF @LotTotal IS NULL OR @LotTotal<>CONVERT(bigint,@_SLGIAO)    THROW 51108,N'Tổng số lượng LOT sau khi phân rã không khớp số lượng dòng phiếu; hủy cấp phát.',1;    SET @sql=N'UPDATE q SET KETQUA=N''DG'',STTBAN=@stt,GIO=@stt     FROM dbo.'+QUOTENAME(@DOCQRTABLE)+N' q JOIN #Chosen c ON c.STT=q.STT     WHERE q.MAHANGFCC=@ma AND ISNULL(q.KETQUA,N'''')<>N''DG'';     SET @n=@@ROWCOUNT;';   EXEC sys.sp_executesql @sql,N'@stt int,@ma nvarchar(100),@n int OUTPUT',@_STTP,@_MaFCC,@affected OUTPUT;   IF @affected<>@chosenCount   BEGIN    DECLARE @claimError nvarchar(2048)=CONCAT(N'QR đã bị tiến trình khác nhận; expected=',@chosenCount,N', actual=',@affected,N'.');    THROW 51106,@claimError,1;   END;    SET @sql=N'UPDATE dbo.'+QUOTENAME(@TMPTABLE)+N'     SET TTPHIEU=N''Đã Thống Kê QR'',STATUSDOC=N''OK''     WHERE STT=@stt AND MAHANG=@ma AND SOLUONG=@qty AND ISNULL(LOT,N'''')=N'''';     SELECT @n=@@ROWCOUNT;';   SET @affected=0;   EXEC sys.sp_executesql @sql,N'@stt int,@ma nvarchar(100),@qty int,@n int OUTPUT',@_STTP,@_MaFCC,@_SLGIAO,@affected OUTPUT;   IF @affected<>1 THROW 51107,N'Dòng phiếu thay đổi trong lúc cấp phát; hủy toàn bộ.',1;    SELECT LOTFCC,SUM(SLTEMFCC) AS FCC,SUM(SLTEMHVN) AS HVN FROM #CtTmp GROUP BY LOTFCC ORDER BY LOTFCC;   IF @OwnTran=1 COMMIT TRANSACTION;  END TRY  BEGIN CATCH   IF CURSOR_STATUS('local','QrCursor')>=0 BEGIN CLOSE QrCursor; DEALLOCATE QrCursor; END;   IF CURSOR_STATUS('local','ChosenCursor')>=0 BEGIN CLOSE ChosenCursor; DEALLOCATE ChosenCursor; END;   IF @OwnTran=1 AND XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;   ELSE IF @Savepoint=1 AND XACT_STATE()=1 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION PctpTakeLot2405;   THROW;  END CATCH; END

   @_SLTEMFCC OUTPUT, @_MaFCC      IF OBJECT_ID('TempDb..#CtTmp') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #CtTmp     SELECT TOP 0 LOTFCC, SLTEMFCC, SLTEMHVN     INTO #CtTmp     FROM DOCQRCODE  -- chỉ dùng để lấy CREATE PROC [dbo].[Usp_Qrcode_Take_LotYMVN]       AS       BEGIN           SET NOCOUNT ON;                   DECLARE @_LOTHVN  NVARCHAR(50), @_LOTFCC NVARCHAR(300), @_SLTEMFCC int, @_ID as int, @_Count_R as int, @_STTDOC as int, @SLTT as int, @_MaFCC NVARCHAR(50);                    IF OBJECT_ID ('TempDb..#CtTmp1') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #CtTmp1;           SELECT TOP 0 MAHANGFCC, CAST(LOTFCC AS NVARCHAR(400)) AS LOTFCC, SLTEMFCC, LOTHVN           INTO #CtTmp1           FROM YMVN_DOCQRCODE;          IF OBJECT_ID ('TempDb..#CtTmp') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #CtTmp;           SELECT TOP 0 MAHANGFCC, CAST(LOTFCC AS NVARCHAR(400)) AS LOTFCC, SLTEMFCC, LOTHVN           INTO #CtTmp           FROM YMVN_DOCQRCODE;                 SET @SLTT = 0;           DECLARE QRcode CURSOR FOR           SELECT MAHANGFCC, CASE WHEN LEN(LOTFCC) <= 20 THEN SUBSTRING(LOTFCC, 1, 13) ELSE LOTFCC END AS LOTFCC, SUM(SLTEMFCC) AS SOLUONG,             STUFF('00000', 5 - LEN(LOTHVN) + 1, LEN(LOTHVN), LOTHVN) AS LOTHVN        FROM YMVN_DOCQRCODE          WHERE KETQUA <> 'DG'          GROUP BY MAHANGFCC, LOTHVN, LOTFCC         ORDER BY LOTHVN;      OPEN QRcode;           FETCH NEXT FROM QRcode INTO @_MaFCC, @_LOTFCC, @_SLTEMFCC, @_LOTHVN;          WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0            BEGIN               IF LEN(RTRIM(@_LOTFCC)) > 13             BEGIN                 DECLARE @_LOTGHEP AS NVARCHAR(100);                 DECLARE DM CURSOR FOR                  SELECT * FROM Split(@_LOTFCC, ',');                  OPEN DM;                 FETCH NEXT FROM DM INTO @_LOTGHEP;                  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0                 BEGIN                      IF CHARINDEX('-', @_LOTGHEP, 1) > 1                 BEGIN                     SET @_LOTFCC = LEFT(@_LOTGHEP, CHARINDEX('-', @_LOTGHEP, 1) - 1);                       END                 ELSE                 BEGIN                     PRINT 'Invalid length parameter for LEFT function';                     SET @_LOTFCC = '';                 END                  IF LEN(RTRIM(@_LOTGHEP)) - CHARINDEX('-', RTRIM(@_LOTGHEP), 1) > 0                 BEGIN                     SET @_SLTEMFCC = RIGHT(RTRIM(@_LOTGHEP), LEN(RTRIM(@_LOTGHEP)) - CHARINDEX('-', RTRIM(@_LOTGHEP), 1));                    END                 ELSE                 BEGIN                     PRINT 'Invalid length parameter for RIGHT function';                     SET @_SLTEMFCC = 0;                 END                  INSERT INTO #CtTmp(MAHANGFCC, LOTFCC, SLTEMFCC, LOTHVN) VALUES(@_MaFCC, @_LOTFCC, @_SLTEMFCC, @_LOTHVN);                     FETCH NEXT FROM DM INTO @_LOTGHEP;                 END;                  CLOSE DM;                  DEALLOCATE DM;             END             ELSE             BEGIN                 INSERT INTO #CtTmp(MAHANGFCC, LOTFCC, SLTEMFCC, LOTHVN) VALUES(@_MaFCC, SUBSTRING(@_LOTFCC, 1, 13), @_SLTEMFCC, @_LOTHVN);             END;              FETCH NEXT FROM QRcode INTO @_MaFCC, @_LOTFCC, @_SLTEMFCC, @_LOTHVN;         END;            CLOSE QRcode;           DEALLOCATE QRcode;           SELECT * FROM #CtTmp;        DECLARE Cu_TB CURSOR FOR         SELECT MAHANGFCC, LOTFCC, SUM(SLTEMFCC) AS SLGIAO, LOTHVN        FROM #CtTmp      GROUP BY MAHANGFCC, LOTFCC, LOTHVN;          OPEN Cu_TB;         FETCH NEXT FROM Cu_TB INTO @_MaFCC, @_LOTFCC, @_SLTEMFCC, @_LOTHVN;          WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0         BEGIN             IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT MAHANGFCC, LOTHVN FROM #CtTmp1 WHERE MAHANGFCC = @_MaFCC AND LOTHVN = @_LOTHVN)                 INSERT INTO #CtTmp1 (MAHANGFCC, LOTFCC, SLTEMFCC, LOTHVN) VALUES(@_MaFCC, CONCAT(@_LOTFCC, '-', CAST(@_SLTEMFCC AS NVARCHAR(10))), @_SLTEMFCC, @_LOTHVN);             ELSE                 UPDATE #CtTmp1              SET SLTEMFCC = SLTEMFCC + @_SLTEMFCC,                  LOTFCC = CONCAT(RTRIM(LOTFCC), ',', RTRIM(@_LOTFCC), '-', CAST(@_SLTEMFCC AS NVARCHAR(10)))               WHERE MAHANGFCC = @_MaFCC AND LOTHVN = @_LOTHVN;              FETCH NEXT FROM Cu_TB INTO @_MaFCC, @_LOTFCC, @_SLTEMFCC, @_LOTHVN;         END;          CLOSE Cu_TB;         DEALLOCATE Cu_TB;          DECLARE @_MHTMP AS NVARCHAR(60), @_LOTHVNTMP AS NVARCHAR(60), @_SLTMP AS INT;        DECLARE PGH CURSOR FOR       SELECT MAHANG, LOT, SOLUONG, STUFF('00000', 5 - LEN(CUA) + 1, LEN(CUA), CUA)      FROM YMVN_TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG;         OPEN PGH;       FETCH NEXT FROM PGH INTO @_MaFCC, @_LOTFCC, @_SLTEMFCC, @_LOTHVN;          WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0       BEGIN           IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM #CtTmp1 WHERE MAHANGFCC = @_MaFCC AND LOTHVN = @_LOTHVN AND SLTEMFCC = @_SLTEMFCC)           BEGIN               SELECT @_MHTMP = MAHANGFCC, @_LOTHVNTMP = LOTHVN, @_SLTMP = SLTEMFCC              FROM #CtTmp1              WHERE MAHANGFCC = @_MaFCC AND LOTHVN = @_LOTHVN AND SLTEMFCC = @_SLTEMFCC;                UPDATE YMVN_TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG              SET LOT = (SELECT LOTFCC FROM #CtTmp1 WHERE MAHANGFCC = @_MaFCC AND LOTHVN = @_LOTHVN)               WHERE MAHANG = @_MHTMP AND STUFF('00000', 5 - LEN(CUA) + 1, LEN(CUA), CUA) = @_LOTHVNTMP AND SOLUONG = @_SLTMP;                UPDATE YMVN_DOCQRCODE              SET KETQUA = 'DG'              WHERE MAHANGFCC = @_MHTMP AND LOTHVN = @_LOTHVN;             END;            FETCH NEXT FROM PGH INTO @_MaFCC, @_LOTFCC, @_SLTEMFCC, @_LOTHVN;        END;        CLOSE PGH;         DEALLOCATE PGH;    END;

CREATE PROC [dbo].[Usp_Qrcode_Take_LotYMVN2405]  --  'TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG_100002','YMVN_DOCQRCODE',0     @TMPTABLE    nvarchar(100) = N'TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG',            @DOCQRTABLE  nvarchar(100) = N'DOCQRCODE',            @ISLOAISP    int           = 0        AS        BEGIN            SET NOCOUNT ON;            SET XACT_ABORT ON;      -- YMVN/HTN have their own configured table families. These identifiers     -- are intentionally separate from the HVN exact-allocation procedure.     IF @TMPTABLE IS NULL OR @TMPTABLE NOT IN (         N'TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG',         N'TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG_100002',         N'TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG_100003',         N'TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG_SP',         N'SP_TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG'     )     BEGIN         THROW 51201, N'Tên bảng YMVN TMPTABLE không hợp lệ.', 1;     END;      IF @DOCQRTABLE IS NULL OR @DOCQRTABLE NOT IN (         N'DOCQRCODE',         N'YMVN_DOCQRCODE',         N'DOCQRCODE_100003',         N'DOCQRCODE_SP',         N'SP_DOCQRCODE'     )     BEGIN         THROW 51202, N'Tên bảng YMVN DOCQRTABLE không hợp lệ.', 1;     END;      IF @ISLOAISP IS NULL OR @ISLOAISP NOT IN (0, 1)         THROW 51203, N'Loại phiếu YMVN không hợp lệ.', 1;      IF @ISLOAISP = 1        AND (@TMPTABLE <> N'SP_TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG' OR @DOCQRTABLE <> N'SP_DOCQRCODE')         THROW 51204, N'YMVN SP phải sử dụng đúng cặp bảng SP đã cấu hình.', 1;      IF @ISLOAISP = 0        AND (@TMPTABLE = N'SP_TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG' OR @DOCQRTABLE = N'SP_DOCQRCODE')         THROW 51205, N'Không được dùng bảng SP cho luồng YMVN MP.', 1;      IF @TMPTABLE = N'TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG_100002' AND @DOCQRTABLE <> N'YMVN_DOCQRCODE'         THROW 51206, N'Cặp bảng YMVN MP không khớp cấu hình.', 1;      IF @TMPTABLE = N'TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG_100003' AND @DOCQRTABLE <> N'DOCQRCODE_100003'         THROW 51207, N'Cặp bảng khách hàng 100003 không khớp cấu hình.', 1;      -- ── Họ bảng theo khách hàng (CustomerTableConfig) ─────────────────────────     -- DOCQRCODE / DOCQRCODE_100003 : có TGLUU + STTBAN + GIO  -> CLAIM MODE     -- YMVN_DOCQRCODE               : KHÔNG có TGLUU           -> LEGACY MODE     -- SP_DOCQRCODE / SP_TMPPHIEU.. : schema khác hoàn toàn    -> không hỗ trợ     DECLARE @tmpTbl nvarchar(300) = N'dbo.' + QUOTENAME(@TMPTABLE);     DECLARE @qrTbl  nvarchar(300) = N'dbo.' + QUOTENAME(@DOCQRTABLE);      DECLARE @TmpOk bit = CASE WHEN COL_LENGTH(@tmpTbl, N'STT') IS NOT NULL         AND COL_LENGTH(@tmpTbl, N'MAHANG') IS NOT NULL AND COL_LENGTH(@tmpTbl, N'SOLUONG') IS NOT NULL         AND COL_LENGTH(@tmpTbl, N'LOT') IS NOT NULL AND COL_LENGTH(@tmpTbl, N'STATUSDOC') IS NOT NULL         AND COL_LENGTH(@tmpTbl, N'TTPHIEU') IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;      DECLARE @LegacyQrOk bit = CASE WHEN COL_LENGTH(@qrTbl, N'MAHANGFCC') IS NOT NULL         AND COL_LENGTH(@qrTbl, N'SLTEMHVN') IS NOT NULL AND COL_LENGTH(@qrTbl, N'SLTEMFCC') IS NOT NULL         AND COL_LENGTH(@qrTbl, N'LOTHVN') IS NOT NULL AND COL_LENGTH(@qrTbl, N'LOTFCC') IS NOT NULL         AND COL_LENGTH(@qrTbl, N'KETQUA') IS NOT NULL AND COL_LENGTH(@qrTbl, N'STT') IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;      DECLARE @ClaimMode bit = CASE WHEN @TmpOk = 1 AND @LegacyQrOk = 1         AND COL_LENGTH(@qrTbl, N'TGLUU') IS NOT NULL AND COL_LENGTH(@qrTbl, N'STTBAN') IS NOT NULL         AND COL_LENGTH(@qrTbl, N'GIO') IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;      IF @TmpOk = 0 OR @LegacyQrOk = 0         THROW 51213, N'Cặp bảng không có schema được hỗ trợ bởi Usp_Qrcode_Take_LotYMVN2405 (ví dụ SP_DOCQRCODE/SP_TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG có cột khác hẳn).', 1;      DECLARE @sql nvarchar(max);      IF @ClaimMode = 0     BEGIN         -- >>> LEGACY-MODE-BEGIN <<< (không đổi hành vi so với bản trước) ═══════════════════         -- Bảng không có TGLUU nên chưa có khóa dòng để claim an toàn         -- (ví dụ YMVN_DOCQRCODE). Giữ nguyên logic cũ; KHÔNG ALTER schema lúc chạy.         -- Muốn claim theo phiếu cho họ bảng này cần quyết định thiết kế riêng         -- (xem WMS_CUSTOMER_TABLE_FAMILIES.md).         -- ── Bước 1: KHAI BÁO BIẾN       --------------------------------------------------------------------       DECLARE @sql NVARCHAR(MAX);     DECLARE @StartedTransaction BIT = 0;     DECLARE @ErrMH NVARCHAR(60) = NULL;   -- mã hàng đang xử lý khi lỗi nghiệp vụ FIFO_SP     DECLARE @ErrQty INT = NULL;           -- số lượng cần giao của dòng đó     DECLARE @ErrTon INT = NULL;           -- tổng tồn khả dụng của mã hàng (chỉ để hiển thị)     DECLARE @SavepointCreated BIT = 0;          DECLARE           @_LOT          NVARCHAR(MAX),           @_SLCONLAI     INT,           @STT           INT,           @MH            NVARCHAR(60),           @_LOTSL_Tach   NVARCHAR(500),           @_LOTOK        NVARCHAR(500),           @_SLOK         INT,           @_KTPC         INT,           @_LOTUD        NVARCHAR(500),           @_SLUD         INT,           @_STTUD        INT,           @_STUP         NVARCHAR(15),           @LotThuc       NVARCHAR(500),         @LockResource  NVARCHAR(255),         @LockResult    INT,         @StockRowsUpdated INT;          --------------------------------------------------------------------       -- 3. TEMP TABLE       --------------------------------------------------------------------       CREATE TABLE #TMPUPDATE       (           STT     INT,           MH      NVARCHAR(60),           LOT     NVARCHAR(MAX),           SOLUONG INT,           STATUS  NVARCHAR(50)       );          CREATE TABLE #STOK       (           STT     INT,           LOT     NVARCHAR(MAX),           SOLUONG INT,           STATUS  NVARCHAR(50)       );          CREATE TABLE #STNG       (           MH       NVARCHAR(100),           LOT      NVARCHAR(MAX),           SLCAN    INT,           SLCO     INT,           SLTHIEU  INT,           STATUS   NVARCHAR(500)       );          CREATE TABLE #PHIEU       (           STT INT,           LOT NVARCHAR(MAX),           MH  NVARCHAR(60)       );          BEGIN TRY          -- Own a transaction when called directly; otherwise participate in the         -- repository UnitOfWork through a savepoint. NẠP PHIẾU           ----------------------------------------------------------------           SET @sql = N'               INSERT INTO #PHIEU               (                   STT,                   LOT,                   MH               )               SELECT                   STT,                   LOT,                   MAHANG               FROM [' + @TMPTABLE + N']               WHERE ISNULL(LOT, '''') <> ''''   -- chỉ xử lý dòng ĐÃ có LOT (đã thống kê); dòng chưa có LOT bỏ qua, kể cả FIFO_SP               AND (STATUS <> ''OK'' OR STATUS IS NULL);           ';              EXEC sp_executesql @sql,             N'@LOTRESOLUTIONMODE NVARCHAR(20)',             @LOTRESOLUTIONMODE = @LOTRESOLUTIONMODE;              ----------------------------------------------------------------           -- Không có phiếu           ----------------------------------------------------------------           IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #PHIEU)           BEGIN             IF @StartedTransaction = 1                 COMMIT TRANSACTION;                SELECT                   STT,                   LOT,                   SOLUONG,                   STATUS               FROM #STOK;                  SELECT                   MH,                   LOT,                   SLCAN AS SLC,                   SLCO AS SLTK,                   SLTHIEU AS SLT,                   STATUS               FROM #STNG;                RETURN;           END;              ----------------------------------------------------------------           -- 6. Serialize the complete delivery identity before checking for             -- an existing confirmation. The lock is transaction-owned and therefore             -- remains held through STOCKTP, ledger, and pending-delivery writes.             ------------------------------------------------------------             SET @LockResource = NULL;             SET @sql = N'                 SELECT @Resource =                     N''PCTP_DELIVERY:'' +                     CONVERT(NVARCHAR(64), HASHBYTES(''SHA2_256'', CONCAT(                         UPPER(RTRIM(ISNULL(MAHANG, N''''))), N''|'',                         ISNULL(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), CAST(NGAYGIAO AS DATE), 23), N''''), N''|'',                         UPPER(RTRIM(ISNULL(CUA, N''''))), N''|'',                         UPPER(RTRIM(ISNULL(TRUYEN, N''''))), N''|'',                         ISNULL(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20), SOLUONG), N''''), N''|'',                         UPPER(RTRIM(ISNULL(GIOGIAO, N''''))), N''|'',                         UPPER(RTRIM(LEFT(ISNULL(@NHAMAY, N''''), 50)))                     )), 2)                 FROM [' + @TMPTABLE + N']                 WHERE STT = @STT;';              EXEC sp_executesql                 @sql,                 N'@STT INT, @NHAMAY NVARCHAR(250), @Resource NVARCHAR(255) OUTPUT',                 @STT = @STT,                 @NHAMAY = @NHAMAY,                 @Resource = @LockResource OUTPUT;              IF @LockResource IS NULL                 RAISERROR(N'Không tạo được khóa chống xác nhận giao hàng trùng.', 16, 1);              EXEC @LockResult = sys.sp_getapplock                 @Resource = @LockResource,                 @LockMode = N'Exclusive',                 @LockOwner = N'Transaction',                 @LockTimeout = 10000;              IF @LockResult < 0                 RAISERROR(N'Không lấy được khóa xác nhận giao hàng; vui lòng thử lại.', 16, 1);              ------------------------------------------------------------             -- 6.1. KIỂM TRA PHIẾU ĐÃ LƯU             ------------------------------------------------------------             SET @sql = N'                   SELECT TOP 1 1                   FROM [' + @TMPTABLE + N'] tmp                   INNER JOIN LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG luu                       ON RTRIM(luu.MAHANG) =                          RTRIM(tmp.MAHANG)                         AND CAST(luu.NGAYGIAO AS DATE) =                          CAST(tmp.NGAYGIAO AS DATE)                         AND RTRIM(luu.CUA) =                          RTRIM(tmp.CUA)                         AND RTRIM(luu.TRUYEN) =                          RTRIM(tmp.TRUYEN)                         AND luu.SOLUONG =                          tmp.SOLUONG                         AND RTRIM(luu.GIOGIAO) =                          RTRIM(tmp.GIOGIAO)                         AND RTRIM(luu.NHAMAY) =                          RTRIM(LEFT(@NHAMAY, 50))                      WHERE tmp.STT = @STT;               ';                  INSERT INTO @CheckResult               EXEC sp_executesql                   @sql,                   N'@NHAMAY NVARCHAR(250), @STT INT',                   @NHAMAY,                   @STT;                  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM @CheckResult)                   SET @DaTon = 1;                  DELETE FROM @CheckResult;                  ------------------------------------------------------------               -- 6.2. FIFO_SP: chọn một LOT vật lý đủ tồn trong cùng transaction.                 --------------------------------------------------------                 IF @LOTRESOLUTIONMODE = N'FIFO_SP' AND ISNULL(@_LOT, N'') = N''   -- không ghi đè LOT đã thống kê                 BEGIN                     DECLARE @FifoLot NVARCHAR(500) = NULL;                      EXEC sp_executesql @sql,                         N'@STT INT, @MaHang NVARCHAR(60), @Qty INT OUTPUT, @Lot NVARCHAR(500) OUTPUT',                         @STT=@STT, @MaHang=@MH,                         @Qty=@FifoQty OUTPUT, @Lot=@FifoLot OUTPUT;                      IF @FifoQty IS NULL OR @FifoQty <= 0                     BEGIN                         SET @ErrMH = @MH;                         SET @ErrQty = @FifoQty;                         THROW 51035, N'Số lượng giao SP phải lớn hơn 0.', 1;                     END;                     IF @FifoLot IS NULL                     BEGIN                         SET @ErrMH = @MH;                         SET @ErrQty = @FifoQty;                         THROW 51036, N'Không tìm được một LOT FIFO đủ tồn cho mã hàng SP (cần đủ trong MỘT LOT, đúng định dạng yyMMdd + [0-3]).', 1;                     IF @FifoTmpRows <> 1                         THROW 51037, N'Phiếu TMP đã thay đổi; không thể gán LOT FIFO.', 1;                 END;                  -- 6.3. TÁCH LOT-SL                   --------------------------------------------------------                   IF OBJECT_ID('TempDb..#SplitResult') IS NOT NULL                       DROP TABLE #SplitResult;                      CREATE TABLE #SplitResult                   (                       LotTach NVARCHAR(500)                   );                      INSERT INTO #SplitResult                   SELECT *                   FROM dbo.Split(@_LOT, ',');                      DECLARE LOT_IN_PGH CURSOR LOCAL FAST_FORWARD FOR                       SELECT LotTach                       FROM #SplitResult;                      OPEN LOT_IN_PGH;                      FETCH NEXT FROM LOT_IN_PGH                   INTO @_LOTSL_Tach;                      WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0                   BEGIN                       ----------------------------------------------------                       -- 6.4. KIỂM TRA LOT TỒN TẠI. Skip duplicate diagnostics if root is ambiguous.                             IF NOT EXISTS                             (                                 SELECT 1 FROM #STNG                                 WHERE RTRIM(MH) = RTRIM(@MH)                                   AND RTRIM(LOT) = RTRIM(@_LOTOK)                                   AND STATUS = N'Mã LOT gốc ánh xạ nhiều LOT vật lý; vui lòng cung cấp LOT đầy đủ'                             )                             AND EXISTS                             (                                 SELECT 1                                 FROM STOCKTP                                 WHERE (LEN(RTRIM(@_LOTOK)) > 13 AND RTRIM(LOT) = RTRIM(@_LOTOK))                                    OR (LEN(RTRIM(@_LOTOK)) <= 13 AND LEFT(RTRIM(LOT), 13) = LEFT(RTRIM(@_LOTOK), 13))                             )                             BEGIN                                      ------------------------------------------------                                   -- ĐỦ TỒN                                   ------------------------------------------------                                   IF @_SLCONLAI >= @_SLOK                                   BEGIN                                       INSERT INTO #TMPUPDATE                                       (                                           STT,                                           MH,                                           LOT,                                           SOLUONG,                                           STATUS                                       )                                       VALUES                                       (                                           @STT,                                           @MH,                                           @_LOTOK,                                           @_SLOK,                                           'OK'                                       );                                   END                                   ELSE                                   BEGIN                                          ------------------------------------------------                                       -- KHÔNG ĐỦ TỒN                                       ------------------------------------------------                                       INSERT INTO #STNG                                       (                                           MH,                                           LOT,                                           SLCAN,                                           SLCO,                                           SLTHIEU,                                           STATUS                                       )                                       VALUES                                       (                                           @MH,                                           @_LOTOK,                                           @_SLOK,                                           @_SLCONLAI,                                           @_SLOK - @_SLCONLAI,                                           N'Không đủ tồn kho ban đầu'                                       ); KIỂM TRA TỔNG SL CẦN XUẤT VS TỒN           ----------------------------------------------------------------           IF EXISTS           (               SELECT 1               FROM #TMPUPDATE               WHERE STATUS = 'OK'           )           BEGIN                  SELECT                   MH,                   LOT,                   SUM(SOLUONG) AS TONG_CAN_XUAT               INTO #GomNhomCheck               FROM #TMPUPDATE T             WHERE T.STATUS = 'OK'               AND NOT EXISTS               (                   SELECT 1                   FROM #STNG E                   WHERE RTRIM(E.MH) = RTRIM(T.MH)                     AND RTRIM(E.LOT) = RTRIM(T.LOT)               )             GROUP BY                 MH,                 LOT;                  ------------------------------------------------------------             -- Aggregate STOCKTP once (not once per delivery line).             --             -- The previous form LEFT JOINed the aggregate with an ON clause that             -- contained OR plus a correlated COUNT(DISTINCT ...) over STOCKTP. SQL             -- Server could not hash/merge-join it, so it compared every delivery             -- line with every physical LOT and re-ran that sub-query each time             -- (minutes on ~66k STOCKTP rows). Same rules, computed once:             --   * input LOT longer than 13 chars -> exact physical LOT only;             --   * 13-char root -> only when it maps to exactly ONE physical LOT             --     in all of STOCKTP (counted without the SLCONLAI > 0 filter).             ------------------------------------------------------------             SELECT                 RTRIM(LOT) AS PhysicalLot,                 LEFT(RTRIM(LOT), 13) AS LotKey,                 SUM(ISNULL(SLCONLAI, 0)) AS SLCONLAI             INTO #StockByLot             FROM STOCKTP             WHERE ISNULL(SLCONLAI, 0) > 0             GROUP BY RTRIM(LOT), LEFT(RTRIM(LOT), 13);
