             DROP TABLE #StockByLot;             DROP TABLE #LotKeyCount;                DROP TABLE #GomNhomCheck;           END;              ----------------------------------------------------------------           -- 8. NẾU CÓ LỖI → KHÔNG UPDATE STOCK           ----------------------------------------------------------------           IF EXISTS           (               SELECT 1               FROM #STNG           )           BEGIN               SELECT                   STT,                   LOT,                   SOLUONG,                   STATUS               FROM #STOK;                  SELECT                   MH,                   LOT,                   SLCAN AS SLC,                   SLCO AS SLTK,                   SLTHIEU AS SLT,                   STATUS               FROM #STNG;                -- Roll back this procedure's work before returning business errors.             -- A doomed caller transaction must be rolled back by its owner.             IF @StartedTransaction = 1                 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;             ELSE IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @SavepointCreated = 1                 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION UspQrcodeUpdateStock2405;             ELSE IF XACT_STATE() = -1                 THROW 51034, N'Giao dịch bên ngoài đã ở trạng thái không thể commit; bên gọi phải ROLLBACK transaction.', 1;              RETURN;           END;              ----------------------------------------------------------------           -- 9. KHÔNG CÓ DỮ LIỆU UPDATE           ----------------------------------------------------------------           IF NOT EXISTS           (               SELECT 1               FROM #TMPUPDATE               WHERE STT NOT IN               (                   SELECT DISTINCT STT                   FROM #STNG               )           )           BEGIN               SELECT                   STT,                   LOT,                   SOLUONG,                   STATUS               FROM #STOK;                  SELECT                   MH,                   LOT,                   SLCAN AS SLC,                   SLCO AS SLTK,                   SLTHIEU AS SLT,                   STATUS               FROM #STNG;                -- No stock rows are eligible: release this invocation's savepoint             -- and transaction-owned application locks before returning.             IF @StartedTransaction = 1                 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;             ELSE IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @SavepointCreated = 1                 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION UspQrcodeUpdateStock2405;             ELSE IF XACT_STATE() = -1                 THROW 51034, N'Giao dịch bên ngoài đã ở trạng thái không thể commit; bên gọi phải ROLLBACK transaction.', 1;              RETURN;           END;              ----------------------------------------------------------------           -- 10. TRANSACTION           ----------------------------------------------------------------           -- The transaction/savepoint was established before the duplicate check;         -- all stock writes below remain inside that same transaction scope.            DECLARE UPDATETMP CURSOR LOCAL FAST_FORWARD FOR               SELECT                   STT,                   LOT,                   SOLUONG,                   STATUS               FROM #TMPUPDATE               WHERE STT NOT IN               (                   SELECT DISTINCT STT                   FROM #STNG               );              OPEN UPDATETMP;              FETCH NEXT FROM UPDATETMP           INTO @_STTUD, @_LOTUD, @_SLUD, @_STUP;              WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0           BEGIN                  SET @LotThuc = NULL;                  ----------------------------------------------------------------               -- 10.1. TÌM LOT VẬT LÝ THẬT               --               -- Input:               --     @_LOTUD = 2609100101410               --               -- STOCKTP:               --     26091001014100861700               --               -- Match:               --     LEFT(LOT,13) = LEFT(@_LOTUD,13)               --               -- Sau khi tìm được mới UPDATE WHERE LOT = @LotThuc.               ----------------------------------------------------------------               IF LEN(RTRIM(@_LOTUD)) > 13             BEGIN                 -- Lock the exact physical LOT while choosing it. Different delivery                 -- identities can still compete for this same stock row.                 SELECT @LotThuc = LOT                 FROM STOCKTP WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK, ROWLOCK)                 WHERE RTRIM(LOT) = RTRIM(@_LOTUD)                   AND ISNULL(SLCONLAI, 0) >= @_SLUD;             END             ELSE IF (                 SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT RTRIM(LOT))                 FROM STOCKTP WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)                 WHERE LEFT(RTRIM(LOT), 13) = LEFT(RTRIM(@_LOTUD), 13)             ) = 1             BEGIN                 SELECT TOP (1) @LotThuc = LOT                 FROM STOCKTP WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK, ROWLOCK)                 WHERE LEFT(RTRIM(LOT), 13) = LEFT(RTRIM(@_LOTUD), 13)                   AND ISNULL(SLCONLAI, 0) >= @_SLUD                 ORDER BY NGAYNHAP ASC, LOT ASC;             END                  ----------------------------------------------------------------               -- 10.2. Không tìm được LOT vật lý               ----------------------------------------------------------------               IF @LotThuc IS NULL               BEGIN                   INSERT INTO #STNG                   (                       MH,                       LOT,                       SLCAN,                       SLCO,                       SLTHIEU,                       STATUS                   )                   VALUES                   (                       @MH,                       @_LOTUD,                       @_SLUD,                       0,                       @_SLUD,                       N'Không xác định được LOT tồn kho hợp lệ khi trừ kho'                   );               END               ELSE               BEGIN                      ----------------------------------------------------------------                   -- 10.3. UPDATE ĐÚNG LOT VẬT LÝ                   ----------------------------------------------------------------                   UPDATE STOCKTP                 SET                     SLCONLAI = ISNULL(SLCONLAI, 0) - @_SLUD,                     SLXUAT = ISNULL(SLXUAT, 0) + @_SLUD,                     NGAYXUAT = CASE                         WHEN @LOTRESOLUTIONMODE = N'FIFO_SP' THEN GETDATE()                         ELSE NGAYXUAT                     END                 WHERE LOT = @LotThuc                   AND ISNULL(SLCONLAI, 0) >= @_SLUD;                  SET @StockRowsUpdated = @@ROWCOUNT;                  IF @StockRowsUpdated <> 1                 BEGIN                     INSERT INTO #STNG (MH, LOT, SLCAN, SLCO, SLTHIEU, STATUS)                     VALUES                     (                         @MH,                         @_LOTUD,                         @_SLUD,                         ISNULL((SELECT SLCONLAI FROM STOCKTP WHERE LOT = @LotThuc), 0),                         @_SLUD - ISNULL((SELECT SLCONLAI FROM STOCKTP WHERE LOT = @LotThuc), 0),                         N'Tồn kho LOT đã thay đổi trong lúc xác nhận giao; vui lòng thử lại'                     );                 END                 ELSE                 BEGIN                     ----------------------------------------------------------------                     -- 10.4. LƯU LOT VẬT LÝ THẬT CHỈ KHI ĐÃ TRỪ ĐÚNG MỘT DÒNG                     ----------------------------------------------------------------                     IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #STOK WHERE STT = @_STTUD)                     BEGIN                         INSERT INTO #STOK (STT, LOT, SOLUONG, STATUS)                         VALUES (@_STTUD, @LotThuc, @_SLUD, 'OK');                     END;                 END;               END;                  FETCH NEXT FROM UPDATETMP               INTO @_STTUD, @_LOTUD, @_SLUD, @_STUP;           END;              CLOSE UPDATETMP;           DEALLOCATE UPDATETMP;              ----------------------------------------------------------------           -- 11. KIỂM TRA LỖI PHÁT SINH TRONG TRANSACTION           ----------------------------------------------------------------           IF EXISTS         (             SELECT 1             FROM #STNG         )         BEGIN             -- Preserve business diagnostics across rollback. The temp-table writes             -- are transactional, but the table variable snapshot survives rollback.             DECLARE @ErrorSnapshot TABLE             (                 MH NVARCHAR(100),                 LOT NVARCHAR(MAX),                 SLCAN INT,                 SLCO INT,                 SLTHIEU INT,                 STATUS NVARCHAR(500)             );              INSERT INTO @ErrorSnapshot(MH, LOT, SLCAN, SLCO, SLTHIEU, STATUS)             SELECT MH, LOT, SLCAN, SLCO, SLTHIEU, STATUS             FROM #STNG;              IF @StartedTransaction = 1                 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;             ELSE                 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION UspQrcodeUpdateStock2405;              INSERT INTO #STNG(MH, LOT, SLCAN, SLCO, SLTHIEU, STATUS)             SELECT MH, LOT, SLCAN, SLCO, SLTHIEU, STATUS             FROM @ErrorSnapshot;                SELECT                   STT,                   LOT,                   SOLUONG,                   STATUS               FROM #STOK;                  SELECT                   MH,                   LOT,                   SLCAN AS SLC,                   SLCO AS SLTK,                   SLTHIEU AS SLT,                   STATUS               FROM #STNG;                  RETURN;           END;              ----------------------------------------------------------------           -- 12. LƯU LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG           ----------------------------------------------------------------           IF EXISTS           (               SELECT 1               FROM #STOK               WHERE STATUS = 'OK'           )           BEGIN                  -- PO_NO / PO_ITEM: chi sao chep khi bang TMP cua khach hang co cot nay             -- (HVN MP/SP, 100003). Tranh mat PO trong ledger ma khong vo bang khong co cot.             DECLARE @LuuPoCols NVARCHAR(100) = N'', @LuuPoSel NVARCHAR(200) = N'';             IF COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.' + @TMPTABLE, N'PO_NO') IS NOT NULL                 SELECT @LuuPoCols += N', PO_NO', @LuuPoSel += N', LEFT(tmp.PO_NO, 50)';             IF COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.' + @TMPTABLE, N'PO_ITEM') IS NOT NULL                 SELECT @LuuPoCols += N', PO_ITEM', @LuuPoSel += N', LEFT(tmp.PO_ITEM, 50)';              SET @sql = N'                   INSERT INTO LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG                   (                       STT,                       CUA,                       TRUYEN,                       MAHANG,                       TENHANG,                       LOT,                       DV,                       SOLUONG,                       NGAYGIAO,                       GIOGIAO,                       STATUS,                       TTPHIEU,                       NHAMAY,                       GIOGIAOFCC,                       HOP,                       STATUSDOC,                       Note' + @LuuPoCols + N'                   )                   SELECT                       tmp.STT,                       LEFT(tmp.CUA, 50),                       LEFT(tmp.TRUYEN, 50),                       LEFT(tmp.MAHANG, 50),                       LEFT(tmp.TENHANG, 60),                       LEFT(tmp.LOT, 500),                       LEFT(tmp.DV, 50),                       tmp.SOLUONG,                       tmp.NGAYGIAO,                       LEFT(tmp.GIOGIAO, 50),                       ''OK'',                       LEFT(tmp.TTPHIEU, 50),                       LEFT(@NHAMAY, 60),                       LEFT(@GIOGIAOFCC, 50),                       LEFT(tmp.HOP, 50),                       LEFT(tmp.STATUSDOC, 50),                       LEFT(tmp.Note, 250)' + @LuuPoSel + N'                   FROM [' + @TMPTABLE + N'] tmp                   WHERE tmp.STT IN                   (                       SELECT STT                       FROM #STOK                       WHERE STATUS = ''OK''                   );               ';                  EXEC sp_executesql                   @sql,                   N'@NHAMAY NVARCHAR(250),                     @GIOGIAOFCC NVARCHAR(250)',                   @NHAMAY,                   @GIOGIAOFCC;                  ----------------------------------------------------------------               -- 13. LƯU LUUDOCQRCODE               ----------------------------------------------------------------               SET @sql = N'                   INSERT INTO LUUDOCQRCODE                   (                       LOTFCC,                       MAHANGFCC,                       SLTEMFCC,                       LOTHVN,                       MAHANGHVN,                       SLTEMHVN,                       STATUS,                       MAFCC,                       STT,                       KETQUA,                       NGAYXUAT,                       GIOXUAT,                       NHAMAY                   )                   SELECT                       LEFT(DQ.LOTFCC, 500),                       LEFT(DQ.MAHANGFCC, 60),                      DQ.SLTEMFCC,                       LEFT(DQ.LOTHVN, 500),                       LEFT(DQ.MAHANGHVN, 60),                       DQ.SLTEMHVN,                       DQ.STATUS,                       LEFT(DQ.MAFCC, 50),                       DQ.STT,                       LEFT(DQ.KETQUA, 30),                       PG.NGAYGIAO,                       LEFT(@GIOGIAOFCC, 30),                       LEFT(@NHAMAY, 60)                   FROM [' + @DOCQRTABLE + N'] DQ                   INNER JOIN [' + @TMPTABLE + N'] PG                       ON PG.STT =                          TRY_CAST(DQ.GIO AS INT)                   WHERE PG.STT IN                   (                       SELECT STT                       FROM #STOK                       WHERE STATUS = ''OK''                   )                     AND ISNULL(DQ.GIO, '''') <> '''';                      INSERT INTO LUUDOCQRCODE                   (                       LOTFCC,                       MAHANGFCC,                       SLTEMFCC,                       LOTHVN,                       MAHANGHVN,                       SLTEMHVN,                       STATUS,                       MAFCC,                       STT,                       KETQUA,                       NGAYXUAT,                       GIOXUAT,                       NHAMAY                   )                   SELECT                       LEFT(DQ.LOTFCC, 500),                       LEFT(DQ.MAHANGFCC, 60),                       DQ.SLTEMFCC,                       LEFT(DQ.LOTHVN, 500),                       LEFT(DQ.MAHANGHVN, 60),                       DQ.SLTEMHVN,                       DQ.STATUS,                       LEFT(DQ.MAFCC, 50),                       DQ.STT,                       LEFT(DQ.KETQUA, 30),                       PG.NGAYGIAO,                       LEFT(@GIOGIAOFCC, 30),                       LEFT(@NHAMAY, 60)                   FROM [' + @DOCQRTABLE + N'] DQ                   INNER JOIN [' + @TMPTABLE + N'] PG                       ON RTRIM(DQ.MAHANGFCC) =                          RTRIM(PG.MAHANG)                   WHERE PG.STT IN                   (                       SELECT STT                       FROM #STOK                       WHERE STATUS = ''OK''                   )                     AND ISNULL(DQ.GIO, '''') = '''';               ';                  EXEC sp_executesql                   @sql,                   N'                     @GIOGIAOFCC NVARCHAR(250),                     @NHAMAY NVARCHAR(250)',                   @GIOGIAOFCC,                   @NHAMAY;                  ----------------------------------------------------------------               -- 14. UPDATE TMP STATUS               ----------------------------------------------------------------               SET @sql = N'                   UPDATE [' + @TMPTABLE + N']                   SET STATUS = ''OK''                   WHERE STT IN                   (                       SELECT STT                       FROM #STOK                       WHERE STATUS = ''OK''                   );               ';                  EXEC sp_executesql @sql;                  ----------------------------------------------------------------               -- 15. DELETE DOCQRCODE ĐÃ XỬ LÝ               ----------------------------------------------------------------               SET @sql = N'                   DELETE DQ                   FROM [' + @DOCQRTABLE + N'] DQ                   INNER JOIN [' + @TMPTABLE + N'] PG                       ON PG.STT =                          TRY_CAST(DQ.GIO AS INT)                   WHERE PG.STT IN                   (                       SELECT STT                       FROM #STOK                       WHERE STATUS = ''OK''                   )                     AND ISNULL(DQ.GIO, '''') <> '''';                      DELETE DQ                   FROM [' + @DOCQRTABLE + N'] DQ                   INNER JOIN [' + @TMPTABLE + N'] PG                       ON RTRIM(DQ.MAHANGFCC) =                          RTRIM(PG.MAHANG)                   WHERE PG.STT IN                   (                       SELECT STT                       FROM #STOK                       WHERE STATUS = ''OK''                   )                     AND ISNULL(DQ.GIO, '''') = '''';               ';                  EXEC sp_executesql @sql;                  ----------------------------------------------------------------             -- 16. ORDER TABLE DELIVERY STATE             ----------------------------------------------------------------             -- Deliberately do not update Purchase_Order_HTN/YMVN here.             -- The application finalizes each successful TMP row inside the             -- same UnitOfWork by building OrderLineKey from PO_NO + MAHANG             -- + NGAYGIAO/GIOGIAO and calling OrderTableSql.MarkDelivered.             -- Keeping this update in one place avoids a second, weaker key             -- interpretation in SQL (especially legacy hour-only GIOGIAO).               END;              ----------------------------------------------------------------           -- 18. COMMIT           ----------------------------------------------------------------           -- Only commit a transaction opened by this procedure. If a caller owns         -- the transaction, leave final commit/rollback to the caller.         IF @StartedTransaction = 1             COMMIT TRANSACTION;        END TRY       BEGIN CATCH              IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0         BEGIN             IF @StartedTransaction = 1                 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;             ELSE IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @SavepointCreated = 1                 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION UspQrcodeUpdateStock2405;             ELSE IF XACT_STATE() = -1                 THROW; -- the caller must roll back the doomed outer transaction         END;              IF CURSOR_STATUS('local', 'LOT_IN_PGH') >= 0           BEGIN               CLOSE LOT_IN_PGH;               DEALLOCATE LOT_IN_PGH;           END;              IF CURSOR_STATUS('local', 'PGH') >= 0           BEGIN               CLOSE PGH;               DEALLOCATE PGH;           END;              IF CURSOR_STATUS('local', 'UPDATETMP') >= 0           BEGIN               CLOSE UPDATETMP;               DEALLOCATE UPDATETMP;           END;              IF @ErrMH IS NOT NULL         BEGIN             SELECT @ErrTon = SUM(ISNULL(s.SLCONLAI, 0))             FROM STOCKTP s             WHERE COALESCE(                     NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(s.SP)), N''),                     NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(s.PART)), N'')                   ) = LTRIM(RTRIM(@ErrMH))               AND ISNULL(s.SLCONLAI, 0) > 0;         END;          INSERT INTO #STNG         (             MH,             LOT,             SLCAN,             SLCO,             SLTHIEU,             STATUS         )         VALUES         (             ISNULL(@ErrMH, N'SYSTEM ERROR'),             CASE WHEN @ErrMH IS NOT NULL                  THEN N'(chưa chọn được LOT)'                  ELSE N'Line ' + CAST(ERROR_LINE() AS NVARCHAR(10)) END,             ISNULL(@ErrQty, 0),             ISNULL(@ErrTon, 0),             CASE WHEN @ErrMH IS NOT NULL AND ISNULL(@ErrQty, 0) > ISNULL(@ErrTon, 0)                  THEN @ErrQty - ISNULL(@ErrTon, 0) ELSE 0 END,             LEFT             (                 N'Lỗi dòng ' +                 CAST(ERROR_LINE() AS NVARCHAR(10)) +                 N': ' +                 ERROR_MESSAGE(),                 500             )         );      END CATCH;          --------------------------------------------------------------------       -- 19. TRẢ KẾT QUẢ       --------------------------------------------------------------------       SELECT           STT,           LOT,           SOLUONG,           STATUS       FROM #STOK;          SELECT           MH,           LOT,           SLCAN AS SLC,           SLCO AS SLTK,           SLTHIEU AS SLT,           STATUS       FROM #STNG;      END;

CREATE PROC [dbo].[Usp_Qrcode_Update_Stock2405]       @GIOGIAOFCC  NVARCHAR(250) = N'',       @NHAMAY      NVARCHAR(250) = N'',       @TMPTABLE    NVARCHAR(128) = N'TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG',       @DOCQRTABLE  NVARCHAR(128) = N'DOCQRCODE'   AS   BEGIN       SET NOCOUNT ON;          /*           ================================================================           QUY ƯỚC LOT           ================================================================              STOCKTP.LOT đầy đủ là định danh chính xác của LOT vật lý.          - Nếu đầu vào dài hơn 13 ký tự: chỉ khớp RTRIM(STOCKTP.LOT) = RTRIM(@LOT).         - Nếu đầu vào chỉ có mã gốc 13 ký tự: chỉ chấp nhận khi mã gốc ánh xạ tới           đúng một LOT vật lý; nếu có nhiều LOT vật lý thì ghi lỗi và dừng trước           mọi cập nhật tồn.         - Tuyệt đối không cộng tồn của nhiều LOT vật lý theo tiền tố rồi trừ một           LOT bất kỳ. Kiểm tra khả dụng và bước trừ kho phải dùng cùng quy tắc.     */          --------------------------------------------------------------------       -- 1. WHITELIST TÊN BẢNG       --------------------------------------------------------------------       IF @TMPTABLE NOT IN       (           N'TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG',           N'TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG_SP',           N'TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG_100003'       )       BEGIN           RAISERROR(               N'Tên bảng TMPTABLE không hợp lệ: %s',               16,               1,               @TMPTABLE           );           RETURN;       END;          IF @DOCQRTABLE NOT IN       (           N'DOCQRCODE',           N'DOCQRCODE_SP',           N'DOCQRCODE_100003'       )       BEGIN           RAISERROR(               N'Tên bảng DOCQRTABLE không hợp lệ: %s',               16,               1,               @DOCQRTABLE           );           RETURN;       END;          --------------------------------------------------------------------       -- 2. KHAI BÁO BIẾN       --------------------------------------------------------------------       DECLARE @sql NVARCHAR(MAX);     DECLARE @StartedTransaction BIT = 0;     DECLARE @SavepointCreated BIT = 0;          DECLARE           @_LOT          NVARCHAR(MAX),           @_SLCONLAI     INT,           @STT           INT,           @MH            NVARCHAR(60),           @_LOTSL_Tach   NVARCHAR(500),           @_LOTOK        NVARCHAR(500),           @_SLOK         INT,           @_KTPC         INT,           @_LOTUD        NVARCHAR(500),           @_SLUD         INT,           @_STTUD        INT,           @_STUP         NVARCHAR(15),           @LotThuc       NVARCHAR(500),         @LockResource  NVARCHAR(255),         @LockResult    INT,         @StockRowsUpdated INT;          --------------------------------------------------------------------       -- 3. XÓA TEMP TABLE CŨ       --------------------------------------------------------------------       IF OBJECT_ID('TempDb..#TMPUPDATE') IS NOT NULL           DROP TABLE #TMPUPDATE;          IF OBJECT_ID('TempDb..#STOK') IS NOT NULL           DROP TABLE #STOK;          IF OBJECT_ID('TempDb..#STNG') IS NOT NULL           DROP TABLE #STNG;          IF OBJECT_ID('TempDb..#PHIEU') IS NOT NULL           DROP TABLE #PHIEU;          IF OBJECT_ID('TempDb..#GomNhomCheck') IS NOT NULL           DROP TABLE #GomNhomCheck;          IF OBJECT_ID('TempDb..#SplitResult') IS NOT NULL           DROP TABLE #SplitResult;        IF OBJECT_ID('TempDb..#StockByLot') IS NOT NULL         DROP TABLE #StockByLot;      IF OBJECT_ID('TempDb..#LotKeyCount') IS NOT NULL         DROP TABLE #LotKeyCount;        --------------------------------------------------------------------       -- 4. TEMP TABLE       --------------------------------------------------------------------       CREATE TABLE #TMPUPDATE       (           STT     INT,           MH      NVARCHAR(60),           LOT     NVARCHAR(MAX),           SOLUONG INT,           STATUS  NVARCHAR(50)       );          CREATE TABLE #STOK       (           STT     INT,           LOT     NVARCHAR(MAX),           SOLUONG INT,           STATUS  NVARCHAR(50)       );          CREATE TABLE #STNG       (           MH       NVARCHAR(100),           LOT      NVARCHAR(MAX),           SLCAN    INT,           SLCO     INT,           SLTHIEU  INT,           STATUS   NVARCHAR(500)       );          CREATE TABLE #PHIEU       (           STT INT,           LOT NVARCHAR(MAX),           MH  NVARCHAR(60)       );          BEGIN TRY          -- Own a transaction when called directly; otherwise participate in the         -- repository UnitOfWork through a savepoint. Start before the idempotency         -- check so concurrent confirmations serialize before reading/writing stock.         IF @@TRANCOUNT = 0         BEGIN             BEGIN TRANSACTION;             SET @StartedTransaction = 1;         END         ELSE         BEGIN             SAVE TRANSACTION UspQrcodeUpdateStock2405;             SET @SavepointCreated = 1;         END;            ----------------------------------------------------------------           -- 5. NẠP PHIẾU           ----------------------------------------------------------------           SET @sql = N'               INSERT INTO #PHIEU               (                   STT,                   LOT,                   MH               )               SELECT                   STT,                   LOT,                   MAHANG               FROM [' + @TMPTABLE + N']               WHERE ISNULL(LOT, '''') <> ''''                 AND (STATUS <> ''OK'' OR STATUS IS NULL);           ';              EXEC sp_executesql @sql;              ----------------------------------------------------------------           -- Không có phiếu           ----------------------------------------------------------------           IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #PHIEU)           BEGIN             IF @StartedTransaction = 1                 COMMIT TRANSACTION;                SELECT                   STT,                   LOT,                   SOLUONG,                   STATUS               FROM #STOK;                  SELECT                   MH,                   LOT,                   SLCAN AS SLC,                   SLCO AS SLTK,                   SLTHIEU AS SLT,                   STATUS               FROM #STNG;                RETURN;           END;              ----------------------------------------------------------------           -- 6. DUYỆT PHIẾU           ----------------------------------------------------------------           DECLARE PGH CURSOR LOCAL FAST_FORWARD FOR               SELECT                   STT,                   LOT,                   MH               FROM #PHIEU;              OPEN PGH;              FETCH NEXT FROM PGH           INTO @STT, @_LOT, @MH;              WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0           BEGIN               DECLARE @DaTon BIT = 0;                  DECLARE @CheckResult TABLE               (                   Found INT               );                  ------------------------------------------------------------             -- 6.1. Serialize the complete delivery identity before checking for             -- an existing confirmation. The lock is transaction-owned and therefore             -- remains held through STOCKTP, ledger, and pending-delivery writes.             ------------------------------------------------------------             SET @LockResource = NULL;             SET @sql = N'                 SELECT @Resource =                     N''PCTP_DELIVERY:'' +                     CONVERT(NVARCHAR(64), HASHBYTES(''SHA2_256'', CONCAT(                         UPPER(RTRIM(ISNULL(MAHANG, N''''))), N''|'',                         ISNULL(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), CAST(NGAYGIAO AS DATE), 23), N''''), N''|'',                         UPPER(RTRIM(ISNULL(CUA, N''''))), N''|'',                         UPPER(RTRIM(ISNULL(TRUYEN, N''''))), N''|'',                         ISNULL(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20), SOLUONG), N''''), N''|'',                         UPPER(RTRIM(ISNULL(GIOGIAO, N''''))), N''|'',                         UPPER(RTRIM(LEFT(ISNULL(@NHAMAY, N''''), 50)))                     )), 2)                 FROM [' + @TMPTABLE + N']                 WHERE STT = @STT;';              EXEC sp_executesql                 @sql,                 N'@STT INT, @NHAMAY NVARCHAR(250), @Resource NVARCHAR(255) OUTPUT',                 @STT = @STT,                 @NHAMAY = @NHAMAY,                 @Resource = @LockResource OUTPUT;              IF @LockResource IS NULL                 RAISERROR(N'Không tạo được khóa chống xác nhận giao hàng trùng.', 16, 1);              EXEC @LockResult = sys.sp_getapplock                 @Resource = @LockResource,                 @LockMode = N'Exclusive',                 @LockOwner = N'Transaction',                 @LockTimeout = 10000;              IF @LockResult < 0                 RAISERROR(N'Không lấy được khóa xác nhận giao hàng; vui lòng thử lại.', 16, 1);              ------------------------------------------------------------             -- 6.1. CREATE PROC [dbo].[Usp_Qrcode_Update_Stock2405]       @GIOGIAOFCC  NVARCHAR(250) = N'',       @NHAMAY      NVARCHAR(250) = N'',       @TMPTABLE    NVARCHAR(128) = N'TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG',       @DOCQRTABLE  NVARCHAR(128) = N'DOCQRCODE',     @LOTRESOLUTIONMODE NVARCHAR(20) = N'INPUT'   AS   BEGIN       SET NOCOUNT ON;          /*           ================================================================           QUY ƯỚC LOT           ================================================================              STOCKTP.LOT đầy đủ là định danh chính xác của LOT vật lý.          - Nếu đầu vào dài hơn 13 ký tự: chỉ khớp RTRIM(STOCKTP.LOT) = RTRIM(@LOT).         - Nếu đầu vào chỉ có mã gốc 13 ký tự: chỉ chấp nhận khi mã gốc ánh xạ tới           đúng một LOT vật lý; nếu có nhiều LOT vật lý thì ghi lỗi và dừng trước           mọi cập nhật tồn.         - Tuyệt đối không cộng tồn của nhiều LOT vật lý theo tiền tố rồi trừ một           LOT bất kỳ. Kiểm tra khả dụng và bước trừ kho phải dùng cùng quy tắc.     */          --------------------------------------------------------------------       -- 1. WHITELIST TÊN BẢNG       --------------------------------------------------------------------       IF @TMPTABLE NOT IN       (           N'TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG',           N'TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG_SP',         N'SP_TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG',         N'TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG_100002',         N'TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG_100003'       )       BEGIN           RAISERROR(               N'Tên bảng TMPTABLE không hợp lệ: %s',               16,               1,               @TMPTABLE           );           RETURN;       END;          IF @DOCQRTABLE NOT IN       (           N'DOCQRCODE',           N'DOCQRCODE_SP',         N'SP_DOCQRCODE',         N'YMVN_DOCQRCODE',         N'DOCQRCODE_100002',         N'DOCQRCODE_100003'       )       BEGIN           RAISERROR(               N'Tên bảng DOCQRTABLE không hợp lệ: %s',               16,               1,               @DOCQRTABLE           );           RETURN;       END;          IF @LOTRESOLUTIONMODE NOT IN (N'INPUT', N'FIFO_SP')     BEGIN         RAISERROR(N'LOTRESOLUTIONMODE không hợp lệ: %s', 16, 1, @LOTRESOLUTIONMODE);         RETURN;     END;      --------------------------------------------------------------------       -- 2. KHAI BÁO BIẾN       --------------------------------------------------------------------       DECLARE @sql NVARCHAR(MAX);     DECLARE @StartedTransaction BIT = 0;     DECLARE @SavepointCreated BIT = 0;          DECLARE           @_LOT          NVARCHAR(MAX),           @_SLCONLAI     INT,           @STT           INT,           @MH            NVARCHAR(60),           @_LOTSL_Tach   NVARCHAR(500),           @_LOTOK        NVARCHAR(500),           @_SLOK         INT,           @_KTPC         INT,           @_LOTUD        NVARCHAR(500),           @_SLUD         INT,           @_STTUD        INT,           @_STUP         NVARCHAR(15),           @LotThuc       NVARCHAR(500),         @LockResource  NVARCHAR(255),         @LockResult    INT,         @StockRowsUpdated INT;          --------------------------------------------------------------------       -- 3. XÓA TEMP TABLE CŨ       --------------------------------------------------------------------       IF OBJECT_ID('TempDb..#TMPUPDATE') IS NOT NULL           DROP TABLE #TMPUPDATE;          IF OBJECT_ID('TempDb..#STOK') IS NOT NULL           DROP TABLE #STOK;          IF OBJECT_ID('TempDb..#STNG') IS NOT NULL           DROP TABLE #STNG;          IF OBJECT_ID('TempDb..#PHIEU') IS NOT NULL           DROP TABLE #PHIEU;          IF OBJECT_ID('TempDb..#GomNhomCheck') IS NOT NULL           DROP TABLE #GomNhomCheck;          IF OBJECT_ID('TempDb..#SplitResult') IS NOT NULL           DROP TABLE #SplitResult;        IF OBJECT_ID('TempDb..#StockByLot') IS NOT NULL         DROP TABLE #StockByLot;      IF OBJECT_ID('TempDb..#LotKeyCount') IS NOT NULL         DROP TABLE #LotKeyCount;        --------------------------------------------------------------------       -- 4. TEMP TABLE       --------------------------------------------------------------------       CREATE TABLE #TMPUPDATE       (           STT     INT,           MH      NVARCHAR(60),           LOT     NVARCHAR(MAX),           SOLUONG INT,           STATUS  NVARCHAR(50)       );          CREATE TABLE #STOK       (           STT     INT,           LOT     NVARCHAR(MAX),           SOLUONG INT,           STATUS  NVARCHAR(50)       );          CREATE TABLE #STNG       (           MH       NVARCHAR(100),           LOT      NVARCHAR(MAX),           SLCAN    INT,           SLCO     INT,           SLTHIEU  INT,           STATUS   NVARCHAR(500)       );          CREATE TABLE #PHIEU       (           STT INT,           LOT NVARCHAR(MAX),           MH  NVARCHAR(60)       );          BEGIN TRY          -- Own a transaction when called directly; otherwise participate in the         -- repository UnitOfWork through a savepoint. Start before the idempotency         -- check so concurrent confirmations serialize before reading/writing stock.         IF @@TRANCOUNT = 0         BEGIN             BEGIN TRANSACTION;             SET @StartedTransaction = 1;         END         ELSE         BEGIN             SAVE TRANSACTION UspQrcodeUpdateStock2405;             SET @SavepointCreated = 1;         END;            ----------------------------------------------------------------           -- 5. NẠP PHIẾU           ----------------------------------------------------------------           SET @sql = N'               INSERT INTO #PHIEU               (                   STT,                   LOT,                   MH               )               SELECT                   STT,                   LOT,                   MAHANG               FROM [' + @TMPTABLE + N']               WHERE (ISNULL(LOT, '''') <> '''' OR @LOTRESOLUTIONMODE = N''FIFO_SP'')               AND (STATUS <> ''OK'' OR STATUS IS NULL);           ';              EXEC sp_executesql @sql,             N'@LOTRESOLUTIONMODE NVARCHAR(20)',             @LOTRESOLUTIONMODE = @LOTRESOLUTIONMODE;              ----------------------------------------------------------------           -- Không có phiếu           ----------------------------------------------------------------           IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #PHIEU)           BEGIN             IF @StartedTransaction = 1                 COMMIT TRANSACTION;                SELECT                   STT,                   LOT,                   SOLUONG,                   STATUS               FROM #STOK;                  SELECT                   MH,                   LOT,                   SLCAN AS SLC,                   SLCO AS SLTK,                   SLTHIEU AS SLT,                   STATUS               FROM #STNG;                RETURN;           END;              ----------------------------------------------------------------           -- 6. DUYỆT PHIẾU           ----------------------------------------------------------------           DECLARE PGH CURSOR LOCAL FAST_FORWARD FOR               SELECT                   STT,                   LOT,                   MH               FROM #PHIEU;              OPEN PGH;              FETCH NEXT FROM PGH           INTO @STT, @_LOT, @MH;              WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0           BEGIN               DECLARE @DaTon BIT = 0;                  DECLARE @CheckResult TABLE               (                   Found INT               );                  ------------------------------------------------------------             -- 6.1. Serialize the complete delivery identity before checking for             -- an existing confirmation. The lock is transaction-owned and therefore             -- remains held through STOCKTP, ledger, and pending-delivery writes.             ------------------------------------------------------------             SET @LockResource = NULL;             SET @sql = N'                 SELECT @Resource =                     N''PCTP_DELIVERY:'' +                     CONVERT(NVARCHAR(64), HASHBYTES(''SHA2_256'', CONCAT(                         UPPER(RTRIM(ISNULL(MAHANG, N''''))), N''|'',                         ISNULL(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), CAST(NGAYGIAO AS DATE), 23), N''''), N''|'',                         UPPER(RTRIM(ISNULL(CUA, N''''))), N''|'',                         UPPER(RTRIM(ISNULL(TRUYEN, N''''))), N''|'',                         ISNULL(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20), SOLUONG), N''''), N''|'',                         UPPER(RTRIM(ISNULL(GIOGIAO, N''''))), N''|'',                         UPPER(RTRIM(LEFT(ISNULL(@NHAMAY, N''''), 50)))                     )), 2)                 FROM [' + @TMPTABLE + N']                 WHERE STT = @STT;';              EXEC sp_executesql                 @sql,                 N'@STT INT, @NHAMAY NVARCHAR(250), @Resource NVARCHAR(255) OUTPUT',                 @STT = @STT,                 @NHAMAY = @NHAMAY,                 @Resource = @LockResource OUTPUT;              IF @LockResource IS NULL                 RAISERROR(N'Không tạo được khóa chống xác nhận giao hàng trùng.', 16, 1);              EXEC @LockResult = sys.sp_getapplock                 @Resource = @LockResource,                 @LockMode = N'Exclusive',                 @LockOwner = N'Transaction',                 @LockTimeout = 10000;              IF @LockResult < 0                 RAISERROR(N'Không lấy được khóa xác nhận giao hàng; vui lòng thử lại.', 16, 1);              ------------------------------------------------------------             -- 6.1. KIỂM TRA PHIẾU ĐÃ LƯU             ------------------------------------------------------------             SET @sql = N'                   SELECT TOP 1 1                   FROM [' + @TMPTABLE + N'] tmp                   INNER JOIN LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG luu                       ON RTRIM(luu.MAHANG) =                          RTRIM(tmp.MAHANG)                         AND CAST(luu.NGAYGIAO AS DATE) =                          CAST(tmp.NGAYGIAO AS DATE)                         AND RTRIM(luu.CUA) =                          RTRIM(tmp.CUA)                         AND RTRIM(luu.TRUYEN) =                          RTRIM(tmp.TRUYEN)                         AND luu.SOLUONG =                          tmp.SOLUONG                         AND RTRIM(luu.GIOGIAO) =                          RTRIM(tmp.GIOGIAO)                         AND RTRIM(luu.NHAMAY) =                          RTRIM(LEFT(@NHAMAY, 50))                      WHERE tmp.STT = @STT;               ';                  INSERT INTO @CheckResult               EXEC sp_executesql                   @sql,                   N'@NHAMAY NVARCHAR(250), @STT INT',                   @NHAMAY,                   @STT;                  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM @CheckResult)                   SET @DaTon = 1;                  DELETE FROM @CheckResult;                  ------------------------------------------------------------               -- 6.2. ĐÃ TỒN TẠI               ------------------------------------------------------------               IF @DaTon = 1               BEGIN                   INSERT INTO #STNG                   (                       MH,                       LOT,                       SLCAN,                       SLCO,                       SLTHIEU,                       STATUS                   )                   VALUES                   (                       @MH,                       @_LOT,                  0,                       0,                       0,                       N'Mã hàng này đã được lưu trước đó!'                   );               END               ELSE               BEGIN                      --------------------------------------------------------                    --------------------------------------------------------                 -- 6.2a. FIFO_SP: chọn một LOT vật lý đủ tồn trong cùng transaction.                 --------------------------------------------------------                 IF @LOTRESOLUTIONMODE = N'FIFO_SP'                 BEGIN                     DECLARE @FifoLot NVARCHAR(500) = NULL;                     DECLARE @FifoQty INT = NULL;                      SET @sql = N'                         SELECT @Qty = TRY_CONVERT(INT, SOLUONG)                         FROM [' + @TMPTABLE + N'] WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)                         WHERE STT = @STT                           AND (STATUS <> ''OK'' OR STATUS IS NULL);                          SELECT TOP (1) @Lot = s.LOT                         FROM STOCKTP s WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK, ROWLOCK)                         WHERE COALESCE(                               NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(s.SP)), N''''),                               NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(s.PART)), N'''')                           ) = LTRIM(RTRIM(@MaHang))                           AND ISNULL(s.SLCONLAI, 0) >= @Qty                           AND LEN(ISNULL(s.LOT, N'''')) >= 7                           AND TRY_CONVERT(DATE, LEFT(s.LOT, 6), 12) IS NOT NULL                           AND SUBSTRING(s.LOT, 7, 1) IN (N''0'', N''1'', N''2'', N''3'')                         ORDER BY LEFT(s.LOT, 6) ASC,                             CASE SUBSTRING(s.LOT, 7, 1)                                 WHEN N''0'' THEN 0 WHEN N''1'' THEN 1                                 WHEN N''2'' THEN 2 WHEN N''3'' THEN 3                             END ASC, s.LOT ASC;';                      EXEC sp_executesql @sql,                         N'@STT INT, @MaHang NVARCHAR(60), @Qty INT OUTPUT, @Lot NVARCHAR(500) OUTPUT',                         @STT=@STT, @MaHang=@MH,                         @Qty=@FifoQty OUTPUT, @Lot=@FifoLot OUTPUT;                      IF @FifoQty IS NULL OR @FifoQty <= 0                         THROW 51035, N'Số lượng giao SP phải lớn hơn 0.', 1;                     IF @FifoLot IS NULL                         THROW 51036, N'Không tìm được một LOT FIFO đủ tồn cho mã hàng SP.', 1;                      SET @_LOT = @FifoLot + N'-' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20), @FifoQty);                     DECLARE @FifoTmpRows INT = 0;                     SET @sql = N'UPDATE [' + @TMPTABLE + N'] SET LOT=@Lot                                  WHERE STT=@STT AND (STATUS <> ''OK'' OR STATUS IS NULL);                                  SET @Rows = @@ROWCOUNT;';                     EXEC sp_executesql @sql,                         N'@STT INT, @Lot NVARCHAR(500), @Rows INT OUTPUT',                         @STT=@STT, @Lot=@FifoLot, @Rows=@FifoTmpRows OUTPUT;                     IF @FifoTmpRows <> 1                         THROW 51037, N'Phiếu TMP đã thay đổi; không thể gán LOT FIFO.', 1;                 END;                  -- 6.3. TÁCH LOT-SL                   --------------------------------------------------------                   IF OBJECT_ID('TempDb..#SplitResult') IS NOT NULL                       DROP TABLE #SplitResult;                      CREATE TABLE #SplitResult                   (                       LotTach NVARCHAR(500)                   );                      INSERT INTO #SplitResult                   SELECT *                   FROM dbo.Split(@_LOT, ',');                      DECLARE LOT_IN_PGH CURSOR LOCAL FAST_FORWARD FOR                       SELECT LotTach                       FROM #SplitResult;                      OPEN LOT_IN_PGH;                      FETCH NEXT FROM LOT_IN_PGH                   INTO @_LOTSL_Tach;                      WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0                   BEGIN                       ----------------------------------------------------                       -- 6.4. TÁCH LOT-SL                       ----------------------------------------------------                       SET @_KTPC =                           CHARINDEX('-', @_LOTSL_Tach);                          IF @_KTPC > 1                       BEGIN                           SET @_LOTOK =                               SUBSTRING(                                   @_LOTSL_Tach,                                   1,                                   @_KTPC - 1                               );                              SET @_SLOK =                               TRY_CAST(                                   RIGHT(                                       @_LOTSL_Tach,                                       LEN(@_LOTSL_Tach) - @_KTPC                                   )                                   AS INT                               );                              ------------------------------------------------                           -- SL không hợp lệ                           ------------------------------------------------                           IF @_SLOK IS NULL                           BEGIN                               INSERT INTO #STNG                               (                                   MH,                                   LOT,                                   SLCAN,                                   SLCO,                                   SLTHIEU,                                   STATUS                               )                               VALUES                               (                                   @MH,                                   @_LOTSL_Tach,                                   0,                                   0,                                   0,                                   N'Số lượng trong chuỗi LOT-SL không hợp lệ'                               );                           END                           ELSE                           BEGIN                                  ------------------------------------------------                               -- 6.5. TÌM TỒN THEO LOT KEY 13 KÝ TỰ                               ------------------------------------------------                               SET @_SLCONLAI = 0;                              -- Full physical LOT is the exact identity. A 13-character                             -- root is accepted only when it maps to one physical LOT.                             IF LEN(RTRIM(@_LOTOK)) > 13                             BEGIN                                 SELECT @_SLCONLAI = ISNULL(SLCONLAI, 0)                                 FROM STOCKTP                                 WHERE RTRIM(LOT) = RTRIM(@_LOTOK);                             END                             ELSE IF (                                 SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT RTRIM(LOT))                                 FROM STOCKTP                                 WHERE LEFT(RTRIM(LOT), 13) = LEFT(RTRIM(@_LOTOK), 13)                             ) = 1                             BEGIN                                 SELECT TOP (1) @_SLCONLAI = ISNULL(SLCONLAI, 0)                                 FROM STOCKTP                                 WHERE LEFT(RTRIM(LOT), 13) = LEFT(RTRIM(@_LOTOK), 13)                                 ORDER BY LOT ASC;                             END                             ELSE IF (                                 SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT RTRIM(LOT))                                 FROM STOCKTP                                 WHERE LEFT(RTRIM(LOT), 13) = LEFT(RTRIM(@_LOTOK), 13)                             ) > 1                             BEGIN                                 INSERT INTO #STNG(MH, LOT, SLCAN, SLCO, SLTHIEU, STATUS)                                 VALUES(@MH, @_LOTOK, @_SLOK, 0, @_SLOK,                                        N'Mã LOT gốc ánh xạ nhiều LOT vật lý; vui lòng cung cấp LOT đầy đủ');                             END;                                  ------------------------------------------------                               -- 6.6. KIỂM TRA LOT TỒN TẠI. Skip duplicate diagnostics if root is ambiguous.                             IF NOT EXISTS                             (                                 SELECT 1 FROM #STNG                                 WHERE RTRIM(MH) = RTRIM(@MH)                                   AND RTRIM(LOT) = RTRIM(@_LOTOK)                                   AND STATUS = N'Mã LOT gốc ánh xạ nhiều LOT vật lý; vui lòng cung cấp LOT đầy đủ'                             )                             AND EXISTS                             (                                 SELECT 1                                 FROM STOCKTP                                 WHERE (LEN(RTRIM(@_LOTOK)) > 13 AND RTRIM(LOT) = RTRIM(@_LOTOK))                                    OR (LEN(RTRIM(@_LOTOK)) <= 13 AND LEFT(RTRIM(LOT), 13) = LEFT(RTRIM(@_LOTOK), 13))                             )                             BEGIN                                      ------------------------------------------------                                   -- ĐỦ TỒN                                   ------------------------------------------------                                   IF @_SLCONLAI >= @_SLOK                                   BEGIN                                       INSERT INTO #TMPUPDATE                                       (                                           STT,                                           MH,                                           LOT,                                           SOLUONG,                                           STATUS                                       )                                       VALUES                                       (                                           @STT,                                           @MH,                                           @_LOTOK,                                           @_SLOK,                                           'OK'                                       );                                   END                                   ELSE                                   BEGIN                                          ------------------------------------------------                                       -- KHÔNG ĐỦ TỒN                                       ------------------------------------------------                                       INSERT INTO #STNG                                       (                                           MH,                                           LOT,                                           SLCAN,                                           SLCO,                                           SLTHIEU,                                           STATUS                                       )                                       VALUES                                       (                                           @MH,                                           @_LOTOK,                                           @_SLOK,                                           @_SLCONLAI,                                           @_SLOK - @_SLCONLAI,                                           N'Không đủ tồn kho ban đầu'                                       );                                   END;                               END                               ELSE                               BEGIN                                      ------------------------------------------------                                   -- KHÔNG TỒN TẠI LOT                                   ------------------------------------------------                                   INSERT INTO #STNG                                   (                                       MH,                                       LOT,                                       SLCAN,                                       SLCO,                                       SLTHIEU,                                       STATUS                                   )                                   VALUES                                   (                                       @MH,                                       @_LOTOK,                                       @_SLOK,                                       0,                                       @_SLOK,                                       N'Không tồn tại LOT trong STOCKTP'                                   );                               END;                           END;                       END                       ELSE                       BEGIN                              ----------------------------------------------------                           -- FORMAT LOT-SL KHÔNG HỢP LỆ      ----------------------------------------------------                           INSERT INTO #STNG                           (                               MH,                               LOT,                               SLCAN,                               SLCO,                               SLTHIEU,                               STATUS                           )                           VALUES                           (                               @MH,                               @_LOTSL_Tach,                               0,                               0,                               0,                               N'Định dạng chuỗi LOT-SL không hợp lệ'                           );                       END;                          FETCH NEXT FROM LOT_IN_PGH                       INTO @_LOTSL_Tach;                   END;                      CLOSE LOT_IN_PGH;                   DEALLOCATE LOT_IN_PGH;               END;                  FETCH NEXT FROM PGH               INTO @STT, @_LOT, @MH;           END;              CLOSE PGH;           DEALLOCATE PGH;              ----------------------------------------------------------------           -- 7. KIỂM TRA TỔNG SL CẦN XUẤT VS TỒN           ----------------------------------------------------------------           IF EXISTS           (               SELECT 1               FROM #TMPUPDATE               WHERE STATUS = 'OK'           )           BEGIN                  SELECT                   MH,                   LOT,                   SUM(SOLUONG) AS TONG_CAN_XUAT               INTO #GomNhomCheck               FROM #TMPUPDATE T             WHERE T.STATUS = 'OK'               AND NOT EXISTS               (                   SELECT 1                   FROM #STNG E                   WHERE RTRIM(E.MH) = RTRIM(T.MH)                     AND RTRIM(E.LOT) = RTRIM(T.LOT)               )             GROUP BY                 MH,                 LOT;                  ------------------------------------------------------------             -- Aggregate STOCKTP once (not once per delivery line).             --             -- The previous form LEFT JOINed the aggregate with an ON clause that             -- contained OR plus a correlated COUNT(DISTINCT ...) over STOCKTP. SQL             -- Server could not hash/merge-join it, so it compared every delivery             -- line with every physical LOT and re-ran that sub-query each time             -- (minutes on ~66k STOCKTP rows). Same rules, computed once:             --   * input LOT longer than 13 chars -> exact physical LOT only;             --   * 13-char root -> only when it maps to exactly ONE physical LOT             --     in all of STOCKTP (counted without the SLCONLAI > 0 filter).             ------------------------------------------------------------             SELECT                 RTRIM(LOT) AS PhysicalLot,                 LEFT(RTRIM(LOT), 13) AS LotKey,                 SUM(ISNULL(SLCONLAI, 0)) AS SLCONLAI             INTO #StockByLot             FROM STOCKTP             WHERE ISNULL(SLCONLAI, 0) > 0             GROUP BY RTRIM(LOT), LEFT(RTRIM(LOT), 13);              CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_StockByLot_PhysicalLot ON #StockByLot(PhysicalLot);             CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_StockByLot_LotKey ON #StockByLot(LotKey);              SELECT                 LEFT(RTRIM(LOT), 13) AS LotKey,                 COUNT(DISTINCT RTRIM(LOT)) AS PhysicalLotCount             INTO #LotKeyCount             FROM STOCKTP             GROUP BY LEFT(RTRIM(LOT), 13);              CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_LotKeyCount_LotKey ON #LotKeyCount(LotKey);              INSERT INTO #STNG             (                 MH,                 LOT,                 SLCAN,                 SLCO,                 SLTHIEU,                 STATUS             )             SELECT                 G.MH,                 G.LOT,                 G.TONG_CAN_XUAT,                 X.SLCONLAI,                 G.TONG_CAN_XUAT - X.SLCONLAI,                 N'Không đủ tồn kho (kiểm tra lần 2)'             FROM #GomNhomCheck G             CROSS APPLY             (                 SELECT ISNULL(                     CASE                         WHEN LEN(RTRIM(G.LOT)) > 13                             THEN (SELECT SUM(S.SLCONLAI)                                   FROM #StockByLot S                                   WHERE S.PhysicalLot = RTRIM(G.LOT))                         WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1                                      FROM #LotKeyCount K                                      WHERE K.LotKey = LEFT(RTRIM(G.LOT), 13)                                        AND K.PhysicalLotCount = 1)                             THEN (SELECT SUM(S.SLCONLAI)                                   FROM #StockByLot S                                   WHERE S.LotKey = LEFT(RTRIM(G.LOT), 13))                     END, 0) AS SLCONLAI             ) X             WHERE                 X.SLCONLAI -                 G.TONG_CAN_XUAT < 0;              DROP TABLE #StockByLot;             DROP TABLE #LotKeyCount;                DROP TABLE #GomNhomCheck;           END;              ----------------------------------------------------------------           -- 8. NẾU CÓ LỖI → KHÔNG UPDATE STOCK           ----------------------------------------------------------------           IF EXISTS           (               SELECT 1               FROM #STNG           )           BEGIN               SELECT                   STT,                   LOT,                   SOLUONG,                   STATUS               FROM #STOK;                  SELECT                   MH,                   LOT,                   SLCAN AS SLC,                   SLCO AS SLTK,                   SLTHIEU AS SLT,                   STATUS               FROM #STNG;                -- Roll back this procedure's work before returning business errors.             -- A doomed caller transaction must be rolled back by its owner.             IF @StartedTransaction = 1                 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;             ELSE IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @SavepointCreated = 1                 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION UspQrcodeUpdateStock2405;             ELSE IF XACT_STATE() = -1                 THROW 51034, N'Giao dịch bên ngoài đã ở trạng thái không thể commit; bên gọi phải ROLLBACK transaction.', 1;              RETURN;           END;              ----------------------------------------------------------------           -- 9. KHÔNG CÓ DỮ LIỆU UPDATE           ----------------------------------------------------------------           IF NOT EXISTS           (               SELECT 1               FROM #TMPUPDATE               WHERE STT NOT IN               (                   SELECT DISTINCT STT                   FROM #STNG               )           )           BEGIN               SELECT                   STT,                   LOT,                   SOLUONG,                   STATUS               FROM #STOK;                  SELECT                   MH,                   LOT,                   SLCAN AS SLC,                   SLCO AS SLTK,                   SLTHIEU AS SLT,                   STATUS               FROM #STNG;                -- No stock rows are eligible: release this invocation's savepoint             -- and transaction-owned application locks before returning.             IF @StartedTransaction = 1                 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;             ELSE IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @SavepointCreated = 1                 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION UspQrcodeUpdateStock2405;             ELSE IF XACT_STATE() = -1                 THROW 51034, N'Giao dịch bên ngoài đã ở trạng thái không thể commit; bên gọi phải ROLLBACK transaction.', 1;              RETURN;           END;              ----------------------------------------------------------------           -- 10. TRANSACTION           ----------------------------------------------------------------           -- The transaction/savepoint was established before the duplicate check;         -- all stock writes below remain inside that same transaction scope.            DECLARE UPDATETMP CURSOR LOCAL FAST_FORWARD FOR               SELECT                   STT,                   LOT,                   SOLUONG,                   STATUS               FROM #TMPUPDATE               WHERE STT NOT IN               (                   SELECT DISTINCT STT                   FROM #STNG               );              OPEN UPDATETMP;              FETCH NEXT FROM UPDATETMP           INTO @_STTUD, @_LOTUD, @_SLUD, @_STUP;              WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0           BEGIN                  SET @LotThuc = NULL;                  ----------------------------------------------------------------               -- 10.1. TÌM LOT VẬT LÝ THẬT               --               -- Input:               --     @_LOTUD = 2609100101410               --               -- STOCKTP:               --     26091001014100861700               --               -- Match:               --     LEFT(LOT,13) = LEFT(@_LOTUD,13)               --               -- Sau khi tìm được mới UPDATE WHERE LOT = @LotThuc.               ----------------------------------------------------------------               IF LEN(RTRIM(@_LOTUD)) > 13             BEGIN                 -- Lock the exact physical LOT while choosing it. Different delivery                 -- identities can still compete for this same stock row.                 SELECT @LotThuc = LOT                 FROM STOCKTP WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK, ROWLOCK)                 WHERE RTRIM(LOT) = RTRIM(@_LOTUD)                   AND ISNULL(SLCONLAI, 0) >= @_SLUD;             END             ELSE IF (                 SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT RTRIM(LOT))                 FROM STOCKTP WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)                 WHERE LEFT(RTRIM(LOT), 13) = LEFT(RTRIM(@_LOTUD), 13)             ) = 1             BEGIN                 SELECT TOP (1) @LotThuc = LOT                 FROM STOCKTP WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK, ROWLOCK)                 WHERE LEFT(RTRIM(LOT), 13) = LEFT(RTRIM(@_LOTUD), 13)                   AND ISNULL(SLCONLAI, 0) >= @_SLUD                 ORDER BY NGAYNHAP ASC, LOT ASC;             END                  ----------------------------------------------------------------               -- 10.2. Không tìm được LOT vật lý               ----------------------------------------------------------------               IF @LotThuc IS NULL               BEGIN                   INSERT INTO #STNG                   (                       MH,                       LOT,                       SLCAN,                       SLCO,                       SLTHIEU,                       STATUS                   )                   VALUES                   (                       @MH,                       @_LOTUD,                       @_SLUD,                       0,                       @_SLUD,                       N'Không xác định được LOT tồn kho hợp lệ khi trừ kho'                   );               END               ELSE               BEGIN                      ----------------------------------------------------------------                   -- 10.3. UPDATE ĐÚNG LOT VẬT LÝ                   ----------------------------------------------------------------                   UPDATE STOCKTP                 SET                     SLCONLAI = ISNULL(SLCONLAI, 0) - @_SLUD,                     SLXUAT = ISNULL(SLXUAT, 0) + @_SLUD,                     NGAYXUAT = CASE                         WHEN @LOTRESOLUTIONMODE = N'FIFO_SP' THEN GETDATE()                         ELSE NGAYXUAT                     END                 WHERE LOT = @LotThuc                   AND ISNULL(SLCONLAI, 0) >= @_SLUD;                  SET @StockRowsUpdated = @@ROWCOUNT;                  IF @StockRowsUpdated <> 1                 BEGIN                     INSERT INTO #STNG (MH, LOT, SLCAN, SLCO, SLTHIEU, STATUS)                     VALUES                     (                         @MH,                         @_LOTUD,                         @_SLUD,                         ISNULL((SELECT SLCONLAI FROM STOCKTP WHERE LOT = @LotThuc), 0),                         @_SLUD - ISNULL((SELECT SLCONLAI FROM STOCKTP WHERE LOT = @LotThuc), 0),                         N'Tồn kho LOT đã thay đổi trong lúc xác nhận giao; vui lòng thử lại'                     );                 END                 ELSE                 BEGIN                     ----------------------------------------------------------------                     -- 10.4. LƯU LOT VẬT LÝ THẬT CHỈ KHI ĐÃ TRỪ ĐÚNG MỘT DÒNG                     ----------------------------------------------------------------                     IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #STOK WHERE STT = @_STTUD)                     BEGIN                         INSERT INTO #STOK (STT, LOT, SOLUONG, STATUS)                         VALUES (@_STTUD, @LotThuc, @_SLUD, 'OK');                     END;                 END;               END;                  FETCH NEXT FROM UPDATETMP               INTO @_STTUD, @_LOTUD, @_SLUD, @_STUP;           END;              CLOSE UPDATETMP;           DEALLOCATE UPDATETMP;              ----------------------------------------------------------------           -- 11. KIỂM TRA LỖI PHÁT SINH TRONG TRANSACTION           ----------------------------------------------------------------           IF EXISTS         (             SELECT 1             FROM #STNG         )         BEGIN             -- Preserve business diagnostics across rollback. The temp-table writes             -- are transactional, but the table variable snapshot survives rollback.             DECLARE @ErrorSnapshot TABLE             (                 MH NVARCHAR(100),                 LOT NVARCHAR(MAX),                 SLCAN INT,                 SLCO INT,                 SLTHIEU INT,                 STATUS NVARCHAR(500)             );              INSERT INTO @ErrorSnapshot(MH, LOT, SLCAN, SLCO, SLTHIEU, STATUS)             SELECT MH, LOT, SLCAN, SLCO, SLTHIEU, STATUS             FROM #STNG;              IF @StartedTransaction = 1                 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;             ELSE                 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION UspQrcodeUpdateStock2405;              INSERT INTO #STNG(MH, LOT, SLCAN, SLCO, SLTHIEU, STATUS)             SELECT MH, LOT, SLCAN, SLCO, SLTHIEU, STATUS             FROM @ErrorSnapshot;                SELECT                   STT,                   LOT,                   SOLUONG,                   STATUS               FROM #STOK;                  SELECT                   MH,                   LOT,                   SLCAN AS SLC,                   SLCO AS SLTK,                   SLTHIEU AS SLT,                   STATUS               FROM #STNG;                  RETURN;           END;              ----------------------------------------------------------------           -- 12. LƯU LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG           ----------------------------------------------------------------           IF EXISTS           (               SELECT 1               FROM #STOK               WHERE STATUS = 'OK'           )           BEGIN                  -- PO_NO / PO_ITEM: chi sao chep khi bang TMP cua khach hang co cot nay             -- (HVN MP/SP, 100003). Tranh mat PO trong ledger ma khong vo bang khong co cot.             DECLARE @LuuPoCols NVARCHAR(100) = N'', @LuuPoSel NVARCHAR(200) = N'';             IF COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.' + @TMPTABLE, N'PO_NO') IS NOT NULL                 SELECT @LuuPoCols += N', PO_NO', @LuuPoSel += N', LEFT(tmp.PO_NO, 50)';             IF COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.' + @TMPTABLE, N'PO_ITEM') IS NOT NULL                 SELECT @LuuPoCols += N', PO_ITEM', @LuuPoSel += N', LEFT(tmp.PO_ITEM, 50)';              SET @sql = N'                   INSERT INTO LUUPHIEUGIAOHANG                   (                       STT,                       CUA,                       TRUYEN,                       MAHANG,                       TENHANG,                       LOT,                       DV,                       SOLUONG,                       NGAYGIAO,                       GIOGIAO,                       STATUS,                       TTPHIEU,                       NHAMAY,                       GIOGIAOFCC,                       HOP,                       STATUSDOC,                       Note' + @LuuPoCols + N'                   )                   SELECT                       tmp.STT,                       LEFT(tmp.CUA, 50),                       LEFT(tmp.TRUYEN, 50),                       LEFT(tmp.MAHANG, 50),                       LEFT(tmp.TENHANG, 60),                       LEFT(tmp.LOT, 500),                       LEFT(tmp.DV, 50),                       tmp.SOLUONG,                       tmp.NGAYGIAO,                       LEFT(tmp.GIOGIAO, 50),                       ''OK'',                       LEFT(tmp.TTPHIEU, 50),                       LEFT(@NHAMAY, 60),                       LEFT(@GIOGIAOFCC, 50),                       LEFT(tmp.HOP, 50),                       LEFT(tmp.STATUSDOC, 50),                       LEFT(tmp.Note, 250)' + @LuuPoSel + N'                   FROM [' + @TMPTABLE + N'] tmp                   WHERE tmp.STT IN                   (                       SELECT STT                       FROM #STOK                       WHERE STATUS = ''OK''                   );               ';                  EXEC sp_executesql                   @sql,                   N'@NHAMAY NVARCHAR(250),                     @GIOGIAOFCC NVARCHAR(250)',                   @NHAMAY,                   @GIOGIAOFCC;                  ----------------------------------------------------------------               -- 13. LƯU LUUDOCQRCODE               ----------------------------------------------------------------               SET @sql = N'                   INSERT INTO LUUDOCQRCODE                   (                       LOTFCC,                       MAHANGFCC,                       SLTEMFCC,                       LOTHVN,                       MAHANGHVN,                       SLTEMHVN,                       STATUS,                       MAFCC,                       STT,                       KETQUA,                       NGAYXUAT,                       GIOXUAT,                       NHAMAY                   )                   SELECT                       LEFT(DQ.LOTFCC, 500),                       LEFT(DQ.MAHANGFCC, 60),                      DQ.SLTEMFCC,                       LEFT(DQ.LOTHVN, 500),                       LEFT(DQ.MAHANGHVN, 60),                       DQ.SLTEMHVN,                       DQ.STATUS,                       LEFT(DQ.MAFCC, 50),                       DQ.STT,                       LEFT(DQ.KETQUA, 30),                       PG.NGAYGIAO,                       LEFT(@GIOGIAOFCC, 30),                       LEFT(@NHAMAY, 60)                   FROM [' + @DOCQRTABLE + N'] DQ                   INNER JOIN [' + @TMPTABLE + N'] PG                       ON PG.STT =                          TRY_CAST(DQ.GIO AS INT)                   WHERE PG.STT IN                   (                       SELECT STT                       FROM #STOK                       WHERE STATUS = ''OK''                   )                     AND ISNULL(DQ.GIO, '''') <> '''';                      INSERT INTO LUUDOCQRCODE                   (                       LOTFCC,                       MAHANGFCC,                       SLTEMFCC,                       LOTHVN,                       MAHANGHVN,                       SLTEMHVN,                       STATUS,                       MAFCC,                       STT,                       KETQUA,                       NGAYXUAT,                       GIOXUAT,                       NHAMAY                   )                   SELECT                       LEFT(DQ.LOTFCC, 500),                       LEFT(DQ.MAHANGFCC, 60),                       DQ.SLTEMFCC,                       LEFT(DQ.LOTHVN, 500),                       LEFT(DQ.MAHANGHVN, 60),                       DQ.SLTEMHVN,                       DQ.STATUS,                       LEFT(DQ.MAFCC, 50),                       DQ.STT,                       LEFT(DQ.KETQUA, 30),                       PG.NGAYGIAO,                       LEFT(@GIOGIAOFCC, 30),                       LEFT(@NHAMAY, 60)                   FROM [' + @DOCQRTABLE + N'] DQ                   INNER JOIN [' + @TMPTABLE + N'] PG                       ON RTRIM(DQ.MAHANGFCC) =                          RTRIM(PG.MAHANG)                   WHERE PG.STT IN                   (                       SELECT STT                       FROM #STOK                       WHERE STATUS = ''OK''                   )                     AND ISNULL(DQ.GIO, '''') = '''';               ';                  EXEC sp_executesql                   @sql,                   N'                     @GIOGIAOFCC NVARCHAR(250),                     @NHAMAY NVARCHAR(250)',                   @GIOGIAOFCC,                   @NHAMAY;                  ----------------------------------------------------------------               -- 14. UPDATE TMP STATUS               ----------------------------------------------------------------               SET @sql = N'                   UPDATE [' + @TMPTABLE + N']                   SET STATUS = ''OK''                   WHERE STT IN                   (                       SELECT STT                       FROM #STOK                       WHERE STATUS = ''OK''                   );               ';                  EXEC sp_executesql @sql;                  ----------------------------------------------------------------               -- 15. DELETE DOCQRCODE ĐÃ XỬ LÝ               ----------------------------------------------------------------               SET @sql = N'                   DELETE DQ                   FROM [' + @DOCQRTABLE + N'] DQ                   INNER JOIN [' + @TMPTABLE + N'] PG                       ON PG.STT =                          TRY_CAST(DQ.GIO AS INT)                   WHERE PG.STT IN                   (                       SELECT STT                       FROM #STOK                       WHERE STATUS = ''OK''                   )                     AND ISNULL(DQ.GIO, '''') <> '''';                      DELETE DQ                   FROM [' + @DOCQRTABLE + N'] DQ                   INNER JOIN [' + @TMPTABLE + N'] PG                       ON RTRIM(DQ.MAHANGFCC) =                          RTRIM(PG.MAHANG)                   WHERE PG.STT IN                   (                       SELECT STT                       FROM #STOK                       WHERE STATUS = ''OK''                   )                     AND ISNULL(DQ.GIO, '''') = '''';               ';                  EXEC sp_executesql @sql;                  ----------------------------------------------------------------             -- 16. ORDER TABLE DELIVERY STATE             ----------------------------------------------------------------             -- Deliberately do not update Purchase_Order_HTN/YMVN here.             -- The application finalizes each successful TMP row inside the             -- same UnitOfWork by building OrderLineKey from PO_NO + MAHANG             -- + NGAYGIAO/GIOGIAO and calling OrderTableSql.MarkDelivered.             -- Keeping this update in one place avoids a second, weaker key             -- interpretation in SQL (especially legacy hour-only GIOGIAO).               END;              ----------------------------------------------------------------           -- 18. COMMIT           ----------------------------------------------------------------           -- Only commit a transaction opened by this procedure. If a caller owns         -- the transaction, leave final commit/rollback to the caller.         IF @StartedTransaction = 1             COMMIT TRANSACTION;        END TRY       BEGIN CATCH              IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0         BEGIN             IF @StartedTransaction = 1                 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;             ELSE IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @SavepointCreated = 1                 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION UspQrcodeUpdateStock2405;             ELSE IF XACT_STATE() = -1                 THROW; -- the caller must roll back the doomed outer transaction         END;              IF CURSOR_STATUS('local', 'LOT_IN_PGH') >= 0           BEGIN               CLOSE LOT_IN_PGH;               DEALLOCATE LOT_IN_PGH;           END;              IF CURSOR_STATUS('local', 'PGH') >= 0           BEGIN               CLOSE PGH;               DEALLOCATE PGH;           END;              IF CURSOR_STATUS('local', 'UPDATETMP') >= 0           BEGIN               CLOSE UPDATETMP;               DEALLOCATE UPDATETMP;           END;              INSERT INTO #STNG           (               MH,               LOT,               SLCAN,               SLCO,               SLTHIEU,               STATUS           )           VALUES           (               N'SYSTEM ERROR',               N'Line ' +                   CAST(ERROR_LINE() AS NVARCHAR(10)),               0,               0,               0,               LEFT               (                   N'Lỗi dòng ' +                   CAST(ERROR_LINE() AS NVARCHAR(10)) +                   N': ' +                   ERROR_MESSAGE(),                   500               )           );          END CATCH;          --------------------------------------------------------------------       -- 19. TRẢ KẾT QUẢ       --------------------------------------------------------------------       SELECT           STT,           LOT,           SOLUONG,           STATUS       FROM #STOK;          SELECT           MH,           LOT,           SLCAN AS SLC,           SLCO AS SLTK,           SLTHIEU AS SLT,           STATUS       FROM #STNG;      END;

CREATE PROC [dbo].[Usp_Qrcode_Update_StockOLD]           @GIOGIAOFCC NVARCHAR(250) = N'',         @NHAMAY     NVARCHAR(250) = N''      AS       BEGIN           SET NOCOUNT ON;                  DECLARE
