 @_STATUS     NVARCHAR(5),               @_SLCONLAI   INT,               @STT         INT,               @MH          NVARCHAR(60),               @_LOTSL_Tach NVARCHAR(500),               @_LOTOK      NVARCHAR(500),               @_SLOK       INT,               @_KTPC       INT                  -- ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════           -- KHỞI TẠO CÁC BẢNG                 END                      -- Nếu dòng này chưa trùng, thực hiện tách LOT-SL và check kho như bình thường                 DECLARE LOT_IN_PGH CURSOR LOCAL FAST_FORWARD FOR                       SELECT * FROM dbo.Split(@_LOT, ',')                          OPEN LOT_IN_PGH                   FETCH NEXT FROM LOT_IN_PGH INTO @_LOTSL_Tach                        WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0                   BEGIN                       SET @_KTPC  = CHARINDEX('-', @_LOTSL_Tach)                                            IF @_KTPC > 1                       BEGIN                           SET @_LOTOK = SUBSTRING(@_LOTSL_Tach, 1, @_KTPC - 1)                           SET @_SLOK  = CAST(RIGHT(@_LOTSL_Tach, LEN(@_LOTSL_Tach) - @_KTPC) AS INT)                                  SET @_SLCONLAI = 0; LOT, SOLUONG, STATUS)                           VALUES (@_STTUD, @_LOTUD, @_SLUD, 'OK')                                  UPDATE TMPPHIEUGIAOHANG                           SET STATUS = 'OK'                           WHERE STT = @_STTUD                       END                              FETCH NEXT FROM UPDATETMP INTO @_STTUD, @_LOTUD, @_SLUD, @_STUP                   END                   CLOSE UPDATETMP                   DEALLOCATE UPDATETMP                          -- LƯU DỮ LIỆU ĐỒNG BỘ SANG CÁC BẢNG LƯU TRỮ CHÍNH CHO DÒNG THÀNH CÔNG                 IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #STOK WHERE NGAYGIAO, GIOGIAO, STATUS, TTPHIEU, NHAMAY, GIOGIAOFCC,                            HOP, STATUSDOC, Note)                       SELECT                           tmp.STT, LEFT(tmp.CUA, 50), LEFT(tmp.TRUYEN, 50), LEFT(tmp.MAHANG, 50),                          LEFT(tmp.TENHANG, 60), LEFT(tmp.LOT, 500), LEFT(tmp.DV, 50), tmp.SOLUONG,                           tmp.NGAYGIAO, LEFT(tmp.GIOGIAO, CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.Usp_QrReaderLock_Acquire     @CustomerNo NVARCHAR(50),     @ScanMode NVARCHAR(2) = N'MP',     @MachineName NVARCHAR(100) = NULL,     @UserName NVARCHAR(100) = NULL,     @TtlSeconds INT = 120,     @Force BIT = 0 AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;     SET XACT_ABORT ON;     DECLARE @mode NVARCHAR(2) = UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(@ScanMode, N'MP'))));     IF @mode NOT IN (N'MP', N'SP') THROW 51001, N'ScanMode chỉ nhận MP hoặc SP.', 1;      DECLARE @ip NVARCHAR(64) = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(64), CONNECTIONPROPERTY('client_net_address'));     DECLARE @now DATETIME2(0) = SYSDATETIME();     DECLARE @owner NVARCHAR(64), @hb DATETIME2(0);     DECLARE @registered BIT = CASE WHEN @ip IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS         (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.FVN_QrReaderMachine          WHERE IsActive = 1 AND ClientIp = @ip AND ScanMode = @mode            AND CustomerNo IN (@CustomerNo, N'*')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;      IF @registered = 0     BEGIN         SELECT @CustomerNo AS CustomerNo, @mode AS ScanMode,                l.ClientIp AS OwnerClientIp, l.MachineName AS OwnerMachine,                l.UserName AS OwnerUser, l.LockedAt, l.HeartbeatAt,                CAST(0 AS BIT) AS Acquired, CAST(0 AS BIT) AS IsMine,                CAST(CASE WHEN l.HeartbeatAt < DATEADD(SECOND, -@TtlSeconds, SYSDATETIME()) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BIT) AS IsStale,                CAST(0 AS BIT) AS Registered         FROM (SELECT 1 AS x) d         LEFT JOIN dbo.FVN_QrReaderLock l           ON l.CustomerNo = @CustomerNo AND l.ScanMode = @mode;         RETURN;     END;      BEGIN TRANSACTION;     SELECT @owner = ClientIp, @hb = HeartbeatAt     FROM dbo.FVN_QrReaderLock WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)     WHERE CustomerNo = @CustomerNo AND ScanMode = @mode;      IF @owner IS NULL         INSERT dbo.FVN_QrReaderLock (CustomerNo, ScanMode, ClientIp, MachineName, UserName, LockedAt, HeartbeatAt, History)         VALUES (@CustomerNo, @mode, @ip, @MachineName, @UserName, @now, @now,                 LEFT(CONCAT(N'-> ', @ip, N' : ', CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), @now, 120)), 200));     ELSE IF @owner = @ip         UPDATE dbo.FVN_QrReaderLock         SET HeartbeatAt = @now, MachineName = ISNULL(@MachineName, MachineName),             UserName = ISNULL(@UserName, UserName)         WHERE CustomerNo = @CustomerNo AND ScanMode = @mode;     ELSE IF @Force = 1 OR @hb < DATEADD(SECOND, -@TtlSeconds, @now)         UPDATE dbo.FVN_QrReaderLock         SET ClientIp = @ip, MachineName = @MachineName, UserName = @UserName,             LockedAt = @now, HeartbeatAt = @now,             History = LEFT(CONCAT(@owner, N' --> ', @ip,                 CASE WHEN @Force = 1 THEN N' (chiếm quyền)' ELSE N' (hết hạn)' END,                 N' : ', CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), @now, 120)), 200)         WHERE CustomerNo = @CustomerNo AND ScanMode = @mode;     COMMIT TRANSACTION;      SELECT CustomerNo, ScanMode, ClientIp AS OwnerClientIp, MachineName AS OwnerMachine,            UserName AS OwnerUser, LockedAt, HeartbeatAt,            CAST(CASE WHEN ClientIp = @ip THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BIT) AS Acquired,            CAST(CASE WHEN ClientIp = @ip THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BIT) AS IsMine,            CAST(CASE WHEN HeartbeatAt < DATEADD(SECOND, -@TtlSeconds, SYSDATETIME()) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BIT) AS IsStale,            CAST(1 AS BIT) AS Registered     FROM dbo.FVN_QrReaderLock     WHERE CustomerNo = @CustomerNo AND ScanMode = @mode; END;

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.Usp_QrReaderLock_ForceRelease     @CustomerNo NVARCHAR(50), @ScanMode NVARCHAR(2) = N'MP' AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;     DECLARE @mode NVARCHAR(2) = UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(@ScanMode, N'MP'))));     IF @mode NOT IN (N'MP', N'SP') THROW 51004, N'ScanMode chỉ nhận MP hoặc SP.', 1;     DELETE dbo.FVN_QrReaderLock WHERE CustomerNo = @CustomerNo AND ScanMode = @mode; END;

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.Usp_QrReaderLock_Heartbeat     @CustomerNo NVARCHAR(50), @ScanMode NVARCHAR(2) = N'MP' AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;     DECLARE @mode NVARCHAR(2) = UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(@ScanMode, N'MP'))));     IF @mode NOT IN (N'MP', N'SP') THROW 51002, N'ScanMode chỉ nhận MP hoặc SP.', 1;     DECLARE @ip NVARCHAR(64) = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(64), CONNECTIONPROPERTY('client_net_address'));      IF @ip IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS        (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.FVN_QrReaderMachine         WHERE IsActive = 1 AND ClientIp = @ip AND ScanMode = @mode           AND CustomerNo IN (@CustomerNo, N'*'))     BEGIN         IF @ip IS NOT NULL             DELETE dbo.FVN_QrReaderLock             WHERE CustomerNo = @CustomerNo AND ScanMode = @mode AND ClientIp = @ip;         SELECT CAST(0 AS BIT) AS Owned;         RETURN;     END;      UPDATE dbo.FVN_QrReaderLock SET HeartbeatAt = SYSDATETIME()     WHERE CustomerNo = @CustomerNo AND ScanMode = @mode AND ClientIp = @ip;     SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN @@ROWCOUNT > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BIT) AS Owned; END;

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.Usp_QrReaderLock_List     @TtlSeconds INT = 120 AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;     DECLARE @ip NVARCHAR(64) = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(64), CONNECTIONPROPERTY('client_net_address'));     SELECT CustomerNo, ScanMode, ClientIp AS OwnerClientIp, MachineName AS OwnerMachine,            UserName AS OwnerUser, LockedAt, HeartbeatAt,            CAST(CASE WHEN HeartbeatAt < DATEADD(SECOND, -@TtlSeconds, SYSDATETIME()) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BIT) AS IsStale,            CAST(CASE WHEN ClientIp = @ip THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BIT) AS IsMine     FROM dbo.FVN_QrReaderLock     ORDER BY CustomerNo, ScanMode; END;

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.Usp_QrReaderLock_Release     @CustomerNo NVARCHAR(50), @ScanMode NVARCHAR(2) = N'MP' AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;     DECLARE @mode NVARCHAR(2) = UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(@ScanMode, N'MP'))));     IF @mode NOT IN (N'MP', N'SP') THROW 51003, N'ScanMode chỉ nhận MP hoặc SP.', 1;     DECLARE @ip NVARCHAR(64) = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(64), CONNECTIONPROPERTY('client_net_address'));     IF @ip IS NULL RETURN;     DELETE dbo.FVN_QrReaderLock     WHERE CustomerNo = @CustomerNo AND ScanMode = @mode AND ClientIp = @ip; END;

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.Usp_QrReaderMachine_CanReadAnyMode     @CustomerNo NVARCHAR(50) AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;     DECLARE @ip NVARCHAR(64) = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(64), CONNECTIONPROPERTY('client_net_address'));     SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN @ip IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS         (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.FVN_QrReaderMachine          WHERE IsActive = 1 AND ClientIp = @ip            AND CustomerNo IN (@CustomerNo, N'*')            AND ScanMode IN (N'MP', N'SP'))         THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BIT) AS Registered; END;

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.Usp_QrReaderMachine_List AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;     SELECT CustomerNo, ScanMode, ClientIp, MachineName, IsActive, Note, CreatedAt     FROM dbo.FVN_QrReaderMachine     ORDER BY CASE WHEN CustomerNo = N'*' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, CustomerNo, ScanMode, ClientIp; END;

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.Usp_QrReaderMachine_Remove     @CustomerNo NVARCHAR(50), @ClientIp NVARCHAR(64), @ScanMode NVARCHAR(2) = N'MP' AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;     DECLARE @mode NVARCHAR(2) = UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(@ScanMode, N'MP'))));     IF @mode NOT IN (N'MP', N'SP') THROW 51006, N'ScanMode chỉ nhận MP hoặc SP.', 1;     DELETE dbo.FVN_QrReaderMachine     WHERE CustomerNo = @CustomerNo AND ScanMode = @mode AND ClientIp = @ClientIp; END;

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.Usp_QrReaderMachine_Upsert     @CustomerNo NVARCHAR(50), @ClientIp NVARCHAR(64), @ScanMode NVARCHAR(2) = N'MP',     @MachineName NVARCHAR(100) = NULL,     @IsActive BIT = 1, @Note NVARCHAR(200) = NULL AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;     SET XACT_ABORT ON;     DECLARE @mode NVARCHAR(2) = UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(@ScanMode, N'MP'))));     IF @mode NOT IN (N'MP', N'SP') THROW 51005, N'ScanMode chỉ nhận MP hoặc SP.', 1;     BEGIN TRANSACTION;     UPDATE dbo.FVN_QrReaderMachine WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)     SET IsActive = @IsActive, MachineName = ISNULL(@MachineName, MachineName),         Note = ISNULL(@Note, Note)     WHERE CustomerNo = @CustomerNo AND ClientIp = @ClientIp AND ScanMode = @mode;     IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0         INSERT dbo.FVN_QrReaderMachine (CustomerNo, ScanMode, ClientIp, MachineName, IsActive, Note)         VALUES (@CustomerNo, @mode, @ClientIp, @MachineName, @IsActive, @Note);     COMMIT TRANSACTION; END;

CREATE PROC dbo.usp_So_Chi_Tiet_Linh_Kien     @_DocDate1     SMALLDATETIME = '',     @_DocDate2     SMALLDATETIME = '',     @_ItemLotCode  NVARCHAR(24) = '',     @_BranchCode   NVARCHAR(3) = '',     @_LangId       INT = 0,     @_ItemCode     NVARCHAR(24) = '' AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;      ------------------------------------------------------------     -- 0. CHUẨN HÓA PARAMETER     ------------------------------------------------------------     SET @_ItemCode =         CASE             WHEN ISNULL(@_ItemCode, N'') = N'[]'                 THEN N''             ELSE ISNULL(@_ItemCode, N'')         END;      SET @_ItemLotCode =         CASE             WHEN ISNULL(@_ItemLotCode, N'') = N'[]'                 THEN N''             ELSE ISNULL(@_ItemLotCode, N'')         END;      IF ISNULL(@_DocDate1, '') = ''         SET @_DocDate1 = '2000-01-01';      IF ISNULL(@_DocDate2, '') = ''         SET @_DocDate2 = GETDATE();       ------------------------------------------------------------     -- 1. TỒN ĐẦU KỲ     --     -- Lấy tồn đầu kỳ theo ItemLotCode + ItemCode     ------------------------------------------------------------     IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#TonDau') IS NOT NULL         DROP TABLE #TonDau;      CREATE TABLE #TonDau     (         ItemLotCode NVARCHAR(24),         OpenQuantity NUMERIC(18,2)     );      INSERT INTO #TonDau     (         ItemLotCode,         OpenQuantity     )     EXEC dbo.usp_Ton_Dau_GetData         @_DocDate0    = @_DocDate1,         @_ItemLotCode = @_ItemLotCode,         @_ItemCode    = @_ItemCode,         @_BranchCode  = @_BranchCode;       ------------------------------------------------------------     -- 2. BẢNG PHÁT SINH     ------------------------------------------------------------     IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#XuatTrongKy') IS NOT NULL         DROP TABLE #XuatTrongKy;      CREATE TABLE #XuatTrongKy     (         DocDate       SMALLDATETIME,         Id            NVARCHAR(50),         DocCode       NVARCHAR(20),         ItemLotCode   NVARCHAR(24),          QuantityNhap  NUMERIC(18,2),         QuantityXuat  NUMERIC(18,2),          DocGroup      NVARCHAR(10),         Description   NVARCHAR(250)     );       ------------------------------------------------------------     -- 2.1. NHẬP     --     -- KHÔNG dùng vB30BizDocReturnDetail_TEM     -- KHÔNG JOIN B20ItemLot vì có trường hợp Lot chưa tồn tại     -- trong B20ItemLot.     --     -- Nguồn chính:     --     B30BizDocReturnDetail     --     B30BizDocReturn     --     -- Số lượng:     --     InfactQuantity     ------------------------------------------------------------     INSERT INTO #XuatTrongKy     (         DocDate,         Id,         DocCode,         ItemLotCode,         QuantityNhap,         QuantityXuat,         DocGroup,         Description     )     SELECT         m.DocDate,          CAST(m.BizDocId AS NVARCHAR(50)),          m.DocCode,          d.ItemLotCode,          ISNULL(d.InfactQuantity, 0),          0,          N'1',          N'Phiếu nhập ngày '         + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), m.DocDate, 103)         + N' số: '         + ISNULL(m.DocNo, N'')      FROM dbo.B30BizDocReturnDetail d      INNER JOIN dbo.B30BizDocReturn m         ON d.BizDocId = m.BizDocId      WHERE         m.IsActive = 1          AND d.IsActive = 1          --------------------------------------------------------         -- ITEM CODE         --------------------------------------------------------         AND         (             ISNULL(@_ItemCode, N'') = N''             OR d.ItemCode = @_ItemCode         )          --------------------------------------------------------         -- LOT         --------------------------------------------------------         AND         (             ISNULL(@_ItemLotCode, N'') = N''             OR d.ItemLotCode = @_ItemLotCode         )          --------------------------------------------------------         -- DATE         --------------------------------------------------------         AND m.DocDate >= @_DocDate1         AND m.DocDate < DATEADD(DAY, 1, @_DocDate2)          --------------------------------------------------------         -- BRANCH         --------------------------------------------------------         AND         (             ISNULL(@_BranchCode, N'') = N''             OR m.BranchCode = @_BranchCode         );       ------------------------------------------------------------     -- 2.2. XUẤT     --     -- QUAN TRỌNG:     --     -- KHÔNG dùng:     --     --     vB30BizDocTemLot_Exported     --         JOIN B30ExportPDDetail     --         ON ItemLotCode     --     -- Vì sẽ gây MANY-TO-MANY:     --     --     t.ItemLotCode = d.ItemLotCode     --     -- và làm nhân dòng / nhân số lượng.     --     -- Nguồn chính:     --     B30ExportPDDetail     --     B30ExportPD     --     -- Mỗi ExportPDDetail là một dòng phát sinh xuất.     --     -- Số lượng xuất:     --     LotQuantity     ------------------------------------------------------------     INSERT INTO #XuatTrongKy     (         DocDate,         Id,         DocCode,         ItemLotCode,         QuantityNhap,         QuantityXuat,         DocGroup,         Description     )     SELECT         m.DocDate,          CAST(m.ExportId AS NVARCHAR(50)),          N'PX',          d.ItemLotCode,          0,          ISNULL(d.LotQuantity, 0),          N'2',          N'Phiếu xuất ngày '         + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), m.DocDate, 103)         + N' số: '         + ISNULL(m.DocNo, N'')      FROM dbo.B30ExportPDDetail d      INNER JOIN dbo.B30ExportPD m         ON d.ExportId = m.ExportId      WHERE         m.IsActive = 1          AND d.IsActive = 1          --------------------------------------------------------         -- ITEM CODE         --------------------------------------------------------         AND         (             ISNULL(@_ItemCode, N'') = N''             OR d.ItemCode = @_ItemCode         )          --------------------------------------------------------         -- LOT         --------------------------------------------------------         AND         (             ISNULL(@_ItemLotCode, N'') = N''             OR d.ItemLotCode = @_ItemLotCode         )          --------------------------------------------------------         -- DATE         --------------------------------------------------------         AND m.DocDate >= @_DocDate1         AND m.DocDate < DATEADD(DAY, 1, @_DocDate2)          --------------------------------------------------------         -- BRANCH         --------------------------------------------------------         AND         (             ISNULL(@_BranchCode, N'') = N''             OR m.BranchCode = @_BranchCode         )          --------------------------------------------------------         -- Không đưa dòng 0 nếu thực sự không có xuất         --------------------------------------------------------         AND ISNULL(d.LotQuantity, 0) <> 0;       ------------------------------------------------------------     -- 3. TẠO BẢNG CHI TIẾT     --     -- Chưa đánh Rank ở đây.     -- Rank sẽ được đánh SAU KHI bổ sung dòng tồn đầu = 0     -- cho những lot chỉ có phát sinh trong kỳ.     ------------------------------------------------------------     IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#V_CtTmp') IS NOT NULL         DROP TABLE #V_CtTmp;      SELECT         Id,         DocDate,         DocCode,         DocGroup,         ItemLotCode,         QuantityNhap,         QuantityXuat,          CAST(0 AS INT) AS _Rank,          N'1' AS _Status,          Description,          CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(18,2)) AS CloseInventory      INTO #V_CtTmp      FROM #XuatTrongKy     WHERE         ISNULL(ItemLotCode, N'') <> N'';       EXEC usp_sys_DefaultTable N'#V_CtTmp';       ------------------------------------------------------------     -- 4. DÒNG TỒN ĐẦU KỲ     --     -- Trước tiên insert tồn đầu kỳ thực tế.     ------------------------------------------------------------     INSERT INTO #V_CtTmp     (         Id,         _Rank,         DocDate,         Description,         ItemLotCode,         _Status,         CloseInventory     )     SELECT         NULL,          0,          NULL,          dbo.ufn_sys_MessageText         (             N'TonDauKy',             @_LangId         ),          td.ItemLotCode,          N'0',          SUM(td.OpenQuantity)      FROM #TonDau td      WHERE         (             ISNULL(@_ItemCode, N'') = N''             OR EXISTS             (                 SELECT 1                 FROM dbo.B30BizDocReturnDetail rd                 WHERE rd.ItemLotCode = td.ItemLotCode                   AND rd.ItemCode = @_ItemCode             )             OR EXISTS             (                 SELECT 1                 FROM dbo.B30ExportPDDetail ed                 WHERE ed.ItemLotCode = td.ItemLotCode                   AND ed.ItemCode = @_ItemCode             )         )          AND         (             ISNULL(@_ItemLotCode, N'') = N''             OR td.ItemLotCode = @_ItemLotCode         )      GROUP BY         td.ItemLotCode;       ------------------------------------------------------------     -- 5. ĐỒNG BỘ RANK CHI TIẾT     --     -- Sau khi đã có rank 0 cho tồn đầu kỳ,     -- đánh rank cho các phát sinh.     ------------------------------------------------------------     ;WITH Ranked AS     (         SELECT             Id,             ROW_NUMBER() OVER             (                 PARTITION BY ItemLotCode                 ORDER BY                     DocDate ASC,                     DocGroup ASC,                     Id ASC             ) AS NewRank         FROM #V_CtTmp         WHERE _Status = N'1'     )     UPDATE v     SET         v._Rank = r.NewRank     FROM #V_CtTmp v     INNER JOIN Ranked r         ON v.Id = r.Id     WHERE v._Status = N'1';       ------------------------------------------------------------     -- 6. BỔ SUNG DÒNG TỒN ĐẦU = 0     --     -- Trường hợp:     --     --     Lot không có #TonDau     --     nhưng có phát sinh NHẬP/XUẤT trong kỳ.     --     -- Nếu không có dòng rank 0 thì recursive CTE không thể     -- tính được tồn lũy kế.     ------------------------------------------------------------     INSERT INTO #V_CtTmp     (         Id,         _Rank,         DocDate,         Description,         ItemLotCode,         _Status,         CloseInventory     )     SELECT         NULL,          0,          NULL,          dbo.ufn_sys_MessageText         (             N'TonDauKy',             @_LangId         ),          x.ItemLotCode,          N'0',          CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(18,2))      FROM     (         SELECT DISTINCT             ItemLotCode         FROM #V_CtTmp         WHERE _Status = N'1'     ) x      WHERE NOT EXISTS     (         SELECT 1         FROM #V_CtTmp td         WHERE td.ItemLotCode = x.ItemLotCode           AND td._Status = N'0'     );       ------------------------------------------------------------     -- 7. TẠO DÒNG TỒN CUỐI KỲ     --     -- Tạo sau khi đã hoàn chỉnh rank.     ------------------------------------------------------------     INSERT INTO #V_CtTmp     (         Id,         _Rank,         DocDate,         Description,         ItemLotCode,         _Status,         CloseInventory     )     SELECT         NULL,          MAX(_Rank) + 1,          NULL,          dbo.ufn_sys_MessageText         (             N'TonCuoiKy',             @_LangId         ),          ItemLotCode,          N'3',          NULL      FROM #V_CtTmp      WHERE _Status = N'1'      GROUP BY         ItemLotCode;       ------------------------------------------------------------     -- 8. TÍNH TỒN LŨY KẾ     ------------------------------------------------------------     IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#cd') IS NOT NULL         DROP TABLE #cd;       ;WITH TonKho     (         ItemLotCode,         CloseInventory,         _Rank     )     AS     (         --------------------------------------------------------         -- 8.1. TỒN ĐẦU KỲ         --------------------------------------------------------         SELECT             ItemLotCode,              CAST             (                 ISNULL(CloseInventory, 0)                 AS NUMERIC(18,2)             ),              _Rank          FROM #V_CtTmp          WHERE             _Status = N'0'             AND _Rank = 0           UNION ALL           --------------------------------------------------------         -- 8.2. PHÁT SINH         --------------------------------------------------------         SELECT             tb.ItemLotCode,              CAST             (                 cd.CloseInventory                 + ISNULL(tb.QuantityNhap, 0)                 - ISNULL(tb.QuantityXuat, 0)                 AS NUMERIC(18,2)             ),              tb._Rank          FROM #V_CtTmp tb          INNER JOIN TonKho cd             ON tb.ItemLotCode = cd.ItemLotCode             AND tb._Rank = cd._Rank + 1          WHERE             tb._Status = N'1'     )      SELECT *     INTO #cd      FROM TonKho      OPTION (MAXRECURSION 0);       ------------------------------------------------------------     -- 9. UPDATE TỒN LŨY KẾ CHO DÒNG CHI TIẾT     ------------------------------------------------------------     UPDATE tb     SET         tb.CloseInventory = cd.CloseInventory      FROM #V_CtTmp tb      INNER JOIN #cd cd         ON tb.ItemLotCode = cd.ItemLotCode         AND tb._Rank = cd._Rank      WHERE         tb._Status = N'1';       ------------------------------------------------------------     -- 10. UPDATE TỒN CUỐI KỲ     --     -- Lấy tồn của dòng phát sinh cuối cùng.     ------------------------------------------------------------     UPDATE tc     SET         tc.CloseInventory =         (             SELECT TOP 1                 c.CloseInventory             FROM #cd c             WHERE c.ItemLotCode = tc.ItemLotCode             ORDER BY c._Rank DESC         )      FROM #V_CtTmp tc      WHERE         tc._Status = N'3';       ------------------------------------------------------------     -- 11. TỔNG NHẬP / XUẤT TRONG KỲ     --     -- CloseInventory phải NULL.     ------------------------------------------------------------     INSERT INTO #V_CtTmp     (         Id,         _Rank,         DocDate,         Description,         ItemLotCode,         _Status,         QuantityNhap,         QuantityXuat,         CloseInventory     )     SELECT         NULL,          NULL,          NULL,          dbo.ufn_sys_MessageText         (             N'TongNhapXuatTrongKy',             @_LangId         ),          ItemLotCode,          N'2',          SUM(ISNULL(QuantityNhap, 0)),          SUM(ISNULL(QuantityXuat, 0)),          NULL      FROM #V_CtTmp      WHERE         _Status = N'1'      GROUP BY         ItemLotCode;       ------------------------------------------------------------     -- 12. KẾT QUẢ REPORT     ------------------------------------------------------------     SELECT         CASE             WHEN v._Status IN (N'0', N'2', N'3')                 THEN N''             ELSE                 CAST(v._Rank AS NVARCHAR(5))         END AS Stt1,          v.Id,          v.DocDate,          v.DocCode,          CASE             WHEN v._Status = N'1'                 THEN                     N'['                     + v.ItemLotCode                     + N'] - '                     + ISNULL(v.Description, N'')              ELSE                 v.Description         END AS Description,          CASE             WHEN ISNULL(v.QuantityNhap, 0) = 0                 THEN NULL             ELSE                 v.QuantityNhap         END AS QuantityNhap,          CASE             WHEN ISNULL(v.QuantityXuat, 0) = 0                 THEN NULL             ELSE                 v.QuantityXuat         END AS QuantityXuat,          CASE             WHEN v._Status = N'2'                 THEN NULL             ELSE                 v.CloseInventory         END AS CloseInventory,          v._Status,          v.ItemLotCode,          CAST         (             CASE                 WHEN v._Status <> N'1'                     THEN N'BOLD'                 ELSE NULL             END             AS NVARCHAR(24)         ) AS _FormatStyleKey,          CASE             WHEN v.DocCode = N'PX'                 THEN                     N'EDIT_BizDocPX PrimaryKeyValue={EXPR=Id}'             ELSE                     N'EDIT_BizDocRT PrimaryKeyValue={EXPR=Id}'         END AS _LinkCommand      FROM #V_CtTmp v      WHERE         (             ISNULL(@_ItemCode, N'') = N''              OR EXISTS             (                 SELECT 1                 FROM dbo.B30BizDocReturnDetail rd                 WHERE rd.ItemLotCode = v.ItemLotCode                   AND rd.ItemCode = @_ItemCode             )              OR EXISTS             (                 SELECT 1                 FROM dbo.B30ExportPDDetail ed                 WHERE ed.ItemLotCode = v.ItemLotCode                   AND ed.ItemCode = @_ItemCode             )         )          AND         (             ISNULL(@_ItemLotCode, N'') = N''             OR v.ItemLotCode = @_ItemLotCode         )      ORDER BY         v.ItemLotCode,          CASE v._Status             WHEN N'0' THEN 1             WHEN N'1' THEN 2             WHEN N'2' THEN 3             WHEN N'3' THEN 4         END,          v.DocDate,          v.DocGroup,          v._Rank,          v.Id;  END

Hoàng Văn Tuấn -->TuanHv) 	IF (SELECT SuggestCodeMethod FROM B00DmFile WHERE Table_Name = @_TableName) = 1 	 	BEGIN 			 		IF ISNULL(@_TableName, N'') = '' OR ISNULL(@_EmployeeName, N'') = '' 		RETURN 		 		DECLARE @_Code NVARCHAR(16), @_i INT  		SET @_EmployeeName = dbo.ufn_nosymbol(@_EmployeeName)  		IF CHARINDEX(' ', @_EmployeeName) = 0 		BEGIN 		SET @_Code = @_EmployeeName 		 		END 		ELSE 			BEGIN 				SET @_Code  = REVERSE(@_EmployeeName)  				SET @_Code  = REVERSE(SUBSTRING(@_Code, 1, CHARINDEX(' ', @_Code)-1)) + SUBSTRING(@_EmployeeName, 1, 1) 			  				WHILE(CHARINDEX(' ', @_EmployeeName) <> 0) 					BEGIN 						SET @_i = CHARINDEX(' ', @_EmployeeName)  						SET @_Code = @_Code + SUBSTRING(@_EmployeeName, @_i + 1, 1) 						SET @_EmployeeName = SUBSTRING(@_EmployeeName, @_i + 1, LEN(@_EmployeeName) - @_i) 					END 	 				SET @_Code = REPLACE(LEFT(@_Code, LEN(@_Code) - 1),' ','') 			END	 		IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM B20Employee WHERE Code = @_Code) 			BEGIN 				SET @_i = 1 				WHILE EXISTS(SELECT * FROM B20Employee WHERE Code = @_Code + CAST(@_i AS VARCHAR(2))) 					BEGIN 						SET @_i = @_i + 1 					END 			 				SET @_Code = @_Code + CAST(@_i AS NVARCHAR(2))	 			END	 			 		SELECT UPPER(@_Code)				                           		 	END	  	ELSE IF (SELECT SuggestCodeMethod FROM B00DmFile WHERE Table_Name = @_TableName) = 2 		 		BEGIN 		IF ISNULL(@_CodeTmp, '') = '' OR ISNULL(@_TableName, N'') = '' OR ISNULL(@_ColumnName, N'') = '' 			RETURN 		 		DECLARE @_CodeMax NVARCHAR(24), @_CodeNew NVARCHAR(24), @_Length INT, @_Right INT,   				@_Number NUMERIC(24, 0), @_NumberPart NVARCHAR(24), @_CharPart NVARCHAR(24)  		DECLARE @_Exec NVARCHAR(2000)  		SET @_CodeTmp = LTRIM(RTRIM(@_CodeTmp))  		SELECT @_Length = LEN(@_CodeTmp), 			@_i = 1, @_Right = 0  		-- Tìm phần số phía sau 		WHILE @_Length >= @_i 		BEGIN 			IF ISNUMERIC(RIGHT(@_CodeTmp, @_i)) = 1 AND CHARINDEX('.', RIGHT(@_CodeTmp, @_i)) = 0 AND CHARINDEX('-', RIGHT(@_CodeTmp, @_i)) = 0 				SET @_Right = @_i 			ELSE 				BREAK  			SET @_i = @_i + 1 		END  		SET @_CharPart = LEFT(@_CodeTmp, @_Length - @_Right) 		 		-- Lấy mã lớn nhất theo định dạng mã cũ 		SET @_Exec = N'SET @_CodeMax = (SELECT MAX(' + @_ColumnName + N') FROM ' + @_TableName +  					N' WHERE ' + @_ColumnName + N' LIKE ''' + @_CharPart + N'%''  						AND LEN(' + @_ColumnName + N') = ' + LTRIM(STR(@_Length)) + '  						AND ISNUMERIC(RIGHT(' + @_ColumnName + ',' + LTRIM(STR(@_Right)) + N')) = 1)' 		EXECUTE sp_executesql @_Exec, N'@_CodeMax NVARCHAR(24) OUTPUT', @_CodeMax OUTPUT  		SET @_Number = RIGHT(@_CodeMax, @_Right)  		-- Nếu phần số tăng thêm là max (99, 999, ...) thì độ dài tự tăng thêm 1 (100, 1000, ...) -- ============================================= -- Author:		Thăng -- Create date: <Create Date,,> -- Description:	Tính số dư tài khoản tức thời khi nhập liệu -- ============================================= CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[usp_sys_CurrentAccountBalance] 	@_vB30AccDocCashPayment_Edit XML	= NULL, 	@_vB30AccDocCashReceipt_Edit XML	= NULL, 	@_vB30AccDocJournalEntry_Edit XML	= NULL, 	@_vB30AccDocOther_Edit XML	= NULL, 	@_DocDate Smalldatetime		= NULL, 	@_LangId SMALLINT			= 0, 	@_BranchCode NCHAR(3)		= NULL, 	@_CurrencyCode0 NCHAR(3)	= N'VND', 	@_ForeignCurrencyOnly INT	= 1 OUTPUT, 	@_nUserId INT				= NULL AS BEGIN 	DECLARE @_docHandle int;  	SELECT TOP 0 Account, CustomerCode, CAST(0 AS TinyInt) AS CustomerAccount 		INTO #AccountList 		FROM B00Cttmp  	IF @_vB30AccDocCashPayment_Edit IS NOT NULL OR @_vB30AccDocCashReceipt_Edit IS NOT NULL 		OR @_vB30AccDocJournalEntry_Edit IS NOT NULL 	BEGIN 		 		DECLARE @_DataSet NVARCHAR(64) 		IF @_vB30AccDocCashPayment_Edit IS NOT NULL 		BEGIN 			SET @_DataSet = '/NewDataSet/vB30AccDocCashPayment_Edit' 			EXEC sp_xml_preparedocument @_docHandle OUTPUT, @_vB30AccDocCashPayment_Edit; 		END ELSE  		BEGIN 			SET @_DataSet = '/NewDataSet/vB30AccDocJournalEntry_Edit' 			EXEC sp_xml_preparedocument @_docHandle OUTPUT, @_vB30AccDocJournalEntry_Edit;	 		END	 		 		IF OBJECT_ID('TempDb..#CurrentDataSet') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #CurrentDataSet 		SELECT *,  				CAST(0 AS TinyInt) AS DebitCustomerAccount, 				CAST(0 AS TinyInt) AS DebitProductAccount, 				CAST(0 AS TinyInt) AS DebitBankAccount, 				CAST(0 AS TinyInt) AS CreditCustomerAccount, 				CAST(0 AS TinyInt) AS CreditProductAccount, 				CAST(0 AS TinyInt) AS CreditBankAccount 		INTO #CurrentDataSet 		FROM OPENXML (@_docHandle, @_DataSet, 2)  			WITH  			( 				BranchCode NCHAR(3),  				DocDate DateType, 				DocCode nvarchar(3), 				DebitAccount CodeType,  				CreditAccount CodeType, 				CustomerCode CodeType, 				BankCode CodeType, 				ProductCostId CodeType 			)  		EXEC sp_xml_removedocument @_docHandle;  		DELETE FROM #CurrentDataSet WHERE ISNULL(DebitAccount, '') = '' AND ISNULL(CreditAccount, '') = ''  		IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #CurrentDataSet) 			GOTO _Return;  		UPDATE #CurrentDataSet SET  				DebitCustomerAccount = ISNULL(B.CustomerAccount, 0),  				CreditCustomerAccount = ISNULL(C.CustomerAccount, 0), 				DebitBankAccount = ISNULL(B.BankAccount, 0),  				CreditBankAccount = ISNULL(C.BankAccount, 0) 		FROM #CurrentDataSet A LEFT JOIN  			B20ChartOfAccount B ON A.DebitAccount = B.Code LEFT JOIN 			B20ChartOfAccount C ON A.CreditAccount = C.Code  		-- Tạo bảng danh sách tài khoản 		INSERT INTO #AccountList (Account, CustomerCode, CustomerAccount) 		SELECT a.DebitAccount,  				CASE WHEN b.BankDocument = 1 AND b.Nh_Ct = '1' THEN ISNULL(a.BankCode,'') ELSE ISNULL(a.CustomerCode,'') END,  				ISNULL(a.DebitCustomerAccount,'')  			FROM #CurrentDataSet AS a 				LEFT OUTER JOIN B00DmCt AS b ON a.DocCode = b.Ma_Ct 			WHERE ISNULL(a.DebitAccount,'') <> '' 		UNION 		SELECT a.CreditAccount,  				CASE WHEN b.BankDocument = 1 AND b.Nh_Ct = '2' THEN ISNULL(a.BankCode,'') ELSE ISNULL(a.CustomerCode,'') END,  				ISNULL(a.CreditCustomerAccount,'')  			FROM #CurrentDataSet AS a 				LEFT OUTER JOIN B00DmCt AS b ON a.DocCode = b.Ma_Ct 			WHERE ISNULL(a.CreditAccount,'') <> '' 	END 	ELSE IF @_vB30AccDocOther_Edit IS NOT NULL 	BEGIN 		EXEC sp_xml_preparedocument @_docHandle OUTPUT, @_vB30AccDocOther_Edit; -- ================================== -- 16/11/2011: Thăng -- Description: Thủ tục set lại cột công thức nếu sử dụng mã số của những dòng khai báo không được in -- ===================================================== CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[usp_sys_FormulaSetValue] 	@_Table NVARCHAR(64)		= N'',				-- Tên bảng cần cập nhật 	@_FormulaKey NVARCHAR(64)	= N'ItemNo',			-- Tên cột mã số 	@_Formula NVARCHAR(254)		= N'Formula',		-- Tên cột công thức 	@_In_CK NVARCHAR(32)		= N'IsPrint'			-- Tên cột In_Ck  --WITH ENCRYPTION AS BEGIN 	SET NOCOUNT ON;  	IF	OBJECT_ID(N'Tempdb..' + @_Table, 'U') IS NULL  	BEGIN 		PRINT 'Table ' + @_Table + ' is not found!' -- ============================================= -- Author:		Đinh Quang Thắng -- Create date: 26/12/2011 -- Description:	Thủ tục lấy key lọc dữ liệu --			+ 1.Nếu giá trị truyền là nhóm của danh mục: key lọc theo tất cả nhóm --			+ 2.Nếu giá trị chính xác: Lọc theo giá trị --			+ 3.Bắt theo điều kiện like --		Example: --	SET @_Key = '' --	EXECUTE dbo.usp_sys_GenKey @_Code = 'A01', @_ColGen = 'CustomerCode',  --			@_ColName = 'CustomerCode', @_TableName = 'B20DmDt',  --			@_AndOrKey = 'AND', @_Key = @_Key OUTPUT -- ============================================= -- 06/05/2014: Nâng độ rộng @_Code - Trường hợp nhập ô điều kiện lọc vượt quá. -- ============================================= CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[usp_sys_GenKey]  	@_Code AS NVARCHAR(256) = NULL,		-- Giá trị kiểm tra 	@_ColGen AS NVARCHAR(64) = NULL,	-- Tên cột để tạo key lọc 	@_ColName AS NVARCHAR(64) = NULL,	-- Tên cột của bảng danh mục để so sánh 	@_TableName AS NVARCHAR(64) = NULL,	-- Tên bảng danh mục 	@_AndOrKey AS NVARCHAR(32) = '', 	@_Key NVARCHAR(2000) = '' OUTPUT --WITH ENCRYPTION AS BEGIN 	SET NOCOUNT ON; 	 	IF OBJECT_ID(@_TableName) IS NULL RETURN 	SET @_AndOrKey = LTRIM(RTRIM(@_AndOrKey)) 	SET @_AndOrKey = CASE WHEN @_AndOrKey = '' THEN '' ELSE ' ' + @_AndOrKey + ' ' END 	 	-- Kiểm tra giá trị tồn tại 	DECLARE @_strExec NVARCHAR(MAX), @_isGroup Bit, @_Found Bit; 	 	-- Xử lý riêng danh mục tài khoản (Không bắt theo isGroup như bình thường) 	IF @_TableName = 'B20ChartOfAccount' 		SET @_strExec =  			N'IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM vB20ChartOfAccount WHERE ' + @_ColName + ' = N''' + RTRIM(@_Code) + ''')' + CHAR(13) + 			N'BEGIN' + CHAR(13) + 			N'	SET @_Found = 1' + CHAR(13) + 			N'	SET @_isGroup = (SELECT TOP 1 IsParentAccount FROM vB20ChartOfAccount WHERE ' + @_ColName + ' = N''' + RTRIM(@_Code) + ''')' + CHAR(13) + 			N'END' 	ELSE 		SET @_strExec =  			N'IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM ' + @_TableName + ' WHERE ' + @_ColName + ' = N''' + RTRIM(@_Code) + ''')' + CHAR(13) + 			N'BEGIN' + CHAR(13) + 			N'	SET @_Found = 1' + CHAR(13) + 			N'	SET @_isGroup = (SELECT TOP 1 isGroup FROM ' + @_TableName  + ' WHERE ' + @_ColName + ' = N''' + RTRIM(@_Code) + ''')' + CHAR(13) + 			N'END' 	 	SET @_isGroup = 0; SET @_Found = 0; 	 	EXECUTE sp_executesql @_strExec, N'@_isGroup Bit OUTPUT, @_Found Bit OUTPUT', @_isGroup OUTPUT, @_Found OUTPUT 	 	IF @_Found = 1 	BEGIN 		IF @_isGroup = 0 -- Tìm tuyệt đối nếu không phải là nhóm 			SET @_Key = @_Key + @_AndOrKey + '(' + @_ColGen + ' = N''' + RTRIM(@_Code) + ''')'; 		ELSE 			-- Tìm theo dạng nhóm 		BEGIN 			IF @_TableName = 'B20ChartOfAccount' 				SET @_Key = @_Key + @_AndOrKey + '(' + @_ColGen + ' LIKE N''' + RTRIM(@_Code) + '%'')'; 			ELSE 				SET @_Key = @_Key + @_AndOrKey + '(' + @_ColGen + ' IN (SELECT Ma FROM dbo.ufn_sys_GetDmDetail(N''' + RTRIM(@_Code) + ''',N''' + @_TableName + ''')))';	 		END 			 		RETURN; 	END 	ELSE IF CHARINDEX(',', @_Code) > 0 		BEGIN 			CREATE TABLE #TblTmp (Code nvarchar(24), IsGroup Bit DEFAULT 0) 			DECLARE @_SqlExec nvarchar(4000), @_CodeList1 nvarchar(4000), @_CodeList2 nvarchar(4000); 			 			SET @_SqlExec = N'INSERT INTO #TblTmp (Code)' + NCHAR(13) + 							N'	SELECT N''' + REPLACE(@_Code, ',', ''' UNION SELECT N''') + '''' 			EXECUTE sp_ExecuteSql @_SqlExec;  			SET @_SqlExec = N'UPDATE #TblTmp SET IsGroup = 1' + NCHAR(13) + 							N'	FROM #TblTmp AS a INNER JOIN ' + @_TableName + ' AS b' + NCHAR(13) + 							N'	ON a.Code = b.Code AND b.IsGroup = 1'; 			EXECUTE sp_ExecuteSql @_SqlExec; 			 			SELECT @_CodeList1 = '', @_CodeList2 = '';  			SELECT @_CodeList1 = STUFF((SELECT ',' + Code FROM #TblTmp WHERE IsGroup = 0 								FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, N'')  			SELECT @_CodeList2 = (SELECT ' OR ' + @_ColGen +  								' IN(SELECT Ma FROM dbo.ufn_sys_GetDmDetail(N''' + Code + ''', N''' + @_TableName + '''))' 								FROM #TblTmp WHERE IsGroup <> 0 								FOR XML PATH('')) 			 			IF @_CodeList1 <> '' OR @_CodeList2 <> '' 			BEGIN 				SET @_Key = @_Key + @_AndOrKey + '(' 				IF @_CodeList1 <> '' 					SET @_Key = @_Key + @_ColGen + ' IN (N''' + REPLACE(@_CodeList1, ',', ''',N''') + ''')' 				IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #TblTmp WHERE IsGroup <> 0) 					SET @_Key = @_Key + CASE WHEN @_CodeList1 <> '' THEN @_CodeList2 											ELSE SUBSTRING(@_CodeList2, 5, LEN(@_CodeList2)-4) END; 				SET @_Key = @_Key + ')'; 			END  			DROP TABLE #TblTmp; 			RETURN; 		END 	 	SET @_Key = @_Key + @_AndOrKey + '(' + @_ColGen + ' LIKE N''' + RTRIM(@_Code) + '%'')'; END

CREATE PROCEDURE [usp_sys_GetControlPermission] 	@_UserId int, 	@_CommandKey varchar(24) AS BEGIN 	SET NOCOUNT ON;  	------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 	-- Hàm/thủ tục được tạo tự động bởi BravoTools nếu không tồn tại hoặc sẽ bị xóa 	-- và tạo lại nếu thực hiện "Cập nhật các hàm và thủ tục TSQL" trong BravoTools 	-- Trả về dữ liệu phân quyền control trong form được mở bằng lệnh @_CommandKey 	------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 	 	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM B00PermissionData WITH (NOLOCK) 		WHERE ParentCommandKey = @_CommandKey AND ColumnName > '') 	BEGIN 		SELECT TOP (0) 			CAST('' AS varchar(48)) AS TableName 			,CAST('' AS varchar(48)) AS ColumnName 			,CAST(NULL AS tinyint) AS NoAddNew 			,CAST(NULL AS tinyint) AS NoEdit 			,CAST(NULL AS tinyint) AS NoEditDOU 			,CAST(NULL AS tinyint) AS NoOpen 			,CAST(NULL AS tinyint) AS NoOpenDOU; 		RETURN; 	END;  	DECLARE @PermissionAll TABLE 	( 		TableName varchar(48) 		,ColumnName varchar(48) 		,BuiltinOrder int 		,RoleId int 		,UserId int 		,NoAddNew tinyint 		,NoEdit tinyint 		,NoEditDOU tinyint 		,NoOpen tinyint 		,NoOpenDOU tinyint 		,NoInherit tinyint 	); 	 	INSERT INTO @PermissionAll SELECT  			pd.TableName 			,pd.ColumnName 			,o.BuiltinOrder 			,p.RoleId 			,p.UserId 			,p.NoAddNew 			,p.NoEdit 			,p.NoEditDOU 			,p.NoOpen 			,p.NoOpenDOU 			,p.NoInherit 		FROM B00Permission AS p WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN  			dbo.ufn_sys_GetPermissionUserListTable(@_UserId) AS o ON  				o.RoleId = ISNULL(p.RoleId, -1) AND o.UserId = ISNULL(p.UserId, -1) INNER JOIN 			B00PermissionData AS pd WITH (NOLOCK) ON pd.Id = p.DataId 		WHERE pd.ParentCommandKey = @_CommandKey AND pd.ColumnName > '' 			AND (ISNULL(p.NoAddNew, 0) = 1 OR ISNULL(p.NoEdit, 0) = 1 OR ISNULL(p.NoEditDOU, 0) = 1  				OR ISNULL(p.NoOpen, 0) = 1 OR ISNULL(p.NoOpenDOU, 0) = 1 OR ISNULL(p.NoInherit, 0) = 1) 			AND p.IsActive = 1 AND pd.IsActive = 1; 	 	WITH ctePermissionNoInherit AS 	( 		SELECT TableName, ColumnName, BuiltinOrder  			FROM @PermissionAll WHERE NoInherit = 1 	) 	, ctePermissions AS 	( 		SELECT	a.TableName 				,a.ColumnName 				,a.NoAddNew 				,a.NoEdit 				,a.NoEditDOU 				,a.NoOpen 				,a.NoOpenDOU 			FROM @PermissionAll AS a INNER JOIN  				ctePermissionNoInherit AS b ON a.TableName = b.TableName AND a.ColumnName = b.ColumnName  					AND (a.BuiltinOrder < b.BuiltinOrder OR (a.BuiltinOrder = b.BuiltinOrder AND a.NoInherit = 1)) 		UNION 		SELECT  a.TableName 				,a.ColumnName 				,a.NoAddNew 				,a.NoEdit 				,a.NoEditDOU 				,a.NoOpen 				,a.NoOpenDOU 			FROM @PermissionAll AS a  			WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM @PermissionAll WHERE  				NoInherit = 1 AND TableName = a.TableName AND ColumnName = a.ColumnName) 	) 	SELECT TableName 			,ColumnName 			,CAST(MAX(ISNULL(NoAddNew, 0)) AS tinyint) AS NoAddNew 			,CAST(MAX(ISNULL(NoEdit, 0)) AS tinyint) AS NoEdit 			,CAST(MAX(ISNULL(NoEditDOU, 0)) AS tinyint) AS NoEditDOU 			,CAST(MAX(ISNULL(NoOpen, 0)) AS tinyint) AS NoOpen 			,CAST(MAX(ISNULL(NoOpenDOU, 0)) AS tinyint) AS NoOpenDOU 		FROM ctePermissions GROUP BY TableName, ColumnName; END;

--===================================== -- Author:		Đinh Quang Thắng -- Create date: 06 Nov 2007 -- Description:	Tạo bảng danh mục và lấy điều kiện lọc  -- ============================================= CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[usp_sys_GetDanhMuc] 	@_TableCreated NVARCHAR(128) = N'', 	@_DmName NVARCHAR(64) = N'B20Customer',					-- Danh mục cần lấy 	@_Find_Id INT = NULL , 	@_LangId TINYINT = 0, 	@_colDmList NVARCHAR(128) = N'Code'				-- Danh sách mã cần lấy AS BEGIN 	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from 	-- interfering with SELECT statements. -- ============================================= -- Author: Updated -- Description: Tách số lượng theo quy cách đóng gói để tạo nhiều tem -- =============================================  CREATE PROC dbo.usp_sys_GetDataBizDocDetail     @_vB30BizDocDetail_Edit XML = NULL,     @_DocDate SMALLDATETIME = NULL,     @_BranchCode NCHAR(3) = NULL AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;      DECLARE @_Handle INT;      -- Đọc dữ liệu XML     EXEC sp_xml_preparedocument @_Handle OUTPUT, @_vB30BizDocDetail_Edit;      IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#B30BizDocDetail') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #B30BizDocDetail;     SELECT *,            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY RequestDate, ItemCode) AS _Rank     INTO #B30BizDocDetail     FROM OPENXML(@_Handle, '/NewDataSet/vB30BizDocDetail_Edit', 1)     WITH     (         ItemCode NVARCHAR(24),         CustomerCode NVARCHAR(24),         EstimatedTimeDelivery SMALLDATETIME,         RequestDate SMALLDATETIME,         Quantity9 NUMERIC(18,2),         DocNoTK NVARCHAR(24),         Remark NVARCHAR(192)     );      EXEC sp_xml_removedocument @_Handle;      IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #B30BizDocDetail)         GOTO _Return;      -- Bảng kết quả     IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Result') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Result;     SELECT TOP 0 *,            CAST(N'' AS NVARCHAR(50)) AS ItemLotCode     INTO #Result     FROM #B30BizDocDetail;      EXEC dbo.usp_sys_DefaultTable '#Result';      DECLARE          @_ItemCode NVARCHAR(24),         @_CustomerCode NVARCHAR(24),         @_EstimatedTimeDelivery SMALLDATETIME,         @_RequestDate SMALLDATETIME,         @_Quantity9 NUMERIC(18,2),         @_DocNoTK NVARCHAR(24),         @_Rank INT,         @_Remark NVARCHAR(192),         @_Id_Item INT,         @_Code0 NVARCHAR(4),         @_Quantity_QC NUMERIC(18,2),         @_SoTemChan INT,         @_Quantity_Du NUMERIC(18,2),         @_Prefix NVARCHAR(50);      -- Xử lý từng dòng dữ liệu     WHILE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #B30BizDocDetail)     BEGIN         SELECT TOP 1             @_ItemCode = ItemCode,             @_CustomerCode = CustomerCode,             @_EstimatedTimeDelivery = EstimatedTimeDelivery,             @_RequestDate = RequestDate,             @_Quantity9 = Quantity9,             @_DocNoTK = DocNoTK,             @_Rank = _Rank,             @_Remark = Remark         FROM #B30BizDocDetail         ORDER BY _Rank;          -- Lấy quy cách đóng gói         SELECT              @_Id_Item = Id,             @_Quantity_QC = CASE WHEN ISNULL(Quantity,0) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE Quantity END         FROM dbo.B20ItemQuyCach         WHERE ItemCode = @_ItemCode AND CustomerCode = @_CustomerCode;          -- Nếu không có quy cách thì mặc định = 1         SET @_Quantity_QC = ISNULL(@_Quantity_QC, 1);          -- Lấy mã khách hàng         SELECT @_Code0 = Code0          FROM dbo.B20Customer          WHERE Code = @_CustomerCode;          -- Tính số tem         SET @_SoTemChan = FLOOR(@_Quantity9 / @_Quantity_QC);         SET @_Quantity_Du = @_Quantity9 - (@_SoTemChan * @_Quantity_QC);          -- Tạo prefix cho ItemLotCode         IF LEFT(ISNULL(@_Code0,''),1) <> '3'         BEGIN             SET @_Prefix =                 RIGHT('0' + CAST(RIGHT(YEAR(@_RequestDate),2) AS NVARCHAR),2) +                 RIGHT('0' + CAST(MONTH(@_RequestDate) AS NVARCHAR),2) +                 RIGHT('0' + CAST(DAY(@_RequestDate) AS NVARCHAR),2) +                 ISNULL(@_Code0,'') +                 CAST(ISNULL(@_Id_Item,0) AS NVARCHAR);         END         ELSE         BEGIN             SET @_Prefix =                 ISNULL(@_DocNoTK,'') +                 ISNULL(@_Code0,'') +                 CAST(ISNULL(@_Id_Item,0) AS NVARCHAR);         END          -- =======================         -- 1. TẠO CÁC TEM CHẴN         -- =======================         IF @_SoTemChan > 0         BEGIN             ;WITH Numbers AS             (                 SELECT TOP (@_SoTemChan)                     ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) AS Seq                 FROM sys.all_objects             )             INSERT INTO #Result             (                 ItemLotCode,                 ItemCode,                 CustomerCode,                 EstimatedTimeDelivery,                 RequestDate,                 Quantity9,                 DocNoTK,                 Remark             )             SELECT                  @_Prefix + RIGHT('000' + CAST(Seq AS NVARCHAR),3),                 @_ItemCode,                 @_CustomerCode,                 @_EstimatedTimeDelivery,                 @_RequestDate,                 @_Quantity_QC,                 @_DocNoTK,                 @_Remark             FROM Numbers;         END          -- =======================         -- 2. TẠO TEM LẺ         -- =======================         IF @_Quantity_Du > 0         BEGIN             INSERT INTO #Result             (                 ItemLotCode,                 ItemCode,                 CustomerCode,                 EstimatedTimeDelivery,                 RequestDate,                 Quantity9,                 DocNoTK,                 Remark             )             VALUES             (                 @_Prefix + 'R',                 @_ItemCode,                 @_CustomerCode,                 @_EstimatedTimeDelivery,                 @_RequestDate,                 @_Quantity_Du,                 @_DocNoTK,                 @_Remark             );         END          -- Xóa dòng đã xử lý         DELETE FROM #B30BizDocDetail WHERE _Rank = @_Rank;     END      -- Kết quả cuối cùng     SELECT *     FROM #Result     ORDER BY ItemCode, RequestDate, ItemLotCode;      RETURN;  _Return:     SELECT '' AS ItemCode, '' AS CustomerCode; END

CREATE PROCEDURE [usp_sys_GetDataPermission] 	@_UserId int,  	@_TableName varchar(48) AS BEGIN 	SET NOCOUNT ON;  	------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 	-- Hàm/thủ tục được tạo tự động bởi BravoTools nếu không tồn tại hoặc sẽ bị xóa 	-- và tạo lại nếu thực hiện "Cập nhật các hàm và thủ tục TSQL" trong BravoTools 	-- Trả về dữ liệu phân quyền dữ liệu khai báo với tên bảng @_TableName 	------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 	 	-- Quyền dữ liệu được lưu với TableName <> '', ColumnName = '', FilterExpr có thể = '' hoặc không 	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM B00PermissionData WITH (NOLOCK) 		WHERE TableName = @_TableName AND ColumnName = '') 	BEGIN 		SELECT TOP (0) 			CAST('' AS varchar(48)) AS TableName 			,CAST('' AS nvarchar(128)) AS FilterExpr 			,CAST(NULL AS tinyint) AS NoAddNew 			,CAST(NULL AS tinyint) AS NoEdit 			,CAST(NULL AS tinyint) AS NoEditDOU 			,CAST(NULL AS tinyint) AS NoDelete 			,CAST(NULL AS tinyint) AS NoDeleteDOU 			,CAST(NULL AS tinyint) AS NoRecall 			,CAST(NULL AS tinyint) AS NoRecallDOU 		RETURN; CREATE PROCEDURE [usp_sys_GetLayoutPermission] 	@_UserId int, 	@_FormName varchar(64),  	@_TemplateName varchar(64) = '' AS BEGIN 	SET NOCOUNT ON; 	SET ANSI_WARNINGS OFF;  	------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 	-- Hàm/thủ tục được tạo tự động bởi BravoTools nếu không tồn tại hoặc sẽ bị xóa 	-- và tạo lại nếu thực hiện "Cập nhật các hàm và thủ tục TSQL" trong BravoTools 	-- Trả về dữ liệu phân quyền của các layout cho form @_FormName hoặc template layout @_TemplateName 	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------  	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM B00PermissionData WITH (NOLOCK) 		WHERE TableName = 'B00Layout' AND ColumnName = '') 	BEGIN 		SELECT TOP (0) 			CAST(NULL AS int) AS Id 			,CAST(NULL AS tinyint) AS NoAddNew 			,CAST(NULL AS tinyint) AS NoEdit 			,CAST(NULL AS tinyint) AS NoEditDOU 			,CAST(NULL AS tinyint) AS NoDelete 			,CAST(NULL AS tinyint) AS NoDeleteDOU; 		RETURN; 	END; 	 	DECLARE @PermissionAll TABLE 	( 		TableName varchar(48) 		,FilterExpr varchar(128) 		,BuiltinOrder int 		,RoleId int 		,UserId int 		,NoAddNew tinyint 		,NoEdit tinyint 		,NoEditDOU tinyint 		,NoDelete tinyint 		,NoDeleteDOU tinyint 		,NoInherit tinyint 		,LayoutId int 	);  	INSERT INTO @PermissionAll 		SELECT  			pd.TableName 			,pd.FilterExpr 			,o.BuiltinOrder 			,p.RoleId 			,p.UserId 			,p.NoAddNew 			,p.NoEdit 			,p.NoEditDOU 			,p.NoDelete 			,p.NoDeleteDOU 			,p.NoInherit 			,l.Id AS LayoutId 		FROM B00Permission AS p WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN  			dbo.ufn_sys_GetPermissionUserListTable(@_UserId) AS o ON  				o.RoleId = ISNULL(p.RoleId, -1) AND o.UserId = ISNULL(p.UserId, -1) INNER JOIN 			B00PermissionData AS pd WITH (NOLOCK) ON pd.Id = p.DataId INNER JOIN 			(SELECT Id, 'Id=' + LTRIM(STR(Id)) AS FilterExpr 				FROM B00Layout WITH (NOLOCK) 				WHERE FormName IN (@_FormName, @_TemplateName) AND IsActive = 1 			UNION ALL 			SELECT NULL, '' AS FilterExpr) AS l ON l.FilterExpr = pd.FilterExpr 		WHERE pd.TableName = 'B00Layout' AND pd.ColumnName = ''  			AND (p.NoAddNew IS NOT NULL OR p.NoEdit IS NOT NULL OR p.NoEditDOU IS NOT NULL  				OR p.NoDelete IS NOT NULL OR p.NoDeleteDOU IS NOT NULL OR p.NoInherit IS NOT NULL) 			AND p.IsActive = 1 AND pd.IsActive = 1; 	 	WITH ctePermissionNoInherit AS 	( 		SELECT TableName, FilterExpr, BuiltinOrder  			FROM @PermissionAll WHERE NoInherit = 1 	) 	, ctePermissions AS 	( 		SELECT	a.TableName 				,a.FilterExpr 				,a.NoAddNew 				,a.NoEdit 				,a.NoEditDOU 				,a.NoDelete 				,a.NoDeleteDOU 				,a.LayoutId 			FROM @PermissionAll AS a INNER JOIN  				ctePermissionNoInherit AS b ON a.TableName = b.TableName AND a.FilterExpr = b.FilterExpr 					AND (a.BuiltinOrder < b.BuiltinOrder OR (a.BuiltinOrder = b.BuiltinOrder AND a.NoInherit = 1)) 		UNION 		SELECT  a.TableName 				,a.FilterExpr 				,a.NoAddNew 				,a.NoEdit 				,a.NoEditDOU 				,a.NoDelete 				,a.NoDeleteDOU 				,a.LayoutId 			FROM @PermissionAll AS a  			WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM @PermissionAll WHERE  				NoInherit = 1 AND TableName = a.TableName AND FilterExpr = a.FilterExpr) 	) 	SELECT LayoutId AS Id 			,MAX(NoAddNew) AS NoAddNew 			,MAX(NoEdit) AS NoEdit 			,MAX(NoEditDOU) AS NoEditDOU 			,MAX(NoDelete) AS NoDelete 			,MAX(NoDeleteDOU) AS NoDeleteDOU 		FROM ctePermissions 		GROUP BY LayoutId; END;

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[usp_sys_PrintOutLongSQL]         @SQLInput NVARCHAR(MAX),         @VariableName NVARCHAR(128),         @Debug BIT = 0 AS  /****************************************************************************************************** **    Name: usp_sys_PrintOutLongSQL.sql **          Script Type: Stored Procedure **    Desc: Description ** **    Auth: Sam Bendayan **    Database:        HRMS_GLOBALDATA **          Scrum Team Name: Sherpas **          VersionOne Story #: '' **    Resync Parent Node: '' ******************************************************************************************************* **          USAGE:         DECLARE @SQLInput NVARCHAR(MAX)          --SET @SQLInput = ''         SET @SQLInput = (select replicate('a', 4000))         SET @SQLInput = @SQLInput +        (select replicate('b', 4000))         SET @SQLInput = @SQLInput +        (select replicate('C', 4000))         SET @SQLInput = @SQLInput +        (select replicate('D', 4000))         SET @SQLInput = @SQLInput +        (select replicate('E', 4000))         SET @SQLInput = @SQLInput +        (select replicate('F', 4000))         SET @SQLInput = @SQLInput +        (select replicate('G', 4000))         SET @SQLInput = @SQLInput +        (select replicate('H', 4000))         --SET @Sqlinput = @SQLInput +  ')'          EXEC dbo.usp_sys_PrintOutLongSQL                 @SQLInput = @SQLInput,                 @VariableName = '@SQL',                 @Debug = 0                    SELECT ASCII('     ')                  SELECT ASCII('     ')                 THE PROBLEM WE'RE TRYING TO SOLVE HERE IS THAT A PRINT COMMAND CAN ONLY PRINT 8,000 CHARACTERS.                 SO WE HAVE TO HAVE MULTIPLE PRINT COMMANDS TO PRINT OUT A STRING LONGER THAN THAT.                 BUT, EVERY PRINT COMMAND STARTS ON A NEW LINE (ADDS A CRLF)...THIS IS THE PROBLEM.                 HOW CAN WE REMOVE THIS CRLF THAT THE PRINT COMMAND GENERATES? *******************************************************************************************************/ SET NOCOUNT ON  BEGIN TRY --get length of @SQLInput --loop through it and print out each 4,000 character chunk.     DECLARE @VariableLength NUMERIC(10,2),             @PrintSQL                NVARCHAR(MAX),             @ParmDefinition NVARCHAR(500),             @Chunk          NVARCHAR(4000),             @SubstringStart INT,             @SubstringEnd   INT      SET @VariableLength = LEN(@SQLInput)     SET @ParmDefinition = N'@SQLInput NVARCHAR(MAX)'     SET @PrintSQL = 'PRINT ''--' + @VariableName + ':  ''' + CHAR(10)     SET @SubstringStart = 0     SET @SubstringEnd = 4000      WHILE (@SubstringStart + @SubstringEnd) < @VariableLength     BEGIN         --FIX "BROKEN LINE AT 4,000 CHARACTER POSITION" PROBLEM.         SELECT @SubstringStart = @SubstringStart + CASE @SubstringStart WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE @SubstringEnd END          SET @Chunk = SUBSTRING(@SQLInput, @SubstringStart, 4000)         IF RIGHT(@Chunk, 1) NOT IN ('', CHAR(10), CHAR(32), CHAR(9), CHAR(13))--IF THERE IS A LETTER IN THE 4,000th POSITION, ASSUME THAT IT'S A BROKEN LINE...         BEGIN             SET @SubstringEnd = LEN(@Chunk) - (CHARINDEX(CHAR(10), REVERSE(@Chunk))) --...AND STOP THE PRINT AT THE END OF THE PREVIOUS LINE.         END         ELSE         BEGIN             SET @SubstringEnd = LEN(@Chunk) --OTHERWISE, END POSITION IS OK.         END          IF @Debug = 1         BEGIN            PRINT 'PRINT SUBSTRING(@SQLInput, ' + CAST(@SubstringStart AS NVARCHAR(10)) + ', ' + CAST(@SubstringEnd AS NVARCHAR(10)) + ')'         END          SET @PrintSQL = @PrintSQL + 'PRINT SUBSTRING(@SQLInput, ' + CAST(@SubstringStart AS NVARCHAR(10)) + ', ' + CAST(@SubstringEnd AS NVARCHAR(10)) + ')'     END      IF @Debug = 1     BEGIN        PRINT @VariableLength     END      IF @Debug = 0     BEGIN         EXEC sp_executeSQL             @PrintSQL,             @ParmDefinition,             @SQLInput = @SQLInput     END     ELSE     BEGIN             SET @PrintSQL = @PrintSQL + 'PRINT ''--' + CAST(@VariableLength AS VARCHAR(20)) + ' characters.'''     END END TRY  --ERROR HANDLING BEGIN CATCH         --Call central error handling proc. --        EXEC HRMS_GLOBALDATA.dbo.spErrorHandler END CATCH

-- ============================================ -- Top vật tư có giá trị trả lại lớn nhất --	trong một khoảng thời gian -- ============================================ CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[usp_sys_Top_Pos_ReturnItem] 	@_DocDate1 Smalldatetime	= NULL, 	@_DocDate2 Smalldatetime	= NULL, 	@_LangId INT				= 0, 	@_nUserId INT				= 0, 	@_CurrencyCode0 NCHAR(3)	= N'VND', 	@_Ma_Dvcs NCHAR(3)			= N'A02', 	@_LAYOUT_XML nvarchar(MAX)	= '' OUTPUT --WITH ENCRYPTION AS BEGIN 	SET NOCOUNT ON;  	-- Tao bang tmp 	IF OBJECT_ID(N'Tempdb..#Tmp') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Tmp 	SELECT TOP 0 ItemCode, ItemName, Amount 	INTO #Tmp 	FROM B00CtTmp  	 	EXECUTE usp_sys_DefaultTable '#Tmp' 	 	INSERT INTO #Tmp (ItemCode, Amount) 		SELECT TOP 10 WITH TIES ItemCode, Amount FROM (SELECT ItemCode, SUM(Amount2) AS Amount 		FROM B30PosDocSalesReturn AS a INNER JOIN B30PosDoc AS b  			ON a.PosDocId = b.PosDocId 		WHERE (a.DocDate BETWEEN @_DocDate1 AND @_DocDate2) 			AND a.BranchCode = @_Ma_Dvcs AND b.IsActive = 1 --AND b.Posted = 1 		GROUP BY ItemCode) B 		ORDER BY Amount DESC  	UPDATE #Tmp SET ItemName = ISNULL(dmvt.Name, '') 		FROM #Tmp ct LEFT JOIN B20Item dmvt ON ct.ItemCode = dmvt.Code  	SELECT * FROM #Tmp	 	DROP TABLE #Tmp  	SET @_LAYOUT_XML =  		N'<BravoLayout> 			<Cols> 				<Column_ItemName> 					<Name>ItemName</Name> 					<Width>280</Width> 				</Column_ItemName> 				<Column_Amount> 					<Name>Amount</Name> 					<Style>Format:"C";</Style> 					<Width>-1</Width> 				</Column_Amount> 			</Cols> 		</BravoLayout>';  END

-- ============================================ -- Danh sách những khách hàng, nhà cung cấp có giá trị giao dịch cao nhất --	trong một khoảng thời gian -- ============================================ CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[usp_sys_Top_RetailCustomer] 	@_DocDate1 Smalldatetime	= NULL, 	@_DocDate2 Smalldatetime	= NULL, 	@_DocCode NVARCHAR(2)		= N'R1', 	@_RepType NCHAR(1)			= N'2',	--1: Mua vào (NCC); 2: Bán ra (Khách hàng) 	@_LangId INT				= 0, 	@_nUserId INT				= 0, 	@_CurrencyCode0 NCHAR(3)	= N'VND', 	@_Ma_Dvcs NCHAR(3)			= N'A02', 	@_LAYOUT_XML nvarchar(MAX)	= '' OUTPUT --WITH ENCRYPTION AS BEGIN 	SET NOCOUNT ON;  	-- Tao bang tmp 	IF OBJECT_ID(N'Tempdb..#Tmp') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Tmp 	SELECT TOP 0 DocDate AS DocDate1, DocDate AS DocDate2, DocCode, CustomerCode, CustomerName, Amount 	INTO #Tmp 	FROM B00CtTmp  	 	EXECUTE usp_sys_DefaultTable '#Tmp' 	 	INSERT INTO #Tmp (CustomerCode, Amount) 		SELECT TOP 10 WITH TIES CustomerCode, Amount FROM (SELECT a.DocCode, CustomerCode, SUM(Amount2) AS Amount 		FROM B30PosDocSalesRetail AS a INNER JOIN B30PosDoc AS b  			ON a.DocDate = b.DocDate AND a.PosDocId = b.PosDocId 		WHERE CustomerCode <> '' AND (a.DocDate BETWEEN @_DocDate1 AND @_DocDate2) 			AND a.BranchCode = @_Ma_Dvcs 		GROUP BY a.DocCode, CustomerCode) B 		ORDER BY Amount DESC  	UPDATE #Tmp SET CustomerName = ISNULL(dmdt.Name, ''), DocDate1 = @_DocDate1, DocDate2 = @_DocDate2 		FROM #Tmp ct LEFT JOIN B20Customer dmdt ON ct.CustomerCode = dmdt.Code  	SELECT * FROM #Tmp	 	DROP TABLE #Tmp  	SET @_LAYOUT_XML =  		N'<BravoLayout> 			<Cols> 				<Column_CustomerName> 					<Name>CustomerName</Name> 					<Width>-1</Width> 				</Column_CustomerName> 				<Column_Amount> 					<Name>Amount</Name> 					<Style>Format:"C";</Style> 					<Width>-1</Width> 				</Column_Amount> 			</Cols> 		</BravoLayout>';  END

-- ============================================ -- Danh sách nhà cung cấp / khách hàng có số lượng hàng trả lại nhiều nhất --	trong một khoảng thời gian -- ============================================ CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[usp_sys_Top_ReturnCustomer] 	@_DocDate1 Smalldatetime	= '20170101', 	@_DocDate2 Smalldatetime	= '20171231', 	@_DocCode NVARCHAR(2)		= N'XT', 	@_RepType NCHAR(1)			= N'1',	 -- 1 : Tốp nhà cung cấp ; 2 -- Tốp khách hàng 	@_LangId INT				= 0, 	@_Ma_Dvcs NCHAR(3)			= N'A02', 	@_CurrencyCode0 NVARCHAR(3)		= N'VND', 	@_LAYOUT_XML nvarchar(MAX)	= '' OUTPUT --WITH ENCRYPTION AS BEGIN 	SET NOCOUNT ON;  	DECLARE @_Key1 NVARCHAR(256), @_strExec NVARCHAR(3000), @_LinkCommand NVARCHAR(MAX) 	 	SELECT @_Key1 = '' 	 	SET @_Key1 = CASE WHEN ISNULL(@_DocCode, '') = '' THEN '' ELSE ' AND (DocCode IN (N''' + REPLACE(@_DocCode, N',', N''', N''') + N'''))' END  	DECLARE @_CacheKey nvarchar(48), @_LastUpdateCache smalldatetime,  			@_LogDataChange tinyint, @_xmlCache xml, @_ConditionKey nvarchar(48); 				 	SET @_CacheKey = 'Top_ReturnCustomer'; 	SET @_ConditionKey = @_Ma_Dvcs + CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), @_DocDate1, 112) + CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), @_DocDate2, 112) + 		@_RepType ; 	 	IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM B00Cache WHERE CacheKey = @_CacheKey AND ConditionKey = @_ConditionKey) 	BEGIN 		SELECT TOP 1 @_LastUpdateCache = LastUpdate FROM B00Cache WHERE CacheKey = @_CacheKey; 		 		SET @_LogDataChange = dbo.ufn_B00EventLog_DataChange(@_Ma_Dvcs, @_LastUpdateCache); 	END 	ELSE 		SET @_LogDataChange = 99; 	 	IF @_LogDataChange = 0  		GOTO PROCESSDATA; 		 	-- Tao bang tmp 	IF OBJECT_ID(N'Tempdb..#Tmp') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Tmp 	SELECT TOP 0 DocDate AS DocDate1, DocDate AS DocDate2, DocCode, CustomerCode, CustomerName, Quantity 	INTO #Tmp 	FROM B00CtTmp  	 	EXECUTE usp_sys_DefaultTable '#Tmp' 	SET @_strExec = 		N'INSERT INTO #Tmp (DocCode, CustomerCode, Quantity)' + CHAR(13) +  		N'	SELECT TOP 5 WITH TIES DocCode, CustomerCode, Quantity FROM (SELECT DocCode, CustomerCode, SUM(Quantity) AS Quantity' + CHAR(13) + 		N'	FROM ' + CASE WHEN @_RepType = 1 THEN N' vB30StockLedger_PurchaseReturn' ELSE ' vB30StockLedger_SalesReturn' END + CHAR(13) +  		N'	WHERE CustomerCode <> '''' AND (DocDate BETWEEN ''' + CAST(@_DocDate1 AS NVARCHAR(11)) + ''' AND ''' + CAST(@_DocDate2 AS NVARCHAR(11)) + ''')' + CHAR(13) +  		N'	AND BranchCode = ' + QUOTENAME(@_Ma_Dvcs, CHAR(39)) + @_Key1 + CHAR(13) +  		N'	GROUP BY DocCode, CustomerCode) B' + CHAR(13) +  		N'	ORDER BY Quantity DESC'  	EXECUTE (@_strExec)  	UPDATE #Tmp SET CustomerName = ISNULL(dmdt.Name, '') , DocDate1 = @_DocDate1, DocDate2 = @_DocDate2 		FROM #Tmp ct LEFT JOIN B20Customer dmdt ON ct.CustomerCode = dmdt.Code  PROCESSDATA: 	SET @_LinkCommand =  CASE WHEN @_RepType = 1 THEN 'REP04_BK_CTPX StartupCommandKey=Refresh;DocDate1={EXPR=DocDate1};DocDate2={EXPR=DocDate2};DocCode={EXPR=DocCode};CustomerCode={EXPR=CustomerCode};' 		ELSE  'REP04_BK_CTPX StartupCommandKey=Refresh;DocDate1={EXPR=DocDate1};DocDate2={EXPR=DocDate2};DocCode={EXPR=DocCode};CustomerCode={EXPR=CustomerCode};' END	  	IF @_LogDataChange = 0 	BEGIN 		print 'Get data from Cache' 		SELECT @_xmlCache = (SELECT CacheValue FROM B00Cache WHERE CacheKey = @_CacheKey) 		 		DECLARE @_docHandle int; 		 		EXEC sp_xml_preparedocument @_docHandle OUTPUT, @_xmlCache;  		SELECT DocDate1, DocDate2, DocCode, CustomerCode, CustomerName, Quantity,  			@_LinkCommand AS _LinkCommand 		FROM OPENXML (@_docHandle, '/root/tmpTable')  			WITH (DocDate1 SmallDatetime, DocDate2 SmallDatetime, DocCode NVARCHAR(16), 				CustomerCode dbo.CodeType, CustomerName NVARCHAR(256), Quantity dbo.QuantityType) 	 		EXEC sp_xml_removedocument @_docHandle; 	END ELSE 	BEGIN 		SET @_LastUpdateCache = GETUTCDATE(); 			SELECT @_xmlCache =  			(		SELECT DocDate1, DocDate2, DocCode, CustomerCode, CustomerName, Quantity 					FROM #Tmp AS tmpTable  					FOR XML AUTO, ROOT('root') 			) 			IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM B00Cache WHERE CacheKey = @_CacheKey) 				UPDATE B00Cache SET LastUpdate = @_LastUpdateCache, ConditionKey = @_ConditionKey, 									CacheValue = @_xmlCache 					WHERE CacheKey = @_CacheKey; 			ELSE 				INSERT INTO B00Cache  					VALUES(@_CacheKey, @_ConditionKey, @_LastUpdateCache, @_xmlCache); 	 		SELECT ct.*,   			@_LinkCommand AS _LinkCommand 		FROM #Tmp ct  		DROP TABLE #Tmp 						 	END	 		 	    	IF @_RepType = '1' -- Mua hàng 		SET @_LAYOUT_XML =  			N'<BravoLayout> 				<TreeColumnPos>5</TreeColumnPos> 			<Rows> 			<Row_0/> 			</Rows> 				<Cols> 					<Column_CustomerName> 						<Name>CustomerName</Name> 						<Width>240</Width> 						<Rows> 						<Row_0> 						<Caption> 							<Vietnamese>Nhà cung cấp</Vietnamese> 							<English>Suppliers</English> 							<Chinese>供应商</Chinese> 							<Japanese>サプライヤー</Japanese> 							<Custom>공급 업체</Custom> 						</Caption> 						</Row_0> 						</Rows> 					</Column_CustomerName> 					<Column_Quantity> 						<Editor> 							<ClassName>BravoQuantityInputBox</ClassName> 							<Expr>False</Expr> 						</Editor> 						<Name>Quantity</Name> 						<Width>100</Width> 						<Rows> 						<Row_0> 							<Caption> 								<Vietnamese>Số lượng</Vietnamese> 								<English>Quantity</English> 								<Chinese>数量</Chinese> 								<Japanese>数量</Japanese> 								<Custom>분량</Custom> 							</Caption> 						</Row_0> 						</Rows> 					</Column_Quantity> 				</Cols> 			 			</BravoLayout>'; 	ELSE 		SET @_LAYOUT_XML =  			N'<BravoLayout> 			<Rows> 				<Row_0/> 			</Rows> 				<Cols> 					<Column_CustomerName> 						<Name>CustomerName</Name> 						<Width>-1</Width> 						<Rows> 						<Row_0> 						<Caption> 							<Vietnamese>Khách hàng</Vietnamese> 							<English>Customer</English> 							<Chinese>顾客</Chinese> 							<Japanese>顧客</Japanese> 							<Custom>고객</Custom> 						</Caption> 						</Row_0> 						</Rows> 					</Column_CustomerName> 					<Column_Quantity> 						<Name>Quantity</Name> 						<Editor> 							<ClassName>BravoQuantityInputBox</ClassName> 							<Expr>False</Expr> 						</Editor>						 						<Width>-1</Width> 						<Rows> 						<Row_0> 							<Caption> 								<Vietnamese>Số lượng</Vietnamese> 								<English>Quantity</English> 								<Chinese>数量</Chinese> 								<Japanese>数量</Japanese> 								<Custom>분량</Custom> 							</Caption> 						</Row_0> 						</Rows> 					</Column_Quantity> 				</Cols> 			</BravoLayout>';  END

-- ============================================= -- Author:		<Author,,Name> -- Create date: <Create Date,,> -- Description:	<Description,,> -- ============================================= CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[usp_sys_Top_Salesman] 	@_DocDate1 Smalldatetime	= NULL, 	@_DocDate2 Smalldatetime	= NULL, 	@_Ma_Dvcs char(3) = 'A02',  	@_DocCode char(2) = 'C2',  	@_Year nvarchar(8) = '2011', 	@_Period smallint = 1,	-- 0 Tuần, 1 Tháng, 2 Quý, 3 Năm 	@_CurrencyCode0 char(3) = 'VND', 	@_LangId int = 0, 	@_LAYOUT_XML nvarchar(MAX) = '' OUTPUT AS BEGIN 	SET NOCOUNT ON;
