      -- ============================================================     -- XUẤT TRƯỚC NGÀY BẮT ĐẦU     -- ============================================================      INSERT INTO #CtTmp     (         ItemLotCode,         OpenQuantity,         QuantityNhap,         QuantityXuat     )     SELECT         Ct0.ItemLotCode,         0,         0,         Ct0.InfactQuantity     FROM dbo.B30BizDocOutDetail Ct0     LEFT JOIN dbo.B30BizDocOut Ct         ON Ct.BizDocId = Ct0.BizDocId     LEFT JOIN dbo.B20ItemLot il         ON il.Code = Ct0.ItemLotCode     WHERE Ct.IsActive = 1         AND (                ISNULL(@_ItemLotCode, '') = ''                OR Ct0.ItemLotCode = @_ItemLotCode             )         AND (                ISNULL(@_ItemCode, '') = ''                OR @_ItemCode = N'[]'                OR il.ItemCode = @_ItemCode             )         AND Ct.DocDate >= @_Ngay_Dau_Nam         AND Ct.DocDate < @_DocDate0         AND Ct.BranchCode = @_BranchCode;       -- ============================================================     -- TỒN ĐẦU NĂM / OPENING LOT     -- ============================================================      INSERT INTO #CtTmp     (         ItemLotCode,         OpenQuantity,         QuantityNhap,         QuantityXuat     )     SELECT         Ct.ItemLotCode,         Ct.Quantity,         0,         0     FROM dbo.B30OpenItemLot Ct     LEFT JOIN dbo.B20ItemLot il         ON il.Code = Ct.ItemLotCode     WHERE Ct.Year = @_Nam         AND Ct.BranchCode = @_BranchCode         AND Ct.ItemLotCode <> N''         AND Ct.IsActive = 1         AND (                ISNULL(@_ItemLotCode, '') = ''                OR Ct.ItemLotCode = @_ItemLotCode             )         AND (                ISNULL(@_ItemCode, '') = ''                OR @_ItemCode = N'[]'                OR il.ItemCode = @_ItemCode             );       -- ============================================================     -- TỔNG TỒN     -- ============================================================      SELECT         a.ItemLotCode,         ISNULL(SUM(a.OpenQuantity), 0)         + ISNULL(SUM(a.QuantityNhap), 0)         - ISNULL(SUM(a.QuantityXuat), 0) AS QuantityTon     FROM #CtTmp a     LEFT JOIN dbo.B20ItemLot b         ON a.ItemLotCode = b.Code     LEFT JOIN dbo.B20Item c         ON b.ItemCode = c.Code     WHERE ISNULL(a.ItemLotCode, '') <> ''         AND (                ISNULL(@_ItemCode, '') = ''                OR @_ItemCode = N'[]'                OR b.ItemCode = @_ItemCode             )     GROUP BY         a.ItemLotCode     ORDER BY         a.ItemLotCode;  END

CREATE PROC dbo.usp_Tong_Hop_Nhap_Xuat_Ton     @_DocDate1    SMALLDATETIME = '',     @_DocDate2    SMALLDATETIME = '',     @_ItemLotCode NVARCHAR(24) = '',     @_BranchCode  NVARCHAR(3)  = 'A01',     @_ItemCode    NVARCHAR(24) = '' AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;      ------------------------------------------------------------     -- 1. TỒN ĐẦU KỲ     --     -- Lấy trực tiếp từ usp_Ton_Dau_GetData     -- SP này đã hỗ trợ @_ItemCode     ------------------------------------------------------------      DECLARE @TonDau TABLE     (         ItemLotCode    NVARCHAR(24) PRIMARY KEY,         QuantityTonDau NUMERIC(18, 2)     );      INSERT INTO @TonDau     (         ItemLotCode,         QuantityTonDau     )     EXEC dbo.usp_Ton_Dau_GetData         @_DocDate0    = @_DocDate1,         @_ItemLotCode = @_ItemLotCode,         @_BranchCode  = @_BranchCode,         @_ItemCode    = @_ItemCode;       ------------------------------------------------------------     -- 2. PHÁT SINH NHẬP / XUẤT     ------------------------------------------------------------      DECLARE @PhatSinh TABLE     (         ItemLotCode NVARCHAR(24),         ItemCode    NVARCHAR(24),         ItemName    NVARCHAR(256),         Loai        NVARCHAR(10),         Ngay        SMALLDATETIME,         SoLuong     NUMERIC(18, 2),         BizDocId    NVARCHAR(36) NULL,         DocNo       NVARCHAR(32) NULL     );       ------------------------------------------------------------     -- 3. NHẬP     ------------------------------------------------------------      INSERT INTO @PhatSinh     (         ItemLotCode,         ItemCode,         ItemName,         Loai,         Ngay,         SoLuong,         BizDocId,         DocNo     )     SELECT         d.ItemLotCode,         d.ItemCode,         i.Name AS ItemName,         N'NHẬP' AS Loai,         d.InfactDate AS Ngay,         d.InfactQuantity AS SoLuong,         d.BizDocId,         doc.DocNo     FROM dbo.vB30BizDocReturnDetail_Explore d      LEFT JOIN dbo.B30BizDocReturn doc         ON d.BizDocId = doc.BizDocId      LEFT JOIN dbo.B20Item i         ON d.ItemCode = i.Code      WHERE ISNULL(doc.IsActive, 0) = 1       AND ISNULL(d.IsActive, 0) = 1        AND ISNULL(d.ItemLotCode, '') <> ''       AND ISNULL(d.InfactQuantity, 0) <> 0        AND d.InfactDate >= @_DocDate1       AND d.InfactDate < DATEADD(DAY, 1, @_DocDate2)        AND doc.BranchCode = @_BranchCode        -- LOT       AND       (           ISNULL(@_ItemLotCode, '') = ''           OR @_ItemLotCode = N'[]'           OR d.ItemLotCode = @_ItemLotCode       )        -- ITEM       AND       (           ISNULL(@_ItemCode, '') = ''           OR @_ItemCode = N'[]'           OR d.ItemCode = @_ItemCode       );       ------------------------------------------------------------     -- 4. XUẤT     ------------------------------------------------------------      INSERT INTO @PhatSinh     (         ItemLotCode,         ItemCode,         ItemName,         Loai,         Ngay,         SoLuong,         BizDocId,         DocNo     )     SELECT         d.ItemLotCode,         d.ItemCode,         i.Name AS ItemName,         N'XUẤT' AS Loai,         d.ExportDate AS Ngay,         d.ExportQuantity AS SoLuong,         d.ExportId,         NULL AS DocNo     FROM dbo.vB30ExportPDDetail_Explore d      LEFT JOIN dbo.B30ExportPD doc         ON d.ExportId = doc.ExportId      LEFT JOIN dbo.B20Item i         ON d.ItemCode = i.Code      WHERE ISNULL(doc.IsActive, 0) = 1       AND ISNULL(d.IsActive, 0) = 1        AND ISNULL(d.ItemLotCode, '') <> ''       AND ISNULL(d.ExportQuantity, 0) <> 0        AND d.ExportDate >= @_DocDate1       AND d.ExportDate < DATEADD(DAY, 1, @_DocDate2)        AND doc.BranchCode = @_BranchCode        -- LOT       AND       (           ISNULL(@_ItemLotCode, '') = ''           OR @_ItemLotCode = N'[]'           OR d.ItemLotCode = @_ItemLotCode       )        -- ITEM       AND       (           ISNULL(@_ItemCode, '') = ''           OR @_ItemCode = N'[]'           OR d.ItemCode = @_ItemCode       );       ------------------------------------------------------------     -- 5. GHÉP TỒN ĐẦU + PHÁT SINH     ------------------------------------------------------------      ;WITH GiaoDich AS     (         SELECT             p.ItemLotCode,             p.ItemCode,             p.ItemName,             p.Loai,             p.Ngay,             p.SoLuong,             p.BizDocId,             p.DocNo,              ISNULL(t.QuantityTonDau, 0) AS QuantityTonDau          FROM @PhatSinh p          LEFT JOIN @TonDau t             ON p.ItemLotCode = t.ItemLotCode     ),      ------------------------------------------------------------     -- 6. TÍNH TỒN LŨY KẾ     ------------------------------------------------------------      GiaoDichTinhTon AS     (         SELECT             *,              ISNULL(QuantityTonDau, 0)             +             SUM             (                 CASE                     WHEN Loai = N'NHẬP'                         THEN ISNULL(SoLuong, 0)                      WHEN Loai = N'XUẤT'                         THEN -ISNULL(SoLuong, 0)                      ELSE 0                 END             )             OVER             (                 PARTITION BY ItemLotCode                  ORDER BY                     Ngay,                      CASE                         WHEN Loai = N'NHẬP' THEN 1                         WHEN Loai = N'XUẤT' THEN 2                         ELSE 3                     END,                      ISNULL(BizDocId, '')             ) AS QuantityTonSauGiaoDich          FROM GiaoDich     )       ------------------------------------------------------------     -- 7. KẾT QUẢ     ------------------------------------------------------------      SELECT         g.ItemLotCode AS LotNo,          g.ItemCode,         g.ItemName,          g.Loai,         g.Ngay,          CASE             WHEN g.Loai = N'NHẬP'                 THEN g.SoLuong             ELSE 0         END AS QuantityNhap,          CASE             WHEN g.Loai = N'XUẤT'                 THEN g.SoLuong             ELSE 0         END AS QuantityXuat,          g.QuantityTonDau,          g.QuantityTonSauGiaoDich AS QuantityTon,          g.BizDocId,         g.DocNo,          CASE             WHEN g.QuantityTonSauGiaoDich < 0                 THEN 'RedColor'             ELSE ''         END AS _FormatStyleKey      FROM GiaoDichTinhTon g      ORDER BY         g.ItemCode,         g.ItemLotCode,         g.Ngay,          CASE             WHEN g.Loai = N'NHẬP' THEN 1             WHEN g.Loai = N'XUẤT' THEN 2             ELSE 3         END,          ISNULL(g.BizDocId, '');  END

CREATE PROC dbo.usp_Tong_Hop_Nhap_Xuat_Ton1     @_DocDate1 SMALLDATETIME = '',     @_DocDate2 SMALLDATETIME = '',     @_ItemLotCode NVARCHAR(24) = '',     @_BranchCode NVARCHAR(3) = 'A01' AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;      ------------------------------------------------------------     -- 1. TỒN ĐẦU KỲ (Dùng Table Variable thay cho bảng tạm)     ------------------------------------------------------------     DECLARE @_Ngay_Dau_Nam SMALLDATETIME,              @_Ngay_Bd_Ht SMALLDATETIME,              @_Nam dbo.Codetype;             SET @_Ngay_Dau_Nam = dbo.ufn_sys_GetOpenDateOfFinanceYear(@_DocDate1, @_BranchCode);     SET @_Nam = dbo.ufn_B00DmStt_GetNam(@_DocDate1, @_BranchCode);     SET @_Ngay_Bd_Ht = dbo.ufn_sys_GetStartDateOfWorkingYear(@_DocDate1, @_BranchCode);     SET @_Ngay_Bd_Ht = CASE WHEN @_Ngay_Dau_Nam > @_Ngay_Bd_Ht THEN @_Ngay_Dau_Nam ELSE @_Ngay_Bd_Ht END;      DECLARE @TonDau TABLE     (         ItemLotCode     NVARCHAR(24) PRIMARY KEY,         QuantityTonDau  NUMERIC(18, 2)     );      INSERT INTO @TonDau (ItemLotCode, QuantityTonDau)     SELECT          a.ItemLotCode,          ISNULL(SUM(a.OpenQuantity), 0) + ISNULL(SUM(a.QuantityNhap), 0) - ISNULL(SUM(a.QuantityXuat), 0) AS QuantityTon     FROM     (         SELECT ItemLotCode, 0 AS OpenQuantity, Ct0.InfactQuantity AS QuantityNhap, 0 AS QuantityXuat           FROM dbo.B30BizDocReturnDetail Ct0          LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.B30BizDocReturn Ct ON Ct.BizDocId = Ct0.BizDocId           WHERE Ct.IsActive = 1            AND (ItemLotCode = @_ItemLotCode OR ISNULL(@_ItemLotCode, '') = '')             AND Ct.DocDate >= @_Ngay_Dau_Nam AND Ct.DocDate < @_DocDate1 AND Ct.BranchCode = @_BranchCode                    UNION ALL                     SELECT ItemLotCode, 0, 0, Ct0.InfactQuantity           FROM B30BizDocOutDetail Ct0          LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.B30BizDocOut Ct ON Ct.BizDocId = Ct0.BizDocId            WHERE Ct.IsActive = 1            AND (Ct0.ItemLotCode = @_ItemLotCode OR @_ItemLotCode = '')             AND Ct.DocDate >= @_Ngay_Dau_Nam AND Ct.DocDate < @_DocDate1 AND Ct.BranchCode = @_BranchCode                    UNION ALL                    SELECT Ct.ItemLotCode, Ct.Quantity, 0, 0           FROM dbo.B30OpenItemLot Ct           WHERE Year = @_Nam AND BranchCode = @_BranchCode AND Ct.ItemLotCode <> N'' AND IsActive = 1             AND (Ct.ItemLotCode = @_ItemLotCode OR @_ItemLotCode = '')     ) a      WHERE ISNULL(a.ItemLotCode, '') <> ''     GROUP BY a.ItemLotCode;       ------------------------------------------------------------     -- 2. LẤY CÁC PHÁT SINH NHẬP / XUẤT (Dùng Table Variable)     ------------------------------------------------------------     DECLARE @PhatSinh TABLE     (         ItemLotCode     NVARCHAR(24),         ItemCode        NVARCHAR(24),         ItemName        NVARCHAR(256),         Loai            NVARCHAR(10),         Ngay            SMALLDATETIME,         SoLuong         NUMERIC(18, 2),         BizDocId        NVARCHAR(36) NULL,         DocNo           NVARCHAR(32) NULL     );      ------------------------------------------------------------     -- 3. NHẬP     ------------------------------------------------------------     INSERT INTO @PhatSinh     (         ItemLotCode, ItemCode, ItemName, Loai, Ngay, SoLuong, BizDocId, DocNo     )     SELECT         d.ItemLotCode, d.ItemCode, i.Name AS ItemName,         N'NHẬP' AS Loai,         d.InfactDate AS Ngay,         d.InfactQuantity AS SoLuong,         d.BizDocId, doc.DocNo     FROM dbo.vB30BizDocReturnDetail_Explore d     LEFT JOIN dbo.B30BizDocReturn doc ON d.BizDocId = doc.BizDocId     LEFT JOIN dbo.B20Item i ON d.ItemCode = i.Code     WHERE ISNULL(doc.IsActive, 0) = 1       AND ISNULL(d.IsActive, 0) = 1       AND ISNULL(d.ItemLotCode, '') <> ''       AND ISNULL(d.InfactQuantity, 0) <> 0       AND d.InfactDate BETWEEN @_DocDate1 AND @_DocDate2       AND doc.BranchCode = @_BranchCode       AND (d.ItemLotCode = @_ItemLotCode OR ISNULL(@_ItemLotCode, '') = '');       ------------------------------------------------------------     -- 4. XUẤT     ------------------------------------------------------------     INSERT INTO @PhatSinh     (         ItemLotCode, ItemCode, ItemName, Loai, Ngay, SoLuong, BizDocId, DocNo     )     SELECT         d.ItemLotCode, d.ItemCode, i.Name AS ItemName,         N'XUẤT' AS Loai,         d.ExportDate AS Ngay,         d.ExportQuantity AS SoLuong,         d.ExportId,         NULL AS DocNo     FROM dbo.vB30ExportPDDetail_Explore d     LEFT JOIN dbo.B30ExportPD doc ON d.ExportId = doc.ExportId     LEFT JOIN dbo.B20Item i ON d.ItemCode = i.Code     WHERE ISNULL(d.IsActive, 0) = 1       AND ISNULL(d.ItemLotCode, '') <> ''       AND ISNULL(d.ExportQuantity, 0) <> 0       AND d.ExportDate BETWEEN @_DocDate1 AND @_DocDate2       AND doc.BranchCode = @_BranchCode       AND (d.ItemLotCode = @_ItemLotCode OR ISNULL(@_ItemLotCode, '') = '');       ------------------------------------------------------------     -- 5. KẾT QUẢ CHI TIẾT     ------------------------------------------------------------     ;WITH GiaoDich AS     (         SELECT             p.ItemLotCode, p.ItemCode, p.ItemName, p.Loai, p.Ngay, p.SoLuong, p.BizDocId, p.DocNo,             ISNULL(t.QuantityTonDau, 0) AS QuantityTonDau         FROM @PhatSinh p         LEFT JOIN @TonDau t ON p.ItemLotCode = t.ItemLotCode     ),     GiaoDichTinhTon AS     (         SELECT             *,             ISNULL(QuantityTonDau, 0) +             SUM             (                 CASE                     WHEN Loai = N'NHẬP' THEN ISNULL(SoLuong, 0)                     WHEN Loai = N'XUẤT' THEN -ISNULL(SoLuong, 0)                     ELSE 0                 END             )             OVER             (                 PARTITION BY ItemLotCode                 ORDER BY Ngay, CASE WHEN Loai = N'NHẬP' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, BizDocId                 ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW             ) AS QuantityTonSauGiaoDich         FROM GiaoDich     )     SELECT         g.ItemLotCode AS LotNo,         g.ItemCode, g.ItemName,         g.Loai, g.Ngay,         CASE WHEN g.Loai = N'NHẬP' THEN g.SoLuong ELSE 0 END AS QuantityNhap,         CASE WHEN g.Loai = N'XUẤT' THEN g.SoLuong ELSE 0 END AS QuantityXuat,         g.QuantityTonDau,         g.QuantityTonSauGiaoDich AS QuantityTon,         g.BizDocId, g.DocNo,         CASE WHEN g.QuantityTonSauGiaoDich < 0 THEN 'RedColor' ELSE '' END AS _FormatStyleKey     FROM GiaoDichTinhTon g     ORDER BY         g.ItemCode, g.ItemLotCode, g.Ngay,         CASE WHEN g.Loai = N'NHẬP' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,         g.BizDocId;  END

CREATE PROC [dbo].[usp_Tong_Hop_Nhap_Xuat_Ton280526]       @_DocDate1 SMALLDATETIME = '',        @_DocDate2 SMALLDATETIME = '',        @_ItemLotCode NVARCHAR(24) = '', -- Giữ nguyên tham số hệ thống đầu vào       @_BranchCode NVARCHAR(3) = 'A01',       @_ItemCode NVARCHAR(30) = ''    AS   BEGIN       SET NOCOUNT ON;          IF ISNULL(@_DocDate2, '') = '' SET @_DocDate2 = GETDATE();          -- 1. LẤY DỮ LIỆU TỒN ĐẦU KỲ TỪ SP VỆ TINH       IF OBJECT_ID ('TempDb..#TonDau') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #TonDau       SELECT CAST(N'' AS NVARCHAR(24)) AS ItemLotCode, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(18,2)) AS OpenQuantity       INTO #TonDau          INSERT INTO #TonDau       EXEC dbo.usp_Ton_Dau_GetData            @_DocDate0 = @_DocDate1,            @_ItemLotCode = @_ItemLotCode,            @_BranchCode = @_BranchCode          -- 2. KHỞI TẠO BẢNG TẠM CHỨA BIẾN ĐỘNG (ĐỒNG BỘ 4 CỘT)       IF OBJECT_ID ('TempDb..#CtTmp') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #CtTmp       CREATE TABLE #CtTmp (           ItemCode NVARCHAR(30),           QuantityTonDau NUMERIC(18,2),           QuantityNhap NUMERIC(18,2),           QuantityXuat NUMERIC(18,2)       )          -- 2.1. TỔNG HỢP SỐ LƯỢNG NHẬP (Lọc theo ItemCode)       INSERT INTO #CtTmp (ItemCode, QuantityTonDau, QuantityNhap, QuantityXuat)       SELECT            t.ItemCode,            0 AS QuantityTonDau,           ISNULL(t.Quantity, 0) AS QuantityNhap,            0 AS QuantityXuat       FROM dbo.vB30BizDocReturnDetail_TEM t       INNER JOIN dbo.B30BizDocReturn m ON t.BizDocId = m.BizDocId       WHERE m.IsActive = 1          AND t.TemStatus = 'OK'          AND (t.ItemCode = @_ItemCode OR ISNULL(@_ItemCode, '') = '')         AND CAST(m.DocDate AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST(@_DocDate1 AS DATE) AND CAST(@_DocDate2 AS DATE) -- Giới hạn trong khoảng ngày chọn         AND m.BranchCode = @_BranchCode          -- 2.2. TỔNG HỢP SỐ LƯỢNG XUẤT (Lọc theo ItemCode và sửa điều kiện ngày theo DocDate gốc)       INSERT INTO #CtTmp (ItemCode, QuantityTonDau, QuantityNhap, QuantityXuat)       SELECT            t.ItemCode,            0 AS QuantityTonDau,           0 AS QuantityNhap,            ISNULL(t.Quantity, 0) AS QuantityXuat       FROM dbo.vB30BizDocTemLot_Exported t       INNER JOIN dbo.B30ExportPDDetail d ON t.ItemLotCode = d.ItemLotCode        INNER JOIN dbo.B30ExportPD m ON d.ExportId = m.ExportId                 WHERE m.IsActive = 1          AND (t.ItemCode = @_ItemCode OR ISNULL(@_ItemCode, '') = '')         AND CAST(m.DocDate AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST(@_DocDate1 AS DATE) AND CAST(@_DocDate2 AS DATE) -- Lọc đồng bộ theo ngày chứng từ thực tế         AND m.BranchCode = @_BranchCode              -- 2.3. TỔNG HỢP TỒN ĐẦU KỲ (Áp từ Lot sang Mã hàng)       INSERT INTO #CtTmp (ItemCode, QuantityTonDau, QuantityNhap, QuantityXuat)       SELECT            il.ItemCode,           SUM(td.OpenQuantity) AS QuantityTonDau,           0 AS QuantityNhap,           0 AS QuantityXuat       FROM #TonDau td       INNER JOIN dbo.B20ItemLot il ON td.ItemLotCode = il.Code       WHERE ISNULL(td.OpenQuantity, 0) <> 0       GROUP BY il.ItemCode          -- 3. XUẤT KẾT QUẢ CUỐI CÙNG: GOM ĐÚNG 1 DÒNG TỔNG CHO MỖI MÃ HÀNG       SELECT            t1.ItemCode AS ItemCode,           vattu.Name AS ItemName,           SUM(t1.QuantityTonDau) AS QuantityTonDau,           SUM(t1.QuantityNhap) AS QuantityNhap,           SUM(t1.QuantityXuat) AS QuantityXuat,           (SUM(t1.QuantityTonDau) + SUM(t1.QuantityNhap) - SUM(t1.QuantityXuat)) AS QuantityTon,           CASE                WHEN (SUM(t1.QuantityTonDau) + SUM(t1.QuantityNhap) - SUM(t1.QuantityXuat)) < 0 THEN 'RedColor'                ELSE N''            END AS _FormatStyleKey        FROM #CtTmp t1       LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.B20Item vattu ON t1.ItemCode = vattu.Code       WHERE ISNULL(t1.ItemCode, '') <> ''         AND (t1.ItemCode = @_ItemCode OR ISNULL(@_ItemCode, '') = '')       GROUP BY t1.ItemCode, vattu.Name       HAVING (SUM(t1.QuantityTonDau) + SUM(t1.QuantityNhap) - SUM(t1.QuantityXuat)) <> 0 -- Loại bỏ dòng không có số dư biến động       ORDER BY t1.ItemCode   END

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.usp_upd_B30BizDoc_TemLot_NewPL1     @ItemLotCode NVARCHAR(50),     @ItemCode NVARCHAR(50),     @Quantity NUMERIC(18,2),     @CreatedBy INT,     @ModifiedBy INT,     @TemBarCodePL NVARCHAR(50) OUTPUT,     @ParentId INT OUTPUT AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;      DECLARE          @TemCounter INT,         @CounterKey NVARCHAR(50),         @IsUnique BIT = 0,         @Retry INT = 0,         @MaxRetry INT = 20;      -- Bộ đếm riêng cho tem pallet     SET @CounterKey = CONCAT('PL', @ItemLotCode);      BEGIN TRY         WHILE (@IsUnique = 0 AND @Retry < @MaxRetry)         BEGIN             -- Lấy số đếm tiếp theo             EXEC dbo.usp_Get_Tem_Counter                 @_TableName  = 'B30BizDocTemLot',                 @_CounterKey = @CounterKey,                 @_TotalTem   = 1,                 @_TemCounter = @TemCounter OUTPUT;             END              SET @Retry += 1;         END          -- Nếu vẫn không tạo được mã duy nhất         IF (@IsUnique = 0)         BEGIN             RAISERROR(                 N'Không thể tạo TemBarCode duy nhất cho lô %s.',                 16, 1, @ItemLotCode             ); create FUNCTION [dbo].[Split] (  @SearchString NVARCHAR (max),  @Separator NVARCHAR (5) )   RETURNS @strtable TABLE (strval NVARCHAR (max)) AS   BEGIN  DECLARE @SeparatorLength INT  SET @SeparatorLength = DATALENGTH(@Separator) / 2    IF (@SeparatorLength = 0)   RETURN    WHILE 1=1  BEGIN   IF (CHARINDEX(@Separator,@SearchString) = 0)   BEGIN    INSERT INTO @strtable    VALUES (@SearchString);    BREAK;   END     INSERT INTO @strtable   VALUES ( LEFT(@SearchString, CHARINDEX(@Separator,@SearchString) - 1))     SET @SearchString = RIGHT(@SearchString, DATALENGTH(@SearchString)/2 - CHARINDEX(@Separator,@SearchString) - @SeparatorLength + 1)  END  RETURN END

B20Employee 			WHERE ISNULL(FirstWorkingDate, '') <> '' AND FirstWorkingDate <= @_Date 				AND Code LIKE RTRIM(@_EmployeeCode) + '%' AND isActive = 1 AND IsGroup = 0 			UNION ALL 			SELECT EmployeeCode, '', CAST(NewValue AS FLOAT) AS NotWorkTime, NULL, Description 			FROM B30HrmEmployeeProfile 			WHERE CustomFieldCode = 'REWORK' AND NewValue <> '' AND ISNUMERIC(NewValue) = 1 				AND BranchCode = @_BranchCode AND Date <= @_Date  				AND EmployeeCode = RTRIM(@_EmployeeCode) 				AND isActive = 1 		)  		INSERT INTO @Result 		SELECT EmployeeCode, MAX(FirstWorkingDate) AS FirstWorkingDate, SUM(NotWorkTime) AS NotWorkTime, 			DATEDIFF(month, MAX(FirstWorkingDate),  				CASE WHEN MAX(ResignDate) IS NOT NULL AND MAX(ResignDate) < DATEADD(day, 1, @_Date)  					THEN MAX(ResignDate) ELSE DATEADD(day, 1, @_Date) END) + SUM(NotWorkTime),  			MAX(Description)  		FROM tb 		GROUP BY EmployeeCode 	END      RETURN END

-- Danh sách nhân viên đến kỳ tăng lương CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[ufn_B20Employee_SL] ( 	@_Date Datetime,  	@_EmployeeCode CodeType = '', 	@_BranchCode CodeType ) RETURNS @Result TABLE  	( 		EmployeeCode NVarchar(24),  		ContractDate Datetime,  		SalaryLevel int,  		TimeToConsiderSL0 int, 		DateToConsiderSL0 Datetime, 		DateToConsiderSL Datetime, 		ExtdTimeSL int, 		Description NVarchar(128) 	) AS BEGIN 	INSERT INTO @Result 	SELECT nv.Code AS EmpployeeCode, 		tb.ContractDate, tb.SalaryLevel, tb.TimeToConsiderSL,  		tb.DateToConsiderSL AS DateToConsiderSL0,  		DATEADD(m, ISNULL(tb1.ExtdTimeSL, 0), tb.DateToConsiderSL) AS DateToConsiderSL, 		ISNULL(tb1.ExtdTimeSL, 0) AS ExtdTimeSL, 		ISNULL(tb1.Description, '') AS Description  	FROM B20Employee nv 		CROSS APPLY  		( 			SELECT TOP 1 tb.BranchCode, tb.ContractDate, tb.EmployeeCode, tb.SalaryLevel,  				tb.TimeToConsiderSL, DATEADD(m, tb.TimeToConsiderSL, tb.ContractDate) AS DateToConsiderSL 			FROM vB30HrmLabourContractDetail tb 			WHERE tb.ParameterCode = 'He_So_Co_Ban' AND tb.ContractDate <= @_Date 				AND nv.Code = tb.EmployeeCode  				AND tb.BranchCode = @_BranchCode AND tb.IsActive = 1 			ORDER BY tb.ContractDate DESC	 		) tb 		OUTER APPLY 		(		 			SELECT TOP 1 tb1.BranchCode, tb1.Date, tb1.EmployeeCode,  					CAST(tb1.NewValue AS FLOAT) AS ExtdTimeSL, tb1.Description 			FROM B30HrmEmployeeProfile tb1 			WHERE tb1.CustomFieldCode = 'EXTDTIMESL' AND tb1.Date <= @_Date 				AND nv.Code = tb1.EmployeeCode  				AND tb.ContractDate <= tb1.Date 				AND tb1.BranchCode = @_BranchCode AND tb1.IsActive = 1 			ORDER BY tb.ContractDate DESC	 		)	tb1 	WHERE nv.IsActive = 1	 		AND DATEADD(m, ISNULL(tb1.ExtdTimeSL, 0), tb.DateToConsiderSL) <= @_Date 	    RETURN END

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[B30HrmTimesheet1_GetStartEndTimesheetDate]  (        	@_DocDate smalldatetime ) RETURNS @Result TABLE (StartDate smalldatetime, EndDate smalldatetime )  AS BEGIN 	 	DECLARE @_StartDay CHAR(2), @_EndDay CHAR(2), @_StartDate smalldatetime, @_EndDate smalldatetime  	SELECT @_StartDay = (SELECT VarValue FROM B00Config WHERE VarKey = 'H_StartTimekeeper') 	SELECT @_EndDay = (SELECT VarValue FROM B00Config WHERE VarKey = 'H_EndTimekeeper') 	 	SELECT @_StartDate = CAST((CAST(YEAR(@_DocDate) AS CHAR(4)) + REPLACE(STR(Month(@_DocDate),2), ' ', '0') + @_StartDay)  AS smalldatetime), 		   @_EndDate = DATEADD(Month, 1, @_StartDate)  	SELECT @_EndDate =  CAST((CAST(YEAR(@_EndDate) AS CHAR(4)) + REPLACE(STR(Month(@_EndDate),2), ' ', '0') + @_EndDay)  AS smalldatetime)  	 	INSERT INTO @Result 	SELECT @_StartDate AS StartDate, @_EndDate AS EndDate   	RETURN;  END

-- ============================================= -- Description:	<Trả về thời gian nghỉ phép đến thời điểm hiện tại của một NV> -- ============================================= CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[ufn_Hrm_WarningVacation_Tb] (	 	@_DocDate2		SMALLDATETIME	= '20131130', 	@_EmployeeCode	NVARCHAR(16)	= '', 	@_nUserId		INT				= 1, 	@_LangId		INT				= 0, 	@_BranchCode	NCHAR(3)		= NULL ) RETURNS @Result TABLE  ( 	Quantity NUMERIC(18,4) ) AS BEGIN 	DECLARE @_Quantity NUMERIC(18,4) 	 	DECLARE @_Loai_Th TINYINT 	DECLARE @_BranchList TABLE (BranchCode NCHAR(3)); 	SET @_Loai_Th = ISNULL((SELECT TOP 1 Loai_Th FROM vB00DmDvCs WHERE Ma_DvCs = @_BranchCode), 0) 	 	DECLARE @_DocDate1 SmallDateTime; 	SET @_DocDate1 = CAST(CAST(YEAR(@_DocDate2) AS NCHAR(4)) + '0101' AS SMALLDATETIME)  	IF @_Loai_Th = 0 		INSERT INTO @_BranchList (BranchCode) VALUES (@_BranchCode) 	ELSE 		INSERT INTO @_BranchList (BranchCode) 		SELECT BranchCode  			FROM [dbo].[ufn_GetChildTable_BranchCode](@_BranchCode) 			 	SELECT @_Quantity = CASE WHEN Sen.Seniority > 12 						THEN 							CASE WHEN YEAR(tb.FirstWorkingDate) + 1 = YEAR(@_DocDate2) 							THEN  								12 - MONTH(tb.FirstWorkingDate) - (12 - MONTH(@_DocDate2)) 							ELSE 								12 + FLOOR((Sen.Seniority/12)/5) 							END 						ELSE 						0 						END 		FROM vB20HrmEmployee tb 		LEFT OUTER JOIN [dbo].[ufn_B20Employee_Seniority] (@_DocDate2-1, '', @_BranchCode) Sen ON Sen.EmployeeCode = tb.Code 		LEFT OUTER JOIN  			(SELECT EmployeeCode,  					SUM(WorkDay)/[dbo].[ufn_B20HrmPayrollPara_GetValue1](@_DocDate2,'_HoursPerDay') AS WorkDay  				FROM dbo.vB30HrmTimesheet  				WHERE Date BETWEEN @_DocDate1 AND @_DocDate2  					AND VAC_Code = (SELECT TOP 1 VarValue FROM B00Config b WHERE VarKey = 'H_Vacation')  				GROUP BY EmployeeCode ) c  			ON tb.Code = c.EmployeeCode 		WHERE tb.FirstWorkingDate IS NOT NULL AND tb.FirstWorkingDate <= @_DocDate2 			AND (tb.ResignDate IS NULL OR tb.ResignDate > @_DocDate2)  			AND tb.Code = @_EmployeeCode 			AND (ISNULL(tb.BranchCode,'') = '' OR tb.BranchCode IN (SELECT BranchCode FROM @_BranchList)) 			AND tb.isActive = 1 AND tb.IsGroup = 0 		 	INSERT INTO @Result(Quantity) VALUES (@_Quantity) 	RETURN END

CREATE FUNCTION [ufn_sys_GetModeratedUserTable] (	 	@_UserId int  ) RETURNS @table TABLE ( 	Id int ) AS BEGIN  	------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 	-- Hàm/thủ tục được tạo tự động bởi BravoTools nếu không tồn tại hoặc sẽ bị xóa 	-- và tạo lại nếu thực hiện "Cập nhật các hàm và thủ tục TSQL" trong BravoTools 	-- Trả về bảng chứa Id của user, Id của các nhóm user có cùng nhóm mẹ với @_UserId 	-- Dùng cho người sử dụng có vai trò quản lý nhóm RoleType = 4 	------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 	DECLARE @uid AS int; 	SET @uid = (SELECT ParentId FROM B00UserList WHERE Id = @_UserId); 	WITH cteDownUsers (Id, ParentId) AS 	( 		SELECT Id, ParentId 			FROM [B00UserList] WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE Id = @uid 		UNION ALL 		SELECT u.Id, u.ParentId 			FROM [B00UserList] AS u WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN 				cteDownUsers ON u.ParentId = cteDownUsers.Id 	) 	INSERT INTO @table (Id) SELECT Id FROM cteDownUsers WHERE Id <> @uid; 	RETURN; END;

-- 16/09/2016 ThangDQ: Chinh lai view cho tang them toc do load du lieu CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vB00EventLog_BySession] AS WITH BySession AS ( 	SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY log.SessionId ORDER BY MIN(log.Id)) AS rId, 		MIN(log.Id) AS Id, log.SessionId,  		MAX(log.LastWriteBy) AS LastWriteBy,  		MAX(log.WorkstationName) AS WorkstationName,  		MAX(log.WorkstationUser) AS WorkstationUser,  		MIN(log.Command) AS Command,  		MIN(log.TableName) AS TableName,  		MIN(DATEADD(hh, 7, log.LastWriteAt)) AS LastWriteAt 	FROM vB00EventLog_GetData log 	GROUP BY log.SessionId 	-- Cập nhật thêm thông tin bảng B00CommandLog 	UNION ALL 	SELECT 		NULL AS rId,   		Id, 'COMMAND' +REPLACE(STR(Id, 20),  ' ', '0') AS SessionId, 		LastWriteBy, WorkstationName, WorkstationUser, 		CommandKey AS Command, CommandKey AS TableName,  		DATEADD(hh, 7, LastWriteAt) AS LastWriteAt 	FROM B00CommandLog ) SELECT BySession.Id, BySession.SessionId,  		BySession.LastWriteBy, BySession.WorkstationName, BySession.WorkstationUser,  		BySession.Command, BySession.TableName,  		BySession.LastWriteAt,  		CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), BySession.LastWriteAt, 3) AS Date, 		CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), BySession.LastWriteAt, 14) AS Hour, 		ISNULL(dmfile.Description, BySession.TableName) AS Description, 		userlist.UserName AS UserName, 		msg.Text AS CommandName, BySession.Command AS CommandName_English, 		CAST(1 AS Bit) AS IsActive, -1 AS ParentId, 0 AS IsGroup 		---1 AS CreatedBy, NULL AS CreatedAt, -1 AS ModifiedBy, NULL AS ModifiedAt, 		--CAST(NULL AS timestamp) AS timestamp FROM BySession  	LEFT OUTER JOIN B00DmFileLog AS dmfile ON BySession.TableName = dmfile.TableName   	LEFT OUTER JOIN B00UserList AS userlist ON BySession.LastWriteBy= userlist.Id 	LEFT OUTER JOIN B00Message AS msg ON BySession.Command = msg.TextKey

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vB20Employee_POS] AS SELECT  empl.Id, empl.ParentId, empl.IsGroup, empl.BranchCode, empl.Ct_Lookup, 	empl.Code, empl.Name, empl.Name2,  	b.RowId AS LastSessionId, b.DocDate AS LastSessionDate, b.Id AS LastSessionId0, 	empl.IsActive, empl.CreatedBy, empl.CreatedAt,  	empl.ModifiedBy, empl.ModifiedAt, empl.timestamp, 	c.WarehouseCode, c.TerritoryCode, 	CAST(RIGHT(STR(YEAR(GETDATE()), 4), 1) + 	CASE WHEN MONTH(GETDATE()) < 10  			THEN STR(MONTH(GETDATE()), 1)  			ELSE CHAR(Ascii('A') + MONTH(GETDATE()) - 10) END + 	REPLACE(STR(DAY(GETDATE()), 2), ' ', '0') + 	REPLACE(STR(DATEPART(Hour, GETDATE()), 2), ' ', '0') + 	REPLACE(STR(DATEPART(Minute, GETDATE()), 2), ' ', '0') + 	CASE WHEN FLOOR(DATEPART(second, GETDATE())/1.6) < 10  			THEN STR(FLOOR(DATEPART(second, GETDATE())/1.6), 1)  			ELSE CHAR(Ascii('A') + FLOOR(DATEPART(second, GETDATE())/1.6) - 10) END + 	REPLACE(STR(c.Id, 2), ' ', '0') AS varchar(12)) AS DocNo FROM dbo.B20Employee AS empl OUTER APPLY 	(SELECT TOP 1 Id, RowId, DocDate FROM dbo.B30PosDocSession AS b  		WHERE empl.Code = b.EmployeeCode AND b.CloseTime IS NULL AND IsActive = 1 			AND DocDate = DATEADD(hh, 0, CAST(CAST(GETDATE() AS varchar(11)) AS smalldatetime)) 		ORDER BY DocDate DESC 	) AS b 	OUTER APPLY 	(SELECT TOP 1 Id, WarehouseCode, TerritoryCode FROM dbo.B20Workstation WHERE Code = UPPER(Host_Name()) 	) AS c

DeptCode0,  	CASE WHEN LastDept.DeptCode IS NULL THEN b.Name   		ELSE LastDept.DeptName END AS DeptName0,  		CASE WHEN LastPos.RowId_JobPosition IS NULL THEN CrPos.Name        ELSE LastPos.JobTitleName END AS JobTitleName0, 	LastPos.RowId_JobPosition AS RowId_JobPosition0, --LastPos.JobTitleName AS JobTitleName0,  	CRPos.Code as ID_CurrentPos,CRPos.Name as Name_CurrentPos, ISNULL(UtDaThanhToan.OriginalAmount, 0) + CtVtHtt.OriginalAmount AS Money) AS DueOriginalAmount, 		CAST(Ut.Amount - ISNULL(UtDaThanhToan.Amount, 0) + CtVtHtt.Amount AS Money) AS DueAmount, 		CAST(NULL AS INT) AS Id_SourceDoc, -- 28/04/2014 ThắngĐQ: Xử lý hạn thanh toán ứng trước khi thêm mới chứng từ 		CtVtHtt.IsActive, CtVtHtt.CreatedBy, CtVtHtt.CreatedAt,  		CtVtHtt.ModifiedBy, CtVtHtt.ModifiedAt, CtVtHtt.timestamp FROM B30AccDocApplyPrepayment AS CtVtHtt 	LEFT OUTER JOIN B30AccDocAtchDoc AS CtDiKem ON CtVtHtt.RowId_SourceDoc = CtDiKem.RowId  	LEFT OUTER JOIN B30AccDoc AS Ct ON CtDiKem.Stt = Ct.Stt 	-- 08/07/2015 ThắngĐQ: Fix thêm phần 1 phiếu ứng trước cho 2 đối tượng trở lên 	LEFT OUTER JOIN B00DmCt AS dmct ON dmct.Ma_Ct = ct.DocCode  	LEFT OUTER JOIN  	( 		SELECT Stt, CustomerCode,  				SUM(PrepayOriginalAmount) AS OriginalAmount,  				SUM(PrepayAmount) AS Amount  			FROM vB30CtHttUt 			GROUP BY Stt, CustomerCode  	) AS UtDaThanhToan ON CtVtHtt.Stt_Ct_Ut = UtDaThanhToan.Stt  			AND UtDaThanhToan.CustomerCode = CASE WHEN dmct.Ma_Nvu = 'V' THEN ct.CustomerCode ELSE UtDaThanhToan.CustomerCode END 	LEFT OUTER JOIN vB30CtUngTruocHtt AS Ut ON CtVtHtt.Stt_Ct_Ut = Ut.Stt 		AND Ut.CustomerCode = CASE WHEN dmct.Ma_Nvu = 'V' THEN ct.CustomerCode ELSE Ut.CustomerCode END 	LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.B20Currency AS DmTte ON DmTte.Code = Ut.CurrencyCode --WHERE ISNULL(CtVtHtt.RowId, '') > ''

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vB30AccDocApplyPrepayment_EditTL] AS SELECT CtUtHtt.Id, CtUtHtt.ParentId, CtUtHtt.IsGroup, CtUtHtt.Stt, Stt_Ct_Ut, CtUtHtt.BuiltinOrder, 		Hbtl.DocCode, Hbtl.DocNo AS PrepayDocNo, Hbtl.DocDate AS PrepayDocDate, 		Hbtl.Description, Hbtl.CustomerCode,  		Hbtl.ExchangeRate AS PrepayExchangeRate, Hbtl.CurrencyCode AS PrepayCurrencyCode, 		Ct0Sum.OriginalAmount2 AS PrepayTotalOriginalAmount, Ct0Sum.Amount2 AS PrepayTotalAmount, 		CtUtHtt.OriginalAmount, CtUtHtt.Amount, 		PrepayOriginalAmount, PrepayAmount, DebitAccount7, CreditAccount7, OriginalAmount7, Amount7, 		Ct.ExchangeRate, Ct.CurrencyCode, Ct0.Account AS Account, 		CtUtHtt.IsActive, CtUtHtt.CreatedBy, CtUtHtt.CreatedAt,  		CtUtHtt.ModifiedBy, CtUtHtt.ModifiedAt, CtUtHtt.timestamp FROM B30AccDocApplyPrepayment AS CtUtHtt 	LEFT OUTER JOIN B30AccDoc AS Hbtl ON CtUtHtt.Stt_Ct_Ut = Hbtl.Stt 	OUTER APPLY ( 		SELECT SUM(OriginalAmount2 + OriginalAmount3) AS OriginalAmount2,  				SUM(Amount2 + Amount3) AS Amount2 			FROM dbo.B30AccDocSalesReturn 			WHERE Stt = Hbtl.Stt AND DocDate = Hbtl.DocDate)  		AS Ct0Sum 	OUTER APPLY ( 		SELECT TOP 1 Stt, DocDate, DebitAccount2 AS Account 			FROM dbo.B30AccDocSalesReturn 			WHERE Stt = Hbtl.Stt AND DocDate = Hbtl.DocDate)  		AS Ct0 	LEFT OUTER JOIN B30AccDoc AS Ct ON CtUtHtt.Stt = Ct.Stt

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vB30AccDocApplyPrepayment_EditXT] AS SELECT CtUtHtt.Id, CtUtHtt.ParentId, CtUtHtt.IsGroup, CtUtHtt.Stt, Stt_Ct_Ut, CtUtHtt.BuiltinOrder, 		Ct_DiKem.DocCode, xt.AtchDocNo AS PrepayDocNo, xt.AtchDocDate AS PrepayDocDate, 		Ct_DiKem.Description, Ct_DiKem.CustomerCode,  		Ct_DiKem.ExchangeRate AS PrepayExchangeRate, Ct_DiKem.CurrencyCode AS PrepayCurrencyCode, DmTte.ExchangeRateOperator AS PrepayExchangeRateOperator, 		CAST(CASE WHEN Ct_DiKem.DocCode = 'NK' AND ISNULL(xt.OriginalDueAmount, 0) <> 0 THEN ISNULL(xt.OriginalDueAmount, 0) ELSE ISNULL(xt.OriginalAmountBeforeTax, 0) END 			+ ISNULL(xt.OriginalAmount,0) AS numeric(18, 2)) AS PrepayTotalOriginalAmount,  		CAST(CASE WHEN Ct_DiKem.DocCode = 'NK' AND ISNULL(xt.DueAmount, 0) <> 0 THEN ISNULL(xt.DueAmount, 0) ELSE ISNULL(xt.AmountBeforeTax, 0) END  			+ ISNULL(xt.Amount,0) AS numeric(18, 2)) AS PrepayTotalAmount, 		CtUtHtt.OriginalAmount, CtUtHtt.Amount, 		PrepayOriginalAmount, PrepayAmount, DebitAccount7, CreditAccount7, OriginalAmount7, Amount7, 		Ct.ExchangeRate, Ct.CurrencyCode AS CurrencyCode, CtUtHtt.Account, 		CtUtHtt.IsActive, CtUtHtt.CreatedBy, CtUtHtt.CreatedAt,  		CtUtHtt.ModifiedBy, CtUtHtt.ModifiedAt, CtUtHtt.timestamp FROM B30AccDocApplyPrepayment AS CtUtHtt 	INNER JOIN B30AccDoc AS Ct ON CtUtHtt.Stt = Ct.Stt AND Ct.DocCode = 'XT' 	LEFT OUTER JOIN B30AccDocAtchDoc AS xt ON CtUtHtt.Stt_Ct_Ut = xt.RowId 	LEFT OUTER JOIN B30AccDocAtchEntry AS E7 ON E7.RowId_SourceDoc = xt.RowId 	LEFT OUTER JOIN B30AccDoc AS Ct_DiKem ON Ct_DiKem.Stt = xt.Stt 	LEFT OUTER JOIN B20Currency AS DmTte ON Ct_DiKem.CurrencyCode = DmTte.Code

ISNULL(CtHtt.OriginalPaymentAmount, 0) + Paybill.OriginalAmount <> 0 					THEN (CdHtt.DueAmount - ISNULL(CtHtt.PaymentAmount, 0) + Paybill.OriginalAmount)/(CdHtt.DueOriginalAmount - ISNULL(CtHtt.OriginalPaymentAmount, 0) + Paybill.OriginalAmount) 				WHEN ISNULL(DmTte.ExchangeRateOperator, 1) = 0 AND (CdHtt.DueAmount - ISNULL(CtHtt.PaymentAmount, 0) + Paybill.OriginalAmount) <> 0 					THEN (CdHtt.DueOriginalAmount - ISNULL(CtHtt.OriginalPaymentAmount, 0) + Paybill.OriginalAmount) / (CdHtt.DueAmount - ISNULL(CtHtt.PaymentAmount, 0) + Paybill.OriginalAmount) 				ELSE CdHtt.ExchangeRate END AS DueExchangeRate 			,CdHtt.TotalOriginalAmount 			,CdHtt.TotalAmount 			,CAST(CdHtt.DueOriginalAmount - CtHtt.OriginalPaymentAmount + Paybill.OriginalAmount AS numeric(18,2)) AS DueOriginalAmount 			,CAST(CdHtt.DueAmount - CtHtt.PaymentAmount + Paybill.Amount AS numeric(18,2)) AS DueAmount 			,CAST(CdHtt.TotalOriginalAmount - CdHtt.TotalOriginalAmount + CtHtt.OriginalPaymentAmount - Paybill.OriginalAmount AS numeric(18,2)) AS TotalOriginalPaymentAmount 			,CAST(CdHtt.TotalAmount - CdHtt.DueAmount + CtHtt.PaymentAmount - Paybill.Amount AS numeric(18,2)) AS TotalPaymentAmount 			,dmtte.DecimalRound, DmTte.ExchangeRateOperator, Ct.CurrencyCode 		FROM dbo.B30AccDocPaybill AS Paybill LEFT OUTER JOIN 			dbo.vB30CdHtt AS CdHtt ON CdHtt.Stt_Cd_Htt = Paybill.Stt_Cd_Htt 			OUTER APPLY 			( 				SELECT Stt_Cd_Htt, SUM(OriginalAmount) AS OriginalPaymentAmount,  					SUM(Amount) AS PaymentAmount 				FROM dbo.vB30CtHtt CtHtt 				WHERE CdHtt.Stt_Cd_Htt = CtHtt.Stt_Cd_Htt 				GROUP BY Stt_Cd_Htt 			) AS CtHtt LEFT OUTER JOIN 			dbo.B20Currency AS DmTte ON DmTte.Code = CdHtt.CurrencyCode INNER JOIN  			dbo.B30AccDoc ct ON Paybill.Stt = ct.Stt

-- 02/04/2014 CuongNc thêm các trường CreatedBy, ModifiedBy, CreatedAt, ModifiedAt, timestamp CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vB30AssetDoc_DisposalDetail] AS WITH CtTs AS ( 	SELECT ctts.Id, ctts.AssetCode, EquityCode, DocDate, DocGroup,  		ctts.DeprDebitAccount, ctts.DeprCreditAccount,  		ctts.DeptCode, ctts.DeprDeptCode, ctts.ExpenseCatgCode, ctts.ProductCostId, ctts.EmployeeCode, 		ctts.AssetTransType, ctts.AssetTransCode, ctts.Quantity, ctts.IsDeprAdjusted,  		ctts.DeprAmountBeginOfYear, ctts.DeprAllocationRate, ctts.DocNo, ctts.Description, CtTs.UsefulMonth, 		DmTgTs.Name AS TransName, ctts.IsActive, ctts.CreatedBy, ctts.CreatedAt, ctts.ModifiedBy, ctts.ModifiedAt, 		ctts.ParentId AS ParentId, ctts.IsGroup 	FROM dbo.B30AssetDoc ctts LEFT OUTER JOIN	 		dbo.B20AssetTrans AS DmTgTs ON CtTs.AssetTransCode = DmTgTs.Code  	WHERE AssetTransType = N'GIAMTAISAN' AND ctts.IsActive = 1 ) SELECT DmTs.BranchCode, CtTs.DocDate, CtTs.DocGroup, CtTs.AssetCode, TgTs.EquityCode,  		CASE WHEN TgTs.DocGroup <> '2' THEN TgTs.OriginalCost ELSE -TgTs.OriginalCost END AS OriginalCost,  		CASE WHEN TgTs.DocGroup <> '2' THEN TgTs.Depreciation ELSE -TgTs.Depreciation END AS Depreciation,  		TgTs.OriginalCost - TgTs.Depreciation AS NetBookValue , TgTs.AmountForDepr AS AmountForDepr,  		CASE WHEN TgTs.DocGroup <> '2' THEN TgTs.Quantity ELSE 0 END AS IncQuantity,  		CASE WHEN TgTs.DocGroup = '2' THEN TgTs.Quantity ELSE 0 END AS DeQuantity,  		CASE WHEN TgTs.DocGroup <> '2' THEN TgTs.OriginalCost ELSE 0 END AS IncOriginalCost,  		CASE WHEN TgTs.DocGroup = '2' THEN TgTs.OriginalCost ELSE 0 END AS DeOriginalCost,  		CASE WHEN TgTs.DocGroup <> '2' THEN TgTs.Depreciation ELSE 0 END AS IncDepreciation,  		CASE WHEN TgTs.DocGroup = '2' THEN TgTs.Depreciation ELSE 0 END AS DeDepreciation,  		CASE WHEN TgTs.DocGroup <> '2' THEN TgTs.AmountForDepr ELSE 0 END AS IncAmountForDepr,  		CASE WHEN TgTs.DocGroup = '2' THEN TgTs.AmountForDepr ELSE 0 END AS DeAmountForDepr,  		CtTs.DeprDebitAccount, CtTs.DeprCreditAccount, CtTs.DeptCode, CtTs.DeprDeptCode,  		CtTs.ExpenseCatgCode, CtTs.ProductCostId, ctts.EmployeeCode, 		CtTs.AssetTransType, CtTs.AssetTransCode, CtTs.Quantity AS Quantity, DmBp.Name AS DeptName, DmNv.Name AS EquityName, DmKm.Name AS ExpenseCatgName,  		CtTs.IsDeprAdjusted, CtTs.DeprAmountBeginOfYear, CtTs.DeprAllocationRate, CtTs.DocNo, CtTs.Description, CtTs.UsefulMonth, 		CtTs.TransName, DmTs.Name AS AssetName,  		CASE WHEN CtTs.DocGroup = '1' THEN 1 ELSE - 1 END AS Trans,  		DmTs.CardNo, DmTs.FirstDeprDate, DmTs.FirstUsedDate, DmTs.AssetAccount,  		DmTs.Unit, DmTs.AssetFuncCode, CtTs.IsActive, CtTs.Id, CtTs.CreatedBy, CtTs.CreatedAt, CtTs.ModifiedBy, CtTs.ModifiedAt,  		dmts.IsActive AS IsActiveAsset,CtTs.ParentId, CtTs.IsGroup FROM CtTs LEFT OUTER JOIN       dbo.B20Equity AS DmNv ON CtTs.EquityCode = DmNv.Code LEFT OUTER JOIN       dbo.B20Dept AS DmBp ON CtTs.DeptCode = DmBp.Code LEFT OUTER JOIN       dbo.B20ExpenseCatg AS DmKm ON CtTs.ExpenseCatgCode = DmKm.Code LEFT OUTER JOIN       dbo.B20Asset AS DmTs ON CtTs.AssetCode = DmTs.Code AND dmts.IsActive = 1 LEFT OUTER JOIN       dbo.B30AssetDoc TgTs ON TgTs.IsActive = 1 AND CtTs.AssetCode = TgTs.AssetCode AND TgTs.AssetTransType <> N'GIAMTAISAN'

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vB30BizDoc] AS WITH FobPoint (Code, Name) AS (SELECT Code, Name 	FROM B20Class 	WHERE ParentCode = 'FOB_POINT' ), PaymentTerms (Code, Name) AS (SELECT Code, Name 	FROM B20Class 	WHERE ParentCode = 'PAYMENT_TERMS' ), FreightTerms (Code, Name) AS (SELECT Code, Name 	FROM B20Class 	WHERE ParentCode = 'FREIGHT_TERMS' ), ShipVia (Code, Name) AS (SELECT Code, Name 	FROM B20Class 	WHERE ParentCode = 'SHIP_VIA' ) SELECT BizDoc.Id, BizDoc.ParentId, BizDoc.IsGroup, BizDoc.BranchCode, BizDoc.BizDocId, BizDoc.DocCode,  		BizDoc.DocNo, BizDoc.DocDate, BizDoc.CurrencyCode, BizDoc.ContactCode, BizDoc.ContactPerson, 		BizDoc.ExchangeRate, BizDoc.CustomerCode, BizDoc.EmployeeCode, BizDoc.Address, BizDoc.Description, BizDoc.TransCode, 		CAST(RTRIM(BizDoc.DocNo) + N' - ' + BizDoc.Description AS nvarchar(84)) AS DocInfo, BizDoc.DeptCode, -- 8/4/2015: CuongNc thêm 		BizDoc.PaymentTermsCode, PT.Name AS PaymentTerms, BizDoc.TerritoryCode, 		BizDoc.ShipViaCode, ShipVia.Name AS ShipVia, BizDoc.PortOfLoading,  		BizDoc.FobPointCode, FobPoint.Name AS Fob, BizDoc.FreightTermsCode, FT.Name AS FreightTermsName, 		DmCbNv.Name AS EmployeeName, DmDt.Name AS CustomerName,  		CAST(ddhct.Amount AS Numeric(18, 2)) AS Amount,  		CAST(ddhct.OriginalAmount AS Numeric(18, 2)) AS OriginalAmount,  		CAST(ddhct.Amount3 AS Numeric(18, 2)) AS Amount3,  		CAST(ddhct.OriginalAmount3 AS Numeric(18, 2)) AS OriginalAmount3,  		CAST(ddhct.OriginalAmount + ddhct.OriginalAmount3 AS Numeric(18, 2)) AS TotalOriginalAmount,  		CAST(ddhct.Amount + ddhct.Amount3 AS Numeric(18, 2)) AS TotalAmount,  		ddhct.ProductDesignNo, ddhct.PartNo, ddhct.SerialNo1, ddhct.SerialNo2, 		BizDoc.FinishedDate, BizDoc.HandoverDate, 		BizDoc.DueDate, BizDoc.DocStatus, Doc.Lock, Doc.Post_SoCai, Doc.Post_TheKho, Doc.IsCancelled, 		BizDoc.IsActive, BizDoc.CreatedBy, BizDoc.CreatedAt, BizDoc.ModifiedBy, BizDoc.ModifiedAt, BizDoc.timestamp, 		DmCt.Ma_Nvu, DmCt.Nh_Ct, DmCt.Ct_Hd, 		(CASE WHEN BizDoc.DueDate <> 0 THEN DATEADD(DAY, BizDoc.DueDate - 1, BizDoc.DocDate)  			ELSE CAST(NULL AS SmallDatetime) END) AS DateDue, 		BizDoc.LoanAmount, BizDoc.LoanOriginalAmount, 		BizDoc.BizDocId_C1, BizDoc.BizDocId_LC, BizDoc.LoanContractType, BizDoc.IsSingleRowInDetail, 		BizDoc.ParentBizDocId, BizDoc.Closed FROM dbo.B30BizDoc AS BizDoc LEFT OUTER JOIN 	dbo.B20Employee AS DmCbNv ON BizDoc.EmployeeCode = DmCbNv.Code LEFT OUTER JOIN 	dbo.B20Customer AS DmDt ON BizDoc.CustomerCode = DmDt.Code 	OUTER APPLY 	( 	  SELECT BizDocId, SUM(Amount) AS Amount, SUM(OriginalAmount) AS OriginalAmount,  			SUM(Amount3) AS Amount3, SUM(OriginalAmount3) AS OriginalAmount3, 			MAX(ProductDesignNo) AS ProductDesignNo, MAX(PartNo) AS PartNo,  			MAX(SerialNo1) AS SerialNo1, MAX(SerialNo2) AS SerialNo2 		FROM dbo.B30BizDocDetail 		WHERE BizDocId = BizDoc.BizDocId 		GROUP BY BizDocId 	) AS DdhCt 	LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.B00DocStatus AS Doc ON BizDoc.DocStatus = Doc.DocStatusKey  	LEFT OUTER JOIN DBO.B00DmCt AS DmCt ON BizDoc.DocCode = DmCt.Ma_Ct 	LEFT OUTER JOIN FobPoint ON BizDoc.FobPointCode = FobPoint.Code 	LEFT OUTER JOIN PaymentTerms AS PT ON BizDoc.PaymentTermsCode = PT.Code 	LEFT OUTER JOIN ShipVia ON BizDoc.ShipViaCode = ShipVia.Code 	LEFT OUTER JOIN FreightTerms FT ON BizDoc.FreightTermsCode = FT.Code WHERE BizDoc.IsActive = 1;

CREATE VIEW dbo.vB30BizDocReturnDetail_Edit AS SELECT a.Id, CAST(0 AS bit) AS IsGroup, CAST(- 1 AS int) AS ParentId, a.BizDocId,  	--a.BuiltinOrder,  	ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.BizDocId ORDER BY a.Id) AS BuiltinOrder, 	a.ItemCode, a.Unit, a.ProductDesignNo, a.ProductSize, a.DocDate,  	a.RequestDate, a.RowId, a.CustomerCode, a.ParentRowId, 	a.Description, 	CASE WHEN a.Description <> '' THEN a.Description ELSE dm.Name END AS Description0, 	a.PartNo, a.SerialNo1, a.SerialNo2,  	a.Quantity, a.Quantity9, a.ConvertRate9, a.EquivalentQuantity, 	a.UnitCost, a.OriginalUnitCost, a.OriginalAmount, a.Amount, a.OriginalAmount3, a.Amount3,  	CASE WHEN ISNULL(Tax.PriceIncludeTax,0) = 1 THEN (a.OriginalAmount + a.OriginalAmount3 + a.OriginalDiscountAmount)  		ELSE a.OriginalAmount + a.OriginalDiscountAmount END AS OriginalAmount9, 	CASE WHEN ISNULL(Tax.PriceIncludeTax,0) = 1 THEN (a.Amount + a.Amount3 + a.DiscountAmount)  		ELSE a.Amount + a.DiscountAmount END AS Amount9, 	dm.Name AS Name_Item, dm.Unit AS Unit_Item,  	dm.Unit0, dm.ConvertRate0, dm.Unit1, dm.ConvertRate1,  	dm.Unit2, dm.ConvertRate2, a.EstimatedTimeDelivery, 	a.TaxCode, Tax.Rate AS TaxRate, Tax.Type AS TaxType, Tax.PriceIncludeTax, 	a.EstimatedCompletionDesign, a.EstimatedConfirmDesign, a.EstimatedQuotationDate, 	a.Remark, doc.DocCode, a.IsGiftItem,  	a.RowId_Price, a.OriginalUnitCost AS UnitPrice_price, 	a.DiscountAmount, a.OriginalDiscountAmount,  	CAST(N'' AS NVARCHAR(64)) AS _TempCol, CAST(0 AS INT) AS IsConverted, 	a.IsActive, a.CreatedBy, a.CreatedAt, a.ModifiedBy, a.ModifiedAt, a.timestamp, 	a.DiffQuantity, a.RevertQuantity, a.InfactDate, a.ItemLotCode, dmdt.Code0, 	a.BizDocId_PO, a.InfactQuantity FROM dbo.B30BizDocReturnDetail AS a LEFT OUTER JOIN 	dbo.B20Item AS dm ON a.ItemCode = dm.Code LEFT OUTER JOIN 	dbo.B30BizDocReturn AS doc ON a.BizDocId = doc.BizDocId LEFT OUTER JOIN 	dbo.B20Tax AS Tax ON a.TaxCode = Tax.Code LEFT OUTER JOIN 	dbo.B20Customer dmdt ON dmdt.Code = a.CustomerCode

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vB30CdHtt_Lookup] AS SELECT Htt1.BranchCode, Htt1.DocCode, Htt1.DocNo AS DueDocNo, 		Htt1.DocDate AS DueDocDate, Htt1.Stt_Cd_Htt,  		Htt1.Description, Htt1.Account, Htt1.CustomerCode, Htt1.EmployeeCode, Htt1.DueDate,  		Htt1.CurrencyCode, 		CASE WHEN ISNULL(Currency.ExchangeRateOperator, 1) = 1 AND Htt1.DueOriginalAmount - ISNULL(Htt2.PaidOriginalAmount, 0) <> 0  			THEN (Htt1.DueAmount - ISNULL(Htt2.PaidAmount, 0))/(Htt1.DueOriginalAmount - ISNULL(Htt2.PaidOriginalAmount, 0))  		WHEN ISNULL(Currency.ExchangeRateOperator, 1) = 0 AND (Htt1.DueAmount - ISNULL(Htt2.PaidAmount, 0)) <> 0  			THEN (Htt1.DueOriginalAmount - ISNULL(Htt2.PaidOriginalAmount, 0))/(Htt1.DueAmount - ISNULL(Htt2.PaidAmount, 0))  		ELSE Htt1.ExchangeRate END AS ExchangeRate, 		Htt1.TotalOriginalAmount, Htt1.TotalAmount, Htt1.DueOriginalAmount, Htt1.DueAmount,  		Htt1.TotalOriginalAmount - Htt1.DueOriginalAmount AS PaidOriginalAmount0, 		Htt1.TotalAmount - Htt1.DueAmount AS PaidAmount0,  		Htt1.TotalOriginalAmount - Htt1.DueOriginalAmount + ISNULL(Htt2.PaidOriginalAmount, 0) AS PaidOriginalAmount,  		Htt1.TotalAmount - Htt1.DueAmount + ISNULL(Htt2.PaidAmount, 0) AS PaidAmount,  		Htt1.DueOriginalAmount - ISNULL(Htt2.PaidOriginalAmount, 0) AS CloseOriginalBalance,  		Htt1.DueAmount - ISNULL(Htt2.PaidAmount, 0) AS CloseBalance,  		CAST(1 AS bit) AS IsActive, CAST(0 AS bit) AS IsGroup, 		ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY Htt1.BranchCode, Htt1.CustomerCode, Htt1.DocNo) Id, CAST(-1 AS Int) AS ParentId,  		CAST(Htt1.DocNo + ' - ' + Htt1.Description AS nvarchar(192)) AS CdHttInfo , 		CAST(YEAR(Htt1.DocDate) AS nchar(4)) + '/' + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(Htt1.DocDate), 2), ' ', '0') AS Thang_Nam FROM dbo.vB30CdHtt AS Htt1 LEFT OUTER JOIN 	(SELECT BranchCode, Stt_Cd_Htt, Account, CustomerCode, 			SUM(OriginalAmount) AS PaidOriginalAmount, SUM(Amount) AS PaidAmount 		FROM dbo.vB30CtHtt 		GROUP BY BranchCode, Stt_Cd_Htt, Account, CustomerCode) AS Htt2  	ON Htt1.BranchCode = Htt2.BranchCode AND Htt1.Stt_Cd_Htt = Htt2.Stt_Cd_Htt  		AND Htt1.Account = Htt2.Account AND Htt1.CustomerCode = Htt2.CustomerCode 	LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.B20Currency AS Currency ON Currency.Code = Htt1.CurrencyCode

CREATE VIEW dbo.vFVN_PXLB_ProcessReport AS SELECT     p.Id AS PhieuXuLyBatThuongId,     p.SoPhieu,     p.Model,     p.MaSanPham,     p.Status,     p.HuongXuLy,     initialQc.SoLuongAnhHuong,     initialQc.SoLuongOK AS InitialOK,     initialQc.SoLuongNG AS InitialNG,     initialQc.SoLuongRework,     initialQc.SoLuongLoaiBoBanDau,     ISNULL(xuat.ReworkDaXuat, 0) AS ReworkDaXuat,     ISNULL(giao.ReworkDaGiao, 0) AS ReworkDaGiao,     reworkQc.SoLuongOK AS ReworkOK,     reworkQc.SoLuongNG AS ReworkNG,     ISNULL(initialQc.SoLuongLoaiBoBanDau, 0) + ISNULL(nhapNg.TongNGNhapLai, 0) AS SoLuongLoaiBoCuoi,     comp.SoLuongYeuCau AS CompensationRequired,     comp.SoLuongDaGiao AS CompensationDelivered,     CASE WHEN comp.Id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE comp.SoLuongYeuCau - comp.SoLuongDaGiao END AS CompensationRemaining FROM dbo.FVN_PhieuXuLyBatThuong p LEFT JOIN dbo.FVN_PhieuXuLyBatThuongQCInitial initialQc     ON initialQc.PhieuXuLyBatThuongId = p.Id OUTER APPLY (     SELECT SUM(x.SoLuongXuat) AS ReworkDaXuat     FROM dbo.FVN_TraHangQTChungXuat x     WHERE x.PhieuXuLyBatThuongId = p.Id ) xuat OUTER APPLY (     SELECT SUM(g.SoLuongGiao) AS ReworkDaGiao     FROM dbo.FVN_TraHangQTChungGiao g     WHERE g.PhieuXuLyBatThuongId = p.Id ) giao OUTER APPLY (     SELECT TOP (1) q.SoLuongDaRework, q.SoLuongOK, q.SoLuongNG     FROM dbo.FVN_TraHangQTChungQC q     WHERE q.PhieuXuLyBatThuongId = p.Id     ORDER BY q.ThoiGian DESC, q.Id DESC ) reworkQc OUTER APPLY (     SELECT SUM(n.SoLuongNG) AS TongNGNhapLai     FROM dbo.FVN_TraHangQTChungNhapNG n     WHERE n.PhieuXuLyBatThuongId = p.Id ) nhapNg LEFT JOIN dbo.FVN_PXLB_Compensation comp     ON comp.PhieuXuLyBatThuongId = p.Id;

-- dbo.vNhapTP: danh sách thành phẩm chờ nhập kho (màn hình NhapKho). -- KET_THUC_LOT tính từ SATUS. Lot đã khóa (SATUS = 1) vẫn hiện trong view để tầng C# so sánh -- SLSX mới (MES) với SLSX đã lưu và cho phép "Mở lại Lot" (DongBoSLSXVaMoLaiNeuThayDoi). -- SLSX_DA_LUU = STOCKTP.SLSX (sản lượng SX đã lưu lúc kho nhập). Lot đã khóa mà SL_DA_SAN_XUAT (MES) -- khác SLSX_DA_LUU nghĩa là kế hoạch SX đã đổi -> có thể mở lại. Cột này nằm CUỐI danh sách cột. CREATE   VIEW [dbo].[vNhapTP] AS SELECT      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY NGAY_SAN_XUAT DESC) AS STT,      (LOT_NO + LY_DO_TRA) AS FIND,      * FROM (     -- ===== NHÁNH 1: phiếu SX chờ nhập =====     SELECT          RTRIM(tt.ItemLot) AS LOT_NO,          COALESCE(NULLIF(RTRIM(tt.Model), ''), NULLIF(RTRIM(s.Model), ''), '') AS Model,         tt.Name AS TEN_SAN_PHAM,          tt.ReceiptItemCode AS MA_SAN_PHAM,          RTRIM(tt.ShiftCode) AS CA_SAN_XUAT,          tt.DocDate AS NGAY_SAN_XUAT,          tt.Qty AS SL_DA_SAN_XUAT,          s.ngaynhap AS NGAY_NHAP,          ISNULL(s.slnhap, 0) AS SL_DA_NHAP,          '' AS SL_DA_TRA,          '' AS LY_DO_TRA,          s.slconlai AS TON_KHO_TP,          '' AS SL_SE_NHAP,          CASE WHEN ISNULL(s.Satus, 0) = 1 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS KET_THUC_LOT,         ISNULL(s.SLSX, 0) AS SLSX_DA_LUU     FROM (         SELECT              t.ItemLot, t.DocDate, t.ShiftCode, t.Model,              t.ReceiptItemCode, t.Name, SUM(t.QuantityT) AS Qty         FROM (             SELECT                  SUBSTRING(SX.ItemLotCodeTP,0,21) AS ItemLot,                  SX.DocDate, SX.ShiftCode,                  -- Model từ danh mục hàng (vB20Item), dự phòng SX.Model                 COALESCE(NULLIF(RTRIM(K.Model), ''),                           MAX(NULLIF(RTRIM(SX.Model), ''))) AS Model,                 SX.ItemLotCodeTP, SX.ReceiptItemCode, K.Name,                  CAST(SUM(SX.ReceiptQuantity) AS INT) AS QuantityT             FROM                  dbo.B30AccDoc AS SX                 INNER JOIN dbo.vB20Item AS K ON SX.ReceiptItemCode = K.Code             WHERE                  SX.ItemLotCodeTP <> ''                  AND SX.IsActive <> 0                  AND SX.ReceiptQuantity > 0             GROUP BY                  SX.DocDate, SX.ShiftCode, SX.ItemLotCodeTP,                 SX.ReceiptItemCode, K.Name, K.Model, K.Id, SX.MachinesCode, SX.GearCode         ) AS T         GROUP BY t.ItemLot, t.DocDate, t.ShiftCode, t.Model, t.ReceiptItemCode, t.Name     ) AS TT     LEFT JOIN dbo.Stocktp AS S ON tt.ItemLot = s.LOT     WHERE          (ISNULL(s.slnhap, 0) = 0 OR ISNULL(s.slnhap, 0) <> tt.Qty)          UNION ALL          -- ===== NHÁNH 2: hàng trả về =====     SELECT          RTRIM(D.Lot) AS ItemLot,          COALESCE(NULLIF(RTRIM(I.Model), ''), NULLIF(RTRIM(D.Model), ''), '') AS Model,         RTRIM(D.Name),          RTRIM(D.part) AS ReceiptItem, RTRIM(D.casx) AS ShiftCode,          RTRIM(D.ngaysx) AS Docdate, D.SLSX AS Qty,          D.ngaynhap, D.slnhap, E.slconlai, RTRIM(E.ly_do_ng),          D.slconlai, '' AS SL_SE_NHAP,          CASE WHEN ISNULL(D.Satus, 0) = 1 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS KET_THUC_LOT,         ISNULL(D.SLSX, 0) AS SLSX_DA_LUU     FROM          Stocktp AS D         INNER JOIN (             SELECT lot AS lottra, SUM(slconlai) AS slconlai, ly_do_ng             FROM dbo.stocktptrahang             WHERE status <> 1 AND slconlai > 0             GROUP BY lot, ly_do_ng         ) AS E ON D.lot = E.lottra         LEFT JOIN dbo.vB20Item AS I ON I.Code = D.part          UNION ALL          -- ===== NHÁNH 3: tồn kho TP của mã không còn SX =====     SELECT          RTRIM(K.Lot) AS ItemLot,          COALESCE(NULLIF(RTRIM(I.Model), ''), NULLIF(RTRIM(K.Model), ''), '') AS Model,         RTRIM(K.Name),          RTRIM(K.part) AS ReceiptItem, RTRIM(K.casx) AS ShiftCode,          RTRIM(K.ngaysx) AS Docdate, K.SLSX AS Qty,          K.ngaynhap, K.slnhap, SUM(T.sltra) AS SL_DATRA,          '' AS ly_do_ng, K.slconlai, '' AS SL_SE_NHAP,          CASE WHEN ISNULL(K.SATUS, 0) = 1 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS KET_THUC_LOT,         ISNULL(K.SLSX, 0) AS SLSX_DA_LUU     FROM          STOCKTP AS K         LEFT JOIN STOCKTPTRAHANG AS T ON K.LOT = T.LOT         LEFT JOIN dbo.vB20Item AS I ON I.Code = K.part     WHERE          K.SLCONLAI > 0          AND K.PART IN (             SELECT ReceiptItemCode FROM B30AccDoc             WHERE IsActive = 0                AND ReceiptItemCode NOT IN (                   SELECT ReceiptItemCode FROM B30AccDoc WHERE IsActive = 1               )         )     GROUP BY          K.Lot, K.Model, I.Model, K.Name, K.part, K.casx, K.ngaysx,         K.SLSX, K.ngaynhap, K.slnhap, K.slconlai, K.SATUS ) AS TTK
